articleTitle: Application of Fiber Grating in Power Equipment Temperature Alarm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In view of the power equipment temperature excessive to lead the electric power accident, takes the fiber Bragg grating as the transmission and sensing media of the signal, through fitting curve of the actual temperature, use the fiber Fabry-Perot (F-P) filter demodulate the Bragg wavelength of the fiber grating, chooses higher reliability light emitter diode as the photosource, through the single chip microcomputer and the double CPU of the DSP realizes data processing and control, has realized the power equipment temperature alarm system. This system has the strong anti-interference ability, the high reliability, the simple mounting, the convenient maintenance, the remote transmitting signal and so on the characteristic, is suitable with long-distance temperature monitoring and alarm of the power equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis of directionality for Pulsed Magnetic Field Measurement Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The basic principle of magnetic field measurement based on the Faraday magneto-optic effect is introduced in this paper. To solve the problem of the sensor directionality the three-dimension measurement scheme is proposed. The simulation and the experiments verify the feasibility of this proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Profibus Intelligent Bridge Based on A Heterogeneous Multiprocessor System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, traditional design of profibus node is based on single processor architecture. To enhance node performance and process more external events, a kind of profibus bridge node with asymmetric architecture design is introduced in this paper, which consists of two heterogeneous multiprocessors and two kinds of communication mode, i.e. profibus and Ethernet ways. The design is primarily based on function modules. Implementation of data flow control and optimized external events are also proposed. In addition, it Compares and analyzes this architecture with communication modes of multiprocessors.

articleTitle: Using Polynomial Phase Signal Modeling against Range False Targets
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel approach of extracting a true target component from radar superposing echoes on the premise of that a repeater jammer is detected, when radar is suffered from range false targets jamming, is presented based on multicomponent polynomial phase signals (mc-PPS's) modeling. For linear frequency modulation (LFM) waveform, the differences of the echoes' polynomial phase coefficients between a true target and a false target are analyzed first. Parameter estimation of the true target by using product high-order ambiguity function (PHAF) is described. After the desired parameters be estimated, the true target signal can be reconstructed. Validity of the method is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: A 500MSPS 8-bit ADC Card based on Time-interleaving Technique
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Time interleaving technique is a significant trend in performance enhancement for high-speed ADC systems. This paper presents an ADC card based on time-interleaving technique. The system uses two 8-bit ADCs in parallel. Each ADC can sample at 250 MHz and the total sampling speed will theoretically becomes 500 MSPS. In an approach to increase the system's performance, a calibration algorithm is developed to suppress spurs due to channel mismatches. This paper is also concerning hardware design features that give the system good performance and practicality. A VGA amplifier provides the system with programmable full scale range adjustment. Up to 1 Gbit data buffering solution is applied using a high bandwidth, low cost DDR-SDRAM. And the utility of FPGA, in which LVDS receiver, DDR-SDRAM controller and PCI controller are implemented, simplifies the circuit and brings down power consumption as well as the cost.

articleTitle: Design of Radiator Thermal Characteristics Measurement and Control System Based on Virtual Instruments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Combined with the water-cooled radiator thermal characteristics experiment system, the computer measurement and control system is designed, which is based on virtual instruments technology. The structure of the system and realization of software and hardware is given. To satisfy the control requirement, the control strategies of hot-water temperature in heating system and the air temperature in cooling system are designed and analyzed. The control system for heating system combines fuzzy control with feedforward control and cascade control to satisfy the different testing work conditions and higher stability requirements. On basis of traditional cascade control system, a new robust cascade control system for cooling system is designed. Finally, some test experiments are done to show the validity of the computer measurement and control system.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Pyrolysis of Cornstalk of a Thermoelectric Station
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: By utilizing the method of thermo-gravimetric analysis, the paper researches the pyrolysis characteristics and dynamics of cornstalk, which is the main fuel of a Hebei thermoelectric station. The samples were heated by 10, 20, 40 degC/min in the high pure N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> which was used as reacting and protecting gas, until heated at about 750degC. The results show that: the agravic process of the sample is made up of three stages which include the deprivation, dramatic weightlessness and slow weightlessness. With the rise of heating rate, the maximum decompose rate and its corresponding temperatures increases and the volatilization of the sample releases faster. The pyrolysis reaction dynamics equation of cornstalk is established, and obtained the parameters of cornstalk's pyrolysis reaction dynamics, and discussed its pyrolysis mechanism.

articleTitle: Double Resonances of Coupled RLC Circuit and Spring System with Internal Resonance Considering Inductance Nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to study the nonlinear vibration of coupled RLC circuit and spring system, a mathematical model of coupled RLC circuit and spring system considering inductance nonlinearity and harmonic excitation is established combined with Lagrange-Maxwell equation. Based on multiple scales method for nonlinear vibration analysis, the first approximation solutions and corresponding to steady state solutions of the doubled resonances system are obtained. Numerical analysis results show that two coupled modals are all excited and vibrated when the system meets for double resonance condition. Energy is transformed between two modals. Amplitudes of two modals change with the parameters of the system and peak value of response curves change with the detuning parameter. It has also been found nonlinear resistance can control vibrations of the system when the parameters and resonant conditions are equal.

articleTitle: A Research on the Knowledge-based Structure Model of Weapon Management System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Any weapon-management institutions in charge of weapon research and acquisition should definitely take the initiative to build up a dynamic operating organization, adjusting the present weapon-management system in units and component parts, so that a better use of resources, an instant reaction to the fast changing acquisition sources, a mutual help and a better communication between the institutions in the same field as well as a greater profit can be achieved. The potential relation between knowledge and institutions is analyzed and a knowledge-based three-dimensional structure model is established in this paper, which provides a new perspective when choosing an appropriate management pattern of weapon items.

articleTitle: EMI Measurement Design for Linear Traction Motor and Experimental Results Analyses
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Electromagnetic environment in the underground has a fatal impact on the reliability and safety of signalling equipments. This paper introduces the ideal differential-mode and common-mode model of Linear Induction Motor (LIM) used in urban rail transit system, and points out the potential EMI problem. For the designed laboratory model, the authors designed the EMI measurement scheme referring to the rotary induction motor regulations. Then the common-mode disturbances and radiation emission experimental results are presented and analyzed. The experimental curves demonstrate that these disturbances are mostly generated by the Pulse Width Modulated (PWM) inverter and the values can be met with CLASS-A standard. The experimental results indicate that the performance of the model of Linear Traction Motor is favorable.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Equipment Procurement Organizational Structure Based on Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the innovation of equipment procurement organizational structure, it is important to evaluate the innovation of equipment procurement organizational system objectively. In this paper, we apply entropy theory in the evaluation model and the concept of entropy is described firstly. Then the effective entropy and the quality entropy are applied in optimizing equipment procurement organizational structure. Finally, we use the evaluation model based on entropy theory to calculation the order degree of a certain equipment procurement organizational structure and evaluate the innovation efficiency of the equipment procurement organizational structure. The results prove that it is applicable and available to use entropy theory in evaluation of equipment procurement organizational structure.

articleTitle: Overall Scheme Desigh of One Kind Synthesis Control System By Meta-Synthesis MDO
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A creative idea is proposed for improving the overall scheme optimization design tank fire control system (TFCS). TFCS is decomposed into three subsystems from the perspective of discipline in this paper. Multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) and meta-synthesis methodologies are combined to optimize the overall scheme design. Accurate mathematical model and inaccurate knowledge model are integrated to achieve coordination and interaction in the subsystem optimization and system level optimization.

articleTitle: SAR Processing System Based on Plug-Ins Architecture
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A system of SAR processing and evaluation based on Photoshop plug-in architecture is proposed in this paper. In this system, all major SAR processing and evaluation functions are integrated into Photoshop. The key technologies of development of plug-ins, including memory management, calling sequence, and so on, are described in details by an example of image quality evaluation filter. This method reduces the complexity and workload of programming on memory management and user interface design, and improve the robust of the system.

articleTitle: Inverse Problem of Multiple Conductors Buried in a Half-Space
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Electromagnetic imaging of buried multiple conductors by using genetic algorithm has been presented. Two separate perfectly conducting cylinders of unknown shapes are immersed in one half-space and illuminated by transverse magnetic (TM) polarization plane wave from the other half-space. Based on the boundary condition and the measured scattered field, we have derived a set of nonlinear integral equations, and the imaging problem is reformulated into an optimization problem. For describing the shapes of conductors, the Fourier series is selected to expanding the shape functions. In inverse algorithms, the improved steady state genetic algorithm is employed to search for the global extreme solution of objective function. Numerical results have demonstrated that the powerful performance of the inverse algorithm. The reconstructed shapes are considerably accurate even when the initial guesses are far away from the exact ones and the buried depths of the conductors are large compared to wavelength.

articleTitle: A New Method of Measuring WDV Based on Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Chaos theory will have a great development in measurement. But now Chaos measurement equipment's sensitive components are all capacitors which measurement precision is not satisfactory, especially in the measuring WDV (Weak Direct Voltage). To solve this problem, this paper successfully brings forward a new method from another way. This new method is also based on chaos theory; however, its measurement equipment's sensitive components are not capacitors but inductors. This new method not only has a valid measurement for WDV but also has a very good accuracy and linearity. From another way, we make a new great progress.

articleTitle: Differential Power Analysis for Cryptographic ICs
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the concrete circuit of embedded system which was realized by AT89C52 microchips and encrypted with DES, the paper introduces the design and implementation of differential power analysis (DPA) attack which is one of the typical and powerful ways of side channel attacks (SCA). This paper explains the relations among the power consumption characters and data-dependent power consumption of CMOS logic gates which function the integrated circuits (ICs). With 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> plaintexts and power consumption samples, 48-bit key of the round 16 of DES was detected successfully. Then the rest 8 in 56-bit effective key of DES was detected easily by exhaustive attack. The result indicates that DES encrypted systems without special protective measures are not strong enough to survive from the attacks of DPA, because of the leakage of the emission of physical signals and the difference of power consumption while processing the different data in ICs.

articleTitle: Research of High Precision Frequency Measure Algorithm Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to get the frequency (f) of an intermediate frequency (IF) signal, during the measure of frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar, we often use the fast Fourier transform (FFT) for transforming time signal to discrete frequency signal, then we can get the frequency by the position of the frequency spectrum's peak. While the data was collecting, the collecting circuit does always not synchronize with the signal, what we collect is the truncated discrete signal, When we apply the discrete Fourier transform on this kind of signal, we can only get some discrete value of the continuous spectrum, the peak of the spectrum always has a departure with the envelope of the spectrum by using the not integral period sampling, and this causes the leak error. For improving the precision of the frequency measure, this paper presents a frequency measure algorithm by integrating automatic adjusting the sampling parameter and spectrum correction. By using this algorithm, we first adjust the sampling number based on current frequency for meeting the request of the integral period sampling, afterwards, the spectrum is further corrected by using the balancing of the energy rules, so we can get a more precise measure.

articleTitle: Using Direction of Longest Line Segment for Aerodrome Forward-looking Scene Matching
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As conventional down-looking matching methods can not overcome perspective transmutation of forward-looking imaging, a new method based on computing direction of longest line segment from image pair is advanced for aerodrome forward-looking scene matching. Considering line feature of runway is distinct and not sensitive to perspective transmutation, firstly use Hough idea to extract longest line segment both from reference image and real-time image. Then, compute the angle difference to restore reference image before matching algorithm can be done. Results show that the method can make full use of image information and has a good ability of aerodrome positioning, especially when image pair exists biggish rotation, and it can be a first try for research of forward-looking scene matching.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring System of Ultra-high-frequency PD in Transformer Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An on-line monitoring system of ultra-high-frequency (UHF) PD was investigated for transformers in this paper. Based on envelope detection technique, the measure principle of UHF PD signals was analyzed, and the hardware of this system was developed. The software of this system, consisting of data acquisitionsquare data storagesquare signal display and graph analysis, was constructed using National Instruments' Measurement Studio software. The PD of five discharge models was measured. Experimental results show that this system has wider band width, stronger ability of interference suppression, and higher stability, and can be useful for on-line monitoring of UHF PD in transformers.

articleTitle: Automated Measurement System for Wireless Transmitters
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an automated measurement system for wireless transmitters with different frequencies, modulation types, and bit rates is introduced. Using VISA (virtual instrument software architecture) and COM API (application programming interface), the system can operate the spectrum analyzer, vector signal analyzer (VSA89600), oscilloscope according to the user's requirements. With the help of peripheral circuits and multithreaded programming techniques, the automated measurement system can measure from DC to radio frequency signals; perform spectrum and modulation quality analysis of EUT (equipment under test) automatically; during the measurement process, operating status of EUT can be real time monitored, if the operating status of EUT is abnormal, EUT would be shut down immediately.

articleTitle: Analyzing Encryption Technology Applied in Farm Product E-commerce System Security
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The fast development of Internet stimulated the e-commerce to advance remarkably, but along with the evanescence of Internet myth, the e-commerce also entered a regulatory period. Security problems have become the bottleneck baffled the healthy growth of the e-commerce. Through analyzing the threats the e-commerce faced and the prerequisites to make the e-commerce system security, it is very easy to get such a conclusion that the application of encryption technology has a great influence on the e-commerce system security.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of STM-16 Optical Network Test System Based on VXI
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To test STM-16 optical communication system, a VXI-based SDH protocol analyzer is constructed. VXI bus is a kind of outstanding instrument bus for ATE (auto test equipment). The core module of the SDH analyzer is FPGA, which can be reprogrammable. So it is convenient to add or reduce test function. In this paper, the payload, overhead and point analysis procedures are listed firstly, and then the signal source control and correspondence software are introduced. At last, the design is proved by SignalTap II embedded logic analysis instrument.

articleTitle: Feature Enhanced Synthetic Aperture Radar Image Formation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: We propose a feature enhanced image reconstruction method for spotlight mode synthetic aperture radar. Based on the image processing of Computerized tomography model, this method has increased resolution, reduced side lobes and reduced speckle by incorporating prior information regarding the features of interested scattering fields. Also, by using the extensions of half quadratic regularization methods, this algorithm effectively deals with the complex valued, random phrase nature of the underlying SAR reflectivities.

articleTitle: Application of LED Light Source in NO2 Concentration Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: LED, as a new light source, has high light intensity, low power consumption, long life time, high reliability, and is easy to drive and connect to IC. Now it's taken into application on transportation, advertisement and instrument display. In this paper, the method for its spectrum acquirement has been introduced. And it analyzed its characteristics. The main characteristics that affect its performance are wave length, band width and dominant wavelength. In this paper, LED is applied on NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> intensity measurement with spectral absorption method. The structure of the measurement system and its operating principle is introduced. And this system has the merits of low power consumption and small \capacity. The measuring results are reliable. LED can be used in NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> intensity measurement. And with this method, it's possible to make a portable/ real-time measurement system.

articleTitle: A Mobile Service Algorithm Based on Separabitity in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel mobile service algorithm based on separability in dynamic wireless sensor networks, for achieving the collection of the sensed information in an energy-efficient way and with real-time guarantees. Our algorithm is intrinsically parallel. The main idea is to dissect a service procedure into subproblems, solve the subproblems and then patch the subtours together to form a global tour. Simulation results show that our algorithm is more effective and suitable for dynamic wireless sensor networks. It can reduce the time and energy cost needed for data collection efficiently, although the loss ratio of sensor data increased slightly.

articleTitle: Consistency Testing of IP in Mixed-Signal SoC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the discussion on the consistency description method used for SoC design, the testing method about the operation consistency of IP (Intellectual Property) blocks is addressed in this paper. The method proposed the guidance for designing the test vectors in mixed signal SoC design. With the method, logical description of operation consistency specification can be built in SoC design. This paper indicates that operation consistency design is a key point and will impact both architecture of hardware and software.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Analysis of Distributed Power System Short-circuit Using Wavelet Fractal Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel method based on wavelet network and fractal theory for detecting short-circuit fault is proposed. To increase the signal-noise-ratio of the fault signal, the signal denoising technology using the statistic rule is brought forward to determine the threshold and the decomposition level of each order of wavelet space. On the basis of the inter relationship of wavelet transform and fractal theory, the whole and local fractal exponents obtained as features are presented for extracting fault signals. The effectiveness of the new algorithm used to extract the characteristic signal is described, which can be achieved by different fractal dimensions values of those types of short-circuit fault. In accordance with the threshold value of each type of short-circuit fault in each frequency band, the correlation between the type of short-circuit and the fractal dimensions can be figured to perform extraction. This detection model incorporates the advantages of morphological filter and multi-scale wavelet transform to extract the feature of faults meanwhile restraining various noises. The simulation results demonstrates that the proposed model is verified effectively.

articleTitle: Single-Ended Loop Testing (SELT) - New Architecture
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Nowadays the embedded copper plant is revitalized for digital subscriber lines (DSL), and identification of the loop make-up is vital for determining what types of DSLs may be deployed and what bit rates they may transmit. Single ended loop testing (SELT) is new emerged loop test and qualification technology. It's essential for achieving low-cost deployment of DSL, since it allows loops to be qualified in bulk and does not involve any human intervention at the customer's location. Though there are several approaches and tools can realize SELT, most of them can't incorporate with DSL chipsets. This paper proposes a novel technique, which can be easily incorporate with the DSL chipsets and accurately qualify a telephone lines. This measurement technique is accord with the Gselt functional model which is proposed by ITU. The measurement technique consists of energizing the line with a spread spectrum signal through the line that is reflected back at the discontinuity. Use correlation length measuring principle by calculate the correlation between the reflected signal and the original transmitted signal it is easy to get the knowledge of the loop make-up. Then in addition using a direct measurement of the PSD it can pre-qualify the loop.

articleTitle: Study on the Pulse Synchronization Ultrasonic Treatment Equipment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The design and realization methods of the system of pulse synchronization ultrasonic treatment equipment is introduced in this paper. The core of the pulse synchronization ultrasonic treatment equipment system is SCM and DDS chip AD9833. The scope of the scale frequency is 998 kHz-1002 kHz. Punch advance is 1Hz. The scope of transmitting intensity of ultrasonic sound is 0.13W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The step-size can be regulated with 0.5W continuously.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation Testing Technology of the Bursting Height of Radio Fuze
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Bursting height testing of radio fuze has great importance on its production and its performance improvement. A type of computer simulation testing system of radio fuze bursting height is introduced, based on the model of certain type radio fuze bursting height testing. Automatic data collection subsystem is built in this system, and waveform could be generated and analyzed automatically by inputting parameter. Besides, parameter could be tested automatically, the data could be processed instantly and whether the result is satisfied the requirement could be analyzed automatically. This system is efficient while testing is simple and all of the performance parameters are obtained within one operation. The design principle and technology could be used in the low frequency part testing of other same type radio fuze by changing the mathematics model of Doppler amplitude.

articleTitle: Joint Estimation of Symbol Timing and Frequency Offset for OFDM Systems based on Selective Superimposed Pilots
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel data-aided joint symbol timing and carrier frequency offset estimation method based on selective superimposed pilot for OFDM system is proposed in this paper, where the pilot sequence is superimposed on a data sequence and transmitted together, and thus it has a high spectral efficiency. The selective pilot sequence owns low correlation with data sequence to reduce the interference. By taking advantage of the correlation between pilot sequences themselves, the proposed algorithm can accurately estimate the symbol timing and frequency offset.

articleTitle: Design of Passive Components in Integrated Optic Chip on SOI Applied in Fiber Optic Gyroscope System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The passive components in the integrated optic chip applied by fiber optic gyroscope are analyzed and designed on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) wafers. These components include a polarizer and a multimode interference (MMI) coupler. The MMI coupler acts as the traditional Y-branch power splitter. The polarizer consists of two 3dB MMI couplers and two straight single mode waveguides between these two MMI couplers. These two straight waveguides have equal length but have different rib width. The mode propagation constants of TE or TM light are not same and the appropriate selection of the length of the straight waveguide will result in the splitting of TE and TM light. The scalar or semivectorial finite difference beam propagation method (FD-BPM) is used to design these photonic components. The mode parameters of straight waveguide with different rib width are analyzed by semivectorial FD-BPM and the reasonable length of straight waveguide was selected. The MMI coupler is designed by scalar FD-BPM and the length of multimode waveguide and the positions of the input or output ports are determined accurately. The curving waveguide is avoided completely, therefore the design is more reliable and the fabrication of the device is much easy.

articleTitle: Sensor Networks Based Grassland and Wetland Humidity Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduced the concepts, functions, architecture, and key techniques of sensor networks, and analyzed the significance of the monitoring of the grassland and wetland humidity. In order to prevent the grassland and wetland to deteriorate desert, the monitoring of the zoology environment of the grassland and wetland become the most important issues. This paper presented the method of monitoring the humidity of the inner and surface of the soil of grassland and wetland by using the sensor networks, analyzed the communications and function model of the system. The sensor networks based grassland and wetland humidity monitoring system has more advantageous than the other system.

articleTitle: Automatic Identification of Multi-interface in Crude Oil Tank Based on Self-adaptive Algorithm of Linearity and Recursion
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new self-adaptive algorithm based on the frequency signal of the moving transmitter was proposed and tested by the experiment, which could identify automatically the dynamic multi-interfaces of gas/oil and oil/water in the crude oil tank, and solve three tough problems to affect accurate measurement. The first, the separate process of the crude oil and water is dynamic, the interface changes inconstantly in that the input time of the crude oil with water is random and the separate process is inconstant and real-time. The second, the composition of higher density crude oil with demulsifiers is complex. The third, the demand of safety is very strict in oil field. The new self-adaptive algorithm based on the least square method is linear and recursive. The processing result of the algorithm is decided by the relative signal of the transmitter without the relationship to the absolute signal, which avoids the dependence on the absolute performance of the transmitter and the effect of the transmitter covered with the crude oil. The simple and low-cost transmitter based on the parallel plate capacitance sensor was chosen; the algorithm also can distinguish the multi-interfaces of oil/water and the pseudo-interface. The experimental data shows the interface position identified by the algorithm is accurate.

articleTitle: Transplantation of GTK+ Based on FrameBuffer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to set up a graphics platform which uses Linux as its kernel, this paper gives an instruction of transplanting GTK+ to the development platform. In this case, an ARM developing platform, using Intel XScale PXA255 as its internal core, is chosen. To enable GTK+ running on the platform, cross-complied is necessary and the relative equipment drivers are uploaded to the platform. GTK+ is based on X Window, however, in this paper, FrameBuffer is used instead.

articleTitle: Design of Serial/Parallel Communication Interface of Digital Potentiometer with PC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: RS-232 serial port of the PC and I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C bus digital potentiometer serial communication can be realized by single-chip microcomputer, PIC16F62 made by Microchip Company and RS-232 voltage converter as the hardware circuitry, its excellence, high run speed, high transmission speed (120 kbps), low power, small bulk, low work voltage, high drive ability etc. Introduced hardware verifies and debugs method. There are two parts of program flow of the software design: one is the communication of PC and PIC16F628, and the other is the communication of PIC16F628 and I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C bus digital potentiometer. Given the example of the communication timing of single-chip micro-computer with I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C bus, and the method of serial communication by the DS2W soft tool between dialog box of the Window and I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C bus digital potentiometer. To realize the communication of PC parallel with I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C bus digital potentiometer, designed one type interface circuitry based on high speed CMOS inverter and Parallel Port soft tool, and insulated the PC parallel circuitry, and turn the TTL level of the parallel to Open-Drain level for the I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C interface, which can take place emulator or evaluate demo board to debug the digital potentiomenter. The designing software should insure to determinant the address of the slave digital potentiomenter. At last given the program and explain of verify and debug the digital potentiomenter by Debug using a typical parallel address. The given design has already validated, and has practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Automotive Eddy Current Retarder and Its Virtual Testing and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, structure and working principles of eddy current retarder (ECR) are discussed, as well as performance requirements of real-time virtual testing and simulation. On the basis of hardware testing platform, virtual models of vehicle and retarder are embedded into application program. In the testing system, Vega API function library is used for second development to control the 3D models, and Visual C++ is used for mathematical models call from MATLAB to simulate the working condition. Integrated with virtual instrument and virtual environment, the limitation of former simulation is broken through. Monitoring and testing on eddy current retarder are achieved efficiently and visually. Besides, the virtual test data is not only compared with the practical vehicle test data to correct the technical parameter of eddy current retarder, but also compared with the simulation of mathematical models for further study. The testing system gives evaluation on the performance of the retarder in different vehicles, so it expands application range and heightens testing efficiency.

articleTitle: Multiplex Temperature Collecting System Based on Dual MCUs and USB 2.0
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a multiplex temperature collecting system is achieved based on 1-wire digital thermometer DS18B20 and USB2.0 interface chip ISP1581. Two MCUs are used in the hardware circuits. One is used to collect the temperature, and the other is used to control the USB interface chip. We adopt Keil C language to develop firmware program, while WINDDK to develop the device driver.

articleTitle: Muzzle Exit Sensation Based on Geomagnetic Detection with Coils
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Up to now, some S&A of non-spin fuze contain single safety feature which takes setback as its only stimuli, and other adopt two independent stimuli which take takes air resistance as its second stimuli accomplished by turbine mechanism except setback. But the shortages of turbine confine its application in fuze, or influent operation effect and storability of fuze. This paper takes muzzle exit signal as the second stimuli, and discusses on board detection of muzzle exit signal with coils based on geomagnetic. Firstly the principle of this signal is analyzed, and then influence of geomagnetic and shooting parameters on signal are analyzed with mathematics and simulation, at last the conclusion that passive muzzle exit signal can be sensed in all condition is drawn.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Load Characteristic of the Purified Regulated Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper examines the effect of loading characteristic changing on the performance of the purified regulated power supply. Toward this end, the firing angle that control it have been summarized with a view toward avoiding the effect of loading characteristic changing. The method that adjust the firing angle is found , assuming an equal conduction angle of thyristors in the two half periods and the voltage waveform is sinusoidal. In the control of the regulated power supply, the output voltage is not unstable in a definite range. The change of load characteristic is a key factor for it. At the case of three kinds of loading, the calculation formulas of output voltage are derived. When the input voltage is quantitated , the influences of loading to the regulated power supply are manifested. Based on the hypothesis of loading characteristic change, the general changing rule of the output voltage have been investigated. At last, follow the example of resistor loading, the phased controlled rule is pointed.

articleTitle: Development of Intellective Management Software On ESP
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the electrostatic precipitator's distributed control system, the ESP intellective management software was developed. According to the software, the real-time monitor could be achieved and the expert knowledge base was established, by which, faults diagnosis could be realized. Basing the outlet dust turbidity on fact, the closed loop control would be achieved to realize the energy management. Meanwhile, the operation efficiency of ESP could be forecasted according to the coal category and the boiler's running conditions.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Wavelet Network for Estimation of Flux and Torque in Induction Motor Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel estimation method of flux and torque based on wavelet network is proposed in direct torque control system. The input nodes of the WN are the current error and the change in the current error and the output node of the WN is the stator resistance error, which can obtain the accurate estimation value. By means of enough training samples, the improved least squares algorithm is used to fulfill the network structure and parameter initialization. The wavelet transform technique can decompose the original signal into several other signals with different levels of resolution. From these decomposed signals, the original time domain signal can be recovered without losing any information. Once the instants are detected, the accurate stator flux vector and electromagnetic torque are acquired by the parameter estimator, which makes the direct torque control applicable in the low speed region, optimizing the inverter control strategy. The simulation results show that the proposed method is effective for estimation of flux and torque in induction motor control system.

articleTitle: ATE Design for Components of Armored Vehicles' Air-Compression System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The air-compression system is one of the most important control systems for armored vehicles, which is composed of an air compressor, a grease segregator, an air cleaner, an automatic air valve, an air pressure indicator, a non-return valve, two gas circuit distributors, a high pressure air collector, two auto-decompression valves, three 3/2-way-electric valves and three types double-acting-drive-cylinders ect. It works an important action when the vehicle is in starting up, braking or paddling mission profile. Therefore, during the vehicle's Intermediate Maintenance (IM), the performance of these key components, such as air compressor, auto-decompression valve, 3/2-way-electric valve and double-acting-drive-cylinder, must be tested to insure the repairing quality. With advanced automatic testing technologies of industry PC, sensor and data acquirement, an automatic test equipment (ATE) is built to test the components of series armored vehicles' air-compression system and to examine those components' performance. Based on Web Service technology, the ATE is integrated in the workshop's Maintenance Information Systems (MIS) to improve manage efficiency.

articleTitle: Application of Multivalued Test Sequencing to fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we consider a multivalued test sequencing (MVTS) problem, in which a test may have an arbitrary number of possible outcomes denoting different behaviors. The multivalued test sequencing problem can be solved through dynamic programming to find the optimal test sequence, but the time and space is large. In order to deal with this problem, we propose multivalued AO* algorithm, called MVAO*, based on multivalued heuristic evaluation function (MVHEF) in the AO*. With one example we demonstrate that MVAO* is efficient and effective for optimizing test sequences problem with multiple test responses.

articleTitle: Tracking Aided Target Identification Based on Evidence Theory Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To improve the precision of target attribute identification, a kind of tracking aided target identification method based on evidence theory data mining is advanced in this paper. Tracking information is imported to attribute fusion, thus improve the performance and accuracy of target identification. The experiment result proves the validity of this method. Especially when there are little sensors of attribute measurement, this method is more practical.

articleTitle: Novel Peak-Search Algorithms of Raman Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is important to locate Raman characteristic peak in qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis of substance. Because of the insufficiencies of comparison method and derivative, convolution and singularity detection of the discrete wavelet transform are used in the peak-search processing of Raman spectrum. The result of experiment shows that peak position can be located by using the methods above accurately, and the precision of peak-search is improved in qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis of substance.

Author Keywords: singularity detection of the discrete wavelet transform

articleTitle: Research on speed regulation algorithm and fault detection of DC speed regulation system
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper designs a speed-current dual close DC speed regulation system (SRS) and introduces the system's fault detection/protection strategy. The speed regulation (SR) algorithm is the core component of the SRS. By studying the SR principle and dynamic transfer function of SRS, adopting the flow of first interior last exterior loop, designs the SR algorithm. The algorithm's Matlab simulation results and real system's running effect based on the algorithm are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Self-adaptive Path-Planning for Aerocraft in 3D Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper provides a new approach to solve the motion planning problems of aerocraft in uncertain 3D dynamic environments. The aerocrafts controlled by this method can adaptively choose the fast way to avoid collision without information about the shapes and trajectories of obstacles. Based on sphere coordinates the new path-planning method accomplishes collision avoidance of aerocraft without any other auxiliary positioning systems. The Self-adaptive system gives aerocrafts self-protection abilities to work in uncertain 3D dynamic environments. Simulations illustrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of Coupling Agent in the Chemical Plating Ni-Cu-P of PVC Plastic
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The surface of PVC plastic was treated by coupling agent before chemical plating, in order to substitute chromic acid due to its toxicity to environment and human beings. Three kinds of coupling agents were chose, of which KH560 was proved to be effective for PVC surface. After treated by KH560, the PVC surface was plated with Ni-Cu-P in a typical chemical plating solution. XRD analysis showed that Ni-Cu-P coatings took an amorphous form, and SEM and EDS was employed to analyze its morphology and component. The adhesive force between the coatings and the substrate was estimated by scarification and flexing test, which showed it is feasible to replace traditional chromium treatment with the handling of coupling agent.

articleTitle: Design and Achievement of a System for Environmental Radiation Level Real-Time Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The three types of constitution of a system for environmental radiation level real-time monitoring and, also, the database contents of the latest system are introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Data Acquisition and Processing System for Mini Raman Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Mini Raman spectroscopy is applied to rapid extraventricular substance identification. Aiming at its outdoor application a particular system design of spectral data acquisition and processing was presented. A novel spectral data acquisition technique with CCD of which the integration time is controllable and self-adjusting was realized. A portable power management design was introduced. ARM and CPLD techniques were combined to implement real-time control and data processing. A program of searching the peak of Raman spectra based on comparison algorithm was given.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DF-2 Multi-Agent Autonomous Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Developing and training of autonomous mobile robot based on multi-agent theory is a hotspot in AI and robot research. The general outline, system design, hardware choosing, agent architecture design and key technique of DF-2 Autonomous Mobile robot developing based on multi-agent theory are proposed in this essay. Finally, the current research is introduced.

articleTitle: Fast estimation of average leakage based on pre-characterizing standard cell
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In CMOS circuits, sub-threshold leakage (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SUB</inf>) has been an important issue during IC design. As technology keeps on scaling down, new leakage mechanisms such as bound to bound leakage (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BTBT</inf>) and gate tunneling leakage (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GATE</inf>) can't still be neglected. Estimating the total leakage of a circuit at high level can help the designers to decide whether the design is eligible or should be modified. This paper introduced the main leakage mechanisms, including I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SUBB</inf>, I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BTBT</inf> and I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GATE</inf>. The authors have also proposed a method to estimate the average leakage quickly based on pre-characterizing standard cell with BSIM models considering the new mechanisms. The results obtained by experiment on ISCAS benchmark circuits show that the method can be used to get the total leakage value and give a early direction for IC design.

articleTitle: Application of Robust Estimation in Sub-pixel Location
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The least square estimation is widely used in parameter estimation. When the measurement error submits to Gaussian distribution, as a maximum likelihood estimate, the precision of the least squares estimation is high, otherwise, especially when the gross error exist, the precision of the estimation is lower. The robust estimation is a parameter estimation that some suitable estimation method is been used to relieve the impact of gross error when it is inevitable and find out the optimal parameter or the parameter nearby. The robust estimation algorithm is injected into sub-pixel locating. As a result, the impact of impulse noise could be reduced greatly and the precision of sub-pixel location could be higher.

articleTitle: Gas Turbine Engine Test Visualizations Using Configuration Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aiming at realizing the aircraft engine test visualization in the test link, we have done research and development on gas turbine engine test visualizations using configuration method. In this paper, a set of aircraft engines test visible plan is introduced. In this paper, the plan has used the advanced object-oriented thought to build basic module, and configuration design technology has been fully applied in the design. And the gas turbine engine model classes, data processing computation class and user interface classes were programmed with VC ++ language. We have given the relations between software module structures and expressed the software processing flow. Finally, we have synthesized some popular numerical analysis and cartography Software, which make the engineering completed with high quality and speed. It shows that the gas turbine engine test visualizations using configuration method is effective in making the gas turbine engine test data visualizing and is helpful to the gas turbine engine designer.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network and Wavelet Analysis in Monitoring Multiple Structural Damage
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Using db5 wavelet to decompose first layer of structural response momentum of acceleration in six layers, selecting damage feature of damaged sensitivity based on response single of acceleration, thus recognizing damage time of structure and realizing the surveillance on time of structural damage. Through wavelet package decomposition of acceleration response signal of obtained structure, it can obtain eigen vector of energy in al frequency ranges and construct characteristic parameter input of BP neutral network and then construct one group of simple network output related to the input. The output can not only indicate location of structural damage and degree of structural damage, but also greatly reduce time spent on training and emulation of network. The adopted BP neural network structure is 8-7-7-6, the activation function in hidden layer is Sigmoid and the activation function in output layer is linear function training 405 group sample, realizing identification on damage location and damage degree. Analogue calculation has indicated that using wavelet analysis and BP neural network together can accurately diagnose the time, location and degree of structure, being of some feasibility.

articleTitle: Study of the Technology for Intelligent Decision-Making in BIT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To meet intelligent diagnostic needs of BIT, it builds up an information network by disperse and single BIT information. And then from using intelligent technologies and information fusion technology, the diagnosability of BIT will be improved greatly. It mainly researches intelligent decision-making technology from three key aspects that are information fusion in decision layer, fuzzy decision and decision-making expert system in the paper. The research has important meanings not only for existing BIT but also for future BIT design work.

articleTitle: Application of an Improved ADSL Technique in the High-Speed Wireline Logging Telemetry System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the development of imaging well logging technology, more and more logging data must be transferred to the surface, but the present transmission technique in the logging system can not meet the demand. ADSL is an experiential technique used in the telecommunication network, its property of asymmetrical transmission is suited to the downhole data transmission. But affected by the terrible environment, the ordinary ADSL technique can hardly meet the needs. So, in this paper, we make analysis of the factors which will damage the quality of data transmission, and make some improvements on the ordinary ADSL according to the property of the logging cable. Experiment is provided to show that the improved ADSL technique can support the high-speed data transmission under the downhole terrible environment.

articleTitle: A method of PLL detection applied in fiber optic evanescent wave temperature sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A method of phase-lock loop (PLL) detection applied in fiber optic evanescent wave temperature sensor is presented in this paper. The fiber optic evanescent wave sensor is fabricated by a fiber optic coupler whose cladding of waist is replaced by temperature sensitive material. In order to demonstrate its sensitivity to temperature with high stability, the PLL detection circuit to measure the temperature variety with high accuracy is be described in detail. Compared with conventional DC signal detection, the PLL detection technique has great improvement on denoise, which is able to detect weak signal buried in noise. Experiments demonstrated that the resolution to temperature could reach 0.091degC with such temperature sensor system.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors of Precision in an Active Vision System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Active vision technologies are important application based on machine vision. In the system, the encoded pattern with some styles and characters will be projected onto the surface of object. Its image will be modulated by object and captured by camera. Then, some image processing algorithms will be utilized to calculate the image coordinate of each interest point. Subsequently, the 3D Euclidean surface of object can be known. In the paper, pseudo-random principle is adopted to make the pattern of the projector in an active vision system. The pattern can make each interest point on the surface of object be recognized exclusively. It can also make following image processing simple and the active vision system convenient. The paper describes the influencing factors of precision in detailed, such as the pre-calibration of projector and the 3D Euclidean reconstruction algorithm. Accordingly, some improving measures have been presented.

articleTitle: Consecutive Polarity Coincidence Based Split-spectrum Processing in Ultrasonic Testing of Coarse Materials
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel split-spectrum processing (SSP) method for ultrasonic echo signal was proposed, which employs consecutive polarity coincidence (CPC) as the recovering algorithm and can be used in ultrasonic nondestructive testing to coarse materials. Both numerical simulation and experimental result manifested that, by using this method, the ratio of signal to noise (SNR) can be improved and the flaw echo can be effectively extracted with better performance than other conventional SSP methods.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Virtual Instrument for Electromagnetic Field Strength Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: After simply analyzing the background in traditional electromagnetic environment test items, a computer-based data acquisition (DAQ) system coupled by means of a general purpose instrumentation bus (IEEE488/ GPIB) with a signal generator is used to create a virtual instrument system with electromagnetic filed strength measurement capability. The software signal-processing capability of the data acquisition system was used to compensate instrument measurement deficiencies and to enhance signal capture. And the virtual instrument is shown to provide auto-increment frequency signals as the test required. The virtual instrument software module is applied to develop the front panel and background calculation and controlling program. The system is programmed in modules, and can be transfer or extended to the other systems. The design theory and technology of this automatic measurement system can also be applied to the other electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) test items, to overcome the difficulties in manual operation, and enhance the test quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Software Platform Design and Realization of Electronic Multi-Test System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Automatic test technology has been applied in weapon maintenance. General-utility and opening is the developmental trend of ATE design. This paper adopts the pattern based on database to establish the software platform, integrates all kinds of technologies to control test processes. The development of test programs uses IVI-MSS and signal-oriented ATS software for reference. The function interface technology and modularization technology are used to achieve the interchangeability and portability of TPS. The practical application indicates that the design of software is reasonable, and the software platform is applicable for fast and accurate fault diagnoses and test of various equipments.

articleTitle: Detecting Frequency for Transient Signal Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The purpose of signal feature abstraction is to extract the substantial informations from the original data. This work proposes an appropriate approach in detecting local frequency of rapidly transient signal using wavelet transform. In particular, we make full use of the wavelet transform modulus maximum technique . Furthermore, a complete illustration of the theoretical background is provided underlying the measurement method. Simulation shows that this method is more effective than other known methods for frequency estimation.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring Method of Large-scale Weapon Equipment Based on Multilayer Competition Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The large-scale weapon equipment is often a complex system, which applies many techniques such as mechanical technique, electronics, hydraulic and so on. Whole weapon system will lose combat capability, if the large-scale weapon equipment is fault. It is necessary to realize real-time monitoring and automatic recognition of working state, to rapidly locate fault's components for the large-scale weapon equipment. For this reason, this method that adopts the competition network to realize on-line monitoring is put forward. When the fault has been found, the fault diagnosis is completed by calling the corresponding neural network. By this method, not only the neural network's scale is reduced, but also the design's complexity of diagnosis system is simplified and computing time is reduced too. This method has an important significance to realizing on-line monitoring and diagnosis of the large-scale weapon equipment.

articleTitle: Application in Fuse Simulation of Algorithm for Near Field Scattering by Complex Target
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper discusses the algorithm of GRECO for near field scattering by complex targets and application in radar fuze simulation. The models of a certain fuze and a typical target meeting are established by the algorithm and computed to obtain the variety characteristics of echo signals in time domain. A certain type of fuze target simulator of an air-to-air missile is realized according to the echo data of missile-target meeting and modulation elements. The simulator has been successfully applied in the synthetical test system to the fuze of the weapon system and the usage effect in practice is perfect.

articleTitle: Research on the Terminal Service and Windows Cluster Technologies in Office Information Popularity
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper focuses on the application of terminal service technology and Windows cluster technology in the renovation of information popularity in corporate offices. The adoption of new ideal, new technologies and new equipment will substitute the traditional mode, to exalt the office efficiency, reduce the costs in operation and maintenance of information popularity, and reach the desirable result.

articleTitle: A Simple Method to Calculate Electric Field Distribution and Characteristic Impedance in ATEM Cell With Rectangular Metallic EUT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: ATEM cell is widely used in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) test. When loaded with equipment under test (EUT), the electric field in ATEM cell will be distorted , and the characteristic impedance changed. In this paper, the field distribution and characteristic impedance in ATEM cell loaded with rectangular metallic EUT is analyzed by a simple method--point matching method. The section of an asymmetric TEM was divided into five regions and potential function is expressed as a Fourier series in each region. The point-matching was used on the interface of these regions to determine coefficients of series. Thus, the characteristic impedance can be calculated and electric field obtained in terms of a potential function.

articleTitle: CRG Godel Based High-level Test Generation algorithm for VLSI
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The development of IC technique, makes IC test to become more and more difficult, and the test expenses has been taken higher proportion in total cost of the IC product, the test expenses even may go higher than the manufacturing cost. Existed high-level circuit models usually can not behave well to demonstrate the controllability, the observability, and the sequence information. Aimed at settle this common problem, a new CRG circuit model was abstracted in this paper. The model is based on the widely adopted techniques in the circuit design, the register transfer level (RTL) behavioral descriptions. The model has the capacity to show the circuit control manner and the data relationships. And on the base of this circuit model, directly test generation method or testability analysis method was proposed. The experimental result indicated that, the proposed model and corresponding algorithm are effective, and the generating test sequence can be used not only in design confirmations or chip test, but also have ability for helping testability analysis for high level description.

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Controlling System in Water Ratio Measuring Experimental Table for Turbine Oil
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Measuring results are very strongly affected by system temperature in the experiment of measuring the water ratio of turbine oil based on microwave resonant cavity perturbation. In order to improve the measuring precision, this paper put forward an experimental plan of temperature control system and implemented the experiment. The hardware circuit design and software implementation method of the temperature control system were presented in this paper. Several heaters with small power to work take turns, controlling the temperature steadily. This temperature controlling system has simple structure, proper price, and the practical application indicates that the system is with friendly interface and convenient operation. Further more, its measuring and controlling accuracy are high, measuring accuracy can be to 0.01degC and controlling accuracy is 0.1degC, meeting to the requirements of wetness measuring system.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Aerospace Electrical Equipment Based on Fuzzy Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The complexity of modern aerospace electric equipment is higher than before, thus it cannot meet the need of speedy fault diagnosis to use single diagnosis pattern. Multi-resource information fusion is imported to the fault diagnosis of electronic equipment in this paper, use all stages information of multi-sensor and multiple information resource, adopt composite disposal, namely integrate the fusion of data, character and decision, and unite the fusion structure of distributed and integrated. The multi-resource fusion diagnosis structure and the fusion arithmetic are detailed. Finally, a computer simulation example is carried out; the simulation result shows that the method is effective and practical.

articleTitle: Design of the Temperature Detecting and Control System of the Inertia Platform Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A temperature detecting and control system of the inertia platform based on virtual instrument is constructed, and the hardware design and the software diagrams of the temperature controlling system are shown. Pulse modulation circuit and temperature measuring circuit are adopted to control the temperature of inertial platform exactly. A virtual panel of friendly-interface is designed for the system by used virtual instrument developing tool, LabVIEW. The experiment proves that the system can adapt for temperature detecting and control of the inertia platform.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Wireless Sensor System for Monitoring Large-Scale Launching Equipments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A method to realize wireless monitoring of large-scale launching equipments is presented in the paper. The method is based on Jennie's JN5139-000-M00 module. The JN5139-000-M00 is a low power, low cost, 2.4 GHz Industrial, Scientific, and Medical (ISM) band wireless microcontroller module suitable for IEEE802.15.4 [1]. It is used to set up a star wireless sensor system for monitoring large-scale launching equipments, of which the hardware nodes are small and integrated, the topology is the simplest and steadiest, and the application software are easy to developed. The whole sensor system is miniaturized and convenient for manipulation.

articleTitle: Reserch on Extracting the Features at Relay Protection Based on Wavelet Transform Modulus Maximum
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In electrical power systems, relay protection is an important protection method. In this paper, according to the theory of detecting abrupt signals with wavelet transformation, we make full use of wavelet transforms modulus maximum technique, the abrupt current signals can be detected quickly when faults occur. At the same time, we also study how to choice a appropriate wavelet for power relay protection. Simulation shows that the proposed method can effectively improve the sensitivity. Also shows the method has a wide range of application for fault diagnosis and extracting signal features.

articleTitle: Research of PF Based on D-S theory Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The application of Particle Filter needs no rigorous precondition, moreover Particle Filter demonstrates good convergence. But Particle Filter has inherence shortcomings, which limit its further application. An new improved Particle Filter is proposed. In the paper, the thought and difficulty for improvement is explained. Then viewpoint to solve the difficulty is introduced with D-S theory. After introducing D-S theory, paper gives then method of overcoming degradation of samples with D-S theory. The simulation result show that the thought is right, the method is feasible, the result is effective.

articleTitle: Study on Prediction Model Based on Grey Residual Information Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The purpose of the investigation is to ensure equipment dependable operation. A novel prediction model based on grey residual neural network is proposed in this paper, which is composed of grey residual model (GRM) and information neural network (INN). Firstly, it predicts key feature information by GRM which is expressed as quantitative values. In this process, the prediction values of GRM are compensated by INN1, so the final prediction values equal to the output values of GRM plus the compensated error values. Then, the final prediction values are inputted INN2 to predict fault or life. And the influence of environment is an input node for network. In the prediction model, INN1 is an error compensator and INN2 is a prediction network. The investigation shows that the model can carry out the prediction successfully, because it uses well the ability of processing the uncertain information for grey system and the function of integrating decision for INN. In this paper, the model is validated with crack data which are obtained from the aerospace launcher. The result shows that the model is tried and has relatively good prediction accuracy and flexibility.

articleTitle: An Embedded Virtual Digital Storage Oscilloscope with 1GSPS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper discusses the chief techniques and design principles of an embedded virtual digital storage oscilloscope, which have two working mode: oscilloscope and data acquisition. The instrument consists of pre-process circuit, A/D converter, on-board memories, high-speed clock generator and control circuit integrated in FPGA. It can concatenate embedded CPU main board through PC/104 bus, and also can achieve 8-bit resolution allowing up to 1GHz sampling rate with 256KByte/channel on-board real-time memory.

articleTitle: Application of STBC in MIMO Atmosphere Laser Communication
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: STBC (space-time block code) is a new technology, which MIMO (multiple input multiple output system) can be achieved through array antenna. The technology can set off fading effectively and increase frequency spectrum efficiency. Firstly, the theory of STBC is described in this paper. And STBC is ameliorated to adapt to optical communication. Secondly, the technique is combined with QPPM modulation and be used in atmosphere laser communication. Lastly, the system channel capacity and error rate are analyzed, and then their change is compared by STBC system and no STBC system using emulation experiment. As a result, the error code performance of system coded STBC is improved effectively, and the channel capacity is drop off.

articleTitle: Research on Storage Reliability of a Certain Long-Distance Rocket Projectile based on Mathematic Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, it is introduced method of confirming experimental sample size of making a certain rocket projectile storage reliability experiment, and research on experiment result. It is discussed data processing method of this rocket projectile using mathematical modeling by which it predicts this rocket projectile's storage life, and gives this rocket projectile's storage life under a certain confidence.

articleTitle: Near-Field Region Propagation Model of Typical Plane Antenna for HPM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: At present research on HPM non-linear propagation mainly focuses on air-breakdown. It is not enough to design the whole HPM system. Theoretical research on HPM should combine with the actual HPM antenna. Three different types of near-field region propagation model of typical plane antenna for HPM are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on Equipment Supply Safety Under Power Leads Conducted Susceptibilty Test
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The threat imposed on the safety of EUT (Equipment Under Test) supply in power leads conducted susceptibility test covered by MIL-STD-461/462 was investigated by using sinusoidal steady state linear circuit phasor. With the impact of testers output impedance characteristic analyzed, the solution that is phase compensation is presented and its effect and feasibility are verified.

articleTitle: Design for Mixed-Signal SoC with IPv4 for Embedded Instruments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A SoC architecture used for with 8-bit CPU and IPv4 hardware is designed in this paper. The SoC is designed for embedded instrument. In additional, to according with the information transmission requirement of smart control system, the function of IPv4 is simplified to reduce the hardware. A function model used for model checking is also given. The function model is very simple and easy to be used in practice because we only take care about the transceiver function of IPv4 hardware.

articleTitle: An Image Filtering Model Based On Content And Rough Compatibility Relation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces an image content filtering model based on Clustering and Rough Compatibility Relation. In order to reduce the influence by lighting, a new Gamma correction method is used to adjust the pixel values. This filtering model use a TLHS color model that improve on the saturation arithmetic based on GLHS color model. TLHS color model has a steady skin color clustering with great efficiency. And use a new image segmentation method combines FCM clustering arithmetic and rough set theory. At first, an information table reflecting the relation of space segmentation is constructed according to the FCM clustering result under different clustering numbers. Secondly the difference degree between objects is confirmed by value reduction and getting the power value of attribute. At last, the α consistent relation under the rough set is defined and the image is divided into segments.

articleTitle: Hardware Design of a High Performance Multi-Channel High Speed Signal Acquisition and Processing System
