publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes the hardware design of a high speed acquisition system based on a single DSP of ADI Blackfin family. In order to realize multi-functions in a single board, CPLD and FPGA chips are integrated in this system. This study discusses several main problems during hardware design of this system, such as sampling of multi-channel analog signals, multi-channel digital signals and communication with host board by extended PCI bus, in addition talking about several points concerned with signal integrity issues. The main aim of this research is to demonstrate that as development of DSP and semiconductor techniques, a more complex electric system can be realized on a single DSP.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Control of Wire Feeder in Pulse Welding System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper presents a new method for the pulse welding, by which the arc welding power supply voltage is kept stable while the feeding speed is set to vary like a pulse, namely, to make the speedy feeding and low-speed feeding alternate. In the feeder, the couple closed-loop fuzzy control system is adopted for the wire-feeding speed control. In the inner closed-loop of the system, the adjustment is achieved with the motor current as the feedback signal while in the outer closed-loop the adjustment is achieved mainly by the actual speed of wire feeder as the feedback signal. The adjustment on rotating speed and the current relies on the fuzzy controller. Proven by the experiments, the feeder of such a kind is swift in system responding and when needed, the motor speed can be excellently steady. If the set signal is a pulse, the peak current and the base current alternate in the actual welding cases.

articleTitle: Study of lower extremity exoskeleton Electronic System Fault Diagnosis Based on Immune Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the complex and compact structure of lower extremity exoskeleton electronic system, a fault diagnosis model based on immune evolution algorithm is given and the design and realization method of the intelligent fault diagnosis system is also presented. According to the defects of immune algorithm that the individual diversity calculation is very complex and the vaccination is difficult, a fault calculation mechanism integrated the induction and statistic is designed, which introduced new immune operators that realized by vaccination, adjustment of diversity of every locus and immune selection. The strategies of calculating, judging and adjusting the diversity of populations by calculating the locus information entropy, the effects of control parameters, the methods of selecting and constructing a vaccine using the system information are all given. The fault diagnosis experiment results show the validity of this method based on immune algorithm, which improve speed and precision of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on High Speed Predictor of Adaptive ADC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper introduces a novel method which can improve the slew rate of Analog-to-Digital Converters based on adaptive filter. The residual signal after digitization is divided into several sub-signals, and then the sub-signals are sent to a signal predictor based on adaptive filter for parallel data processing. It analyses the performance of Signal Noise Ratio (SNR) and Spurious Free Dynamic Range (SFDR) influenced by the number of sub-signals, constructs a simulation on computer by Matlab. The detailed simulation results show that the method can satisfy the requirements of adaptive ADC.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Management System (IMS) for Dwelling Houses
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes an integrated intelligent automatic inquiry and management community system for dwelling houses. The system is a host driven, multi-level network system consisting of AT89C51, HT9200A and MSM7512B, with built-in flexibility and expandability, for acquiring and transmitting data. The system can send two different kinds of information. The first kind of information comes from family gateways, including data shown on the eight meters, alarm email and urgency. The second kind comes from the system platform, including control information and notes (such as broadcasting). Through sending these two types of information, the system can function as remote meter reading, urgent alarm, urgency help, note service and remote control for each family. The success of this system is very helpful for speeding up modern automatic management.

articleTitle: A New Resources Sharing Protocol of Heterogeneity Operating Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Heterogeneous network resource sharing protocol (HNS) is a protocol working above the TCP/IP. It is given to share resources in heterogeneity operating systems on local area network. This protocol works in the application and presentation layers of OSI/RM. The identification mode is based on user level. The files in the sharing directory on the server can be operated directly by authorized user. Files can be delivered by command. A repository is used to implement the protocol. It manages the transformation of different format between the heterogeneity operating systems. The repository can be maintained dynamically in order to adapt the expanding applications. It is a characteristic that this protocol can separate format transformation from communication process. The present achievement is that the program on Linux server side and program on Windows client side. It proves the usability of HNS protocol.

articleTitle: Fast Fourier Transform based Earthquake Precursor Analysis of Radon in N-W Himalayas
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Study of the radon concentration in soil and water, and periodically occurring anomalies in emitted concentrations of radon has been identified by many workers as a potential precursor to earthquake event. However, event prediction through the so far used techniques has significant failure rates and false alarms associated with it. This paper brings out a significant variation to the existing techniques by using Fast Fourier transforms and demonstrates a more reliable event prediction.

articleTitle: A General Purpose Test Apparatus for High-Speed, High Resolution Analog to Digital Converters Based on IEEE Standard
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Nowadays high-speed, high resolution ADCs (Analog to Digital Converter) are employed in many fields, thus there exists an important task--how to test these ADCs, giving reliable results. This ADC test apparatus is based on the IEEE Std. It aims for the test of high speed, high resolution ADCs (16 bit at most, with the sample rate up to 166 MSPS and expandable) and the "General Purpose" ability. This essay will present the basic techniques of ADC testing and the skills used in this apparatus, meanwhile giving the real test results of a commercial ADC for the illustration of its performance.

articleTitle: Investigation on Natural Radioactivity Level of Fly Ash in Xi'an DaTang Thermoelectricity Group
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to have a comprehensive understanding of the application and radioactivity level of fly ash in Xi'an DaTang thermoelectricity group, five samples were collected from fly ash stack of the group by quincunx collecting method. Natural radioactivity nuclide contents in the samples were measured by a low background anti-Compton HPGe Gamma spectrometer. The result was that the contents of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">238</sup>U, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">226</sup>Ra, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">232</sup>Th <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</sup>K respectively were 67.6Bq/kg, 79.5Bq/kg, 72.7Bq/kg, 190Bq/kg. According to national standard GB6566-2001,the result indicates the radioactivity level of all the samples is at the common background level and the fly ash can be used as the A kind building materials. Finally, the future application of the fly ash in Xi'an DaTang thermoelectricity group was analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Fitting the Second-harmonic Spectrum of the Coal Mine Gas with Multiple Regression Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It uses the tunable diode laser absorption spectrum method in the coal mine gas detection which is not only the high precision and the strong selectivity but also the quickly response. The results of experiment indicate that the second-harmonic signal of methane with different density use multiple regression processing and fitting to obtain the density value. It shows that along with the decrease of the density the correlation coefficient reduces more and more, and the lower limit value of density detected is 0.087mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. As the high sensitivity of the experiment installation it can realize in coal mine that continuous monitoring online and remote sensing.

articleTitle: A Research on New Measurement System for the Grayscale Response Time of LCD
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this article, a new measurement and system for the grayscale response time of LCD was proposed based on the methods of measurement for Digital Television Flat Panel Display and TCO'06 Media Display. The luminance signal of LCD was detected by a photoelectric probe, and converted to analog signal. The analog signal difference of the luminance levels between two neighborhood grayscales was not big enough to calculate the grayscale response time correctly. The analog signal was processed by a special designed circuit. The analog signals were amplified first. The amplified signals were add to the subtraction circuit. The lesser signal of the lower grayscale was subtracted. The difference of the signals was detected and amplified farther, and then converted to digital. The reference voltage of the subtraction circuit and amplify multiples were under the control of the single chip. Finally, the digital signals were transmitted to computer. The computer dealt with the data and calculated the grayscale response time of LCD. The experimental results showed that the repeatability error of the response time with this method was less than plusmn0.5 ms, and the accuracy met the requirements of methods of measurement for digital television flat panel displays and TCO'06 completely.

articleTitle: Evolving D/A Circuits Based on Adaptive Mutation Evolutionary Mechanism of Single Chromosome
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduced the method to evolve the analog bio-inspired circuits based on adaptive mutation evolutionary mechanism of single chromosome. The result shows that FPTA architecture and cell circuit are correct and the method is efficient.

articleTitle: LXI-based Airborne-missile Remoteness Test and Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The airborne-missile remoteness test and fault diagnosis is that the experts in academy and graduate school can test straightly the airborne-missiles and locate remotely the fault by the means of network and computers to shorten the time in locating the fault and decrease the cost in maintaining the airborne-missile. Due to network latency, the test process is possible to work abnormally in the normal remoteness test and fault diagnosis system sometimes it even leads to not executing exactly. LXI is a new instrumentation standard that builds on LAN communications standards. The instrument of LXI class A and B can synchronize their system clocks to a high degree of accuracy automatically and transparently according to IEEE STD 1588 Precision Time Protocol. To overcome the disorder of the test process in airborne-missile remoteness test, build the LXI-based airborne missile remoteness test system. The system improves the efficiency to locate the fault and cuts down the cost to maintain the equipment.

articleTitle: Research and Application of LZW Algorithm in Embeded Detection and Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Bridge detection with embedded system makes detection easier, and improve the automation and accuracy of measurement. But there are a lot of data in the process of detection, such as: displacement, strain, amplitude and so on. On the other hand, storage resources and data transmission speed in an embedded system are usually limited. To resolve this conflict, this paper presents a new method to detect bridge with data compression. The speed of data transmission and storage resources issues are partly resolved in this method, which usually exist in an embedded system. The system also reduces communication time and costs, extendes equipment use time. With wireless network, it achieves bridge detection elsewhere.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Analog Circuit Based on Multi-layer Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The theory of the fault diagnosis of analog circuit is a new offshoot of the theory of circuit networks. In this paper, the neural network is used in the fault diagnosis of analog circuit to improve the adaptive capacity. This makes the way of the directory be of use in fault, and enhances the validity of the fault diagnosis. Simulation results have shown that this claim is valid. Results indicated that the structure of BP network influents not only training process, but also assorting effecting. Overfull or fewer more neurons in hidden-layer would also reduce order of accuracy. On the condition of same training sample, two-hidden-layer is more quickly than single hidden-layer, but sometimes there would be agitation in network with two-hidden-layer. When being trained, net work must have proper performance target.

articleTitle: Optimization Realization of Data Display on SCM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: LCD, which is commonly utilized for HMI design in data display on SCM(Single-chip Microprocessor), provides users effective ways to communicate with machines by large amount of information. However, the codes will be more complicated with more data or display style, thus the study of optimum design becomes necessary for data display program. The Debug and Diagnose Interface, one HMI in Flow Measurement System based on Ultrasonic, is demonstrated as an example in this paper. Furthermore, this paper defines the data structure, analyses the optimization in program design. Considering the characteristics of SCM, the optimum design procedure of data display is illustrated in detail, with methods for data display of numeric type provided. The design could be utilized in other LCD display program of SCM.

articleTitle: Upsetting Machine Control System Based on the Embedded Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, based on the electrothermal upsetting processing method, the process of valve upsetting is divided into two steps: initial upsetting and formal upsetting. Four parameters, including 1.hearting current; 2.press; 3.velocity; 4.material, which influence the manufacture process in evidence, is mainly discussed. Analyzing defect and deficiency of tradition processing, the article puts forward to a controlling strategy with iteration technique and designed an embedded valve upset forging microcomputer control system. The electrothermal upsetting control system based on embedded technology stores the experience and technique of local worker, optimizes the tradition processing by using ARM S3C2410X chip. During the process, controlling parameters such as press, displacement and voltage are real-time monitored. Signal feeds back to system by sensors to realize the closed loop controlling on-line self-study function. And the technics parameters and the controlling process will display on the HMI (Human Machine Interface). Using the system, the quality and efficiency of the valve manufacture are improved, and the robustness gets stronger. The system has been applied in enterprises. Comparing with the tradition one, the automaticity in manufacture is improved, and the rejection rate is reduced. It also benefits the informationization of production of enterprise.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Stepping optimal controlling of a rucklidge-like chaotic system
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: A More Homogeneous, Less Massive Halbach Magnet array for Portable NMR
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A more homogeneous, less massive Halbach magnet array for portable NMR was presented. Based on the general theory of cylindrical magnet, we describe a construction and performance of a small cylindrical magnet using crescent-shaped configuration to improve the 2D field homogeneity, and a novel test tube magnet (TTM) composed of a dipole cylinder magnet and a hemi-sphere magnet at one end to improve the 3D field homogeneity. The improved field of cylindrical magnet, with inner radii, 30 mm, and outer radii, 35 mm, is simulated by ANSOFT MAXWELL 3D and MATLAB. Flux density elements are effectively corrected in the homogeneous magnetic field region. The homogeneity increases, the magnet volumes and mass are relatively decreased, and the construction is very reasonable. Taken together the new designs have improved characteristics for portable NMR.

articleTitle: Virtual Prototyping of Guns and Optimization of Firing Stability with DS Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Conventional design and analysis of gun system are based on three assumptions of plane, symmetry and static equilibrium, and the consistency between theoretic analysis and experimental results cannot satisfy us despite that varieties of correctional coefficients are introduced. Progressive sensitivity analysis method is presented, and the important degrees of factors with different dimensions are compared. Structural parameters that most affect firing stability are achieved according to sensitivity analysis, and they are optimized with the objective of firing stability by Design Sub-space method (DSM). Finally, a group of structure parameters which can optimize firing stability are obtained, the application perspective of virtual prototyping technology applied in military fields is presented.

articleTitle: Classification of Mental Task EEG Signals Using Wavelet Packet Entropy and SVM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper address on the classification of mental task EEG signals, which is one of the key issues of Brain-Computer Interface (BCI). We proposed a method using wavelet packet entropy and Support Vector Machine (SVM). First, we apply 7 levels wavelet packet decomposition to each channel of EEG with db4. After extraction four spectrum bands (δ,θ,α,β), an entropy algorithm was performed on each bands. The resulting entropy vectors are then used as inputs to SVM to train and test. We test the method on EEG signals during 5 mental tasks collected by 2 subjects. The accuracy on 2-class classification for subject 1 is averaged 93.0%, and 87.5% for subject 2. The results also show that our method outperforms the classical methods for multi-class problems.

articleTitle: Pavement Crack Detection and Analysis for High-grade Highway
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The image processing technology has been widely applied to maintaining and manipulating the high-grade highway, but it is difficult to make a balance between the processing effect and the processing speed. In order to solve this problem, we introduce the morphology to the pavement crack detection for the high-grade highway and propose a novel image processing method in this paper. The approached method reconstructs the median-filter algorithm with four structural elements to enhance the gray-scale pavement images, and combines the morphology-gradient operator with the morphology-close operator to extract the crack edges and fill the gaps of the cracks. After the above processing, the proposed method employs the improved morphology-erosion operator to thin the cracks and obtain the skeletons, and then gets the length and width of cracks by counting. Compared with other traditional methods, the experimental results indicate that our method can not only effectively extract the edges of cracks and evidently decrease the influence of noises, but also gain the exact characteristics of the pavement cracks.

articleTitle: An Improved Single-Stage Flyback PFC Converter for High-Luminance Lighting LED Lamps
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a universal power supply for high-luminance LED lamp test. The proposed power supply is designed and implemented by adopting an improved single-stage Flyback configuration. A constant current control method is used to regulate the lamp current and brightness under different pieces of LED series connection. A laboratory prototype has been built and tested. With the prototype, high efficiency, high power factor, and constant lamp current can be achieved for the performance test of various LED lamps.

articleTitle: A Modified Particle Swarm Optimizer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presented a modified particle swarm optimizer algorithm (MPSO). The aggregation degree of the particle swarm was introduced. The particles' diversity was improved through periodically monitoring aggregation degree of the particle swarm. On the later development of the PSO algorithm, it has been taken strategy of the Gaussian mutation to the best particle's position, which enhanced the particles' capacity to jump out of local minima. Several typical benchmark functions with different dimensions have been used for testing. The simulation results show that the proposed method improves the convergence precision and speed of PSO algorithm effectively.

articleTitle: Development of Image Processing System Based on DSP and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Real-time image processing system is widely used in many field, it is required to have high speed. In order to satisfy the demand, an image processing system structure based on DSP and FPFA is presented, that is DSP is used as advanced image processing unit and FPGA as logic unit for image sampling and display. The hardware configuration and working principle is introduced firstly, and then some key problems which include of image data stored mode, color space conversion and image transmission based on EDMA are described. Finally the program flowchart for developing image processing software is given. The developed system can acquire image, display image and make some image processing operations which include of geometry transform, orthographic transform, operations based on pixels, image compression and color space conversion. The developed system can meet the real-time requirement and has been used in our teaching.

articleTitle: A Remote Measurement and Control System for Greenhouse Based on GSM-SMS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A remote measurement and control system of large-scale greenhouse was developed based on GSM-SMS. The whole system consists of a central station and base stations. The central station is composed by a PC server along with its application software, the GSM module, and the database system. The base station consists of a microcontroller, sensors, the operation administer, and GSM module. Modularization is adopted in the design of the system hardware; and the software exploitation is realized by embedded operating system, all of which make the system easy to be extended, maintained and transplanted. The remote monitoring system can also realize remote real-time data analyzing and processing.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Improved Butterworth Low Pass Filter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The conventional Butterworth low pass filter exists the contradiction problems between test precision, stability and response time, so a kind of improved Butterworth low pass filter is put forth in this paper. Firstly n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order improved Butterworth low pass filter, whose n poles are chosen from poles of (n+2)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order Butterworth low pass filter, is deduced. Lastly, the improved Butterworth low pass filter is analyzed. Compared with the conventional Butterworth low pass filter of the same order, the improved Butterworth low pass filter has rapider response, smaller overshoot. This kind of filter can be used to enhance the test precision.

articleTitle: An Improved Self-Adaptive Filter Based on LMS Algorithm for Filtering 50Hz Interference in ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we firstly introduce three conventional digital filtering methods and analyze their qualities of filtering. Then we use a new method based on self-adaptive digital filter and median filter for their defects, and simulate it. It is demonstrated that not only the noises are successfully restrained, but also the useful information is preserved as much as possible, and the performance of the new method is superior to the others.

articleTitle: An Optimal Lights Layout Scheme for Visible-Light Communication System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The visible-light communication is a novel kind of optical wireless communication utilizing the white LEDs. As compared with infrared indoor communication this system has high radiation power to enable high quality of service for the light is "visible". Generally, there are several plural lights installed in a room for sufficiently illuminating. So the layout of lights determining the distribution of received power is a key problem affecting the performance of visible light communication system. In this paper, the relation between the layout of lights and received power is studied and a best scheme is proposed to solve the design of lights layout, which is identified by simulation.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Network Based on IEEE 1451.0 and IEEE 1451.5-802.11
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes a wireless sensor network (WSN) based on the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)'s 1451.0, 1451.5, and 802.11 standards. The implementation of the IEEE-based WSN was developed at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). The WSN consists of two wireless nodes - the network capable application processor (NCAP) node and wireless transducer interface module (WTIM) node. In operation the NCAP node communicates wirelessly with the WTIM node using the IEEE 1451.0 and IEEE 1451.5 interfaces through the IEEE 802.11 wireless communication modules. In the paper two case studies illustrate the implementation of the request and response of the sensor data and transducer electronic data sheet (TEDS) using the client-server model. The work described provides a foundation and some guidelines for implementing a wireless sensor monitoring application based on the IEEE 1451.0 and 1451.5 standards.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of TEM Double Ridge Guide Horn Antenna
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A small dimension UWB (ultra wideband) TEM double ridge guide horn (DRGH) antenna, which operates between the frequency range of 0.1~1 GHz, is designed and optimized using the CST soft in this paper. By comparing three kinds of structure, the antenna size can be largely reduced through adjusting the ridge curve and ridge width. The results show that the optimized antenna has well-behaved broad performance in the band of 0.1~1 GHz.

articleTitle: Non-stationary Signals Processing Based on STFT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Simply introducing the define and algorithm of STFT, this article discuss the select of windows function and windows length of STFT when it was used in Non-stationary Signals, point out the specialty of some windows function, and examples of telemetry dates are adopted to validate it¤

articleTitle: Application of the Pockels Effect to High Voltage Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The traditional way to measure an electric field electrically disturbs the original field, so that can cause a number of measuring problems. Using a Pockels' crystal to measure an electric field has several advantages over electrical methods, such as interference from electromagnetic radiation, high sensitivity and wide frequency bandwidth. This paper presents a kind of new optical method for measuring electric voltage, current and power, and this new method makes the Sensing Technology on Pockels effect and optical Technology together. The study shows that this kind of method can be used to measure the electric voltage, current and power when the voltage is high and/or the current is large. And a comparison is made between transverse Pockels effect and longitudinal Pockels effect. Electric-optic effect voltage measurement system is designed based on longitudinal Pockels high-voltage measurement methods odotThese methods can applying to high-voltage levels up to 400 kV in a wide bandwidth between dc to30 MHz is developed. In addition, an excellent agreement is observed between the measured and predicted values.

articleTitle: An Audio Watermark Embedding Algorithm Based on Mean-Quantization in Wavelet Domain
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents an audio watermark embedding algorithm based on mean-quantization in DWT domain. It uses planar and binary image as watermark, and encrypts the binary image with chaos sequence. In this algorithm, the audio signal is decomposed using appropriate wavelet basis. Low-frequency coefficients are selected to embed watermark using mean-quantization method. The watermark can be extracted without the original audio signal. Experimental results show that compared with basic quantization watermark embedding algorithm, the algorithm presented in this paper is robust to many attacks, such as noise addition, MP3 compression, requantization, and the robust performance has been improved highly.

articleTitle: A Real Time Fingerprint Recognition System Based On Novel Fingerprint Matching Strategy
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Fingerprint based personal identification is becoming more and more popular in everyday life. Designing an accurate real time automatic fingerprint identification system is of great importance in many circumstances, and this question has attracted lot of scholar's attention. In this paper we present a new real time fingerprint recognition system based on a novel fingerprint minutiae matching algorithm. The system is developed to be applicable to today's embedded systems for fingerprint authentication, in which small area sensors are employed. The system is comprised of fingerprint enhancement and quality control, fingerprint feature extraction, fingerprint matching using a novel matching algorithm, and connection with other identification system. Experiment on FVC2002 database show this system is fast, accurate and suitable for the real time personal identification.

articleTitle: Efficient Wavelet Transform on FPGA Using Advanced Distributed Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Recently, wavelet transformation has shown itself as a useful tool in many fields. Due to the increasing important of this technique, there was a growing need to embed it into a real system. However, the computation-intensive nature obstructs its way for a lot of applications needing real-time control. By using high-density field programmable logic devices (FPGAs), the discrete wavelet transformation obtains higher processing speed and lower costs than other implementation methods. The polyphase filterbank structure and the improved distributed architecture are adopted in this paper, to speedup wavelet computation. Performance results show that the distributed arithmetic formulation results in a considerable performance gain.

articleTitle: An Effective Approach for the Noise Removal of Mud Pulse Telemetry System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Mud pulse telemetry is a method used for measurement-while-drilling (MWD) in the oil industry. Information (tool-face orientation, temperature, pressure etc.) which is modulated by means of pulse positioning modulation (PPM) is sent from the bottom of the well to the surface by means of pressure waves in the drilling fluid (the drilling mud). Due to the influence of kinds of noise, the noise removal before decoding is of great importance. Considering the drilling fluid pulse's depending on the position and the width of the pulse to transmit the information, after the description of the mud pulse telemetry system and the analysis of the received signal, a new method based on the digital filter to process the signal received from the down-hole to recover the useful signal is applied. The result and the decoding process indicate that all of the pump noise, the reflection noise and other random noise can be wiped off, and the received signal can be recovered effectively and decoded with low error rate.

articleTitle: Programmable Voltage Regulator Design based on Digitally Controlled Potentiometer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The traditional adjustable linear voltage regulator and switching regulator are both through adjusting the resistance value to change the output voltage. This method has the defaults of low accuracy and not convenience. Using the digital controlled potentiometer but the adjustable resistor, a programmable voltage regulator controlled by computer can be composed. The paper provided three design projects of programmable linear voltage regulator that composed by digitally controlled potentiometer. In the first design project the digitally controlled potentiometer is running in adjustable resistor mode. The second one is adjustable voltage divider mode. And the third design project is using the digital controlled potentiometer to realize the accurate adjust of the output voltage in a small range. Then the paper analyzed the voltage regulation range of the programmable voltage regulator and the stabilized voltage characteristic without load of the voltage regulator and the design note. It is often needed in the field of industry control that a kind of high efficiency, low output voltage digital controlled linear voltage regulator, which can be adjusted exactly in a small range. To meet the need, a kind of programmable accurate low dropout regulator is design by the digital controlled potentiometer and LDO (low dropout regulator). Finally a kind of programmable switching regulator is provided, which is composed by digital controlled potentiometer and adjustable buck mode switching regulator. The voltage regulator not only has the turn off function, which can cause the regulator into stand by mode with low power dissipation, but also the regulator has good protection circuit includes over current protection and overheat protection. The design projects provided are all of practical value.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the hardware platform based on the Nios soft-core processor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Programmability and flexibility are the trend of current electronic system. The Nios, a soft-core processor integrated in a FPGA chip, is characterized by its flexibility and programmability. Since its introduction in June 2000, Altera's Nios soft-core processor has rapidly been integrated in a wide range of applications. In this paper, design and realization of the hardware platform based on the Nios soft-core processor is discussed. The basic architecture and characteristics of the Nios soft-core processor are studied first. Then, on analyzing the requirement of the platform, the holistic design scheme of the hardware platform is given. The hardware platform consists of several functional blocks such as power, clocking, FPGA device, RS232 serial port, 10/100 Base-T Ethernet Port, memory, connector. The design of each functional block is presented in detail. Furthermore, some layout practices are pointed out. By practical rigorous test, the schematic circuit diagram is proved to be correct and the hardware platform is proved to be reliable and stable. This hardware platform is of great use in controlling and monitoring systems.

articleTitle: A Design of Embedded Terminal Unit Based on ARM and Windows CE
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Embedded system based on ARM has been widely used in many different fields. Windows CE is a real-time, multi-task operating system on 32-bit embedded processor. This paper introduced Windows CE embedded operating system, and how to build a platform for Windows CE embedded in a ARM9 microprocessor S3C2410, and also the design of Windows CE embedded applications. Based on ARM microprocessor and Windows CE operating system, using RS-232 serial port and ZigBee wireless data communications module, designed a terminal unit for the ZigBee wireless network locating system, with a friendly user interface. It can realize functions including: the information and data receiving, saving, processing and display, has advantages of high performance, low cost, and low power consumption, is an important component of the network locating system.

articleTitle: Design of Automobile Collision Avoidance Warning System Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a warning system for automobile collision avoidance based on LabVIEW. The procedure is designed by LabVIEW7.0. The system adopts FMCW radar sensor and high-quality data acquisition card. This system can monitor the distance and velocity forward vehicle. According to the run law of vehicle, a simple formula for safety distance is set up.lt can give the alarm when the collide danger is predicted, and it can assist the driver to brake control, thus some collision accidents will be avoided.lt is flexible to design the programme, the different signal processing algorithm can be inputted and the better programme can be selected.The paper given the design method and main test data.

articleTitle: Study of Myoelectric Prostheses Hand based on Independent Component Analysis and Fuzzy Controller
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Recently, blind source separation (BSS) by independent component analysis (ICA) has received attention because of its potential in many signal processing fields. In this paper, ICA is applied to the electromyography (SEMG) signal analysis. One side, the experiment shows that ICA can decompose SEMG signal and separate source and noise effectively. On the other, after SEMG has been reconstructed, a method of Spectrum Coefficient is adopted and a fuzzy controller is designed specially to control the adjustment of myoelectric prosthetic hand's movement. Many experiments show that some steady independent components always appear when muscle does the same tasks. This result will provide us with a promising method in the classification of muscle pattern recognition and the research on the Human-Computer Interface (HCI) technology.

articleTitle: UAV Servicing and Training System Based on VR and HLA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The servicing and training of UAV before are depended upon the real armaments. Lots of problems are in front of us such as high budget and narrow training content especially is low efficiency. Thus the UAV servicing and training system based on DIS and VR has been developed. We use Creator which developed by MultiGen-Paradigm Inc. to do modeling, Vega Prime to drive the environment and objects and HLA to do simulation design over system construction over the view of some type UAV virtual servicing and training system. The UAV servicing and training system based on virtual reality make the servicing and training easier and more convenience which is an important progress in comparison with the before.

articleTitle: Control Strategy and Simulation analysis of Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Optimizing of multi-energy powertrain control strategy was the key technique of hybrid electric vehicle. Three kind structure of HEV and their control strategy were investigated, series hybrid electric vehicle, parallel hybrid electric vehicle, and PSHEV. Considering about driving cycle of CYC_NEDC and CYC_HWFET, three control strategy such as electric assistant control, adaptive control strategy and genetic algorithms control were simulated based on advisor to analysis vehicle performance. The results of simulation indicated that the fuel consumption economics and exhaust character were improved by using genetic algorithms control. In CYC_NEDC, compared with electric assistant control, fuel consumption economics was improved 47.4%, HC decreased 6.2%, CO decreased 4.6%, and NOx decreased 7.7%. Compared with adaptive control strategy, fuel consumption economics was improved 20.4%, HC decreased 0.6%, CO decreased 29.5%, and NOx decreased 13.5%.In CYC_HWFET, same results were achieved.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: A New EVM Calculation Method for Broadband Modulated Signals and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

by Zhang Qijun, Xu Qinghua, Zhu Wei
in the Proceedings of the Eighth International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments, July 2007

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper contains significant portions of original text from the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"EVM Calculation for Broadband Modulated Signals"
by Michael D. McKinley, Kate A. Remley, Maciej Myslinski, J. Stevenson Kenney, Dominique Schreurs, Bart Nauwelaers,
in the Proceedings of the 64th ARFTG Conference, December 2004, pp. 45-52


To characterize the quality of wireless telecommunications system more efficiently and integrally, it is necessary to use error vector magnitude (EVM) to be the figure of merit. We describe a typical EVM normalization, and deduce its calculation process. We also have simulated EVM of various modulation types specified by the IEEE 802.11aTM-1999 standard from a given average symbol power based on the basic equation, and compared with the corresponding bit error rate (BER).

articleTitle: Time-difference Ultrasonic Wind Detection Methods Based on Cross-correlation Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A time-difference ultrasonic wind speed and direction detection method is introduced. The two transducers are operated on unilateral V-mode. After the up-stream and down-stream echo signal being sampled, interpolated and cross-correlated, the time-difference of the echo signal is gained in accordance with the peak of the echo signal's cross-correlated function. Through the time-difference, the wind speed and direction can be measured indirectly. The time-resolution of the echo signal is improved and the measure of the minuteness time-difference is realized by the data interpolation. The Wavelet Transform and Temperature Compensation are used to depress the environment noise and revise the error of the velocity of sound. The high detection precision and good statistic characters of the system had been proved with the experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Spindle Drive Control System of High Speed Winding Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: By means of analyzing principles of spindle drive of high speed winding machine for synthetic filament, four kinds of practical mathematical models of spindle drive are discussed in view of definition of linear density of synthetic filament, winding mass, measurement of actual rotating speed of contact roller and spindle as well as synthesis. At same time, control methods of computer control system are provided. Theoretical supports and effective measures are provided for putting into effect quickly in production process and ensure constant velocity winding. It is an important technology for high speed winding machine.

articleTitle: Verification of AMBA Bus Model Using SystemVerilog
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A verification environment to verify an ARM-based SoC (system-on-chip) by using system Verilog is presented in this paper. The new verification constructs can be easily reused for the objected-oriented feature of SystemVerilog. The paper also introduced how to design the AMBA (advanced microprocessors bus architecture) verification IP (intellectual property) by SystemVerilog, which include AHB (advanced high performance bus) master and AHB monitor. The verification IP can be reused to verify any AMBA protocol based SoC. To reduce the time spending in the verification, a reference model designing method is also discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Study of Adaptive PID Controller Based on Single Neuron and Genetic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is necessary to select the proportion weights and study speeds in the design of single neuron PID controller, and in order to improve its performance, a method utilizing genetic algorithm to optimize these parameters of single neuron PID controller is presented. And some developed genetic algorithm methods are proposed, such as combining roulette wheel selection with elitist selection, using adaptive crossing and mutation operator and great mutation probability strategy, so the efficiency of optimal is improved. The simulation results of an electro-hydraulic position servo control system using adaptive PID controller based on neuron optimization show that the genetic optimize algorithm can get better control characteristics, the problem that it is difficult to select parameters of single neuron PID controller is solved.

articleTitle: Research on 1-Wire Bus Temperature Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on 1-Wire bus technology, the 1-Wire bus temperature monitoring MicroLan was designed through using computer serial communication port, protocol transform chip DS2480 and 1-Wire bus digital temperature sensor DS18B20. The structure, character, ROM command, function command of DS18B20 and operating principle of DS2480B were analyzed. Consequently, the interface circuit between 1-Wrie bus and COM port is provided. At the same time, operating interface of 1-Wire bus temperature monitoring MicroLan was well designed by using the DLLs and API functions provided in the TMEX SKD by Dallas Corporation and taking DELPHI as developing tool. Finally, the existing problems and improving methods was put forward.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of AGC in Gas Ultrasonic Flowmeter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper proposes a new circuit of all-digital automatic gain control (AGC) in the gas ultrasonic flowmeter at first. The design is implemented on the EP1S40F1020 FPGA chip. A scheme, design of main function modules and test are given in the paper. This design can achieve 40dB dynamic range control, with advantages of high precision, high rangeability, little environment influence, good stability and excellent reliability. In order to achieve a larger dynamic range control, the circuits which are composed of all-digital AGC and analog AGC using AD8367 are proposed and tested. The result is when the input signal dynamic range is from -60dBm to 0dBm, the output fluctuation is under 3dB and the designed AGC system is more suitable for the demand of the gas ultrasonic flowmeter's real-time and high precision.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Data Acquisition System Based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Data acquisition plays an important role in the field of modern industry control. In many cases, remote data should be transferred to monitor center which is far from the manufacturing field. Traditional data acquisition system by wired means could not meet the needs. This paper presents a new data acquisition and analyzing system based on GPRS technology. The result of the experiment shows that system works well for data acquisition and wireless transferring based on GPRS rapidly which has a reference value for remote diagnosis, remote monitoring and so on.

articleTitle: Effects of the Solar Module Installing Angles on the Output Power
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the cost going down and encouragement from national energy policies, photovoltaic cells have become one of the most important energy resources for the future. The output power increment of photovoltaic cells is mainly based on two factors. One is decreasing the cell modular temperature and the other is increasing the cells' received solar illumination intensity. The former can be simply achieved by maintaining a proper radiating space between the modules and the ground. The later is more complicated. One needs to consider the installation of cell modules and then the maximum power output which can be derived. This paper will theoretically calculate the solar orbit and position at any time and any location. With the estimation of our model on the variation of solar illumination intensity, we can derive the output power of the solar modular cell at any tilt angle and orientation. The simulated results could be utilized in large-scale photovoltaic power generation systems when considering placement for optimal installation. It also provides a useful evaluation for the output power of photovoltaic cells mounted on roofs and outwalls of buildings.

articleTitle: A New Method of Weak Signal Detection Using Chaos Phase Change
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The method of the weak signal detection using the Duffing oscillator's initial conditions sensitivity was analyzed, the existing transition process would affect the detection capability. Then an improved method was presented. In order to compare this two method, the inputting false noise expression and the calculate step selection in simulation were researched, and the simulation models were established. This new method has better capability through analyzing the detection experimental results in the typical noise intensity background. The experiments shows that the Duffing oscillator in special critical chaos state is also sensitive to noise, which illustrates the difficulty in exactly deciding the minimal amplitude by state phase change, and the limitation of the phase change methods was discussed.

articleTitle: A Fast Harmonic Detection Method Based on Recursive DFT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper proposed a fast harmonic detection method based on recursive discrete Fourier transform, which is suitable for real-time calculation. The main features of the proposed method are that (1) it can be used to detect only specific harmonic components, (2) the recursive method needs few calculation, so harmonic detection and compensation can be implemented on-line, (3) spectrum update is implemented in a step larger than one sampling period to avoid over-sampling, (4) time-domain windowing has been taken into account to reduce spectral leakage caused by asynchronous sampling. These characteristics make the proposed method especially compatible with hybrid active filter, in which structure only specific harmonic components concerned are needed to be analyzed and harmonic compensation is implemented almost immediately.

articleTitle: Wireless Monitoring and Assessment System of Water Quality Based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the knowledge about today's systems of water quality auto-monitoring and managing at home and abroad, a wireless monitoring system of water quality based on GPRS has been designed in this paper. And the model for water quality state recognition is established by BP neutral network based on water monitoring data. The software for wireless monitoring and assessment system of water quality is developed by using C++ Builder language and Matlab. The database is developed by using Microsoft SQL Server 2000.The experimental results show that the developed system which combines the wireless communication technology with the monitoring technology can greatly improve the real-time and continuity for the water quality state monitoring.

articleTitle: A Genetic Training Algorithm of Wavelet Neural Networks for Fault Prognostics in Condition Based Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The main idea of condition based maintenance (CBM) is to monitor the health of critical machine components and system almost continuously during operation and maintenance actions based on the assessed condition. If done correctly, CBM has the benefits such as reducing catastrophic failures, minimizing maintenance and logistical cost, maximizing system security and availability and improving platform reliability. A CBM system usually has four major functional modules, namely feature extraction, diagnostics, prognostics and decision support. Among them, fault prognostics is the most important enabling technology. It is the most challenging research area which is so called crystal ball of CBM. But it has the potential to be the most beneficial. This paper presents a fault prognostic algorithm based on a generic wavelet neural networks (WNN) architecture. Its training process based on genetic algorithm is described in detail. Finally, the fault prognostic algorithm has been verified using a simulation experiment, and the results are very satisfactory.

articleTitle: Quick Sorting Algorithm of Matrix
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: On the basis of the quick sorting algorithm of one-dimensional array, the quick sorting algorithm of Matrix was provided. It is not recursion. Theoretical analysis and the results from a large number of experiments dealing with data showed that the average calculation time of the algorithm was O(nlog<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>n), and generally the required stack space was also O(log<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>n), which was an effective and reliable quick sorting algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Data Acquisition Equipment Based on USB
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Now, USB interface has became the most extensive interface in computer and computers' peripheral equipment. This paper introduces a design of data acquisition equipment based on USB. First it introduces the USB protocol, the structure and the function of the EZ-USB FX2 chip CY7C68013A and then this paper expatiates on the implementation of this data acquisition equipment in the aspects of both hardware and software.

articleTitle: Study on Accurate 3D Magnetic Field Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The existed magnetic field measurement systems have some shortcomings just as poor accuracy and automation. Most of them can only achieve one or two dimensions' measurement. The research of accurate 3D magnetic field measurement system is introduced. The 3D magnetic field sensor is made by six Hall devices which are attached to six surfaces of a cube respectively. The output signals of Hall devices are amplified by differential amplifiers and send to data acquisition system. The influence of the surround temperature to Hall device's input resistance is compensated using voltage proportional method which is achieved by sampling the Hall sensor's output voltage and the voltage drop on the sampling resistance alternatively. The measurement result is calculated from the proportion of them, thus constant current source is no longer necessary for the measurement system. Experiments prove that the system's error is 0.5 percent. The system is used to measure the magnetic fields of magnetic levitation vehicle.

articleTitle: Implement of Increment-model PID Control of PLC in Constant-pressure Water System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Because of the continuous change of surroundings temperature, the flux of cooling water should not be constant. Then the water undulation, direct ratio to the square of water flux, is so large that it can reach to the half of total head. It is means that much electric energy is wasted. In order to control the water pressure value and retrench power, the system introduces FX2 series programmable controller as kernel control unit, uses digital PID technique to control the output frequency of transducer automatically. One pump is driven by the transducer, others is driven by industrial electric network. When transducer's output reaches to the most but the power is shortage all the same, one pump will be driven by industrial electric network. If the total power is less than requirement, other pump will be start-up until the real water pressure reaches to set value. In this way, the electric energy will be retrenched.

articleTitle: Developing Trend of Industrial Fieldbus Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The evolvement of the industrial field control system is brief reviewed. Its main contents include intelligent device and instrument, distributed control system, fieldbus and industry Ethernet. In the past several years, the standard of Ethernet had been improved much especially on determination, speed and information priority. Industrial Ethernet has been combined with fieldbus and gradually infiltrate into the layer of industrial field devices. After stating the use of Ethernet in industry field and giving some examples, the paper comes to a conclusion: the combination of Ethernet and fieldbus is the future of industry automation.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Research on Piezoelectric Sensors Response to Dynamic Strain
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As one of new sensors, piezoelectric sensor has been gotten more and more interests in various fields such as mechanics, highway traffic, construction, air and sea transportation, etc, because of its special characteristics. The paper discusses the dynamic nature of piezoelectric sensor for measuring strain of structure. A method for low-frequency vibration measurement through dynamic strain measurement based on piezoelectric sensing is presented. The study involves theoretical analysis as well as experimental research on piezoelectric sensors response to dynamic strain. Dynamic response of piezoelectric sensor under different exciting frequency(from 0.1Hz to 40Hz) was tested, and experimental results with good precision were obtained. It shows that piezoelectric sensor has the characteristic of high sensitivity, wide frequency-response range and good linearity, which meet the requirement of low-frequency vibration measurement in engineering, and can be used for structure health monitoring.

articleTitle: Crosstalk Analysis and Simulation in High-Speed PCB Design
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: We discuss the necessary of crosstalk analysis in the process of high-speed PCB design and introduce the theory and characteristics of crosstalk. Several methods are concluded to weaken or eliminate the crosstalk, and these methods are proved to be effective through crosstalk simulation using Hyperlynx software.

articleTitle: Research on Intellectualized Fault Diagnosis System Based on Distributed Multi-Agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The fault diagnosis agent that integrate agent technology with fault diagnosis technology has become the important direction of currently intellectualized fault diagnosis technology, if we adopt agent simulates fault diagnosis expert of artillery command system, multi-agent system (MAS) simulates expert consultation group of artillery command system, then the intellectualized fault diagnosis system based on multi-Agent for artillery command system has already be set up. Multi-agent technology is applied to fault diagnosis domain of artillery command system. Intellectualized fault diagnosis system model based on MAS is set up. Multi-agent distributed intellectualized fault diagnosis system for artillery command system is designed. Fault diagnosis task decompose and control, correspond and cooperate among fault diagnosis agent key technology is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Shape Control and Active Vibration Control of Piezoelectric Composite Laminated Shell
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The shape control and active vibration control for the laminated shell bonded with piezoelectric sensors and actuators is researched in this paper. A set of vibration control equations, sensing equations and actuating equations are derived through using the finite element method and the modal theory for the piezoelectric laminated shell, then the model are converted into form of state space and transfer function. From the view of energy dissipation, the optimized placement of sensor and actuator units is analyzed with the genetic algorithm. From interdisciplinary view of structure dynamic and control, based on engineering background, considering defect and deficiency of conventional design method, structure and control integrated design is realized and the simulation platform is developed. Further, the active vibration control test for the advanced flexible composite barrel which is constituted with piezoelectric composite laminated shell is designed and developed. Experiment results demonstrate that the controller is able to suppress efficiently the flexible composite barrel's vibration with piezoelectric laminated shell unit, which establishes further the basis of integrated design and engineering implementation for the weapon assemblage system active vibration control.

articleTitle: Human's Health Monitoring SYSTEM Based on Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This system integrates sensing technology and radio frequency technique together, and puts a new method forward on the acquire of human's health parameters. Base on this method, a portable human's health parameters acquire system with low cost was designed. The precision in body heat measure is plusmn0.5degC and in blood pressure measure is plusmn1mmHg. Within an effective communication distance, the practical rate of inaccuracy of wireless transmission is 0%.

articleTitle: Design of Neural Network Output Layer in Fault Diagnosis of Analog Circuit
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we have developed a new way to design the output layer of neural network in fault diagnosis of analog circuit. The primary focus of our method is to simplify the network architecture while offering the value information of faulty component. A comparison of our work with reference indicates that our work ensures a robust and fast fault diagnosis in analog circuit including effects due to tolerances. The concepts of our work can be extended to detect multiple faulty components.

Index Terms: Output Layer Of The Neural Network

articleTitle: Wafer Defects Detecting and Classifying System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The wafer defects detecting and classifying system based on machine vision aims at inspecting macro wafer defects. After acquiring disk images using CCD, through digital images process we realized defects inspection and defects segmentation. Finally defects classification was achieved by neural networks. The experiment results prove that the proposed system features a strong background of specialty and can be applied into practice.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Testing Network for Power Line Fault Detection Based on nRF905
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The design scheme of automatic power line fault detection system based on wireless sensor network is proposed. The hardware architecture and software design based on nRF905 are also described in detail. The experimental results show that the system has the advantages of simple installation, high stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Calibration System for Thermocouple Application Based on Technology of Virtual Instrument and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Sensors of thermocouple is used in measure temperature system widely. However, the relation between thermocouple voltage E and temperature T, which is also called character of thermocouple, is non-linear. In automatic calibration system for thermocouple, means to realize transfer between thermocouple and temperature are method of tables and establish mathematical model of thermocouple character E~t. The paper combined technology of virtual instrument with neural network to found model on thermocouple character of E~t and the gradient descend algorithm with a momentum factor is used to adjust the parameters of RBF neural network. Then use it to measure thermocouple on-line. The paper introduces new methods about calibration system for thermocouple based on technology of virtual instrument. And it shows the hardware and software. Compare to conventional methods, it improves transfer precision, and applicable in practice.

articleTitle: Combined Terrain Aided Navigation based on Correlation Method and Parallel Kalman Filters
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As an important part of modern integrated navigation system, terrain aided navigation (TAN) compares measured terrain height with the onboard digital elevation map (DEM) to locate a vehicle's position. However, traditional TAN methods cannot work robustly when flying over flat terrain. This paper proposes a combined terrain aided navigation (CTAN) system, which incorporates the correlation method with the parallel Kalman filters. In this system, both the correlation method and the parallel Kalman filters are utilized to calculate the position by analyzing the difference between the DEM data and the set of height measurements, which is collected in real time. Two obtained position are used to correct the possible estimation error, caused by the repetitive characteristic of terrain or the noise of measurements. Compared with the TAN system uses only the correlation method, simulation results approve the proposed system can significantly improve the navigation performance.

articleTitle: Study on Real-Time Test-Bench of Speed Governor Using Matlab/xPC Target
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper the nonlinear simulation model of a turbocharged diesel engine is programmed in Matlab/Simulink, and then the simulation model is translated to real-time model by Matlab/xPC target toolbox, finally through I/O interface circuit the virtual engine and real speed governor are combined as a closed loop control system. The feedback debugging function which can reflect factually the speed governor characteristic of diesel engine is realized by the hardware-in-the-loop simulation in test-bench, so it can examine and adjust the performance of governor before installing it to the diesel engine. By using this test system, the efficiency and security of the speed governor testing work can be improved.

articleTitle: An Improvement Algorithm of Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The conventional method of principal component analysis (PCA) is reducing data dimensions directly from m to k (k<m) by one step. The lost information of PCA is holistically determined by the k. To reduce the lost information in the case of k is determined, we decrease the dimensions of the data from m to k by n(1≤n≤(m-k))steps. This new PCA method is called multi-step PCA (MPCA). The algorithm of MPCA is shown in the article. Two linear Neural Networks based on the PCA or MPCA is analyzed. Compared the PCA with MPCA and compared the numeric algorithm with Neural Networks, we find that the correct classification capability of MPCA is some better than the PCA and the correct classification capability o f Neural Networks is some better than the numeric algorithm.

articleTitle: EMI Reduction by Chaos in the Forward Converter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a voltage-model controlled forward converter circuit which is different from the previous investigated chaotic circuits. The power transformer is modeled in Pspice program. On basis of the model, we built a simulation circuit of the forward converter. When the converter is operated chaotically, the spectrum peaks of inductor current and capacitor voltage, especially in high frequency are greatly reduced and therefore EMC is apparently improved, compared with the periodic cases.

articleTitle: Realization of Home Remote Control Network Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Home automation control is the most important application domain of short distance wireless communication technical, this article describes the realization of home net gateway based on ZigBee protocol which is the new short distance wireless communication protocol, the home net gateway realizes the connection of low-rate wireless home network and Internet, user can control their home devices though the home net gateway. Based on analysis and experiment, the paper discusses the home wireless network technology based on ZigBee and its network topology, and demystifies the hardware and software design of home gateway and device nodes, at last, realizes the home remote control network based on ZigBee.

articleTitle: A New Inverter Output Passive Filter Topology for PWM Motor Drives
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper a new inverter output filter is proposed. The proposed filter is comprised of a conventional resistance, inductance, capacitance (RLC) network cascaded with an LC trap filter and an additive coil on the inductor of the RLC filter. The scheme is very effective in reducing the switching harmonics, suppressing the common-mode voltage and reducing differential-mode d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub>/d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub> . This paper illustrates and analyzes the common-mode and differential-mode equivalent circuit of the filter in detail. The voltage transfer functions of the differential-mode circuit and the common-mode equivalent circuit are analyzed. An engineering design method of the filter parameters is presented. The experiments with a conventional filter and the proposed filter are also done. The comparison verifies the proposed filter viability and effectiveness in eliminating in eliminating common-mode voltage and differential-mode d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub>/d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub> .

articleTitle: Design of Fuzzy PID Controller and Application in Glass Furnace
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the structure and feature of fuzzy logic controllers are described first, then a new type of the fuzzy PID(proportional- integral- derivative) controller is presented. The fuzzyPID controller has the simplest structure, but it has the nonlinear properties, which provide the fuzzy PID control system with a surperior performance over the conventional PID control system. The fuzzy PID controller is used in the temperture control of the glass furnace. The online runing results show that this projcet is rational and effective.

articleTitle: New dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithm for Ethernet PON
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: EPON is an emerging local subscriber access network that consists of low-cost point-to-multipoint fiber infrastructure with Ethernet. Because several ONUs use a single shared medium in EPON, it is important to control upstream traffic. An EPON allocates upstream bandwidth to ONUs using a request/permit mechanism. In this paper, we proposed a new DBA algorithm supporting priority ueues and fairness among the ONUs over EPON. At last we evaluate the performance of the proposed DBA algorithm through simulation results.From the simulation result, we have confirmed that our proposed DBA algorithm can reduce the average queue length in comparison to that of ETRI's DBA algorithm.

articleTitle: Development of a Display Platform of the AIS Information
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: AIS (automatic identification system), a new type of the radio navigation system at sea, can provide more target information than radar. It is very important how to make a desk officer intuitively observe the information so as to conveniently judge the motion tendency of the targets around own ship. We had developed a system of the AIS information display based on the platform of ENC (electronic nautical chart) by using Microsoft VC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup> software tool. The 6 bit encapsulated data from the AIS output interface were received and decoded. After being converted into ASCII code in the format, the AIS information was showed on the platform of ENC with both graphic and alphanumeric mode, complied with the international criterion. The results of a spot test show that the system has a lot of advantages including good interface and so on.

articleTitle: Design of the Measurement System of the Pump Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Pump plays a key role because it is an important device used to drain water in mine. It is very significant to keep it working normally. The flow velocity and the flux of the pump are the typical indexes that can indict its state. A measurement system that can measure these two indexes is designed to detect the state of the pump. The virtual instrument technology based on LabVIEW is used to build the software part of this measurement system. The ultrasonic sensor is also used in this system.
