Because of the use of this sensor, the pump can be detected without stopping working. The mathematical model of the correlation function for processing the discrete signal is built. The signal from the DAQ card is processed based on the model above. The value of the flow velocity and the flux is obtained. The precision and efficiency of the measurement are enhanced.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Thinning Algorithm Based on Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Thinning plays an important role in automatic fingerprint identification system (AFIS). This paper applies hit-miss transform which is based on mathematical morphology to fingerprint thinning, It proposes a new view on thinning algorithm based on the transform, and improves structuring element on the ground of predecessor's research, getting improved thinning effect.

articleTitle: Development of the Electric Energy Collection System Based on Embedded LINUX
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The energy remote terminal unit is the necessary equipment of the electric energy collection system. It has been an important part of the alteration in the power automation system with the energy data collection system of automated, reliable, maintenance convenient. This thesis is based on the design for energy remote terminal unit. In this thesis, the idea of real-time embedded system is applied in traditional energy data collection system. A design and implementation of energy remote terminal unit is proposed according to the requirement of the project, based on the real-time operation system Linux. The system may complete collect record monitor in real time the data of energy meter's and so on. The hardware is based on the signal board computer of industry CPU chip PC 104, Modularization hardware drive and function design, The software adopt embedded Linux operation system, the GPS module can decide time of the collecting system, guarantee accuracy of collecting time, the data which the system collected send to master server.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automatic Test Instrument for Digital Circuits Based on USB 2.0 Interface
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It proposes the design and implementation of an automatic test system for digital circuits based on USB 2.0 interface. It adopts EZ USB FX2 produced by Cypress Corporation as interface chip, the soft-configure function of EZ-USB makes it easy to realize function expand of the system. Isp MACH LC4512 produced by Lattice Corporation realizes the hardcore of system, we use Verilog HDL and ISPLEVEL platform to develop it. The whole system has many excellences, such as good adaptability, high reliability and so on.

articleTitle: Expert System for Radar Equipment Faults Diagnosis Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper puts forward a fault diagnosis expert system based on rough set theory on foundation of traditional radar equipment fault diagnosis; In order to solve the bottle neck problem in the expert system, which is difficult in acquiring completing knowledge. The systems starts from the decision table of historical fault data and reduces by rough set theory, and then construct the model for expert system knowledge. After it calculates diagnosis rule roughness degree, it determines the confidence degree. It uses the reasoning mechanism and fault cases database to implements dynamical maintenance of the knowledge database.

articleTitle: A System of Detection, Analysis and Diagnosis on Electromechanic Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A system of detection, analysis and diagnosis on electromechanic systems is introduced in this paper. It combines PCI-6025E and LabVIEW for Windows in order to construct the system that can detect, analyze and diagnose the potential, subtle or invisible problems in electromechanic systems that are in service. With FFT, cross correlation, Okay database and Problem Sample database, this system helps distinguish the mechanical problems from the electrical problems and even make a further diagnosis so as to prevent the hidden dangers related to the whole electromechanic system.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction Based on SVM and GA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new time series prediction method based on support vector machine (SVM) and genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed. At first, SVM is used to partition the whole input space into several disjointed regions. Secondly, GA is adopted to determine the parameter combination of the SVM corresponding to the partitioned region obtained above. At last, the different SVM in the different input-output spaces is constructed and used to predict time series. The simulation result shows that the multiple SVM achieve significant improvement in the generalization performance in comparison with the single SVM model.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Multi-UUT Parallel Test Task Scheduling Based on Multi-objective GASA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Parallel test is a new important feature of the future ATS (automatic test system). The optimized parallel test task scheduling is a key problem to the parallel test. In this paper, the genetic algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm are combined effectively to find the multi-UUT (unit-under-test) parallel test tasks array to suffice multiple objectives. The mathematical model and multiple objectives of the multi-UUT parallel test task scheduling are put forward first. Then the gene coding and genetic annealing operating methods are introduced. The result of simulation shows that the algorithm is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Image Process Technology to the Mouth of Beer Bottle Defect Inspection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The defect on bottle mouth is one of the most important defects of beer bottle. To eliminate unqualified bottles reliability, this work has developed a set of defects-inspected system based on digital image process technology. The results of experiments indicate that the system is provided with higher precision and speed, adapted to online detection.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on feedback Kalman Model of MEMS Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The time sequence analysis method, such as ARMA model, was usually adopted in creating drift error model for MEMS gyroscope. This model decreases drift error a lot by making use of Kalman filter algorithm based on ARMA model, but, at the same time, its dynamic feature will be depressed. In this paper, we proposal a novel Kalman method which change Q through feedback. Though this method has the same effect on static state, it improve dynamic performance greatly. We has implemented it on FPGAs, and has did some experiment research on one gyroscope, the result show that this method can improve static and dynamic feature simultaneously.

articleTitle: MEMS Gyroscope Performance Estimate Based on Allan Variance
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The performance of MEMS gyroscope is crucial to its application, and the zero-bias stability is the main characteristic parameter of gyroscope performance. In this paper, a method of using Allan variance is presented. Experimental results using this method with gyroscopes of different precision show that Allan variance is a reasonable tool to analyze the performance of MEMS gyroscopes. Through analyzing Allen variance, the performance of MEMS can be estimated with precision and a large amount of data is not necessary as with standard variance.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for line detection based on the Randomized Hough Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The Hough transform is an elegant way of extracting global features like line segments from binary edge images. However, long computation time and large memory requirements prevents it from being used for practical computer vision tasks. In this paper, we introduce a new randomized Hough transform to improve line detection accuracy and robustness, as well as computational efficiency. The method is based on the fact that choosing all feature points as seed points, and random picking a part of feature points for pairing with seed points, and corresponding accumulator cells are incremented in the space. The experimentation have proved that the new algorithm is more effective and robust than others.

articleTitle: A Method of Deleting Noise in A Binary Image Based on the Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the application of theoretical approach based on the mathematical morphology to binary image in deleting noise is introduced. Two binary images consisting of noises are processed by this method. The effectiveness of the approach is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: A MAC Protocol for Underwater Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: There exists an increasing demand for reliable, high capacity underwater sensor networks. Application interests include oceanographic information acquiring, environmental monitoring, and coastal defense. A multi-channel media access control (MAC) protocol used for underwater acoustic channel which improves the network efficiency by using RTS-CTS exchange is presented. Simulation tests on OPNET modeler show that, its network communication performance is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Study on Moving Object Tracking Algorithm in Video Images
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Moving object tracking algorithm in video images is studied. Mean shift is optimization algorithm based on gradient descended, which tracks moving object through iteration. While particle filter is a robust method of tracking in non-gauss and non-linear case. Considering the excellence and disadvantage of mean shift and particle filter algorithm, a tracking algorithm based upon the two methods is proposed. Experiments show that the method can tracking moving objects efficiently, even in the situation of occlusion.

articleTitle: Researches on Digital Image Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To meet well the requirements of transparence, robustness, and security of digital image watermarks at one time, the scrambling technique of digital images and discrete wavelet transform have been organically combined, the watermarking technique of digital images in wavelet transform domain has been seriously studied according to the basic characteristic of human visual system. The performances of the embedding and extracting algorithm of watermarking images are mainly discussed in two cases, namely the watermarked image resists the disturbing of Gaussian white noise and being cropped. To successfully extract the watermarking image from the watermarked image disturbed and attacked, some effective measures should be taken for the embedding and extracting algorithm of the watermarking image, and the preprocessing of the watermarked image disturbed and attacked.

articleTitle: Application of NN-PI Controller in Direct Current Motor Servo System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In motion control, static friction coming into being nonlinearity in actuator results in the tracking error when speed or moment turns around. It is difficult to eliminate as usual. Neural network can self-learn and approach to any nonlinear function at any given precision, so it can be used to deal with such problem. In this paper the friction phenomenon is analyzed and the friction model given. A friction compensation method based on BP neural network is presented. Neural network identifier and neural network compensator are trained with input and output data acquired from servo motor and compensator is connected with PI adjustor in parallel. So measurement results are compared with results adopting fuzzy-PI algorithm. Application in DC motor servo system indicates that this method improves further the system responding speed, and improves the tracking precision accordingly.

articleTitle: Calibration of Time-Skew Error in a M-Channel Time-Interleaved Analog-to-Digital Converters
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Offset mismatch, gain mismatch, and time-skew error between time-interleaved channels limit the performance of time-interleaved analog-to-digital converters (TIADC). This paper focused on the time-skew error. A new technique for calibrating time-skew error in M-channels TIADC is developed, and simulation results are also presented.

articleTitle: Design of three-phase SPWM signal generation system based on soft-switch technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A three-phase SPWM signal generation system based resonant DC link inverter (RDCLI) soft-switch is designed on the basis of our previous design work of three-phase SPWM signal generation system chip. The control method of RDCLI in soft-switch SPWM converter is given by researching the principle of resonant synchronous signal, which is the key theory for the design. According to the controlling method of RDCLI and the system structure of three phase SPWM signal generation system chip, the whole system structure based on soft-switch technology is designed. Each module and the system are stimulated functionally. Based on Chartered 0.35um technology synthesis library ASIC physical design is performed, the post simulation results show that the output signal has 10.788ns delay time than system clock edge as adding gates and wire delay, which meets the system timing requirements. The whole system specification reaches the design requirements, and the area of chip is 4.502mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Combining FFT and Circular Convolution Method for High Dynamic GPS Signal Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: GPS signal acquisition is very crucial in GPS receiver. The circular convolution and FFT method are often used to achieve GPS signal acquisition in time domain and frequency domain, respectively [1]. FFT acquisition method is usually adopted in high dynamic GPS receiver because of its faster process speed than circular convolution. But FFT acquisition spent more time to get GPS signal in order to reach the higher requirement of position precision, when the carrier has larger dynamic range. This paper discusses a new method combined FFT and circular convolution. This new method can reduce the cost time of acquisition.

articleTitle: Design of a Composite Video Signal for DVD Recorder Measurement System Based on Virtual Instrument Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a new source video signal is designed for online DVD evaluation and then its composite video signal waveform is produced through a video waveform generator board PXI-5431. The composite video field, no matter NTSC or PAL system it is, includes both visible image and invisible lines. The visible image has been set to different patterns, and the invisible lines include three lines such as copy once, auto clock setting and electronic program guide. Detailed procedures to produce both parts are well illustrated and the virtual instrument blocks in G-language are also presented.

articleTitle: Power Reduction in BIST Design Based on Genetic Algorithm and Vector-Inserted TPG
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A test pattern generator (TPG) for reducing power consumption during built-in self-test (BIST) application is proposed. It consists of an n-stage linear feedback shift register (LFSR) and some control logic, which makes the actual clock frequency of the LFSR become 1/m that of the original one, thereby, lowering the transition density at the LFSR. Thus, (m-1) vectors are inserted between successive test patterns generated by the original LFSR, during the cycles when the LFSR is unactuated. The number of inserted vectors and the location where some bits change between successive vectors are achieved by using optimization based on genetic algorithm (GA). Experimental results based on the ISCAS'85 benchmark circuits were reported to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on reducing the peak power consumption, and also on reducing the total power and the average power consumption, without losing stuck-at fault coverage.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Based Scheduling for Batch Process
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new approach to schedule batch process using a cooperative multi-agent system was proposed. The architecture of the system was developed and the cooperative problem solving process for online batch process scheduling using the multi-agent system was described. Finally, a practical application of the system was present. Research work shows that the proposed method can find an optimal scheduling plan according to the requirements posed by customer and can modify the scheduling plan online.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Fire Alarm System Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: CAN bus is one kind of serial communication bus which support distributed control and real time control effectively. In this paper, an intelligent fire alarm system based on CAN fieldbus technology and multi-single-chip-computer communication system is introduced. CAN (controller area network ) is a fast serial bus that is designed to provide an efficient, reliable and economical link between fire detect sensors and fire control actuator, some intelligent algorithm or methods are adopted in the system to solve these problems, which miss alarm and error alarm are two difficult problems in the current fire alarm system. By use of the new technology of CAN fieldbus and single-chip-computer technology, Hardware circuit and software design for intelligent node SJA1000 based on CAN and fire detector are given. The designs of structure for network, parameter assignments for network and communication protocols are described in detail.

articleTitle: Detection of Amplitude-varied Weak Signal by Genetic Adaptive Stochastic Resonance Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: For the important role that adaptive stochastic resonance plays in weak signal detection, an adaptive stochastic resonance algorithm with genetic algorithm is proposed. Furthermore, the algorithm is optimized by using niche technique and 'cross generational elitist selection' technique. The paper gives the realization steps of the algorithm and its simulation. The results of experiments indicate that the frequency of carrier in the weak amplitude modulated signal can be recognized through the algorithm. The problem that the time-varied amplitude signal cannot be detected by traditional algorithm is resolved so as to extend the application scope of adaptive stochastic resonance in engineering realization.

articleTitle: A Research about the Temperature Compensation of Hall Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Hall sensor is made based on Hall effect. Because of electric field, semiconductor interior conducts. When exterior magnetic field exists, Lorentz force compels originally directional moved electron excursing and electron accumulates on one side of semiconductor. An electromotive force which is called Hall electromotive force comes into being. According to the theory, measuring magnetic can be realized. But the conductance and excursion trait of semiconductor are affected easily by the temperature. The inner resistance and the output of Hall sensor change along with the change of the temperature. The article studies the temperature character of Hall sensor. At the same time, design and use temperature compensation circuit to reduce the temperature influence, which can make the output more precise.

articleTitle: Research on Gyroscope Free Strapdown Inertial Navigation System Based on 3-axis accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Gyroscope free strapdown inertial navigation system is introduced in this paper; and a new strapdown scheme based on 3-axis accelerometers (mainly to ADXL330) is put forward. At the last of this paper, this allocation scheme is compared with traditional scheme of several single axis accelerometers.

articleTitle: Application of Digitally Controlled Potentiometers in the Intelligent Sensor's Measure and Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Sensor or transducers is a kind of important tool for completion of signal collection, and is a device which can feel the physical world of light, pressure, temperature, flow, level, acceleration, force, etc. Then convert this signal into usefulness output signal according to a certain law. The output of some sensors, such as piezoresistive sensor, strain sensor bridge sensor, thermocouple sensor, thermal resistance sensor, angle sensor, accelerometer sensor, humidity sensor, capacitive sensor, piezoelectric sensor etc., is very weak. Its temperature dependence and linearity are worse, and the SNR in the process of transference decrease significantly. For this disadvantage, the signals must be processed before post-processing. It can be realized by the digitally controlled potentiometers. In the fiber receiver, photodiode programmable transimpedance amplifier with digitally controlled potentiometers converts the current into voltage. Using the digitally controlled potentiometers, it can be linear that the characteristic of the platinum thermal resistance temperature sensor (including zero adjustment and full-range adjustment) and fault detect, and it can meet the request of accurate temperature measurement. The digitally controlled potentiometers also can be used in pressure measurement system to calibrate the offset voltage and full-range of the pressure sensor. Finally, the topology with feedback system constituted by digitally controlled potentiometers was provided.

articleTitle: DOA Estimation Methods Using Weighted Subspace Fitting Technique Based on Immune Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Weighted subspace fitting technique can eliminate coherency between the signal sources, so it is effective to noncoherent signal and coherent signal and the iteration method is often adopted to search DOA. But this method has large amount of computation and the slow search speed. So evolutionary algorithm is introduced to the solution of weighted subspace fitting technique. Evolutionary algorithm is a computation model to simulate evolution process of creature, and it adopts crossover and mutation to provide optimizing chance or evolution direction, but degradation is inevitable in common evolutionary algorithm. If immune concept is introduced to evolutionary algorithm, degradation phenomenon can be restrained in the optimizing process under the condition of reserving excellent characteristics of original algorithm. So using immune evolutionary algorithm to search DOA in weighted subspace fitting technique can reduce search time and quicken search speed, and in the end the simulation results validate that this algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Long-wave Irregularity Detection of High-speed Maglev Track
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a method of detecting the long-wave track irregularity of Transrapid (TR) high-speed maglev based on inertial measuring principle. With this method, an acceleration signal, a velocity signal and a gap signal are required. The acceleration signal and the gap signal were sampled at an equal space interval controlled by the velocity signal. A double integration filter was used to transform the acceleration signal to a displacement signal. And a variable linear phase IIR filter was designed to extract the waveform of long-wave irregularity from the measuring waveform. The test result proves that this method is practicable for detecting long-wave track irregularity of high-speed maglev accurately, the measuring result is also immune to the variation of speed from 150 km/h to 430 km/h, and a single parameter is needed to adjust when extracting various waveforms of long-wave irregularity.

articleTitle: Application of Information Fusion Technology in the Remote State On-line Monitoring and Fault Diagnosing System for Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This research focuses on the development of the on-line state monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on the information fusion technology for the power transformer during its running. In order to improve the fault diagnosis accuracy, a new fault diagnosis model combining the on-line monitoring of five characteristic gases dissolved in transformer oil with the feature extraction of three-dimensional temperature field of power transformer is put forward, which can realize fusion of the multivariate fault information of power transformer and improve greatly the fault diagnosis accuracy of the power transformer based on the information fusion technology. Besides, an embedded on-line state monitoring and fault diagnosis system composed of ARM and DSP is designed for the power transformer in this paper. In order to realize remote communication, a new method of data wireless transmitting based on General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) is designed. Finally, Simulation experimental results show that the developed embedded system can effectively monitor the state of the power transformer during its running and diagnose its fault. Therefore, the developed on-line state monitoring and fault diagnosis system will change the existing maintenance and repair pattern for power transformer and realizes accurate diagnosis or forecasts faults of transformer intelligently.

articleTitle: An XML-Based Software Non-Functional Requirements Modeling Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper focuses on the lack of software non-functional requirement describing methods during software design phase. A software non-functional requirements describing model is built up. The model is made up of three templates, namely attributes, constraints and operations templates. On this basis, the software non-functional requirements data model structure is defined using XML Scheme and an integrated software development process was studied, which can deal with software non-functional requirements. Lastly an example was studied and the example showed that the methods can help software designer define a clear and rational software non-functional requirements specification.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction of Hyperspectral Data Based on ISOMAP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a new manifold learning method to reduce the dimension of hyperspectral data is proposed. In this method, ISOMAP algorithm is used to extract the inherent manifold of hyperspectral data to transform the high-dimensional space into a low-dimensional space. Experiments show that the method is effective, meaningful, and provides a new way for reducing the dimension of hyperspectral data while expands the application area of manifold learning in the hyperspectral data processing filed.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of the ELVE Intelligent Electrical Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: AHDI (Automotive High-energy Dry Ignition-Coil) discussed in this paper is a new type production of modern automotive electrical equipment. The process of epoxy-resin liquid vacuum encapsulation is the important link of AHDI's manufacturing and shaping. Therefore, fault diagnosis setting based on BP-NN (Back Propagation-Neural Networks) is used in the intelligent pouring electrical control system in order to ensure processing quality. Strict real-time monitoring and control is carried on through the whole pouring process to ensure the pouring process operating in the faultless condition and so make sure the quality of the AHDI products reliably.

articleTitle: Condition Residual Life Evaluation by Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is more and more important to predict the condition residual life according to the condition information of the equipment in order to make scientific and exact maintenance decision in modern production and defense construction. Currently the adopted models in the on-condition maintenance field are proportional hazards model (PHM) and filtering model. Both of them have complex forms and complex calculation process, the estimation of parameters is established on an amount of sample. However support vector machine (SVM) is a new machine learning method. It has the characters of simple structure, excellent learning capability and fitting in small sample. It also can transfer the problem to the square regression problem. So it can get the best resolution in the public area. SVM is extended to the application of the regression estimation of system. Therefore, SVM is adopted in the condition residual life regression. And the algorithm of the realizing this method is proposed. Finally the predicted result of the example adopted SVM show that SVM can better solve the same kind of problem.

articleTitle: Error Analysis and Compensation of Three-axis Strap-down Magnetometers
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Three-axis strap-down magnetometers can be used to determine the magnetic heading angle. The magnetometers are widely being employed in vehicle navigation systems. But the precision is enormously affected by additional magnetic field, which is generated by ferrous material and electric devices in the vehicles. In this paper, the basic principle calculating the magnetic azimuth of the body according to outputs of magnetometers is introduced. Then the paper provides the analysis about the error of the magnetic azimuth and the relationship of the error and the interferential magnetic field. The compensation method is also presented and the experimental result shows that the method is effective.

articleTitle: High Precision Multi-frequency Multi-function Receiver for Electrical Exploration
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Pseudo-random multi-frequency (PRMF) signal's bandwidth is controllable, its energy concentrated on several frequencies, which equally spaced on log-scale coordinate, and it is used as excitation for electrical exploration to improve the working efficiency. To realize high precision data acquisition and processing of pseudo-random signal in electrical exploration, PRMF multi-function receiver for electrical exploration is developed. This receiver adopts up-to-date electronics and technology, such as low-power Pentium-166 PC/104 embedded industrial computer, 24-bit CS5321/5322 A/D converter module, high reliable Actel anti-fuse FPGA, 32-bit data acquisition and processing software based WINDOWS operation system, adaptive correlation synchronization, weak signal detection based on cross-power, digital filter de-noising, and so on. Above measures make the receiver owns the advantages of fast signal processing, large dynamic range, lightweight, easy usage, good anti-interference ability, ability to receive PRMF signal and rectangular wave. It can carry out major electrical exploration methods, such as resistivity method, induced polarization method (time and frequency domain), complex resistivity method, controlled source audio magnetotelluric (CSAMT) method, and so on.

articleTitle: Instrument for Compensating hole of Brake Cylinder Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Measuring instrument for compensating brake master cylinder is mainly to measure the place, dimension and figure of the compensated hole and at the same time to measure the quality of machining and foundry by image for inner exterior of brake master cylinder. The measuring instrument adopt high differentiate rate image technique of CCD and using high precision's drive framework to finish the measure assignment. It has some virtues, such as easy to handle, precision is high, automatous degree is good, and eliminate the influence of subjective complication. It is high-powered exactitude measuring instrument which gathered optics, mechanics, electronics and computer language. The measuring instrument for compensating brake master cylinder is made up of computer data acquire and process system, control system, CCD system, optical grating bit shift sensor and micro-machine drive system. The whole system adopt human-computer interactive measurement, when the cylinder was retracting, we can install the workpiece to be measure to orientation fixture, and then the cylinder hold out and compaction the workpiece to be measure. To the effect that the orientation surface of workpiece to be measure can close to orientation fixture, then the step motor drive ball leading screw circumgyrate, then drive the endoscopy to move, meanwhile worm gear drive the bar circumgyrate, bases on the result of image CCD, then confirm the place of sampling point, note the information of grating ruler, save the quality information of cylinder inner exterior, by way of the member content of the date-base.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Approach of Analog Circuits Based on Genetic Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The selection of parameters and structure are critical for wavelet neural networks (WNN) when they are used for fault diagnosis. Genetic algorithm is presented to optimize the structure and the parameters of WNN in the training process because of its good ability of global optimization. This method solves the main problem of easily falling into local extreme minimum to cause slow convergence when the classical gradient descent algorithm is employed for training WNN. A three-layer network trained with genetic algorithm is applied to fault diagnosis of analog circuits. Simulation results show that WNN adopting this scheme achieves a comparatively simple structure and fast convergence. It has excellent capability of fault identification and diagnosis for analog circuits. Comparing with non-genetic WNN with same structure, the proposed approach gains better diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: Using High Performance Spectrum Analyzer to Measure Residual AM of Signal Generator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The traditional method of measuring the residual AM is to use modulator analyzer or measuring receiver with the function of demodulation option to measure it directly for its simplicity and convenience. This paper interprets the definition of residual AM and proposed the way that is using to measure the residual AM with the condition that PSA once has fairly low Displayed Average Noise Level, good Resolution bandwidth switching uncertainty and absolute amplitude accuracy .The example is given that how to measure the residual AM of signal of Agilent 8648C Signal Generators using Agilent E4447A PSA. Evaluation and expression of uncertainty in the measurement of residual AM are also showed. Contracted with Agilent 8902 Measuring Receiver with the function of demodulation option, using high performance PSA to measure the residual AM is available.

articleTitle: A Multistage Interactive Track Algorithm for W-FOV System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: We present a real time multistage interactive track algorithm for wide field of view staring infrared system. Algorithm contains three main stages: a simple track according correlation, a fine track base on content and a screener served for both. If track mission is easy, the first simple track runs. If it couldn't track effectively, the second fine track will take over. Screener judges which track stage run, saves all possible targets and information for more track. Algorithm adjusts operational flexibility according different track situation. Finally, algorithm was demonstrated via simulation of real infrared image sequences. Results show that the performance of the fine track is better than the simple track. This interactive algorithm can work effectively and be robust for more widely using.

articleTitle: Method for Separating Multiplicative Noise Sharing a Common Band with Desired Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is hard for the traditional homomorphic filtering technique to deal with the multiplicative noise effectively as its frequency band is overlapped with the one of desired signal. A novel method is proposed that is able to separate multiplicative noise from observed signal even though they share a common band completely. The method integrates the basic idea of homomorphic transform with the advantages of partial time-domain coherence algorithm in separating linear-mixed signals. It works by taking logarithmic operation first to observed signal, a mixture of the signal and noise, and then applying partial time-domain coherence algorithm to it in order to analyze the power proportion of each separated component. The results of computer simulation experiments have shown that the separation of orthogonal multiplicative signals can be very accurate, and the separation of partial nonorthogonal signals or random multiplicative noise are still acceptable.

articleTitle: AIS Information Display System Design Based-on the Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Existing shipborne AIS (Automatic Identification System) based on the text mode, the larger the amount of information, is not conducive to visual observation of the ships around, this paper presents a graphical interface for information display way. The paper adopts the method of AIS information display system with embedded system to explain system's hardware architecture and interface, analyzes the key software technology at the same time and gives a result.

articleTitle: Constitutive Relations and Scattering Characteristics of General Bi-Isotropic Objects
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper discusses Different constitutive relations of generalized circular polarization in chiral media by using Maxwell's equations. In a chiral medium for fields with generalized circular polarizations, the Maxwell equations and constitutive relations have the same form in the achiral medium, but the equivalent material parameters differ for field with different circular polarization. Thus a wave of circular polarization (left or right) propagates with the same wave number regardless of its direction of propagation. In this paper, electromagnetic scattering characteristics by general bi-isotropic objects are investigated based on the surface integral equations. By applying the surface equivalent principle, electromagnetic fields inside a homogeneous bi-isotropic region can be represented in terms of equivalent electric and magnetic currents distributed over its boundary surface.

articleTitle: A Measurement System With Wide-Range High-Input Resistance and Float Input
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: There are two problems to be met often in the measure practice of AC and DC voltage, one is that the input resistance of the measurement circuit would divide the input source voltage measured. Another is the short circuit destruction and common-ground disturbance caused by the common-ground between the measurement circuit and the source voltage measured. Aiming at the two problems above, the authors had designed a floating ground measurement system with high-input resistance, which divide the ±1000V into four ranges and convert every range within the range of ±5V in order to meet the need of most of the A/D converters for input voltage range. The input resistance is greater than 10GΩ when the input voltage is less than 50V and 1MΩ the input voltage above 50V. There are wide applications in measurement and instruments, specially, in the design of signal acquisition units controlled by computer.

articleTitle: A Study of Data Processing Based on SDH Measurement and Control Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With increasing demands of bandwidth and quantity on test and control network, it's necessary to find more efficient transmit ways. This article introduces construction of test and control network based on IP over SDH firstly. By analysis of transmit structure and protocol stack, several keys of information processing are pointed. After processing, the concerned information on the test and control network can be identified and picked up from the SDH frame directly. Furthermore a system module designed with FPGA is proposed.

articleTitle: Research of Precision Farming Expert System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The research, designing and implement of the precision farming expert system was introduced in this paper. With agro-technology, scientific research result and specialist's experience were united with computer technology by GIS technology, we established a comprehensive precision farming expert system which having high intelligence, the domain knowledge and the way of analyze and solve problem of expert will be popularized and inherited. This system has the ability of analysis, forecast and aided decision-making, moreover could draw up different special topic diagrams and synthesis diagrams, so attain the aim of guiding agricultural yield.

articleTitle: Research on fuzzy diagnosis Expert System of electronic control engine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the character of the Electronic control engine, Diagnosis Expert System of Electronic control engine was developed based on commix fuzzy reasoning. The system includes Knowledge base, Reasoning machine, Explain system, management system. Considering about fuzzy relation between fault cause and symptom, commix fuzzy reasoning diagnosis method was set up by means of fuzzy synthesize judge. Knowledge of expert was expressed as three parts: Fault Symptom, System's Fault and Part's Fault. On-Board-Diagnosis method and general measure instruments method worked together in the system, and by utilizing commix fuzzy reasoning method, complex fault's diagnosis become efficient. By using Diagnosis Tree method, the causes of faults can be found in best way, with high distinguishing rate, low error diagnosis rate and least cost. By means of Waveform Analysis diagnosis method, abundant information about fault can be acquired accurately as waveform by measuring. And by basic character of waveform's main observation point, cause of a fault and Certainty Factor can be achieved. By utilizing commix fuzzy reasoning diagnosis method and Diagnosis Tree method and Waveform Analysis diagnosis method, fault orientation became more convenience.

articleTitle: Portable Data Acquisition System Based on CompactFlash Interface
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel portable data acquisition (DAQ) system based on CompactFlash (CF) interface is designed. In the system, FPGA (field programmable gate array) is used as CF interface controller and DAQ controller. CF interface controller transfers data between client and host (PDA), DAQ controller selects measurement scale and controls A/D converting. PDA accesses client's data across CF interface, sends instructions to client such as measurement scale select word and DAQ parameter, data are sent to host in interrupt mode and then processed. The experimental results proves the successful implementation of DAQ, processing, display and control, and the data received by the host show that the largest relative error is 1.067% for amplitude measurement and 1.230% for frequency measurement.

articleTitle: Study on Viscosity of Jet Fuel by CCD Near Infrared Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The analysis of viscosity in 50 jet fuel samples was studied using CCD near infrared spectroscopy. The NIR data were pretreated by the second derivative, and the calibration models were built using the partial least square (PLS) in the region of the 700-1 100 nm wavelength. High coefficients of correlation were obtained between the CCD near infrared spectroscopy prediction and those obtained from traditional chemical method. The result shows that the precision obtained through common chemical methods is almost the same as the one through CCD near infrared spectroscopy. The standard error of calibration (SEC) were 1.456, the determination coefficient (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) were 0.8321. This technique is well suitable for rapid quantitative determination of the Viscosity of jet fuel, and is simple, cheap, and can present real time result.

articleTitle: Measurement Permanent Volumetric Expansion Ratio for Gas Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The permanent volumetric expansion ratio is one of the most important parameters in quality estimating of the gas cylinders, and the correctness and accuracy are dependent on the measuring device, which can be improved by the device technical level and weakening the environment influence. In this paper, it discusses the principle and composition of computer-controlled system. The experimental results show that the permanent volumetric expansion ratio tests of the gas cylinder by computer-controlled are more efficient and higher precision than the traditional manual control test and easy to operate; the pressure measurement error is at the range 0. IMPa, volumetric expansion measurement error is at the range 0. lml.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Control in CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is very necessary of power control in wireless cellular data networks for the complexity of the radio communication environment and the scarcity of the wireless resource. To carry out power control for more benefit, this paper presents the cost function which is relevant to the multiple address disturbance and the distance between a terminal and its base station, furthering the primary work of Goodman. Simulation results show that the superior performance of the cost function based power control scheme over the traditional method.

articleTitle: Network Multi-parameters Medical Treatment Monitoring Instrument Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This system is a sickroom multi-parameter monitor based on S3C44BOX ARM7 chip of Samsung. It transforms physiological parameters of a patient to standard electrical signal through sensor of blood pressure, pulse and temperature, and then sends the signals to dealing instrument after A/D conversion. In this system, the physiological parameters of a patient are shown on LCD after deal, stored in flash memory in a fixed form and sent to remote computers through TCP/IP Network. Users can configure the system through keyboard, for instance, setting IP address, storage time, transfer time and system time. The system can also show real-time data of each physiological parameter at the same time or one subentry at one time according to the requirement of users.

articleTitle: Determination of Optimal Air/Fuel Ratio and its Control Using CBR Methodology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Optimal air over-plus coefficient is one of the most important technical parameters in hot blast stoves combustion process. This parameter is usually measured with some hardware instrumentations. But this kind of instrumentation is very expensive and difficult to be maintained. So a novel method for determining the optimal range of air/fuel ratio according to off-line or on-line data of the on-gas phase was proposed after analyzing the huge amount of data accumulated on the control system of hot blast stoves. With the optimal combustion efficiency as its control target, a new kind of experience-based AI control algorithm using CBR methodology for the air/fuel ratio control of hot blast stoves was developed and implemented.

articleTitle: Fitting System Using Loop Subdivision Surfaces for Distributed Mesh Generation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: We propose a fast method of generating an approximate polygonal mesh from an implicit surface. Current workstations are still not capable of producing polygon meshes fast enough for the interactive modelling of complex implicit models. In this paper we first of all give overviews of our implicit polygonization and sub-division surface techniques. Our approach is to minimize an energy function that explicitly models the competing desires of conciseness of representation and fidelity to the data.

articleTitle: Path Delay Fault Design For Test and Testability Analysis of Conditional Sum Adders
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Conditional sum adders (CSA) are kinds of high-speed adders and the existing delay faults have crucial influence on their performance. Detail path delay fault testability analysis is proposed and a design-for-test scheme with low overhead and low size of test set is presented which can guarantee single path propagating hazard-free fully robust path delay fault testability of CSA. This is the strictest requirement for path delay fault testing. Based on the scheme, a test set of minimal size is derived by exploiting its structural property and parallel testing.

articleTitle: Quality Inspection System of Ammunition Based on VXI-bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the author summed up the characters of VXI-bus and the importance of this technology applied for ammunition was analyzed. Having presented the characters of ammunition testing work, an inspection system of ammunition based on VXI-bus is introduced. The construction and function of such system are shown. The design method of hardware and software of this system is introduced in detail. This system based on VXI-bus is of high capability and versatility, which may do great help to the reliability of ammunition quality testing work.

articleTitle: Research on Moisture Measurement of Sinter Mixture with Standing Wave Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The moisture content is important to produce quality and optimum production conditions for sinter mixture processing. The standing wave method of microwave is used to measure sinter mixture moisture and a helpful conclusion is advanced. The measurement of standing wave could realize by the determination of standing wave maximum value at stable position through a large amount of experiments and detecting device could be decreased largely. This makes the standing wave method feasible in moisture measurement.

articleTitle: Investigation and Progress of Micro-Spectrometer's Light Splitting System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It becomes possible to micro spectrometers with the development of micromachining techniques such as MEMS (Micro Electro Mechanical Systems). According to different dispersive elements used by micro spectrometers, the paper mainly illuminates the principle and fabrication technology of typical micro spectrometers whose dispersive elements adopt silicon micro grating, filter and Febry-Perot resonant cavity. The paper briefly summarizes the advantages, disadvantages and application of the micro spectrometers. In addition, it shows the interrelated parameter indexes of these micro spectrometers. Many potential applications where needing poor resolving power of wavelength are predicted. The development tendency of micro spectrometers is also presented.

articleTitle: Non-uniform Sampling Signal Spectral Estimation of Tire Pressure Monitoring System Using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Abnormal tire pressure can be detected in many ways. One method is to monitor the tire's response vibration caused by the stochastic ground excitation. According to measure the vibratory frequency, the tire pressure can be estimated. In this paper, a resonance frequency of event based sampling signal in tire pressure monitoring system is properly estimated by utilizing non-uniform wavelet transform. The processing procedure is presented from the uniform wavelet to non-uniform wavelet. The results by simulation show that it's effective.

articleTitle: Application of Oversampled A/D Converter in Low-cost Strapdown Inertial Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) the inertial sensors mounted directly on the vehicle, have large scales inputs. Even in the low-cost SINS the gyroscopes have over 19 bits scales inputs. Conventional A/D converters only have 12~14 bits, can not meet the need. The oversampled A/D converter can reduce the quantization errors and improve the scales to fit for the low-cost SINS. The effect of oversampling was analyzed, not only in reducing quantization errors and signal noise, but also in improving integral filtering precision. The DPS+FPGA structure was used to collect the six signals of gyros and accelerometers in high speed and parallel mode. The experiment results show that, the low-cost SINS using the oversampled A/D converter have good performance in common integrate navigation applications.

articleTitle: Virtual-Reality-Based Instrument Development in a Virtual Vehicle Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) has been causing much concern in various industrial fields, and its applications are widening rapidly. This paper discusses the application of virtual reality in the field of instrument development, and the basic idea is to develop instruments in a virtual development environment generated by computer, with appropriate supports of computer hardware and software, and some essential VR peripherals. The users and developers can preview and interact with the instrument under design, thus making the design more sound an acceptable to both parties. The basic idea, principle and flowchart of the instrument development system is discussed, and a prototype example is given to show the initial effect of the approach when used in a virtual vehicle simulation system. The application of VR in instrument development can greatly enhance the efficiency and flexibility of the instrument development systems. The conclusion is that VR can play a very active and important role in the field of instrument development.

articleTitle: Analysis of BER for MC-CDMA with Effect of Multi-path
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces a telecommunication technology - multi-carrier CDMA based on OFDM system, presents its structure, and compares it to CDMA system. MC-CDMA has better BER than CDMA due to frequency diversity and the capabilities in dealing with multi-path time delay. In conclusion, MC-CDMA than CDMA in spectral frequency, and anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Application of Walsh Matrix in Encoding Laser Beam for Pointing Multi-Target
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aimed at the interference in laser beams when laser target designators point to multiple targets, a new method for laser code is presented based on Walsh matrix, and its mechanism and realization are discussed. This method has some advantages such as high anti-interference ability, good security and easy realization, and can be adequate for the multi-channel remote-control system.

articleTitle: A Duplex Wireless Audio Communication System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper mainly introduced the principle, hardware, software, functions and technical difficulties of the system. This system applied wireless communication technique, audio frequency technique and network technique. The functions were carried out by embedded system. Its core part was micro-controller unit ET44M210, and it included several sub-systems. They were J2A audio encoding and decoding sub-system, RF wireless communication sub-system, OLED manifestation sub-system, alarm sThis paper mainly introduced the principle, hardware, software, functions and technical difficulties of the system. This system applied wireless communication technique, audio frequency technique and network technique. The functions was carried out by embedded system. Its core part was micro-controller unit ET44M210, and it included several sub-systems. They were J2A audio encoding and decoding sub-system, RF wireless communication sub-system, OLED manifestation sub-system, alarm sub-system and FLASH memory sub-system. This system was used in the hospital and it can make real-time communication, medical record management, calling alarm and calling manifestation integrate together then worked perfectly with each other. This duplex wireless audio communication system contacted patient and paramedic quickly and efficiently, so it can raise the nursing efficiency, lighten the intensity of labour, improve the service level of hospital.

articleTitle: RS Image Content-Based Semantic Retrieval System for Mt. Tai Scenic Spots and Historical Relics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The status in quo of remote sensing (RS) image inquiry is discussed in this paper firstly. Then, on the basis of analysis of content-based image inquiry and image data characteristics, an image content-based retrieval method supported by GIS is proposed. This method makes the fusion of image data and vector data's attribute, so it can assign the semantic information to image data indirectly and realize image inquiry. Finally, supported by "digital Mt. Tai construction" project, the semantic retrieval method of Mt. Tai scenic spots and historical relics based on RS image data content is studied and a well-planned scheme and framework to construct the retrieval system is proposed. It is ensured that the management level of Mt. Tai scenic spots and historical relics and service level of Mt. Tai tourism industry is promoted.

articleTitle: Defective Target Detection by Ultrasonic Image Using Multifractal Geometry
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In ultrasonic imaging system, the system to distinguish objects from measurements of their pulse backscatter signals is a topic of considerable investigation. Current nondestructive detection, it encounter difficulty in identifying small pieces of defect, these targets hard to recognize because targets signal have to compete with other clutter signals. Therefore to improve the performance of image for applying multifractal geometry, we must first gain a understanding of the characteristics of image clutters.

articleTitle: An Iterative Connectivity-based Localization Algorithm for Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: There has been a lot of work on localization for sensor networks. A considerable part of existing localization schemes are based on connectivity (average number of neighbors), that affects the robustness and achievable throughput of communication in a sensor network. However, very little research has been done for the case out of the radio range that lacks connectivity. In this paper, we propose a distributed localization algorithm based on both neighbor and non-neighbor constraints. We compare our localization scheme to convex optimization approach (COA). Using extensive simulations, we show that the new algorithm achieves more accurate solutions than COA, especially when there are few network nodes or anchor nodes.

articleTitle: Low-cost Monitoring and Control for Multi-dimensional Time
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An important class of statically-analyzable loops is affine control loops (ACLs). Expected value signals related to fluid preference, the expected magnitude, or probability of reward were decoded simultaneously with the intended goal. An inverse method was also used by previous investigators to reconstruct the input signal of a saccade from the Fourier transform of the padded and mirrored position profile and the impulse response of the system model. In this paper, we present the application of independent component analysis (ICA) to decompose the components of saccade and vergence eye movements.

articleTitle: A Research of Sonde Balloon Orientation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aviation security is the most important thing in the civil aviation. It is the security rule for aviation that one over ten thousand possibilities may result in a hundred percent calamity. The meteorological department sends sonde 3 times to the air to get weather data everyday, whose impetus is the sonde balloon. At the same time, the sonde balloon is also the air reef. The sonde balloon monitoring system can measure the position of the sonde balloon online and transmit the data to the civil aviation manage center through network, which is as the science basis for the dodging of the airplane. The monitoring system is oriented by the sphere coordinate, in which the parameters measured include the pitching angle, azimuth angle and inclined distance. The civil aviation manage center needs transform the sphere coordinate into longitude, latitude, height above sea level and air pressure height. The pressure height is relevant to the real air pressure value of the sonde balloon. The practicable algorithm is proposed based on the theoretical analysis to civil aviation manage center. The results show this system can be applied to resolve the hidden security trouble from the sonde balloon.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Pattern Identification Based on Its Non-linear Dynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) on-line monitoring can detect the insulated defect of electric equipment effectively, which will prevent suddenly accident. On the basis of PD mechanism research, the relation between PD detecting signal non-linear dynamics eigenvector and insulation defect pattern is investigated by experiment. Using the characteristic parameters, such as Lyapunov exponent, Kolmogorov, fractal dimension extracted from the PD detecting signal time sequence data to be the eigenvector of PD pattern identification. A series of typical insulation PD experiments is carried out in the lab. Through analyzing the non-linear dynamics character of PD detecting signal time sequence, such as Lyapunov exponent, fractal dimension, Kolmogorov entropy, the PD process is identified be a non-linear chaotic system under some voltage condition. A series of dynamics estate equations have been set up and analyzed, to go along PD pattern identification. The typical insulation defect models used to the PD experiment include needle-broad poles discharge of oil, insulation cardboard interior gas discharge, cardboard surface discharge, suspending discharge in oil and so on. Broadband PD detecting system and digital memorial oscillograph TDS3054B are used to measure PD impulse current signal and ultrasonic signal. The experiment diagram and experiment result are presented in this paper, which shows this method has a favorable PD pattern identification effect. It's significant to the insulation condition-based maintenance of high-voltage power equipment.

articleTitle: An Efficient Ultrasonic Zero-detection Method Using DWT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Ultrasonic detecting technique has the advantage of higher resolving power and lower cost, and it has become a common measure way in industry filed. The measurement accuracy of the ultrasonic zero point always determines the whole system performance; so many research has focus their attention on this issue. There the wavelet algorithm has been used to detect the zero point and the field-programmable gate arrays realized the algorithm, the experimentation results shows that this method can be a feasible way to detect the zero point.

articleTitle: Design for Pool Alarm System Based on Pulse-width Anti-narrow
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to reduce child drowning in the unattended ponds or swimming pools, a design method of a pool alarm system is proposed. The design of hydrophone probe was simplified by making the sealed probe model up of rigid plastic pipe, pond surface, piezoelectric ceramic and other elements. The influence on measurement accuracy caused by many factors such as vibration was weakened through adopting the differential equipment amplifier. The application scope of system was widened by using programmable amplifier. The alarm accuracy was increased and the miss rate was decreased because of adopting pulse-width anti-narrow filter. The experimental results indicate that the system has a good applicability and the accuracy of alarm is over 98%.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Method for Analyzing of Nonlinear Interharmonic of Power System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The application of the new algorithm for the calculating of the power quality factors is presented in the paper. To estimate their spectra and fundamental frequency, the current and voltage signals are first processed and then the power quality factors calculated. The algorithm considers frequency, amplitude and phase as unknown parameters. The proposed algorithm was evaluated using a theoretical signal and a real signal.

articleTitle: System Parameter Estimation and Performance Prediction Using Fuzzy-Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel method based on fuzzy-set theory, which permits the probability distribution unknown and the data number small, is introduced to overcome the defect of classical statistics. Some concepts including point and interval estimation, optimal level, empirical probability distribution and confidence level are recommended. The performance prediction in the system for application is also investigated. The validity of this method is examined by engineering experiment under the condition of small sample. The confidence level is proved to be higher than 95%.

articleTitle: Laser Spectrum Measurement and Correction Based on Virtual Instrument Techniques
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the requirements of laser beams' spectrum measurement and correction, the laser spectrum measurement constructed with WDS4A and WDS4C raster and based on Virtual Instruments (Vis) technique are provided. The detailed methods and applied programs based on techniques of Graphical programming for instrumentations platform LabVIEW are also introduced. After the description to the principles and the construction of the laser spectrum measure system, the policies to software and modules of the system are carefully discussed, including software structure and system driver configuration, raster control module, spectrum energy measure module, and spectrum calibration module. Meanwhile, the details to realize the laser spectrum correction methods and the raster control for the test are delivered. At last, measure data of the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser spectrums based on VI techniques in practical implement of different environment are given. Practical examples indicate that, by the use of VI technique, the precision is excelled to ±0.015μm as well as the automation levels have been improved.

articleTitle: Design Method of Multi-Micro-Computer Redundancy System Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Redundancy technology is an important measure to enhance the reliability of computer control system. The characters of traditional redundancy and CAN bus are analyzed. The design and implementing method of Multi-Micro-Computer is presented. In the system, none of the nodes is assigned as master changelessly. The node, which acts as master, is determined through competition after the system is powered up. This way ensures that the system can be working order even if only one node is in normal. The logical structure of the system is presented too. The switch protocol between master computer and backup computer and the method of competing for master among all the nodes are described in detail. The system can achieve that backup computer switches to master computer without disturbance. Because the method of software and field bus combination is adopted to replace traditional hardware switch circuit in the system, the reliability of the whole system is enhanced. The novel redundancy system is of low-cost, openness and good maintainability.

articleTitle: An Embedded Web Services Framework and Data Representation for Distributed Testing Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces the design and implementation of an embedded Web service framework, called ghttpd-based Web services framework that can be applied distributed computing and testing environments. The ghttpd-based Web services framework is develop in embedded Linux operating system and can be portable to most embedded system environment, such as Windows and VxWorks. The data representation of testing contents and command is based on XML/DTD, and the message is transmitted by HTTP or UDP that selected by the message type. The design supports remote process call that based on SOAP and supports an implementation-independent way for programs to communicate with each other in distributed testing environment.

articleTitle: Certain Missile Fault Diagnosis Method Research Based on Dynamic Test
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Certain missile ATS (automatic test system) improves the fault diagnosis greatly, but it still prolongs with traditional static test method, and leads to many shortcomings. Dynamic test can resolve such problems effectively. Dynamic test for certain missile is realized by simulating the missile's flight course. According to the missile's characters displayed at each stage of boost, cruise, fall, swoop in real flight, we issue control commands to course channel, pitching channel and incline channel at the right moment respectively. At the same time, simulate the missile's pose change by controlling the turntable's moving. So we can simulate the missile's flight and attack course factually. This article puts forward a residual error energy characteristic vector method based on wavelet analysis. And use this method to process the dynamic test data of certain missile, extract the fault character. With above understanding, we take advantage of BP neural network to realize fault diagnosis and orientation.

Author Keywords: fault residual error energy characteristic vector

articleTitle: Design of Network Communication Module Based on RMII
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The hardware design of homing system in torpedo has adopted a way of DSP+FPGA. DSP is used to process system information and FPGA (field programmable gate array) is used to control the bottom hardware. Considering the great amount of DSP in the system, 100 M Ethernet switcher is used to set up the interconnection of DSP. So any two DSP network node can conveniently do the data communication. It is by RMII (reduced medium-independent interface) that the Ethernet switch completes the network communication, but DSP don't have homologous peripherals to match with it. Apparently, it is required to design the module of network communication in the FPGA, who can complete the conversion from DSP data format to RMII data format. In the design, the communication module is divided into transmit state machine and receive state machine. Each state machine has two 2 k bytes dual-port block memories, which are used as ping-pong buffers. One port of dual-port block memory is RMII data interface, whose width is 2 bits. The other port is DSP data interface, whose width is 32 bits. Writing command word to the address appointed can start sending data. Reading from the address appointed can judge whether data have been received. This module works in full duplex mode. Communication speed of this module is above 11 MBytes/s through tests, and the resource which has been used up is small. So this module can attain the requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Design of TD-SCDMA Communications Test Set Physical Layer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on an innovative design approach named DSP-centered-design, the solution of a TD-SCDMA communications test set physical layer design is highlighted, in which both hardware and software solutions are detailed respectively. Innovative hardware schematics are given. Then FPGA and DSP program design are explained with great emphasis on flowchart of DSP software because of its important role in the entire system. Finally results of implementation are demonstrated. It shows that the innovative physical layer design supports RF conformance testing defined in 3GPP protocol completely and brings shorter cycle of development, more flexibility and scalability compared to traditional method. Recently the design has been applied in a test set which is adopted widely by TD-SCDMA industry vendors.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Inference in the Confidence Analysis on the Sound Wave Data of Water Leakage
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper summarized several commonly-used parameters in data analysis of the water leakage sound wave, proposed two key factors which affect the confidence of water leakage, and discussed the feasibility that the fuzzy inference applies to the confidence analysis of the sound wave data. And this paper introduced the entire process of the fuzzy inference, which provided advantages for the work to detect the water leakage effectively and scientifically.

articleTitle: A Clear-level Robot Based on Laser levelling Navigation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Research the software and hardware composing and control mode of the clear-level robot. The system adopts the laser scanner of electronic automation levelling, the model number of which is JP30 as the navigation laser signal. After the laser signal is carried through the light filter treatment, and then amplified and modulated, last transmitted to controller. Controller adjusts motor to driver the executive part to make clear-level robot work in a plane. Navigation receiver adopts two-way signal receiver to keep the working part levelling. The whole level of levelling robot is measured by inclination angle sensor and the error adjusting range of inclination angle is plusmn0.05deg. The separate time treatment avoids simultaneously adjusting the laser and inclination signal to each other interfere. The test result shows that the levelling navigation precision in x and y vertical direction is plusmn2.5 mm/100 m. Its can satisfy with the request of engineering execution of works.

articleTitle: Cause of Formation and Correcting Method for Wind Error of Tracking Radar
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
