abstract: This paper introduces the cause for wind error of the antenna servo system. The effect of wind error for tracking system is analyzed. A method by adjusting feedback ratio to decrease error and improve tracking precision is presented.

articleTitle: Application of LMS200 Laser Examination in Intellectualization Logistics Transporting
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Introduced the application of one kind examination method in the intellectualization logistics transporting, uses the LMS200 of the German SICK range finder, in the intellectualization logistics transporting to carry on the position examination to the parking goods, uses many kinds of algorithms gain the configuration information and the positional information about goods, then carries on the data fusion to the goods shape, adjusts the posture to the goods, enables the goods put in the warehouse storage spot smoothly, the experiment prove that using the LMS200 to carry on examination, obtains much more information, high reliability, convenient data takeoff, the nimble second exploitive, in the application of the intellectualization logistics transporting to be able to meet the need well.

articleTitle: Research on Infrared Image Reconstruction Based on Cone Scanning
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to enhance the resolution of infrared image and take full advantage of the scan data with corresponding space information, the infrared image is needed to be reconstructed. The paper throws more light on the infrared frame image simulation with equal row frequency sampling and variable row frequency sampling. The paper simulated the reconstruction frame images based on the two sampling modes. The result indicated that the reconstruction image with equal row sampling is better than the other. But the two modes could all obtain high resolution infrared reconstruction images.

articleTitle: Research of A Monitoring System for the Intelligent and Efficient Automated Handling Container Terminal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the high speed development of international shipping business, it was an important matter how to meet the requirement for the fast handling of large-size vessels and terminals. In this paper, the Intelligent and Efficient Automated Handling Container Terminal (IEAHCT) was regarded as the study object, and the field-bus technology (PROFIBUS-DP for MICREX-SX series) was adopted to build monitoring system for the IEAHCT. PROFIBUS-DP was a kind of the field-bus control system, was communication medium of master station (MICREX-SX series PLC) and slave stations (MICREX-SX series PLC). The data communication programs for IEAHCT had been worked out which makes it possible to monitor and control the IEAHCT effectively.

articleTitle: Immune Algorithms Based Approach for Inverter Control
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper a new control law of inverters based on immune algorithms (IA) is presented. Because the control law is based on float-coded immune algorithms, it overcomes the disadvantages of binary-coded genetic algorithm (GA), effectively adopts float-coded manner to make the work simple and quick and improves the speed and precision of the algorithm. Through computer simulation the result shows that the immune algorithms are effective to the inverter control.

articleTitle: Information Fusion of Two Redundant Sensors Based on Time
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To improve the reliability of the vehicle control system of a large scale weapon system, a scheme of adopting sensor redundancy is proposed. The structure of the redundancy adopts parallel redundancy and the dimensions of it are two. To solve the problem of dualistic decision with almost equal probability, a trapezium probability distribution function which well solves this problem is constructed. This distribution function proposed based on the idea that the implementation time contains a lot of system information which is useful to judge the system state rightly. By this function, when both sensors give position signals, neither sensors give position signals, and only one sensor gives position signal the reliability of the system is improved remarkably. This design is validated in the hardware-in-the-loop model and the result is satisfied.

articleTitle: Steady Analysis of Output Switch and Research on Integrated PLL Control for Cycloconverter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on electrical equivalent circuit and stator vector diagram of induction electromotor, theoretical discussion is made about the problem of output switching for cycloconverter. It is pointed out that whether the high-power electromotor can be successfully switched from VF to WF lies on phase consistency between work frequency phase voltage and corresponding variable frequency phase voltage. Furthermore it is presented that PLL is integrated inside cycloconverter, when the frequency of PLL input sine wave is equal to the VCO base frequency, PLL can eliminate initiative deviation, thus PLL can rapidly lock frequency and phase of transducer output voltage, and keep phase consistency between WF power supply and corresponding VF output power supply. In the industry test it is realized to successfully complete the switch from VF to WF. As the switch electrical current is small, non-impact switch of the large-power electromotor is realized.

articleTitle: In Terms of Testability on the Design of Fire Extinguishing and Explosion Suppression System of Armored Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to improve the testability of electrical system of the armored vehicles of the PLA, the author of this paper elaborates on the concept of DFT (design for test) in designing the fire extinguishing and explosion suppression system of armored vehicles, analyzes the structural characteristics of the system and the test strategies of DFT and puts forward two effective strategies on fault diagnosis and fault isolation of analog circuitry close-loop systems which are difficult to isolate, and provides efficient and brand-new detecting methods for monitoring system power supply by applying the theory on series of numbers. Featuring DSP as control kernel, the new system can be categorized into fire alarm checking module, fire extinguisher checking module, detonating driving module and CAN communication module in terms of test strategy and module function. The author also designs BIT circuitry for input/output of analog and on-off signals through hardware encirclement methodology and BIT circuitry for serial communication and for A/D, D/A conversion through hardware back-circling methodology. The experiment result shows that the overall performance of the newly-designed system has reached and even surpassed the level of its predecessors and the system's DFT can meet the requirements of fault detection and isolation.

Author Keywords: Fire Extinguishing and Explosion Suppression System

articleTitle: Application of Rough Set Theory in the Fault Diagnosis of Distribution Line
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the rough set theory, a new distribution network fault diagnosis approach to deal with the imperfect alarm signals that caused by malfunction or failing operation of protection relays and circuit breakers, error in the communication equipment is proposed. Due to rough set theory can effectively handle the imprecise problems without any ancestor information except the data set itself, a decision table including all kinds of fault cases is established by considering the signals of protection relays and circuit breakers, and the approach can extract diagnosis rules from the set of fault samples directly. The inherent redundancy in the alarm information is exposed. Finally, a practical fault diagnosis program of the typical distribution network is proposed based on VC#. The result shows the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Logic of Collision Elimination for Reducing Propagation Delays on Ethernet and its Application Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, logic of collision elimination for reducing propagation delays on Ethernet is advanced. The strategy requires no change of the host network repeaters and is completely transparent to hosts. Incoming signals at the repeater ports are handled by a collision elimination method in the strategy. Logic of realizing the strategy is simulated. For the standard BEB Ethernet protocol operating at moderate load, it can reduce mean end-to-end network delay 20% at least according to the result of emulation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Multivariate Information Feature Extraction Based on Graphical Presentation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel method for optimizing the principal component analysis in feature extraction is proposed, which making use of parallel coordinate plot for graphical presentation of multivariate information. In supervised multivariate information classification, before feature extraction on principal component analysis, filtering the variable that has bigger variance and has little effect on classification by observing the parallel coordinate plot of the multivariate data, the eigenvector from principal component analysis will be more in favor of classification. We achieved better performance when using this method to test the vegetable oil data. We believe that this method can be used in many other feature extraction methods, and will obtain better performance than them.

articleTitle: Study and Apply on Field Test Instrument for Specific Resistivity of Fly Ash Burned Coal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The probe of this instrument can be inserted into the flue directly for testing the specific resistivity of fly ash. It adopts the ceramic filtration catcher and iso-speed sampling based on static pressure balance technique with parallel short-tube. The collection efficiency of ceramic filtration catcher (η) can reach even exceed 99.9%, and the error of sampling in different velocities is less than 5%. All these make the sameness between samples and the actual fly ash in many facets, including size distribution, carbon content, element compositions, etc. The coefficient of optimizing ringed electrode for concentric cirques k is 14.6, which can adapt all kinds of fly ash whose specific resistivity is in the range from 104 to 1013 Ω • cm. In addition, the ceramic filtration catcher made of white corundum powder can endure high temperature, high voltage, and acid cauterization. So this test instrument can work well under the conditions in which the flue temperature is from room temperature to 300°C and in the caustic gas. Ceramic filtration catcher also has many excellences, such as avoiding disassembly, cleaning ash easily, repeating use for long time. This instrument has obtained the invention patent in China and applied widely in the domestic range.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of A MedicalInfusion Heating system
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces the main constitution, the method of software and hardware structure realization of a medical infusion heating system. The system is based on AT89C52 single-chip microcomputer and adopts the integral-separated PID increment arithmetic algorithm combined with pulse width modulation (PWM). The application programs of the system is composed of structured models. The application result shows that the system is simple, reliable, easy to operate and has high controlling accuracy and short control time, which meets both the requirements of patients and hospital.

articleTitle: System Design of MRH Device
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the system of MRH device measuring heading of a vehicle, ship or plane, which is based on a biaxial accelerometer and a triaxial MR sensor is designed. The theory of MR sensor and references to its peripheral components, such as amplifier and A/D convertor are presented. The method of measuring and analyzing signals with LabVIEW is summarized. The software arithmetic of heading for plane and space is evaluated. The influence of environmental magnetic field and others to the measuring result is analyzed and the error of influence is investigated, and furthermore, the arithmetic of compensation to calibrate the influence is discussed. The proposed system can be used to measure the accurate values of heading, roll and pitch for carrier. The experiment result shows that the system can provide outputs accurate to ±0.5° or better while the biaxial accelerometer is supplying roll and pitch value in strapdown condition.

articleTitle: A Modified Registration Algorithm Using Affined Transform for W-FOV IR System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an modified registration algorithm is introduced. Image registration is a key technology in small target detection. Considering the special need of W-FOV IR system, who can work all field and all-time, we establish a 2-D affine transform model, the maximum correlation between image sequences as feature. To balance the effectiveness and running time of algorithm, simplified LSM criterion is used to converse six parameters of affined transform to four parameters. Registration window selected can also shield clutter's influence. Experimental results using real IR sensor image sequences are presented. Simulation and test shows that this model registration precision can reach single pixel level and shield background clutter influence effectively.

articleTitle: Analyzing Input Match Manipulation Based on Comparative Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Since thermal plants are multi-input, multi-output and uncertain complex systems, it is important to capture the characteristics of the system for controlling combustion reliably and economically. If the gas of cookery is used as fuel, the input quantity of gas is closely connected with the output quantity of coke plant, so the characteristic of fuel is not steady. The process of combustion must be completely, that is, when the ratio of atmosphere and gas is the setting value, the precision of thermal control is high and the output thermal efficiency can meet the needs of design. The paper uses comparison theory of Lyapunov method to analyze the input ratio of fuel and atmosphere in combustion control system. The balance between adjustment value and set value after affected by outside interference shows that at that time the combustion efficiency is the highest and the thermal value is the steadiest. It analyzes the supply status of fuel and atmosphere by simulating combustion process mode and confirms the validity and stability.

articleTitle: Study on Camera Calibration for Binocular Vision Based on Genetic programming
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In view of the camera calibration existent questiones, on the basis of Stereo Vision, a new method of camera calibration for binocular vision based on genetic programming is proposed. It is used to learn the relationships between the image information and the 3D information. For two-cameras system, the complicated relation between the cameras is established by training the genetic programming without the parameters of the cameras calibrated. It neither requires an accurate mathematical model nor needs any prior knowledge about the parameters. The 3D information of target is achieved from genetic programming output. The results of the experiment showed that this method was more accurate with traditional visual calibration methods.

articleTitle: Design of Multiprocessor Parallel SystemBase on Switched Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To make multiprocessor parallel system which is made up often float digital signal processors TMS320C6713 work cooperatively and exchange data flexibly, the design that uses switched Ethernet as the communication method among processors is presented. The protocol conversion between serial port of DSP and reduced medium independent interface of Ethernet switch controller RTL8316 is realized by FPGA, so DSP can transmit and receive data by Ethernet. In order to improve communication reliability and reduce the communication protocol, forward error correction is presented. In view of character of application condition, (7,4) hamming cyclic code is used to correct stochastic communication errors, the cyclic coder and encoder based on error pattern identification are realized by FPGA. Lastly, a larger scale parallel system can be realized when multiple system referred above are connected with each other because of the expansibility of Ethernet architecture.

articleTitle: Enterprise Maintenance Flexible Process Modeling Based on ExSpect
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Enterprise modeling and performance measurement are two major problems in enterprise research fields. To evaluate the maintenance process performance, a flexible maintenance model is provided using Executable specification—ExSpect. ExSpect is based on timed coloured Petri net which is a powerful tool for describing and studying systems that are characterized as being concurrent, asynchronous, distributed, parallel, nondeterministic, and/or stochastic. The maintenance enterprise normally works as job shop and the maintenance process is flexible. In the model, the maintenance process information is defined as token type by ExSpect functional part and the process information is decomposed by Petri net to generate executable group task in order, which is executed by group maintenance process model. The model can simulate directly to analyze the enterprise performance qualitatively and quantitatively.

articleTitle: A SAT Method for Improving Test Pattern Generation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a solution for test pattern generation (TPG) based on Boolean satisfiability (SAT). The key to a SAT-solver can be scalable is that it is able to take into account the information about high-level structure of formulas. The paper augments a circuit structure layer to the SAT-solver to maintain circuit-related information and value justification relations. It dovetails binary decision graphs (BDD) and SAT techniques to improve the efficiency of test pattern generation. More specifically, it first exploits inexpensive reconvergent fanout analysis of circuit to gather information on the local signal correlation by using BDD learning. It then uses the above learned information to restrict and focus the overall search space of SAT-based TPG. Its learning technique is effective and lightweight. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Test and Fault Diagnosis for Encapsulated Hydraulic System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this article, according to the study of the encapsulated hydraulic system structure and work principle, it put forward the scheme and method of performance test and fault diagnosis for this hydraulic system. Single-chip processor test technology, sensor technology and dynamic test technology have also been introduced. By way of the analysis of work state and work parameter, it has realized the performance test and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Headway of Transformer Models in EMTDC/EMTP
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The developments of transformer models in electromagnetic transients programs of EMTP/EMTDC are introduced in details. We show that different transformer models can result in different transients' phenomena. It is seen that UMEC model is more accurate for simulation on non-linear analysis than classical transformer models.

articleTitle: An Enterprise Intelligent System Development and Solution Framework
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The recent trend has been using hybrid approach rather than using a single intelligent technique to solve the problems. In this paper, we describe and discuss a framework to develop enterprise solutions that are backed by intelligent techniques. The framework not only uses intelligent techniques themselves but it is a complete environment that includes various interfaces and components to develop the intelligent solutions. The framework is completely Web-based and uses XML extensively. It can work like shared plat-form to be accessed by multiple developers, users and decision makers.

articleTitle: Air Vehicle's Attitude Control System Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As an important part of the air vehicle's control systems, the attitude control system has an important effect to the vehicle's performance. This paper introduces a new method of development of the vehicle's attitude control system by using virtual instrument. In the system, the air vehicle's attitude signals which come from SINS on two-axis turntable are received by RS232 in real-time, at the same time control algorithm in computer give the output control signals to Actuator via NI-DAQ . Air vehicle model and theoretic trajectory are given by MATLAB/Simulink which can be carried out in Lab VIEW. By using technology of virtual instrument, the parameters of the air vehicle can be show timely, control algorithm can be improved in real-time, and the performance of the control actuator can be tested all through. This system has hardware-in-loop which strengthens the reliability and authenticity.

articleTitle: Research on the Resource Management in ATS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The test task of ATS generally needs various test resources for its completion. One main task of TPS runtime system in the ATS software is to find out the matching test resources for every specific test task and the reasonable coincidence relations between Test/ Excitation channels. The ATS software development method based on signal-oriented is an approach to resolve the problem. The interchangeability of instruments, the portability of software and the interoperability of the systems are the goals pursued in the design of nowadays ATS software. In this ATS software background, how to manage effectively the test resources of the system, especially how to satisfy the demand of multitask in parallel test system for the test resources optimizing allocation is a key point for the design of ATS software. Therefore, the paper puts forward a dynamic test resource management method that is based on the resource lifecycle manager. At the same time according to the model of ATS test resource capability that is signal-oriented, the method of resource matching based on the extraction of the keywords is put forward. As for the demand of multitask in parallel test system for the test resources, the resource allocation method based on the generalized resource load is brought forward. The resource management methods brought forward not only enable the rapid matching of the test resources to be achieved effectively but also can realize the portability of test software and the interchangeability of instruments.

articleTitle: Research on the Verification Method of Vertical Tank Capacity
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The factors that affect measurement accuracy of vertical tank are briefly analyzed, and the method of measuring with wall-climbing robot is proposed to reduce the radial deviation that occurs in the process of measuring the tank bottom quantity. Putting-into-type level meter is firstly applied to measure the tank bottom increment, and the corresponding verification is designed. These two new methods has overcome the drawbacks of traditional ones, and effectively improved the calibration accuracy of vertical metal tank.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Automation Information Platform in Power Plant Based on Fieldbus Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The important significance of comprehensive automation information platform (CAIP) and the implementation by means of FCS are elaborated. Several solutions to implement CAIP in power plants in different condition are researched on and analyzed. The network architecture of CAIP based on fieldbus is proposed, functions and the roles of each part in the architecture are elaborated; two schemes for the implementation of the communication subsystem between management level, supervision level and field level, which is the key part in the implementation of CAIP in power plant, are proposed, merits and problems are pointed out for and the selection principle of the schemes is expounded. Operation practice with the proposed solution showed a good result and improved production efficiency in power plant. Significant economic benefit is achieved.

articleTitle: Satisfying Filter Algorithm In the Future Airspace Windows Shot System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper addresses target tracking algorithms in the future airspace windows shot system. Because probability density of shell distributing in the Future Airspace Window is equal or approximately equal, there is the same target damage probability in any position of window. Therefore, target state estimate precise requirement is decreased. According to satisfying control and estimation theories, steady current-estimation-type satisfying filter based on LMI approach is designed. Its engineering significance is as follows: at the same time requirement of target state estimate precise in the future position is satisfied, the filter can accommodate target maneuver with intensity as large as possible.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Identification and Modelling for State Equation Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The principle of system's identification and modelling based on the artificial neural network (NN) were analysed. In order to avoid complex description and improve simple of algorithmization for the models of dynamic systems, the models of state equation had been adopted, and the identification models of state equation for dynamic systems based on the NN were given out. For comparing to identification effect and generalization ability of different structure of the NN's models, simulation researches had been done to three kinds of different network structure schemes of state equation models for the dynamic systems. Simulation results show, the identification models of state equation for dynamic systems based on the NN are effective, and the simply reasonable structure of the NN models can be raised the generalization ability of the NN models.

articleTitle: A Non-contact Measurement Research Base on Objects Luminous Radiation Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Objects will generate luminous radiation when objects is stimulated by external visible light, X-ray, γ-ray and electron beam etc. The key that detecting and identifying the objects luminous radiation characteristic is the measurement. The measurement decided the luminous generation when the objects are excited . This is a more sensitive expertise when we apply the measurements to detect the reflected radiation from measured objects in certain distance, and the time parametric analysis of measured objects luminous radiation decide the measuring sensitivity through luminous radiation time resolving power and luminous radiation time decay rate. The experimental result indicates that the measurement has more accuracy and sensitivity.The paper includes the basic principle of measurement, algorithm of measurement and measurement construction diagram.

articleTitle: Excitation System Test Device Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the hardware and software architecture of excitation system test device were introduced. In the signal conditioning circuit, the Hall effect transducers and isolation amplifier were used to convert and isolate the relevant signals to accord with the DAQ (data acquisition) USB-6259. LabVIEW was used to create the test software. The device was proved to be an ideal instrument for excitation system testing.

articleTitle: A New System Tested the Dielectric Characteristic of High-Resistance Powder
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The Dielectric Characteristic of high-resistance powder, such as industry powder, chemical raw material, soil and suspended particle in atmosphere, is important to study electrostatic precipitate, electrostatic coating, lightning stroke and contamination flashover of high-voltage equipment. A new test system has been studied. The test range of specific resistivity is from10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>Ω·cm to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>Ω·cm, the test range of voltage is from 0.5kV to 30kV (direct current), the least leak current is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> A, and the range of test temperature is from room temperature to 300°C. By studying on the volt-ampere characteristic, the resistivity characteristic and the electric breakdown characteristic of fly ash burned coal, it is found that the relation among the voltage forced to the ash layer, the leak current flowed to the ash layer and the specific resistivity of fly ash does not always follow the classical ohm's law, that is, V/I is not always constant. The volt-ampere characteristic curves of fly ash have different shapes while the voltage is in the different phases.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Airborne Real-time Video Image Compression System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the design and implementation of an airborne real-time video image MPEG-4 compression system are based on the newest media processor TMS320DM642 and the hardware structure and the working flow also are introduced in detail. The MPEG-4 algorithm has been optimized by using the software optimization technique based on C64X CPU, and the system implements the real-time compression and transmission of the D1( 704times576) or CIF ( 352times288 ) images at the rate of 25 frames per second , moreover, the compression rate is alterable according to the command.

articleTitle: A Method for Ship Target Detection Based on Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the analysis of the characteristics of infrared ship target in the complex background, a multi-frame image fusion method using morphological difference pyramid or wavelet transform was proposed to get a more clear and reliable image. The experimental results show that both of the methods can overcome the noise interfere of the complex background in a certain extent, which enhance the capabilities of target detection and situation awareness, but there are still some differences in their work speed and performance.

articleTitle: On-Line Monitoring Device of Airborne Particulate Concentration Based on The Principle of Vibration
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The protection of the atmosphere environment that relates with people's health relies on the monitoring of the environment. As an important index of the monitoring work, monitoring the concentration of the particulates in the air, especially PM10 and those particulates' diameter that are shorter than 10μm is now the emphasis of research both in foreign country and our own country. At present, foreign countries have already applied automatic monitoring method to observe PM10 particulate and PM2.5 monitoring is popular there. However, the routine off-line monitoring to PM2.5 has not been implemented and the auto on-line monitoring to PM10 still has some technique problems in China. An on-line monitoring method and device of the particulate concentration, based on the principle of vibration was put forward here and the feasibility of this method is proven by the calculation. It provides effective technology support for the research of particulate pollution status and source analysis of particulate and it improves the monitoring operation in the field of real-time character and accuracy.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Cleaner System Based on A Panoramic Camera
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A kind of intelligent cleaner system is introduced, which uses a panoramic camera to provide information for navigation. In the system design, improved CAMShift and `active' Frame-Difference Algorithms are used, based on which object-detecting, tracking, route-planning and automatic control are realized. Experiments are carried out. Compared with the first generation of intelligent cleaners in the market, the system introduced in the paper takes advantage of feedback information from the panoramic camera, thus is much more efficient while doing the cleaning, even with outside interferences.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis System of Power Network Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The harmonic analysis system of power network was developed based on wavelet transform by using the virtual instrument. The system consists of sensors, signal conditioning circuits, data acquisition and computers. Within the system, the wavelet packet was adopted to analyse harmonics and locate the distortion point by means of the MATLAB script node in LabVIEW, in which the signals were divided into multi -frequency band according to the power signal character, and the frequency band was selected adaptively so as to promote the time-frequency resolution of signals.

articleTitle: A New Test Method for the Electrical Parameter Deviation of GPS Antenna Patches
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The electrical parameter deviation of GPS antenna patch base material is caused by the productive processes, and it influences on the performance of GPS antenna. A rapid test method for the electrical parameter deviation of GPS antenna patches is proposed in this paper. The design principle and the test apparatus are given in detail based on the stripline model. The test result shows the proposed method is efficiency and the test method is also convenient for large-scale manufacture.

articleTitle: Carbon Potential Measurement and Control System Based on Gas Sensors Array
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents the principles and experiment results of a new carbon potential control system based on the gas sensors array. The carbonizing process is controlled with the sensors outside of the heat treatment furnaces. The phase transformation dynamic model was employed to the feature extraction of the responding signals of gas sensors. The mathematical model built with the feature vectors can be used to calculate the carbon potential. The relationships between carbon potential and responding signals of gas sensors were established. Working environment of sensors were greatly improved comparing with those sensors working in the heat treatment furnaces. The measurement precision satisfys the needs of carbonizing processes.

articleTitle: Investigation on Natural Radioactive Nuclide Uranium Concentration of Water Specimen from Wangyu River by Laser Microanalysis Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an apparatus and method which uses laser microanalysis apparatus (LMA) to analyze trace uranium of water was introduced. By this apparatus, the natural radioactive nuclide uranium consistency of water specimen from Wangyu River is investigated. The results show that natural radioactive uranium consistency of Wangyu River increases when the water flows through the drainage of uranium mine. According to the published research result, the uranium consistency of Wangyu River has increasing trend in recent years.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Test Software
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The general test system developed in recent years has solved the generality problem of test equipments. However, the software for test systems still does not meet the demand of generality nowadays, so that we have to change its code or totally reprogram it when that is applied from one unit under test (UUT) to another. In order to solve this problem, we propose a reconfigurable test software (RTS) based on automatic test markup language (ATML) and IVI-COM. It uses the virtual instrument modules and some other functional components which already exist to implement the dynamic reorganization of test system or test function. When the test requirements or the instruments are changed, RTS doesn't need to reprogram. In this paper, the framework of RTS is introduced at first, and then the behavior model and extensibility of RTS is described. At last, it has been demonstrated how to use ATML to describe test procedures.

articleTitle: Comparison of Performance Between Digital and Traditional Gamma Spectrometry
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, study on nuclear radiation pulse comparing between digital analysis and traditional spectrometry at the true-false of acquiring pulse information, measure time, index of energy resolution, detection efficiency and spectrum histogram of analysis. It shows and demonstrates the superiority of digital pulse analysis spectrometry by analyzing instances.

articleTitle: Coherent Accumulation Algorithm Based Multilevel Switching Adaptive Line Enhancer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: For effectively extracting line spectrum signals from non-Gaussian noise, a coherent accumulation algorithm based two-path three-stage switching adaptive line enhancer (CATTSALE) was established. In the CATTSALE, one path is composed of a Fourth order cumulant variable step size sign coherent accumulation algorithm based adaptive line enhancer (FVSCAALE), a least mean square coherent accumulation based adaptive line enhancer (LCAALE), and a short-term correlation coherent accumulation based adaptive line enhancer (SCCAALE), whereas the other one is made up of the FVSCAALE and two SCCAALEs. Two-path may be switched by the on-off in the second level of the CATTSALE to obtain the much better effect of enhancing line spectra. Simulation tests with real data of the underwater moving target-radiated noise were carried out. The results have shown that the CATTSALE has immunity to Gaussian noise and that better ability to suppress non-Gaussian noise and to trace time-varying signals and outperforms the single LCAALE, the FVSCAALE, and the SCCAALE.

articleTitle: A Ground Monitor Designed For An Electronic Safety and Arming Fuze
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the technique of programming by VC++ and the architecture of several I/O cards in a computer, the ground monitor designed for electronic safety and arming fuze is a special equipment for ground test and control. The technical request, basic function, architecture and the corresponding key points are introduced separately. The foundational scheme, hardware configuration and the software design involved in improving the working reliability are discussed. The tests show that the ground monitor can satisfy the design specification perfectly. It has many advantages, such as friendly interfaces, perfect functions and simple operation. And it is easy to expand functions, design upgrade, system maintain.

Author Keywords: equipment for ground test and control

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Analysis of Circular Plane Magnetron Sputtering Source
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The transverse component of magnetic flux intensity is pivotal that affect the utilization rate of target material and quality of deposition film as well as the instability of the sputtering process. The distribution of transverse component of magnetic flux intensity on the surface of the target was calculated by means of the finite element method. Furthermore, the experiment distribution of the transverse component on the target surface was gained by practical measurement with Gauss instrument. The simulation results are consistent with the practical measurement results accurately with a good precision. These results will have important practical values in optimizing the design of magnetron sputtering target and improving the quality of thin films.

articleTitle: Signal Decoding Realization of Air Data Dynamics Test System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Air data system is used to calculate and indicate the flight parameters. It has very important meaning to test and diagnosis the air data system. In air data dynamics test system, the measured pressure and temperature signal should be transferred to the air data computer. After analyzed, the decoding signal Arinc429 is used to output the signal. The principle of Arinc429 signal decoding in air data system is introduced. A high efficiency air data test decoding method, the diagram of the system and the software realization are provided also.

articleTitle: Design of SDRAM Controller in High-Speed Data Acquisition Based on PCI Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To solve the problem of large capacity and high speed storage requirement in PCI high-speed data acquisition system (HDAS), a scheme of utilizing FPGA to realize the timing-logical control for the synchronous DRAM (SDRAM), which is used as a data memory, is proposed. After analyzing the structural features of the SDRAM, the idea of design for SDRAM controller with Verilog HDL is given in detail. In the mean time, the FIFO technique is especially employed to solve the problem that SDRAM accessed by computer through PCI bus. Lastly, the correctness of the design is proved by the corresponding timing simulation.

articleTitle: How implement IEEE 1641 on Signal-Oriented ATS development
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This article researches on how to implement IEEE 1641 in signal-oriented ATS development. Signal-oriented ATS is the best choice to achieve the modern ATS designs goals such as instrument interchange; ATE adaptability; faster technology insertion; TPS rehost; TPS interoperation and so on. According to the signal-oriented ATS development process, the signal definition standard and the interface description design are the most important questions required to solve. The uniform signal and measure definition; XML interface description method; object Model interface provided by IEEE 1641 can fulfill all above requirements. An application is offered to explain how to construct a complex signal based on common models which defined in BSC layer of IEEE 1641. And how to description signal's schema in XML develop environment is afforded in succession. The signal requirement with textual format in TPL and the corresponding mapping test program codes in VB are provided subsequently. Finally, a conclusion is gived with some deficiencies of this implement in practice.

articleTitle: Implementation of Boundary-scan testing Platform Based on Programming with Labwindows/cvi
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the development of VLSI chips and application of boundary-scan testing, large changes occurred in the auto testing systems, and boundary-scan testing which offers the capability to efficiently test components on PCBs with tight lead spacing become the central test ways gradually in stead of the traditional test methods. The boundary-scan testing is well-known and researched widely because of its special test technology. This paper first introduced some basics about boundary-scan testing in a nutshell, and how to institute the testing platform with Labwindows/cvi, included hardware framework and software realization. In the software side, it described the integrality test, interconnect test and memory's access of the Jtag scan chain, hereinto, the interface functions using in the testing platform and their uses were present. Finally give the application and its results to validate the functions of the boundary-scan testing platform.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm of Image Vector Quantization and VLSI Implementation Architecture
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: One of the main drawbacks of vector quantization (VQ) image compression is computation complexity in encoding process. A novel algorithm based on cross mean order codebook, is presented to reduce codeword search computation, and its VLSI implementation architecture of VQ encoder is proposed. The FPGA implementation results show that the proposed architecture will reduce three-quarter coding computation complexity and be capable of real-time coding rate of 45 frames per second at 50 MHz system clock.

articleTitle: Laser Doppler Velocimetry based on self-mixing effect in vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a laser Doppler velocimeter is developed base on self-mixing effect in a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL). The monitor photodiode mounted on the back facet of the VCSEL acts as a transducer and it generates the self-mixing current signal. Measuring the power spectrum of Doppler frequency of this signal, the target velocity component projected along the optical axis of the laser beam is calculated. The experiment results show that the accuracy of velocity measurement is high with relative error of Doppler frequency lower than 2%, while for the velocity higher than 70 mm/s. The selection of one polarization state in the detection light beam by inserting a polarizer can enhance of several dB the responsivity of VCSEL to external optical injection.

articleTitle: A New Method for Evaluating the Communication Quality of FM Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: FM communication, which has the stronger antijamming ability, has been applied in the military communication. The demodulation signals that evaluate the communication quality can not be obtained easily in most cases. To evaluate the FM signal communication quality efficiently, the key feature based on the envelop information was extracted and a new method was present. The results of simulation test have proved its good performance.

articleTitle: Research of Uniform Stream Fuzzy Optimization Control in Power-Plant Straight-heating Boiler
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: On the basis of bias-flow analysis of burning system about power-plant straight-heating boiler and its countermeasures, a control scheme is given for the three fuzzy controller to be built by three pipes export absolute temperature-difference as the input , the openness valve as the controlled object. After realizing this control scheme, the problem of coked heat-pipes in burning process has be resolved perfectly. It makes the heat-pipe's life increase more than three times. The result of in real running shows the new design scheme is in reason and in effect.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of wavelet coefficient for image based on fractal lower order statistics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An alpha stable distribution and its fractional lower order statistics (FLOS) are introduced in this paper. Meanwhile the non-Gauss characteristics of some signals are considered in the practical applications. The method based on FLOS is the important method of signal analysis and processing under the signal and/or noise condition of non-Gauss alpha stable distribution. The medicine images are taken as the example. The FLOS in company with wavelet transform is introduced, and two parameters of wavelet coefficients for the images: alpha and gamma are estimated. It is explained that when in the practical image processing, we must consider the non-Gauss characteristics of signal to avoid performance degeneration with conventional signal processing methods. The proposed algorithm builds the foundation for the following image processing such as using Bayes wavelet to remove the noise.

articleTitle: Study on the Relation of Electrostatic Discharge Parameters
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper puts forward the investigation result of the air electrostatic discharge through experimental method. The time- domain waveform of the discharge current and coupling voltage are measured at different transient discharge voltages. By analyzing the data of the parameters, the correlation between the peak value of discharge current and the rising time is summarized. The analysis also shows that the peak value of discharge current and the discharge voltage influence the coupling voltage in a small loop. These conclusions are conducive to further understanding of the principle of ESD, which provide experimental and theoretical basis for ESD damage mechanism towards the electronic devices and equipment.

articleTitle: Design of Circuit Board Schematic Validating System Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: When the circuit board schematic of spare parts are hardly obtained, it is of importance and significance that circuit board schematic validating system is designed, by which the circuit board schematic is calibrated and the spare parts can be designed and produced. On the basis of the combination of virtual instrument and developed in this paper, a circuit board schematic validating system is designed. Virtual instrument and its architecture are narrated in brief firstly. Then the system software design is developed. By applying the data acquisition cards, and Labview, the virtual instrument is built to schematic validating. The method used in this research can also be used another similar calibration systems.

articleTitle: Detection of Weak Simple Harmonic Signal in Strong Noise Based by Use of Chaotic Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Duffing oscillator's response to external simple harmonic excitation was studied by using numerical analysis method. With the increasing of amplitude of the simple harmonic excitation, the behavior of the system changed qualitatively in some critical values of the amplitude, such as from periodic oscillation to chaos. When the excitation was polluted by noises or other harmonic signals whose frequencies were higher or lower enough than the excitation's frequency, the critical values changed little. The oscillator could be applied to detect weak simple harmonic signal in the strong noise based on this character. Since primary phase of the simple harmonic component to be detected in the sampled signal was unknown, the method which ignored primary phase didn't work any longer when primary phase was concerned. Phase delay method was introduced to solve the problem. Numerical simulation indicated that simple harmonic signal with Gauss noise could be detected when SNR was bigger than -90dB.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Communication Module of LXI Data Interface Based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: LXI is the new generation test systems bus which is based on using Ethernet technology. Adopting Ethernet as the bus for instruments communication, LXI can take advantages of the Ethernet. In terms of the realization for a LXI instruments, the most important part is the design of the communication module of LXI instruments, except for the essential function for test. The module must meet the need of the communication in the Ethernet, as well as, realize the specification of the software trigger and the hardware trigger, which is the central technology of the design for LXI instruments. This paper presents the critical technology of the communication module of LXI instruments and the approach to implement some function, which is based on using 8 bit MCU. For the sake of the LXI communication module's application in the advanced instruments, the paper gives a scheme to design intellectualized LXI communication module based on the MCU with ARM core.

articleTitle: A Voting strategy for N-Version Program based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The thesis study the consensus question about float data in N-Version Programming, and put forward a voting strategy based on dynamic fuzzy cluster. At first, the strategy process the output from multi-time operations with standardization, and then analyze the degree of membership between each data, so produce the λ-cut set by dynamic fuzzy cluster method according to the degree of membership, the ultimate output is decided by the consensus of majority number of members. The strategy can eliminate the incorrect or error data, judge the consistency between data correctly, and then acquire the correct output.

articleTitle: Attenuating the Wheel Speed Sensor Errors Based on Resilient Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Wheel speed is a very important control signal in modern car control systems. The quality of the processed wheel speed determines the performance of these systems. However, the quality of the signal is not so good due to manufacturing tolerances or wear and tear of the sensor. In this paper a method to compensate for the mechanical inaccuracy of the sensor is presented. We train Resilient Back Propagation (RPROP) neural network by utilizing large amounts of sensor angular errors to correct the wheel speed. The results by simulation show that it's effective and has high quality of anti-noisy.

articleTitle: Design Principle of the Precision Digital Control Reference Voltage Source
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Reference voltage source is a high stabilization voltage source as a sort of voltage standard, used abroad in digital instrument, intelligent instrument and test system at present. At the auto-control domain, often need one output voltage adjustable precision reference voltage source to control the action of the execute machine. The characteristic of the digital control reference voltage is precision setting or adjusting the reference voltage by the keyboard of the single chip micro-computer or the micro-processor, and between the reference voltage and the input number has strict corresponding relation. By the theory of the band gap reference voltage using the positive temperature of the resistor to compensate the negative temperature of the emission of the transistor, thereby realized zero temperature, bring forward two design project for the precision reference voltage source: the first project is replaced resistor by digital potentiometer, which can adjust the reference voltage directly, its shortcoming is as the limit of the inner number and the error of the cell resistance within the digital and the wiper resistance, the adjust precision is not very high; the second project is using with reference voltage source and voltage converter high differentiate D/A converter, and with the single-chip micro-computer, composed precision reference voltage, its strongpoint is circuit simple, can get 8192 types different value of the reference voltage, the temperature coefficient of the output reference voltage is 16 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>/degC,which can satisfy the design. The expatiated design project has practicality value.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Coupling Effect Emulation Analysis of Metal Body with Small Hole
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to study the electromagnetic coupling law of a metal body with different form holes, the body model and electromagnetic field needed were set up by the electromagnetic emulation software FEKO. Data showed that: the electromagnetic wave near the source presented obvious reflection; the intensity of electric and magnetic field changed tempestuously at frequency of 700MHz, which was the resonance frequency of electromagnetic coupling; the intensity of the round hole coupling field in the experiment is higher than the square hole; obvious electromagnetic wave diffraction happended at a distance from the body; the vertical far field changed greatly, affected by the body reflection mainly; in z, y direction the internal electromagnetic fields had asymmetry nature as to the hole.

articleTitle: A New Robust Structured Residual Generation Method Based on Residual Space Identification
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper the problem of robust structure residual design based on unknown input observer is studied. For the residual set lying in a fixed and fault-specific direction in the residual space in response to each fault, a new residual vector generation method based on residual space identification is presented, and the detail simulation example demonstrate validity and efficiency.

articleTitle: Rotor Winding Inter-Turn Short Circuit Fault Diaginosis System Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The diagnosis system of generator rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault based on artificial neural network (ANN) is developed. First, adapting for the need of faster speed and higher diagnosis precision of fault diagnosis, a new faster back-propagation (BP) with the error contracting gradually algorithm is selected, and the diagnosis model of rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault based on ANN is proposed. Then the diagnosis system is developed by Visual Basic and SQL Server database, which uses the RS485 digit communication port of the exciting current meter and power meter of the generator to collect the data of exciting current, active power, inactive power, and uses the NPort to transfer them to the SQL Server database of the server. Finally, the diagnosis system is successfully applied to power plant.

Author Keywords: rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault

articleTitle: On-line current sensing circuit for the over-current protection of the electronic ballast
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new on-chip current sensing circuit for the over-current protection of the electronic ballast is presented in this paper. The proposed scheme increases the sense accuracy and noise immunity over the full temperature range of the devices and can avoid fault over-current protection. Simulation results verify the accuracy of the on-chip current sensing circuit.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Transform and Fuzzy Theory for Turbo-Generator Fault Mode Classification
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel combined method based on wavelet transform and fuzzy neural network for concurrent vibrant faults of turbo-generator sets is presented. The fault feature is distinct and the high frequency components in the process can be employed to reveal fault characteristics. Fuzzy neural networks show good ability of self-adaption and self-learning, wavelet transformation or analysis shows the time frequency location characteristic and multi-scale ability. The fault diagnosis model of turbo-generator set is established and the improved least squares algorithm is used to fulfill the network parameters initialization. By means of choosing enough samples to train the fault diagnosis network and the information representing the faults is input into the trained diagnosis network, and according to the output result the type of fault can be determined. The computation of wavelet fuzzy network is dynamic and global optimized, therefore the convergence speed and the error precision are improved. The test results of demonstrates that the proposed method has its advantage in dealing with concurrent fault situations and is featured by a high probability of accuracy, proving the method to be effective.

articleTitle: Optical Inspection System for the Inner Surface of a Pipe
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The inspection for the inner wall is necessary during the life of a pipe from the production to the condemnation. A corresponding optical inspection system has been developed. This system uses the motion of a complicated mechanism in the axial direction droved by a stepper motor, and the detection of panoramic images from the illuminated circumferential inner surface realized by a hemispherical panoramic imaging system (HPIS). Irregularities of images due to corrosion or accumulation of brass deposits on the inner surface are inspected by this system. The experimental system reported in this article has the following specifications: resolution of detection of 0.3 mm at the circumference direction and 1.1 mm at the axial direction of a pipe, and inspection speed of 15 mm/s at an interval of 0.5 mm.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Portable Vibration Calibrating Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Portable vibration calibrating instrument is a kind of portable vibration measuring instrument, which not only can be used for calibrating many sorts of vibration sensors including acceleration, speed, displacement sensors, but also can calibrates vibration measuring instrument, vibration monitoring system and data acquisition system composed of these sensors. This system is mainly composed of signal generator, power amplifier, vibrator, standard piezoelectric acceleration sensor, charge amplifier, A/D converter module, control and display module. It has the characteristics of small volume, high accuracy, simply operation, convenient usage etc., and can be applied in the field or laboratory. Firstly this paper gives the working principle of this system. According to this, a mathematics model about it is established, from which the calculation formula of each parameter is deduced. Then the design and realization of each function module is illuminated. Finally, the system testing is carried out and the testing data is obtained too.

articleTitle: Research on Image Resolution in Ultrasonic Imaging Inspection of Welding Defect
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The resolution problem of welding seam ultrasonic imaging system is studied in this paper, a triple-stage stepwise solutions is proposed, the measured ultrasonic signal is processed by super-resolution algorithm based on wavelet transform, signal processing result shows: the method is feasible to improve image quality of ultrasound imaging equipment and enhances its ability to identify subtle defects in welding seam. Moreover, the algorithms is under further improving and enhancing in ultrasonic image.

articleTitle: Analysis of Radar Emitter Signal Feature Based on Multifractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Fractal theory has applied to radar signal analysis, in which fractal dimensions such as Hausdorff dimension, box dimension, information dimension, similarity dimension, correlation dimension and so on always are used to depict the complexity of radar emitter signal. But single fractal dimension is not enough to describe a complicated fractal object, so multifractal is introduced to analyze radar emitter signal. Multifractal is the expansion of fractal dimension, which uses multifractal dimensions to describe growth features of fractal object in different levels and compensate the lack of single fractal dimension. Because radar emitter signal is a time series, the method to study time series multifractal can be adopted and the multifractal feature can be regarded as the basis of radar signal classification and recognition. Through simulating several typical radar signals and computing their multifractal dimensions, the simulation results validate that analysis of radar emitter signal multifractal feature has certain instructional meaning.

articleTitle: Time-domain Simulation Research on EMP Simulator with Fast Rise-time
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the transmission characteristic of EMP with fast rise-time in bounded-wave simulator is studied. The double exponential waveform is used as pulse power. The time-domain analysis of electric field is studied using the method of moment (MoM). The result indicates that the rise-time of EMP is increase with the distance of transmission. The transmission of electromagnetic field in EMP simulator with fast rise-time has the characteristic of TEM (transverse electromagnetic) wave.

articleTitle: Active Vibration Control by Piezoelectric Self-sensing Actuator for Beam under a Moving Mass
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This research aims at the dynamic response and the active vibration control with piezoelectric self-sensing actuators for the cantilever beam under a moving mass. After analyzing the vibration characteristics of the beam under a moving mass, the active vibration control technology is introduced to suppress its vibration. The dynamic response model and state space model for active vibration control of beam under a moving mass is established. Then the piezoelectric self-sensing actuator sensing signal separation method based on two-dimension adaptive compensating principle is put forward. And the adaptive fuzzy control strategy is introduced to suppress the beam vibration. The testing system of dynamic response and active vibration control for beam under a moving mass is designed and developed. The experimental results showed the effectiveness of this kind of control strategy for beam bonded with piezoelectric self-sensing actuator under a moving mass, which demonstrated that using the smart material could suppress actively the time-varying flexible structure vibration.

articleTitle: Minimum Zone Evaluation of Sphericity Error Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, based on the analysis of existent evaluation methods for sphericity errors, an intelligent evaluation method is provided. The evolutional optimum model and the calculation process are introduced in detail. According to characteristics of sphericity error evaluation, ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm is proposed to evaluate the minimum zone error. Compared with conventional optimum evaluation methods such as simplex search and Powell method, it can find the global optimal solution, and the precision of calculating result is very high. Then, the objective function calculation approaches for using the ACO algorithm to evaluate minimum zone error are formulated. Finally, the control experiment results evaluated by different method such as the least square, simplex search, Powell optimum methods and GA, indicate that the proposed method can provide better accuracy on sphericity error evaluation, and it has fast convergent speed as well as using computer expediently and popularizing application easily.

articleTitle: A Method of Sinusoidal Frequency Estimation Based on Chaotic Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of frequency estimation of sinusoidal signal submerged in hybrid noise (chaotic signals and Gaussian noise). Our algorithm uses the phenomenon of chaos synchronization, and utilizes the knowledge of invariance principle. First, we construct a master-slave chaos synchronization system and using the mixed signal as driving signals. When the synchronization occurred, the signal of received system has small error with driving chaotic signal. Then we subtract the received signal from the driving signals, so the sinusoidal signal is left in the arithmetical compliment, and the frequency is estimated using power spectrum method. The simulations show that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Virtual Measurement System for Muzzle Velocity and Firing Frequency
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper develops a measurement system for muzzle velocity and firing frequency based on virtual instrument technology. The procedure, method of implementation, and the hardware, software structures are put forward. An application example of small-arms system is carried out. The voltage signals produced by two infrared targets are acquired when bullet is thrilling through. The muzzle velocity and firing frequency are real-timely got. The experiment results fully prove that the system is reliable and practical.

articleTitle: Design of an intelligent Three Phase Electric Energy-measuring Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A intelligent tri-phase electric power measuring instrument based on CS5460 is introduced on this paper. The instrument uses embed microcomputer as the controller and CS5460 for sampling electric power. According to the theory of testing, counting and correcting AC power's synthetic error, synthetic error can be traced dynamically and corrected in time in the instrument. It has be proved to be effective.

articleTitle: Study of Fuzzy Sensor to Environment Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the development of measure technology, traditional sensors cannot meet the needs of all real world applications. Fuzzy sensors play a new role with linguistic description. How to using fuzzy sensor to measure gas collector pressure and adaptability of gas collector pressure state to the environment under valve position are given in this paper. Using linguistic descriptions of the two gas collector pressure state which is outputted by fuzzy sensor, we design the pressure control system and working effectively for cookery techniques.

articleTitle: Application of Model-based and Data-driven Techniques in Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Model-based fault diagnosis, using statistical techniques, residual generation (by analytical redundancy), and parameter estimation, has been an active area of research for the past four decades. However, these techniques are developed in isolation and generally a single technique can not address the diagnostic problems in complex systems. In this paper, we investigate a hybrid approach, which combines different techniques to obtain better diagnostic performance than the use of a single technique alone, and demonstrate it on a fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) system.

articleTitle: Frequency Measurement of the Automatic Generator Quasi-synchronizer Based on SCM and CPLD
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The quasi-synchronizing parallel is an important operation in the power system. If the frequency error is too great, the oncoming generator could slip a pole, causing damage to the machine. Therefore, the precision frequency measurement of the generator and the power system is one of important conditions to ensure that the automatic quasi-synchronizer can operate accurately. A new method of frequency measurement used in the generator automatic quasi-synchronizer is discussed in this paper. The basic principle of the frequency measurement is introduced. The frequency measurement is finished by combining SCM and CPLD (complex programmable logic device) technique. CPLD detects the frequency and the SCM manages the data and implements intelligent control, the hardware circuit diagram and the software flow chart are showed in the paper. The experiments indicate that the measurement precision and system integration are improved. The measurement error is less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and the novel quasi-synchronizer is practical.

articleTitle: Design and Realization Technology of High-Frequency Attenuator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In industry measuring field, or cable television system, attenuator is a kind of familiar electronic measuring instrument, usually located between signal source and its load. It not only can be used for regulating signal voltage to prevent loading circuit overloading, but also can provides the measured system with standard weak signal and satisfies the voltage requirement of port. This paper introduces the design of fixed attenuator based on resistance network, and the realization of multi-node adjustable attenuator by proper design of single fixed attenuators. Firstly, the thinking pattern of this design is given, and then the realization technology is illuminated, in the end, after the testing of practical electric circuit, the frequency response curve is shown under different attenuation.

articleTitle: Photoelectric Detecting System for measuring the Number density of Ship Optical-wakes' Bubbles
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper aims to design a detecting system for measuring the number density of ship wake's bubbles based on its optical forward scattering characteristics. The sizes of ship wakes' bubbles are almost in the range from 10300um, which are far greater than the wavelength of incident blue or green light, so the bubbles' scatterings are predominantly the small angled. The theoretic expression of the received power, coming from the detector placed on the axis of incident direction, is derived from narrow-angle radiative transfer equation. And the transmission function, denoting the ratio of received radiant power to reference power, is introduced, which is a function of bubbles' size and concentration. The reference power, decided by experimental condition, is obtained from the same detector when there are no bubbles in testing region. Since the received power and reference power can be obtained from detectors distinctly, given the detecting system and bubbles size distribution, we can find the bubbles' concentration. Based on this method, we designed a testing system to detect the simulated ship wakes, and obtained the number density of the bubbles. The theoretic analysis and experimental results confirmed that this detecting system and method can be used for measuring the bubbles number density of ship wakes.

articleTitle: Test Sequencing Strategy with Imperfect Test
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we consider imperfect test sequencing problem under a single fault assumption. Our approach is based on the comparing the imperfect test phenomenon to perfect test, and the integrating this phenomenon into the test sequencing strategy, called IPT-TS strategy. The results of numerical simulations on the test case show that the proposed approach significantly decreases test costs and is more adaptable to solve test sequencing problems with imperfect test for diagnosis when compared with that based on the random strategy.

articleTitle: Integrating Frequent Itemsets Mining with Relational Database
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Frequent itemsets mining is becoming increasingly important since the size of databases grows even larger. Currently database systems are dominated by relational database. However the performance of SQL based data mining is known to fall behind specialized implementation and expensive mining tools being on sale.
