In this paper we analyzed a famous frequent itemsets discovery algorithms FP-growth, and propose a new implementation approach called DBFP-Growth to create disk-based FP-tree based on ORACLE PL/SQL, it can execute faster than using SQL directly. Also presents a novel SQL-based method DRRW, which can remove duplicate records from database without temp table generation.

articleTitle: Application of Ultrasonic for Pipeline Flaw Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The principle of Ultrasonic detection and the detection method of the flaw signal are described. Wavelet neural network is used for signal processing of ultrasonic detection. This method that makes full use of characteristic of self-learning for wavelet neural network reduces wave loss. And convergence speed is improved by modifying error function. It is proved that this method has the good effect and acquires exact location of the flaw and amplitude of the flaw signal. Wavelet neural network is the great significance for signal processing of ultrasonic detection.

articleTitle: Adaptive Enhancement Algorithm of Color Image Based on Improved PCNN
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Considering the disadvantage of enhancement method of traditional color image, an adaptive enhancement algorithm based on improved PCNN is proposed. On the basis of the traditional PCNN, the optimization strategy is designed to reduce the subjectivity of the selection of parameters in PCNN. Then the improved PCNN is used to realize the enhancement of color image. Simulation experiment shows the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of Data Processing in Mine Safty Monitoring System Based on Multisensor Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Due to the advent of the sensor technology and communication technique, multi-sensor systems have recently attracted considerable attention, especially, those with diversified complex using background. In order to improve effectively the accuracy rate and reliability of mine safety monitoring system, a new model is proposed, which utilizes the multi-sensor information fusion theory to process multi-source data of mine monitoring system. The framework and formula of information fusion applied in mine monitoring system is given. Lots of simulations show : the primary mode of processing information and monitoring precision is improved .

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Digital Circuit Test Module Based on VXI Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent digital circuit test module based on VXI bus is developed using universal bus simulation technology. Composition and design principle of the hardware and the software are given in the paper. To reduce the area of the circuit board, the logic circuit of the hardware is realized using CPLD devices, the design of which makes the delay time between two test sequences be zero. The module can be operated by the softpanel directly or programmed by calling the given drive functions. Experiment shows that the module can well accomplish simulation test function for microprocessor-based and other bus-structured intelligent digital circuit boards.

articleTitle: Development of Platinum Resistance Temperature Measurement System with 30mK Precision
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Platinum resistance thermometer is a carrier for metrological transferring by international temperature scale. This paper introduced a temperature measurement system that is designed base the data of metrological transferring, the operation of its upper computer include three user interface, the interlace of "temperature measurement" can display real time temperature and track record its curve, the interface of "parameter setting" can make the calibration points table according to the data of metrological transferring, the interface of "system calibrate" makes digital calibrate of the zero and full scale value. In apparatus of the system, the thermocouple effect of contact resistance is eliminated by countercurrent method; the infection of noise wave of the reference source is restrained by the current source on rule of three. The thermostatic chest within the apparatus take on advanced control policy, it guarantees the reference resistance can work in invariableness temperature environment. The software skill contains that translating the measure value to temperature by bisearch linear interpolation, filtering de-noises with sampling value, and digital calibration technology etc. Experiments show that the precision and 3 month stability are all not exceeded 30 mK.

articleTitle: Automatic Fingerprint Matching using Improved Vector Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The performance of an automatic fingerprint identification system is essentially determined by its fingerprint matching algorithm. In this paper, a novel improved fingerprint image matching algorithm based on vector matching method with variable weight modification is proposed. That is features are extracted from fingerprint image as "vector points" and an improved vector matching method with weight modification is used to match these features. Experiment result in this paper shows that this fingerprint matching algorithm not only improve the accuracy but also effectively reduce FAR with maintaining the same FRR. We believe this method has a great advantage and opens a new way to improve the performance of fingerprint recognition system.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm Based on Multi-scale Order Morphology for Gray Image Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we present the basic concept of order-morphology and multi-scale structure elements. For gray image segmentation, we develop a new approach for edge detection by combining order-morphology and multi-scale structure elements. Here, the image is convolved with a set of multi-scale structure elements, after then sorted by order morphology, at last all the result images are integrated into one according to how much edge clues it reflects. Compared to traditional Laplacian, Robert and Canny edge detectors, the experiments show that this proceeding produces clearer and more continuous edges, particularly to noised pictures. It obtains good anti-noise capacity due to both order-morphology and multi-scale elements could suppress the influence of noise when detecting edges.

articleTitle: Information Fusion Fault Prediction Method Based on Multi-Class Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a novel fault prediction method is proposed for complicated equipments, which extracts features by energy comparing method and realizes pattern recognition by multi-class support vector machines (SVM). Firstly, signal features are extracted by energy comparing method, which combines multi-resolution analysis of wavelet packets and energy spectrum. Through three scales wavelet packet decomposition, it takes energy as the feature vector of element, and establishes corresponding relations between feature and fault state. Then, using the experimental data and Riemannian geometry analysis of kernel function, an improved RBF is obtained as a new kernel function for the multi-class SVM. Conformal function of the kernel function is expressed by Euclidean distance in improved RBF, which can decrease the number of support vectors and reduces the workload, and it can fit the actual problems nicely. Finally, the multi-class SVM is adopted to realize fault information character-level fusion and pattern recognition for complicated equipments. Samples of some kinds of engine fault prediction are verified, and the result proves this method is effective and commendable.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring System of Power Network Based on Virtual Instrument and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This remote monitoring system of power network was developed by using the virtual instrument technology, network technology and database technology. The basic structure of the system is Browser/Server mode. Through Internet Explorer, remote client can browse the real-time monitoring data of power network, such as frequency; power factor; virtual value of voltage and current, etc. In the system, the wavelet transform was applied to virtual instrument by using the MATLAB script node in LabVIEW, and utilizes denoising method of sqtwolog soft threshold to eliminate the high-frequency noise. The remote storage and query for a large quantity of data in power network monitoring was realized by using ADO in LabVIEW. remote panel technology built-in LabVIEW 7 Express was applied to satisfy the real-time data display of remote monitoring.

articleTitle: A New Automatic Modulation Recognition Method in Test and Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a method is presented based on the cyclic spectral features and the neural network classifiers for performing automatic modulation recognition. The process of the automatic modulation recognition using the method is divided into three basic steps: cyclic spectrum analysis, feature extraction and neural network classifier. Because a new method called as maximum likelihood filter method is used to estimate cyclic spectral density of communication signal, better estimate performance can be acquired in the scene of short length of data. Probability neural network algorithm improves the performance of classifier. Some computer simulation results showing the performance of the method in this paper are improved. The method can efficiently recognize almost all currently used modulation types and the recognition accuracy rate is over 95% at the SNRs of 10 dB.

articleTitle: Radar Reflected Signal Process of High Spinning Rate Projectiles
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: By slotting at the bottom of the projectiles, the target characteristics such as the spinning rate and the attitude can be obtained by Doppler radar. The reflection of spin projectile is a nonstationary AM-FM signal. The index of AM represents the attitude of the projectile. And the modulation frequency shows the spinning rate. The model of the reflected waveform is given. Chirp-Z transform (CZT) is adopted to improve the measurement precision. The process approach and the complexity of CZT are present. Its time cost is in the same grade to FFT. Simulation results and perspective are also given.

articleTitle: Design Intelligent Multi-sensor Fire Monitoring Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In fire alarm and monitoring system, fire detector is provided with great function. But traditional fire detector does not possess or be short of the ability to detect in early state fire. Because that signal of fire alarm and monitoring isn't alarmed in time and fire is controlled effective, to cause heavy losses by fire. In this paper, it is start that to analyze mechanism of fire occurred process and combine case of fire, multi-sensor fire detector is design. And the proposed fire detector may detect and recognizes signal of early fire in the early state of fire by photo-electricity, temperature. Acquisitive signal is sent to amplify and shape. And then shaped signal is introduced TMS320VC5402 DSP chip. Intelligent recognition program is embedded in the TMS320VC5402 DSP. The program embedded judges alarm signal. And the position of fire happed and the fire signal are messaged to host computer by bus means. Fire signal and fire alarm are confirmed in real time by this proposed fire detector. And ability of its sensitivity and reliability is advanced and enhanced.

articleTitle: Impact of Breaker Operations on Ferroresonance in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The impact of breaker operations on ferroresonance is studied for a 1100kV test system. The research is conducted on EMTDC. We show that ferroresonance is sensitive to the operation time of breakers, which illustrates the characteristics of chaos in ferroresonace. Therefore, it is necessary to control operation time of breakers exactly in order to restrict ferroresonance.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on Electromagnetic Radiation Effects to an Electronic System Through EMP Source
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The radiation effect experiment to a complicated electronic system by using of GW ultra-wide band (UWB) radiation source has been carried out. In cases of opening or closing the door of device under test (DUT) , the responses of test points on combination No.04 and No.08 of DUT have been measured. The response characteristics of test points on combination No.02 have been tested at different orientations of antenna of EUT And spectrum analysis has been performed for response waveforms. The results have shown that the response voltage on internal circuits of EUT may reach about 1.6 kV at condition of opening door of DUT when radiated by UWB source with 2.0 X 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> V/m of field strength (rise time is 0.3 ns and pulse width is 3~4 ns). The maximum response voltage on combination No.02 is about 1.6 kV under condition of optimum coupling of antenna. In this case, some of the electronic components which are sensitive to electromagnetic field may be damaged.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Display Control Terminal Based on Windows Mobile 5.0
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The method of designing the embedded display control terminal based on Windows Mobile 5.0 is introduced in this paper. Through the analysis of movement of target, the two track models of straight flight movement and round arc movement are built. The key technique of drawing screen by using GDI+, and the data transmission by FT245BM chip are given in the final part.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis System with Natural Repair Function for Screw Oil Pump Based on Radial Basic Function Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Considering the issues that the relationship between the fault of screw oil pump existent and fault information is a complicated and nonlinear system, and the radial basic function network (RBFNN) has the advantages of learning speed rapidly and fine ability of function approaching and model classify, a fault diagnosis system with natural repair function for screw oil pump based on RBFNN is presented in this paper. We construct the structure of radial basic function network that used for the fault diagnosis of screw oil pump, and adopt the K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm to train the network. With the ability of strong self-learning and function approach and fast convergence rate of radial basic function network, the diagnosis system can truly diagnose the fault of screw oil pump by learning the fault information. The real diagnosis results show that this system is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Analog Circuits Fault Diagnosis Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: in this paper a new method for diagnosing analog circuits fault based support vector machine (SVM) is presented. The fault features are extracted from the frequency domain response of circuit under test (CUT) and the SVM which trained by the fault features is used to recognize and classify the unknown faults. Support Vector Machine is simple in architecture and strong generalization ability. The experimental results show that the proposed method for diagnosing analog circuits fault based on SVM correctly classifies faulty components with more than 99% accuracy.

articleTitle: 32-bit High Performance Embedded Microprocessor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The Aviation Microelectronic Center of NPU (Northwestern Polytechnical University) has recently completed the development of a 32-bit superscalar RISC microprocessor, called "Longtium" R2. In this paper the architecture of "Longtium" R2 is presented. Firstly, the whole architecture of the "Longtium" R2 microprocessor is presented in section 2. Fig 1 gives the schematic diagram of the architecture of the "Longtium" R2. Then the design and implement are discussed in Section 3. Finally, the conclusions of "Longtium" R3 microprocessor is concluded in section 4. The "longtium"R2 CPU is fabricated in a 0.18μ CMOS process. The die size of the chip is 4.1 mmǒ 5.2 mm and the CPU operating frequency is at least 233MHz.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Model and Level Set Based Image Segmentation Method and Its Medical Application
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To overcome the deficiency of conventional methods in image segmentation influenced by image noise, level set image segmentation based on Mumford-Shah model is often used. But it has the drawback of large calculation. This paper proposes a multi-scale algorithm based on Mumford-Shah method. Experimental results show that the given multi-scale algorithm can greatly decrease the amount of computation and enhance the noise suppressing ability. Finally the algorithm is successfully applied to segmentation of images of abdominal macrophages of mice.

articleTitle: Research on Function Interface Based on Component Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the principle of IVI, IVI-MSS and IVI-Signal, this thesis proposed a conception of function interface based on component technology, and introduced its design thinking, model structure and realization principle of instruments interchangeability, while actually exploited the function interface component which was invoked in a certain unit for the test of some missile, and has realized transplantability, reusability and instrument interchangeability of the test program set.

articleTitle: ET Gravimeter Data Collecting System Based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To meet the needs of researches in earth tides, polar motion, free oscillation of the earth, etc., we design an long-distance data collecting system for the ET gravimeter. The system collectes the data of the ET gravimeter and the temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure etc., to which the ET gravimeter is exposed, and then saves them to multimedia card. The system can receive the command from and transfer data to an observation center by wireless. The rapid development of modern wireless communication technology has brought great convenience to long-distance data collecting systems. In the research of geophysics, the ET gravimeters are often placed in the observation stations far away from cities for long-term observation. In these places, not only the observers' lives are inconvenient, but also the observation costs are greatly boosted. Therefore, we have developed the ET gravimeter data collecting system based on GPRS. GPRS is the short name for general packet radio service, which is a kind of packet exchange data load and transmission mode developed on the basis of GSM, has the merits of high data transmission speed, high communication quality, 'always on-line', charging according to flow, etc., and is widely used. This article is divided into 5 parts: in the first part, the motivation and the purpose of this job are introduced; in the second part, the constitution and working principles of the system are described; in the third part, introduction are made for the implementation approaches of GPRS in the system, as well as the hardware design of communication modules; in the fourth part, the program design of system is stated, including the communication program of data collecting systems and observation center; in the last part, it's the conclusion for this job.

articleTitle: Edge Detection of the Low Contrast Welded Joint Image Corrupted by Noise
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To extract the edges from the low-contrast welded joint image corrupted by noise, the morphological filter is firstly proposed to remove the noise from the image. Then the improved fuzzy edge detection (FED) algorithm is adopted to realize the multi-level fuzzy enhancement of the filtered image and extract the edges from the enhanced image using multi-directional edge detection operator. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved FED algorithm can extract the continuous and thin edges and remove the false edges from the image, which leads to its better performance than the Sobel operator, Canny operator, traditional FED algorithm and fast FED algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault Location for Radial Feeders Based on Branch-Fault Diagnosis Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new approach to fault location for radial feeders in distribution networks is proposed based on branch-fault diagnosis method for analog circuits. The presented technique consists of two stages: line fault sector identification and distance estimation. It performs line fault detection by measuring the measurable node voltages responses corresponding to a particular current excitations applied at accessible nodes of distribution lines. The criterion of line fault sector identification and the corresponding fault location process are proposed. Based on it, a fault location system is developed, which consists of signal current source inject subsystem, voltage detection subsystem and communication subsystem. It is applicable to either single-phase fault or multiple-phase fault location.

articleTitle: Simulation Model of Maintenance Support System's Efficiency Based on Petri-net
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on analyzing the characteristic of the maintenance support system, considering the requirement and authenticity, the maintenance support system was to be simplified, the efficiency of system was analyzed, and then the simulation model of the maintenance support system's efficiency was constructed applying Petri-net and its software ExSpect. Finally, an example was probed to validate the correctness and the usability of simulation model.

articleTitle: A Step-step Calibration Method Based on Two-eye Stereo Vision Measuring Robot
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The two-eye vision measuring method was very importance makeup of measuring robot. The two-eye stereo vision was rebuilt three-dimensional information by distilling discriminating matching of two pictures same object. Its key technology was two-eye stereo vision calibration of measuring robot. Therefore, the calibration method was put forward, at the same time, discussed compensatory methods of calibration error.

articleTitle: Development of the ATS Software Platform Based on Function Interface Model
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The ATS software platform based on function interface model (FIM) has built the function interface between the test program and specific instruments. It has isolated the test program from the instrument control. The test program does not need to control the instruments directly. This paper introduced the running mechanism of the platform in detail. It includes function interface library, instruments static description, signal channels description and instruments configuration. Because the function interface function does not refer to any specific instruments, when the instruments are changed, the test program does not need any change. So the instruments can be interchanged. We also can implement different function interface function based on different platform to make the TPS can be transplanted to other platform. The software platform is of great benefit in the practical applications. It can reduce the developing time for TPS greatly. It also can improve the readability of the test program greatly.

articleTitle: Design of Interface Module for LXI Class B Based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The precise clock synchronization technique based on IEEE1588 protocol is one of the key techniques of LXI. This technique is used in LXI class B device. First, the development trend of LXI is introduced in this paper. Then the basic principle of precise clock synchronization technique is analyzed, precise clock synchronization based on MCU platform is designed and the LXI class B module is designed. In order to improve the precision of clock synchronization, FPGA is used in the system to stamp time label for Ethernet data.

articleTitle: An Automatic Test System for Axial Ratio of GPS Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: During the design of GPS microtrip antenna, the axial ratio of antenna is a vital parameter, so it should be measured and assure it less than 2dB. In order to promoting the efficiency of testing, it's necessary to design an automatic test system for axial ratio. In this paper, an automatic test system based on GPIB and NI Labwindows/CVI for GPS microtrip antennas is discussed. With the automatic test system, we can measure the axial ratios automatically in the microwave anechoic chamber, which can reduce the electromagnetic interface outdoor. The tested axial ratio varied with measuring frequencies is displayed with the diagram of curve and tables. By the diagram we can judge intuitively if the frequency of the best axial ratio is on the GPS working frequency or not. If there is frequency shift, the shift direction can be a guidance to modify the GPS patch. The automatic test system has been used in our research center and works well.

articleTitle: A New Method for Semi-Automatic Image Annotation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Semantic-based image retrieval bridges the gap between visual features and human understanding of image in the field of image retrieval. Image annotation is one important technology of image retrieval based on the semantic. This paper proposed one method to realize semi-automatic image annotation with the tool Support Vector Machine (SVM). The image collection was divided into two parts, one for manual annotation and the other for testing. After being classified by SVM, the output was changed into a probability, and K-NN algorithm was applied to get the keywords for unlabeled images. The experiments show that the approach is feasible.

articleTitle: Link Adaptive Technology in Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Link adaptive technology is an efficient way to improve the performance and resource utilization of wireless communication system. This paper introduces the basic principles and application of the technology and analyzes relative wireless channel models. It also studies several popular adaptive technologies at present, especially the adaptive modulation and coding technology, as well as their implementing schemes and algorithms. Then, combining with the applying standards, such as 3GPP, a performance analysis proves that the system with link adaptive technology could achieve larger throughput and better performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Image Quality Analyzing System of CMOS Camera
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The imaging quality detection of CMOS digital image sensor is a key link of the manufacturing process of camera. Through USB2.0 interface, transmit the digital image video stream of CMOS sensor to the PC and intercept a frame image data from the video stream; detect the MTF, brightness and defect of CMOS camera imaging and know the performance of the camera after analysis. It has been tested that this system can measure the imaging performances of all the CMOS cameras less than 3 million pixels accurately.

articleTitle: Design of High-speed Active Anti-aliasing Filter for Video Application
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Signal-aliasing is a common distortion in high-speed video sampling system. To avoid that, this paper presents a design of a fourth-order active anti-aliasing filter using high speed dual operational amplifier, which can be placed in a tiny PCB (Printed Circuit Board). An optimal design of this filter is introduced as well. Results show that the designed filter offers good flatness of frequency response, good effects of stopband rejection, high differential gain and high differential phase, and almost no peaking occurs within video frequency range. In addition, this filter operates well with 100Ω source impedance. Finally this paper ends with discussions on how to choose operational amplifiers based on practical application, how to choose capacitance and resistance, how to eliminate oscillation and on how to layout.

articleTitle: Aliasing Probability for Single Input Linear Feedback Signature Registers
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper discusses a novel approach for calculating the exact aliasing probability for linear feedback signature register, which tracks the states of a fictitious linear feedback signature register comprised of two identical linear feedback signature register, one driven by the output sequence of the fault free circuit under test and the other driven by the output sequence of the faulty circuit under test. By deriving the state probability distribution of Markov Chain corresponding to the fictitious linear feedback signature register, we can be able to calculate the exact aliasing probability for any test input vector length. Furthermore, we investigate the dynamic properties of aliasing probability for linear feedback signature register. The analyses in the paper indicate that the asymmetric error model will provide more detailed information in modeling, analyzing, and the exact calculation of aliasing probability. Finally, simulation results will be shown for demonstrating the effectiveness of the approach proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: CAM Design Based on Virtex Family Devices
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A content addressable memory (CAM) is a storage array designed to quickly find the location of a particular stored value. By comparing the input against the data in memory, a CAM determines if an input value matches one or more values stored in the array. If the comparison is done simultaneously, the CAM is said to be performing at maximum efficiency. If a match exists, it is found in a single clock cycle. CAM is used in networking, telecommunication, Ethernet, ATM (asynchronous transfer mode) switches applications. This design introduces a methodology for designing a flexible, small to medium size CAM, in Virtex or Virtex-E slices.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of the Automatic Monitoring System for the Bridge's Structure Security in Active Service
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The secure monitoring problem of the bridge's structure in active service is the hotspot problem to which the whole bridge field is paying attention all the time. The sensor can obtain the stress and the strain's situation of the bridge's parts, but the strain is only a relative one. How to obtain the integral and absolute strain information of the bridge's structure is a hard nut to crack. On the basis of the cause supra, the automatic monitoring system about the bridge's structure security in active service based on the RTK-GPS technology and the measuring robot has been developed. Load Response Spectrum Method, an effective method to diagnose the bridge's health status, which is based on the monitoring data's characteristic of the two automatic monitoring technologies. The basic principle, monitoring method and monitoring process of these two automatic monitoring technologies are introduced.

articleTitle: Proposal for Security Extensions for HLA RTI in Distributed Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes the security extension for the High Level Architecture (HLA), an IEEE standard for distributed interactive simulation, using IPSec (IP Security) and its use for collaborative simulation development. This work is an on-going work that aims to avoid the security issues of simulation data link (such as network listening, information leaking, etc.). Security extension HLA with widely-used internet security protocols will grantee confidentiality and integrity of simulation data packets in distributed environment. This paper analyzes the critical security attributes of data link in HLA/RTI simulations and presents options for a security extension for HLA/RTI in distributed environment. Also a detailed implement of a proposed solution is presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bent Circular Waveguide Mode Converter for Gyroklystron
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The geometry of the mode converter that is required depends on the details of the two modes that are being interchanged. Nonperiodic variations structure can often be used to reduce the length of the converter, but in these devices, virtually all modes may experience significant mode conversion. The design methodology and numerical result for mode converter that are suitable for high-power microwave application are reported. Based on the mode coupling theory, design of TE01—TM11 mode converter geometry configuration with traditional waveguide axis constant curvature and improved waveguide axis sinusoidal curvature is given for more acceptable geometry parameters. The conversion efficiency of 8mm high-power circular waveguide with waveguide axis sinusoidal curvature is about 99% with bandwidth of 32%.

articleTitle: Real time Compensation of Quartz MEMS Gyroscope Drift Periodic Error
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to make use of the characteristics that the drift of quartz series MEMS gyroscopes has strong periodicity and to improve the performance of the quartz gyroscope, the present real-time compensation methods of quartz gyroscope drift is researched and the relationship between the periodic error items in the original sampled data and smoothed data is studied. Then a new compensation method, UFCL (Using Former period characteristics to Compensate Latter smoothness data ), is proposed by the former conclusions. Both theory analysis and experiment results demonstrate that the method has a lower operation quantity and higher compensation precision, and it's a better method for periodic error items real-time compensation of quartz series MEMS gyroscope zero drift.

articleTitle: ARM+DSP Embedded System Applied in Marine Electric Propulsion Dynamic Load Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces the Marine Electric Propulsion Dynamic Load Simulation System, and puts forward a new type ARM+DSP embedded system to implement the screw load dynamic simulation, which is the vital part of this real-time HIL simulation system. Hardware and software of ARM+DSP embedded system, as well as some problems in practical implementation and corresponding solutions are discussed in detail. Some simulation experiment results produced by the simulation system are also shown in the paper.

articleTitle: A Complex Electronics System Built-in-Test Based on Time-Triggered CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes the built-in-test design and analysis of the X-by-wire system named complex electronics system (CES). The components of CES communicate with each other based on the CAN bus with time-triggered schedule, to support deterministic and safety-critical applications. The behavior of all nodes are based on global schedule, global clock synchronization, and mixed of event-triggered with special window in the system matrix period. The test ECU module is designed with ARM9 processor, can support a powerful testing function sets. The experiment and simulation expressed that the built-in-test schema with mixed schedule of CAN bus is a good method to solve the deterministic behavior and guarantee some basic quality of service, even in presence of faults.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Power Plug
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to make the power plug better security and controllability, a kind of elecontrol power plug is presented and developed based on infrared communication in the paper. The user not only can turn on or off the power, but also can set the time for power on/off according to his need through a remote controller. Moreover, the early-warning signal is sent before the power is turned off by the elecontrol power plug. The idea about realizing these functions is introduced in detail in the paper. It is proved by the experiment that the stable and reliable performance of the elecontrol power plug is good and its operation is convenient and simple. It not only can be used in the intelligent house, and also can be used in the field that the operator is not convenient to be close. The idea, realization method and achieved performance are introduced in detail in the paper.

articleTitle: Electrical Railway Harmonic Suppression Research Based on Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to realize real-time examination and compensation to the electrical railroad harmonic and reactive power, this paper proposes an optimum control rule of the switch component in the active power filter based on genetic algorithm. Simulation experiment shows that it has tangible effect on electrical railroad harmonic compensation which based on the genetic algorithm active power filter. This will not only will enhance the reliability of electric railway traction transformer station but also play an important role in the operating security of electric network.

articleTitle: A Novel Electrocardio Signal Detection and Analysis System Based on Virtual Instruments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The acquisition and processing of human cardiovascular electrical signals is one of the focuses in biomedical engineering research. This paper describes a novel system based on virtual instrument concept, which makes use an INA128 weak signal amplifier and a universal active filter chip UAF42 to acquire and process electrocardio singals, and to sample data into computer via a PCI6024E data acquiring board. System software was developed based on Lab VIEW platform and a difference threshold algorithm is used to detect of R wave and calculate R-R duration. The system was applied to analyze standard MIT/BIH electrocardio signal data and also was used to collect and analyze electrocardio signal data from 20 patients in real time. The result shows high efficiency and accuracy in extracting main characteristics of electrocardiogram, displaying electrocardiogram in real time, providing real time information such as R-R duration, heart rate, etc., and alerting when abnormal heart-rate occurs.

articleTitle: Application of Multisim8 in the Circuits Fault Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Fault simulation is an important step in the study of circuits fault diagnosis, the choosing of the software has a big effect on the efficiency and correctness. The paper introduces Multisim8 simulation software used in the circuits fault simulation, using a typical digital-analog circuit to illustrate the process of the fault simulation and something that should be paid attention to. It can be proved that the process is simple and the effect is good. Multisim8 is propitious to the fault simulation of digital-analog circuits specially, because it can simulate digital and analog components together.

articleTitle: Age Replacement Model based condition information
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Condition information is the important indicator of the equipment healthy management. In order to embody the condition information in the traditional age replacement model, age replacement availability model based condition information is established in the long run. Finally an example is used to demonstrate the relation between condition information and the replacement interval. The application result shows that the model based condition information can improve the scientific maintenance decision-making.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Detecting Pulse Signal Based on Wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the principle that wavelet transform can calculate the correlation of wavelet function and the observed data, a signal detector is developed. It can distinguish pulse signal real-time from random noise signal. The detection process is analyzed with Mexican Hat wavelet and the first derivative of Gaussian wavelet. And the simulation experiment presents the validity of the signal detector.

Author Keywords: the first derivative of Gaussian function

articleTitle: Design and Data Processing Of Virtual Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, three kinds of hardware design schemes for virtual oscilloscope is introduced firstly. Then the measurement and parameter calculation methods are depicted, and correlative error analysis is executed. In virtual instrument design, how to ascertain correct hardware is a precondition of all other works. This paper, using theoretic analysis and example demonstration to summarize the evaluating methods of DAQ cards, is a good reference to engineering applications.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive Sensor Weighted Data Fusion in Strain Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This article describes the basic principle of multi-sensor data fusion; In view of the great span roof structure strain detection system characteristics, we has put forward the self-adaptive sensor weighted fusion algorithm, which may enhance the strain examination system effectively antijamming ability, and guarantee the strain exceptionally examines reliability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Design for High-Speed, Real-time and Vast-Capacity Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper shows a new design for data acquisition system in automobile engine analysis instrument. Having been compared with some schemes, the system is characteristic of automatism, high-speed, vast-capacity, and real-time. Through adopting ping-pong memory access to DSP and FPGA/CPLD, and setting four modes, the system controls two slices of SRAM to write and read the data converted from A/D alternately. In this way, A/D acquires data uninterruptedly while DSP reads and processes the sample data. Furthermore the data pretreated by DSP communicate with upper ARM using the HPI that has function of DMA. Accordingly, the system realizes parallel communication of collecting data, pretreating and transmitring, while solves the problems including of depth of buffer, DSP control and FPGA/CPLD status. In this paper, the logic structure of FPGA/CPLD was designed using VHDL and was simulated and analyzed. The design and debug of soft interface was completed by applying C language of DSP, which supply the driver for the software design on apply layer.

articleTitle: A Method for Measuring the Cylinder Wear and Predicting the Cylinder Lifetime of Engine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper has measured the wear data of engine cylinder in its whole lifetime in way of capacitance measure. Though this method we got accurate data. This paper analyzed the wear characteristic, causes and influence factors of cylinder, obtained the wear trend of cylinder along its working time, and determined the wear limit. Based on these, an artificial neural network model was set up to predict the lifetime of cylinder.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Measuring Instrument for Dielectric Loss Tangent
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The dielectric loss tangent measurement is an important normal item to test the insulation condition of high voltage equipment in an electric power system. This paper describes a measurement method—improved fundamental harmonic separation algorithm which is used for measuring the dielectric loss of the electric equipment. According to this measurement method, a digital measuring instrument for dielectric loss tangent which is based on 80C196KC single-chip microcomputer is designed. Its hardware circuit and software programs are described briefly. The instrument takes a series of anti jamming measures in the hardware circuit and software procedure. It can realize many functions, such as automatic measurement, running parameters and mode setting, data display and printing. The experiment results show that the instrument has high precision of measurement, high stability and reliability, strong anti jamming ability, easy to operate and so on.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of MPPM performance in Free Space Laser Communications
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we study on the fundamental principle of MPPM (m-ary pulse position modulation) in free space laser communications. Firstly we discuss the definition of performance parameters, such as signalling ability, transmission efficiency, and bandwidth utilization rate. Then we compare the performance of MPPM with that of PPM (pulse position modulation), such as bandwidth and power efficiency. Finally we discuss the channel capacity, Information transmission rate and the energy efficiency for MPPM and PPM channel, and give the expression of channel capacity in optical MPPM channel with guard interval.

articleTitle: Optimization of Mapping Function in Chaotic ADC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes the application of the chaotic systems in A/D conversion. According to the connection between the symbolic sequence and the initial conditions, we can realize the ADC. Because of the errors in choosing the different mapping functions, the chaotic system may be out of its attractor and unstable. In order to avoid the problems, the mapping function of the random shift dynamical systems associated with the IFS is analyzed to find the appealing one. Finally, the optimized mapping function with high resolving power and robust is obtained by theoretical analysis and typical simulation.

articleTitle: Development of an Airborne Vision Recording and Replaying System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An airborne vision recording and replaying system has been developed to satisfy the military needs. It used MPEG-2 compression standard to compress the video and audio data, and prolonged the recording time greatly. By channel selection it can record the data from different sensors; by software control it can easily manage the recorded data (such as download, delete, replay and etc). Dynamic procedure of instruments and sounds in the aircraft cockpit and operations of the pilot were all able to be truly recorded by the designed system. By downloading and replaying, it can recur the scene in the air completely. Thus it can supply reliable references for evaluating flight, improving flying qualities and increasing maintenance service capability. From performance test and practical experiments, it has been proved that the system reached the standard of the design function and satisfied the demands of performance index. Nowadays the system has been also equipped in the army. This paper mainly discusses the system scheme, hardware structure and software flow.

articleTitle: Research on Parametric Drift in ESD-injected Silicon Dynatron Transistors
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Currently, with the extensive application of electronic devices and systems, the interests in ESD failure in electronic devices had mushroomed rapidly. There were many approaches to analysis static failures. The electronic parametric measurement was the most common approach for parts detection. With high-frequency low-noise Silicon dynatron transistors, in order to find the most sensitive parameter of ESD damage/failure, nearly all the normal electrical characteristics were measured and compared before and after ESD injection. By statistic and analysis, it was observed that saturation falloff, forward break-over voltage, correlated power gain, noise figure and junction capacitance were not sensitive to ESD, reverse breakdown voltages and cutoff currents were more sensitive. Especially, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BRCEO</sub> and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CEO</sub> of high-frequency low-noise Silicon dynatron transistors were the most sensitive to ESD injection.

articleTitle: Design of the Motion Controller of the Soccer Robot
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Described a bottom motion controller framed by ARM embedded chip S3C44B0X used as main chip, MCX314 used as driving chip. Used a fuzzy self-adoption PID control arithmetic to accomplish closed loop control. The result showed that as the bottom motion controller of Robocup middle-size robot the controller achieved the request of velocity and locational precision.

articleTitle: Research on Typical Faults Test and Simulation for Artillery
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To illustrate the typical fault test and simulation technologies for artillery, three key aspects are discussed in detail, which are selections of characteristic parameters, dynamic fuzzy inference and virtual prototype. To denote and analyze the typical faults, an index system is proposed from mission reliability angle. Aiming to the deficiencies of traditional fuzzy evaluation method, a new dynamic fuzzy inference method is put forward and adopted into fault forecast fields. To simulate the typical fault emergence and development process, virtual prototype of large-caliber artillery is established and four groups of fault relationships are given as simulation results. Based on the fault test and simulation system, severe faults will be predicted and commander can determine corresponding campaign decision and maintenance decision.

articleTitle: Research of Crack Depth Detection Method Based on Frequency Scanning Technique
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: After introducing some familiar methods of crack depth detection, frequency scanning technique is applied to alternative current field measurement. The ratio of the upright magnetic intensity divided by total magnetic intensity is used as a characteristic value to achieve crack depth detection. The influence of encouraging frequency to crack depth detection is analyzed and the rule of characteristic value varying with scanning frequency is observed. It is found that at first when encouraging frequency increases, the characteristic value increases too. When encouraging frequency continue to increase, the characteristic value decrease instead. The scanning frequency when the characteristic value obtains minimum is recorded and named as inflexion frequency. Thus a crack depth detection model is established based on frequency scanning technique. At the same time quantitative relationship of crack depth and inflexion frequency is analysed. Experimental results prove that crack depth detection can be achieved commendably using frequency scanning technique.

articleTitle: Study on Access Technology of Storage Data in Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the fast development of network technology, the amount of network resources increases rapidly. Because of diversification of network, heterogeneous network interconnection and information access become more and more important. So it has very important realism meaning and practicality value to study methods and mechanism of data access in heterogeneous network. This paper introduces two access methods of storage data in heterogeneous network in detail.

articleTitle: A Multi-parameter Synthetic Signal Sorting Algorithm Based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Radar signal sorting is one of important techniques in electron reconnaissance signal processing and generally uses PRI, RF, DOA, PW, PA and pulse-inner characteristics and so on parameters. Traditional signal sorting is a serial regulation detection system and has some limitation. Especially for a great lot of complicated data, it will be useless. Clustering is an important technique of data mining. It can divide data objects into several classes or clusters based on the comparability of data objects. So a multi-parameter synthetic signal sorting algorithm based on clustering is proposed in order to overcome the limitation of traditional radar signal sorting algorithm. This algorithm makes use of the clustering technique of data mining and combines with DOA diluting algorithm and PRI sorting algorithm, so it can be applied to signal sorting of general radar and special radar. In the end of paper, the simulated experiments show that the synthetic algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Warning System for Power Plant Based on Virtual Instrument Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A kind of virtual instrument which is applied to the tele-monitoring and real-time warning system for power plant was researched and realized in the paper. The virtual monitoring and warning system was developed based on LabVIEW software of NI Company according to the running characteristics of the power plant. It can acquire the key signals, and realize some useful functions, such as real-time monitoring and warning and so on. At last it can create daily report forms. If accident takes place, it will send the alarm signal and give the reason for the accident. The idea of designing the system is introduced in detail in the paper. The interface of the system is friendly and easy to use. It may take the distributed control system (DCS) effective assistance. It can also be taken in the analysis of the running status and history operating record inquiry conveniently.

articleTitle: A Method of Implementing One Module Multiple Usages for VXI Module
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A method of developing an A16/D16 register based VXIbus device, which is a C size mould and has one module multiple usages figure, is introduced. As a platform with plug-in boards, the interface circuits and the internal bus controlling circuits are integrated on the mother board. The functional circuits, controlled by the VXIbus commander through the internal bus, are implementing on wiring boards. The circuits on wiring board are usually used to implement the relatively unsophisticated circuit controlled by CPLD or "CPLD+MCU", such as switch controller, signal source and others. This mode can makes VXIbus devices been developed easier and improve cost performance ratio of VXIbus device.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Infrared Temperature Fields of Bolt and Rock in Condition of Loading
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The Infrared radiation experiments on bolt and rock in the process of loading were carried out. It was found that the infrared radiation temperatures of non-bolted block rose wholly and uniformly before stress peak with increase of loading. The bolted rock presented local dissimilation in the thermal image after stress peak. The multi-layer round infrared radiation isothermal lines were formed around bolt. The closer from the bolt centre, the higher, the farther from the bolt centre, the lower temperature was. The temperature was gradually reduced from inside to outside. The change of infrared radiation temperature fields responded to stress fields around bolt. The high infrared radiation isothermal lines corresponded with the high stress areas. The low infrared radiation isothermal lines corresponded with the low stress areas.

articleTitle: Study on Software of VXIbus Boundary Scan Test Generation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The goal of this paper is to develop a set of software of boundary-scan test (BST) generation using some test generation algorithms and test data. In order to get the test data quickly and effectively, a new innovative method of establishing test project description (TPD) file is presented. During the testing of two different boundary-scan circuit boards, all faults can be detected, indicating that the expected design objective is achieved.

articleTitle: Laser Diagnostics Technology Research for Measurement Cylinder Temperature Field in Direct-injection Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To measure cylinder temperature field in direct-injected diesel engine laser induced fluorescence (LIF) technology has been demonstrated. This technique introduces a new tool with respect to practical combustors for the analysis of temperature field, turbulent flame front structure, and differences between standard and improved combustors. Schematic of the experimental set-up is outlined and the experimental data on the diesel engine is summarized. Experiments are taken using a common rail injection system able to work at a maximum pressure of 135 MPa, a swirled type injector with a nozzle diameter of 0.124 mm and a nominal cone angle of 150deg. The investigation is conducted by applying the 2D imaging and the LIF techniques in a flow test rig, designed for capturing the tumble motion in a prototype cylinder. The measurement system includes a blower, which supplied the intake flow rate, and a prototype single-valve direct injection diesel engine head modified to lay down the swirled-type injector. The temperature field spatial distributions in the cylinder for different crank angle degrees are carried out in a single direct-injection diesel engine. It gives the theory and method about measuring temperature field exactly in directed-injection diesel engine.

articleTitle: An Approach to Measuring Vehicle Four-Wheel Alignment Parameters Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Due to traditional four-wheel alignment measurement techniques have such problems as need for many sensors, complicated calibration, fussy operation, low speed of inspection and low accuracy etc. Based on computer vision, the mathematical model for vehicle four-wheel alignment is set up. By taking sequence images of the target board fixed on the wheel in motion and calculating homography matrices between the target board and its images and rotation matrices, the directional cosine of rotation axis is obtained and further more the wheel alignment parameters are solved. Finally, the effectiveness of the mathematical model is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Design of Piezoelectric Power Amplifier Used for Adaptive Structural Vibration Control
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Some capacitive loads of power amplifier usually bring inexpectant problems such as phase lag and impulse hunting. So a new power amplifier which is suitable for driving piezoelectric ceramics in the filed of piezoelectric intelligent structure's adaptive vibration control is designed on the base of PA95 core chip which is produced by APEX Corporation. By adding feedback network, compensation loop and protect circuit, the power amplifier can amplifies signal's voltage amplitude from ±5V to ±350V in frequency range of 5KHZ while output transient current can reach 200mA, steady output current is 120mA and steady voltage ripple is below 150mV. The power amplifier's stability is analyzed and result shows that power amplifier's signal response is steady in frequency range of 1MHZ because phase margin is always larger than 45 degree. At last this power amplifier is applied to experimental platform of intelligent structure's active vibration control which follows adaptive filtering LMS algorithm and gains excellent experimental control efforts.

articleTitle: Study on multi-carrier modulation in Atmosphere Laser Communications
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: We usually adapted the method of single carrier wave modulation, such as OOK and M-PPM, in atmosphere communication. In this paper, we apply multi-carrier modulation (MCM) that belongs to RF communication system. We validated its reliability by matlab, and the result indicates MCM can be used in atmosphere laser communication system.

articleTitle: 3D Modeling of Small Ancient Keramics Based on the Projector-Camera System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper proposes a flexible and practical method to 3D model the ancient keramics based on the projector-camera system. The projector-camera system is composed of a slide projector, a digital camera, a control ground and a computer. The computer controls other three equipments working together automatically and efficiently. The control ground is a planar grid on the centre of a rotating platform. According to the size of the planar grid, the target ancient keramics is relatively small. The planar grid is functioned as the calibration of the slide projector and the digital camera. After calibrated respectively in advance, the projector-camera system is similar with the binocular vision system in the principle of 3D reconstruction. The digital camera takes two images of small ancient keramics with the projected texture characteristic and without it at one time. The two sequential images are taken from the different orientations. 3D coordinates of the space feature point can be computed by the space forward intersection. Using the whole adjustment, 3D coordinates of all space points projected on the whole surface of the target small ancient keramics from the different orientations can be worked out accurately. 3D model of the target small ancient keramics is acquired by connecting all neighbor space feature points and the real texture is rendered from relative images without the projected texture characteristic. 3D modeling of small ancient keramics is achieved entirely and finally. 3D modeling of small ancient keramics proposed in the paper is confirmed to be correct and effective completely by the results of the modeling experiments.

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Estimate Current Leakage of Laser Diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The low frequency noise (LFN) properties are investigated on the high power 808 nm InGaAsP/GaAs quantum well (QW) laser diodes under low bias current (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> A) in order to estimate the current leakage of semiconductor lasers. For the first time, we investigate the LFN peak under very low bias current. After a short time electrical aging (50 or 150 hours), the right-shifted position of the LFN peak and annealing effect are observed. An equivalent circuit model considering of parallel shunt path is employed to interpret these experimental results. It is concluded that LFN peak under low injected current is sensitive to the mechanisms of microscopic current leakage, and can be used as an indicator of reliability of laser diodes.

articleTitle: ECT Technique and Its Application to Gas/Solid Flows Concentration Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A method of image reconstruction of electrical capacitance tomography applying to unknown permittivity object in two-phase flows is studied in the paper. An one-simulation-calibration method is provided, which implements simulation calibration when the pipe fills with high and low permittivity medium respectively, and combines with iterative algorithm to realize image reconstruction for unknown permittivity object. The results of simulation and experiment show that the image of unknown permittivity object can be well reconstructed and the two-phase flows concentration can be measured as well.

articleTitle: Design and performance of a six-electrode conductance probe for measuring the water fraction in oil-in-water pipe flow
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The performance of ring-shape electrodes for measuring the conductance of oil-in-water mixtures in pipes was studied theoretically and experimentally. In particular the work is aimed at optimizing the probe geometry in order to decrease the axial current leakage and improve the measuring precision of water fraction under oil-well logging application. Starting from the basic four-electrode probe including two exciting and two measuring rings, a new six-electrode probe characterized by adding two guarding rings to be found, the distance and width of guarding electrodes were optimized theoretically. The experiment was performed with reference to annular, stratified and bubble phase distributions and the results were compared with available theoretical models. The analysis demonstrates the response of new six-electrode probe is accurate and reliability, the measuring precision is enhanced.

articleTitle: New Research about the Continuously Measure Wheel/Rail Contact Point On-rail
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The security issue of running vehicle is very important, and the accurate measurement of wheel/rail force is the necessary precondition of real-time monitoring the safety status. Researching in wheel/rail contacting point makes important sense to improve the measurement accuracy of wheel/rail force. But on-rail detecting of contacting points between wheel/rail is very difficult, because of the rotation of the wheel. On the basis of conventional instrumented wheelsets, an additional bridge to induce the changes of contact point is added. In order to decrease the influence of the rotation of the wheel, 6 bridges needed. Equations between output of the bridges and contact point are non-linear. So it must convert non-linear equations to linear equations first. Contact points can be obtained by the solution of the linear equations.

articleTitle: A New Improved Hierarchical Model of Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The basic conceptions of image fusion are given in the paper and the hierarchical model of image fusion is supplemented. Some preprocessing segments, such as the re-sampling of image, spatial and temporal registration, are introduced to the improved model. Together with the results obtained from single-image processing, the fusion results of previous hierarchy are input to the next fusion layer. The previous fusion achievement can be effectively utilized. The evaluations to the fusion results are feedback to the hierarchical model. The fusion algorithms and criteria are adjusted according to the evaluations. Some other pending-solving questions in image fusion are given.

articleTitle: Research On Ascertaining The Stable Area of A Certain of Gliding Range-extended Projectile's Controlling Parameters
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Firstly, this paper sets up attacking angle equation of gliding range-extended projectile with rigid body, then works out the corresponding differential equations and calculates the stable area of controlling parameters k1and k2 through stable conditions. It takes on important instructing meaning and useful value for the gliding and controlling of gliding range-extended projectile.

articleTitle: Research and implementation on μC/OS-II operating system into wireless networked sensors
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Many sensor networking applications such as surveillance and environmental monitoring are time-sensitive in nature. To support such applications, we improved and implement muC/OS-II, an embedded real-time operating system with preemptive support for use in wireless sensor networks. In this paper, we introduced the significance that applied muC/OS-II on wireless networked sensors firstly. Then, the specialties what a sensor nodes operating system should possess are discussed in detail, which includes essential and advanced specialties. At last, we elaborated the strategies and measurements that used to improve muC/OS-II. The results of performance evaluations shows that improved muC/OS-II offers enhanced advantages than other sensor network operating systems, so we can notice it is easily applied to real sensor network applications.

articleTitle: Design of Online State Monitoring System of Certain Missile Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, introduce the whole design of online state monitoring system certain missile system, firstly introduces the cause of developing the monitoring system, next, introduces the design of hardware and software of the monitoring system in separately,. During the design represents the whole structure of the hardware and software of the monitoring system., and gives the technique which adopted of the design of hardware and software.

articleTitle: Micro Photo-electricity Ion Concentration Detecting System for Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A micro photoelectricity system for environmental monitoring is developed in this paper. The detection is based on the theory of substance absorbency. The developed system is composed by a light-emitting diode (LED) as light emission component, a photocell as brightness taking-over component and appropriate circuits. The whole system is light, cheap and portable and it has many advantages such as few optical elements, high measurement accuracy, structure simplicity, small volume etc. The first-step experimental results indicate that the minitype photo-electricity system has realized to detect the solution zinc ion concentration and it shows a great potential for extensive applications.

articleTitle: Indrawing on the Picture Edge Based on Wavelet Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Have studied the wave technology's application in drawing on the picture edge, the local segmentation problem preliminarily solved existing in the picture. The traditional chain-length concept is discarded and the percentage concept of the chain is proposed. The edge-growth method is adopted to get the good closed image. The edges checked by wavelet transforms are of single pixel and accurate orientation and wavelet transform on every image scale can see some edge information. An evident method is to integrate all edge images with all scales in an attempt to play their different advantages to gain accurate edge with wide single pixel.Based on peculiarities of wavelet transform, we can adopt a special general arithmetic to obtain image edge with wide single pixel. Taking advantage of wavelet transform technology, we can not only avoid some trivial and uncertainty brought by setting gray threshold but also wavelet has anti-noise function and is able to capture image details. Most importantly, wavelet can be usable in all images with various gray levels. Firstly, we use designed adaptive filter to filter the waves and then transform wavelet for three times, so we can see wave filter maintain edge while getting rid of noises,Lastly the image segmentation is implemented by finding large regions.

articleTitle: Status Monitoring for Nuclear Steam Generator Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to improve the capacity of nuclear steam generator (SG) status monitoring, a new monitoring approach based on neural networks (ANN) is investigated in this work. In this approach, a three-layer BP neural network was trained as the process model of SG. In the process of status monitoring, when the deviations between process signals measured from an actual SG and corresponding output signals from the ANN model of SG exceed the limits accepted, the abnormal events are thought to occur. The ANN modeling for the SG process is implemented by using of the monitoring data of the SG' important operation parameters, which are the steam flow rate, feed water flow rate, pressure and water level. The error back propagation algorithm with momentum factor and adaptive learning rate is employed to train the network. The typical operation patterns of SG were used to demonstrate the feasibility of the approach. The results reveal that employing ANN can improve the capacity of SG status monitoring.

articleTitle: Integral Framework of Software Testing Platform for General Support Equipment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Support equipment software is integrated all kinds of instruments, equipments and modules. It has the characteristic of high reliability, strong real-time and interactivity. So it is the most difficult software to test. In this paper, after fully understanding these characteristic, we put forward a software testing model-GSESTM (general support equipment software testing model) and the integral framework of software testing platform for general support equipment. It is proved by the experiment that the functions provided by the testing platform can basically satisfy the requirement of software testing; it is provided a good platform for embedded software testing.

articleTitle: System of Setting Calculation and Simulation of Relaying Protection on Local Power Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the running condition of local power network at present, system of setting calculation and simulation of relaying protection is developed for power system based on graphic modeling. It makes use of graphical software to complete data and process management, fault analysis of power network, setting and simulation of fixed value. By building all kinds of calculation models of running method, setting calculation can be achieved in both automatic and semi-automatic calculation. Through the control of calculation process and the experience of setting engineer, it optimizes the setting value of relaying protection equipments in different ranks of power network by virtue of setting procedure, achieving the optimal setting scheme in different structures of power network and running modes. Setting the running mode in main wiring diagram, random fault, fault point and simulation time, software is designed to simulate the fault calculation and logical decision automatically, making sure the action of relaying protection and tripping out the corresponding circuit breaker. As the base of whole system analysis, graphic system is developed in Visual C++ and Microsoft Access with adoption of the object-oriented ideas. Having such excellent features as visualization and modularization, the whole system is easy to expand and maintain.

articleTitle: Fitting Smooth Subdivision Surfaces With Normal Control
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: We introduce a new algorithm for fitting a subdivision surface to a given shape within a prescribed tolerance. In an interactive environment the smooth mesh points can be migrated to the implicit surface, in idle moments when the user is not interacting with the model. To solve the mesh optimization problem that captures the competing desires of tight geometric fit and compact representation.
