We demonstrate that displaced subdivision surfaces offer a number of benefits, including geometry compression, editing, animation, scalability, and adaptive rendering.

articleTitle: New Approach Based on Double-Crossed Step-down-Stress Accelerated Life Testing
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: New approach based on DCSDS-ALT which is a reverse process of traditional DCSUS-ALT is introduced. Procedure of this method is given, and numeral example is shown. Conclusions are that though DCSDS-ALT is not always better than DCSUS-ALT, its effect in improving testing efficiency is obvious when some product parameter reaches to certain value. For high reliability long lifetime test, this condition usually can be satisfied, so it is applicable.

articleTitle: A Novel Reentry Telemetry Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the reentry telemetry data acquisition system's features and special requirements, this paper introduces a novel reentry telemetry data acquisition system. With two high-speed DSP chips and ping-pong storage, it realizes acquisition function of hundreds of slow-changing signals. And the system can meet the needs of high-speed data acquisition, transmission and storage with low error rate and easy maintenance in practice.

articleTitle: A Programming Model for Instrument Calibration System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A programming model for instrument calibration system is designed applying the concepts and techniques of software architecture. The model consists of two parts: one is the instrument calibration framework that provides an infrastructure and general functions to the calibration system, and the other is the calibration component library that performs different instrument calibration tasks. A calibration system was implemented applying this model and it was proved that different instruments could be calibrated correctly. At the same time the reusability, flexibility, extensibility and maintainability of the system was well improved.

articleTitle: Reliable Assessment of CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the most impossible fault path method the paper proposes to create a reliable model to the network structure of CAN bus with the intelligent node. By computing, we can see that the average non-fault working time MTF of CAN bus declines with the enhancement of the system lapsed time n in the maximum transmission time. With the movement of n, the non-efficiency U increases linearly. That is to say, the larger of n, the lower of reliability. Therefore, considering the reliability of CAN bus, the less of intelligent node layer, the better of reliability.

articleTitle: Develop A New Type Apparatus for Measuring Inner Diameter of Gun Barrel Using Optical Grating Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In aimed at the technic actuality of measuring inner diameter of gun barrel, we set forth a technique for improving precision of measuring inner diameter of gun barrel. The optical grating measuring apparatus developed has overcome the limitation of traditional optical grating measuring apparatus, and has resolved the puzzle of inaccurate count for traditional optical grating measuring apparatus. The results show that measuring technique using optical grating sensor has extensive application foreground.

articleTitle: Design of the Generators' Testing System of Certain Movable Power Station
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to satisfy the normal demand of certain movable power station's power supply, it is necessity to design a generators' testing system. The testing system can carry on an automatic test to the parameter of the generators that fixed greatly. This essay introduced the make-up, working principles, programmer design, the result that the expectation attain of the generators' testing system of certain movable power station.

articleTitle: Calibration Algorithm of Granularity Distribution Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The characters of granularity distribution measurement and the reasons of errors caused when particle size analyzer calibrated or compared with another were analyzed. Point out that it is difficult to eliminate the errors by just adjusting construction and circuits of particle size analyzer, but calibration calculation by programming can effectively do that. The calibration algorithm of differential fitting based on linear interpolation was expatiated on and experiment results were listed. Compared linear interpolation with nonlinear spline interpolation, the linear interpolation algorithm is simple, effective, less error and extends easily. It can be applied in auto calibration of particle size analyzer in overall range and the conversion of test results for different instruments. The experiment results show that the calibration errors is less than 1%, can meet requires of the practical calibration.

articleTitle: MIMU and Its Application in Mobile Robot's Self-localization
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces principal of micro inertial measurement unit (MIMU), designs a arrange form of MIMU. According to lots of experiment data, the gyroscope's drift and accelerometer's warp are analyzed, and provides an AR(1) model. After Kalman filtering, the simulation results show that the bias of MIMU reduces to one tenth of the original, and prove this methodological feasible.

articleTitle: Design of Regulator Digitally Controlled With 89C51 SCM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The adjustable voltage source that is using today, is done commonly by the change of the sliding contact surge location of autotransformer. This voltage regulation is with low precision, slow response, complicated structure, and poor reliability. This paper is about a new type of AC voltage regulator technology. It uses the 89C51 as the controller, auto-ranging the output of the secondary winding employ SCR combination of the transformer with two-way control, through the introduction of zero-turn-off and the whole cycle wave and triggered technology, then output adjustable AC voltage. Without sliding contact and SCR using zero-crossing triggered, AC voltage output wave is continuous and yet almost infidelity. It also really doesn't generate space radiation of a high-order harmonic.

articleTitle: A New Theory and Technique on Measurement Electric Field of Electric Quadrupole
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper studied the problems on measurement a static, axial symmetric and passive electric field. In the circumstances of the electric field that is limited and differentiable on a symmetric axis, it provides a kind of alternating iteration method by making use of Maxwell equations. Out-of-axis electric field can be transformed into series by means of the method. The series include the field on the symmetric axis and its different order derivatives. Applying the method is very easy, quick and exact to perform numerical calculation. Using the method studied the electric field emitted by an electric quadrupole. Approximate reasoning was performed. When choosing only the first fourteen terms, on the curved surface that r and z is in a ratio of one to three, the relative errors of approximate results and their exact values of z and r components of the electric field are 0.000000003% and 0.000000004% respectively.

articleTitle: Design of IP Sensor Access Module And Its Application in Motor Vehicle Detecting System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper designs a distributed monitoring system applied in the motor vehicle detecting field. A detailed introduction to designing of the IP sensor access module are presented, and then the author focuses on the realization of all functions of the monitor system, which has been put into use with reliable and stable working results.

articleTitle: Uncalibrated Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Angle Restriction and Single Image for an Active Machine Vision System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In research on machine vision, the theory and technique of recovering 3D scenes are important research subjects. They have been developed from 3D reconstruction method with calibrated cameras to uncalibrated cameras. Generally speaking, in order to reconstruct a 3D scene, at least three images must be needed. These images are grabbed at three different viewpoints with a moving camera keeping its internal parameters constant. In this paper, however, it is carried out in metric space with an uncalibrated camera and a single image of the scene. It is based on active machine vision system including a color encoded pseudo-random array pattern projector. In the paper, we focus on the uncalibrated 3D reconstruction algorithm for a scene. The algorithm is divided into three steps: projection reconstruction, affine reconstruction and Euclidean reconstruction up to a scale.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Scattered Data Repairing Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper researchs the approaches of scattered data pretreatment in reverse engineering and surveys from process of data treatment and data repairing. The self-learning algorithm of the network architecture based on generalization ability has been developed, which can increase the precise of the model reconstructed and decrease the time of data treatment later.

articleTitle: A Design of the Test According to Amplitude-frequency Characteristic in the Radar Antenna Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a design of the test according to amplitude-frequency characteristics and the advantages of the test system are introduced. It took the advantage of the control of single chip, improving its accuracy and sensitivity.

articleTitle: Design of On-line Monitoring and Measurement System of Flue Granules
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The system adopts advanced virtual instrument concept and technology, applies computer vision technology and digital image processing technology and realizes the monitoring of tested objects untouchably in real time. The paper adopts light reflection method to capture images, analyzes and compares several kinds of thresholding selection methods and finally adopts optimized one-dimensional maximum-entropy method. The method increases the computation speed of image segmentation. The system adopts closing operation with all structuring elements 1 to modify image distortion resulting in CCD's scanning granules in an interleaved mode without altering areas and shapes of granules. This system has such characteristics as strong function, quick response speed, high sensitivity, good stability, strong interference rejection and meets users' needs completely.

articleTitle: Effect of Sampling Rate on Data Acquisition Card to Gamma ray Energy Resolution of the Digital Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the effect to gamma ray resolution of the digital spectrometer is analyzed by changing the sampling rate of digitizer. The hardware consists of Cd(Zn) Te detector, PXI-5122 high-speed digitizer and computer. The software of data acquisition is programmed mainly with Laboratory Virtual Instrument Engineering Workbench (LabVIEW). The result shows the sampling rate of digitizer is lower, the resolution is worse. The resolution is close to the best resolution when the digitizer sampling rate increases.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Detect and Diagnosis Based on System Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper use time series ARMA model to seek the transfer function of gearbox system, then draw the steady state and transient state linearity frequency characteristic pattern under normal and several gear fault conditions. Through pattern compared, it can judge the sort of fault condition. The method has important applied worthiness to gearbox fault detect and diagnosis.

articleTitle: DataSocket Technology and Its Application in Remote Data Transmission Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Datasocket technology is a kind of way for remote data transmission, it consists of Datasocket server, Datasocket server manager and its function library. The remote data Transmission measurement system with Datasocket technique includes data collection, instrument control, data process and network server. This paper presents the principle about it, and gives out an example for remote data transmission. The result shows that it works well about data exchange in remote worksite.

articleTitle: Sewage Bleedoff Robot with Visual Location of Adoption Specific Feature Recognition Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Abstract: One kind of binocular stereo visual location of adoption specific feature recognition based on embedded system is used on the sewage lorry bleedoff robot in this paper. The embedded processor EPXA10 is adopted to be as the center control unit. According to the condition of sewage lorry bleedoff work, the fuzzy theory is adopted for detecting the edge of the target image and the Stereo Vision algorithm is used for the robot visual location. Aimed at the working peculiarity of the sewage discharging robot, this method can achieve the fast and exact three-dimension localization to the nozzle on the sewage lorry. According to the located coordinate, the robot can connect the sewage discharging pipes, and let sewage into the puddle.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Vibration Of Slab Track on Subgrade under the dynamic loads
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Slab track on subgrade was paved for the first time on Sui-Yu railway line in China. The dynamic performance of track structure was tested under train load, with the passenger train and the freight train at variable speeds, in order to analyse its vibration and deformation characteristics. The displacement of track structure was obtained from a self-assembly displacement meter with half bridge converter on a cantilever beam of uniform strength. Vibration measurements have been performed in the test. The signals were preamplified, then data acquisition system Wavebook512, combined with software platform Lab View, were used to sample and process the signals in real-time.

articleTitle: Study on testing system of CW/QCW high-power laser diode array's divergence angle
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new testing system of CW/QCW high-power laser diode arrays (HLDA)'s divergence angle was presented. The testing system included driving power, water cooling system, module of adjusting to center, detector and data acquisition module etc. The most important part of this testing system was detector for laser signal. It was designed by ourselves and made of two hemicycle probes. Two key problems of existing methods were resolved by this system. First, testing error induced by looking HLDA as point light source was reduced. Second, the problem that detector was shattered or burned because of high power was resolved. Besides data acquisition module contained two suits of disposing processes, in order to test divergence angle of either CW or QCW HLDA.

articleTitle: Cellular Automata Based M-Sequence Generation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Due to the global processing characteristic, the traditional M-sequence generation method based on LFSR is restricted by the speed. Because of the cellular automata has the characteristics of simple regular structure, locality of information processing, and posses the complex dynamic properties, these make it more suitable for the high speed M-sequence generation method based on the cellular automata. For a giving irreducible polynomial, using the synthesis algorithm based on the Euclid's division which bring forwarded by Kevin Cattle, we can obtain the rule vector of the 90/150 cellular automata, and by analyzing the homogeneous characteristic of the cellular automata, we can obtain a set of the cellular automata to generation the M-sequence with high speed.

articleTitle: Application of Generalized Frequency Response Function in Gearbox Nonlinear Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper clarified the basic theory and quality of generalized frequency response function (GFRF) and applied it in the gearbox nonlinear fault diagnosis. We presented two GFRF methods to diagnose nonlinear system. The GFRF model expressed and reflected system dynamic characteristics. Because its definite physics means and ease to understand, it is confirmed that using GFRF method to diagnose gearbox nonlinear fault will be gain effective results.

articleTitle: CAT&C System Design and Experimental Analysis of a Solar Heat Pump Multi-function Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the experiment research's need of the direct expansion solar heat pump multi-function machine (DX-SAHPM ) , this paper introduces the design plan of the computer-aided testing and controlling system(CAT&C), with temperature, pressure, flux measured by sensor used as inputting parameters, with industry programme computer(IPC) used as micro process unit and with man-machine interface used as real-time monitoring thermal physical parameters. The CAT&C system can complete automatic measuring, monitoring and saving of all real-time experiment data, and it can also extend its function so it can control some parameters(such as flux) intelligently according to the real status. The CAT&C system's testing result in spring and winter is well consistent with theory calculation, which indicates that the design plan is reasonable and the data are exact and that at the same time it also offers reliable hardware platform for the future study of DX-SAHPM heat pump. The CAT&C system can also test and adjust thermal parameters for the other similar thermal system. This paper emphatically introduces the measuring points' layout, system monitoring, control principle and method, and it also analyzes the experimental testing data and intellective control.

articleTitle: Design of Equipment Fault Injection System Based on BIT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: At present, the microprocessor technology and micro-electronics technology are developing fast. The complication of equipment electronic systems is improving continuously, so is the density of the circuits. Therefore, BIT (built-in test) has become a crucial element in solving fault diagnosis of equipment electronic systems. In order to design BIT effectively and evaluate its fault diagnosis ability, fault injection technology should be applied to the system to carry out the testability experiment. Aiming at the requirement of testability experiment for certain equipment, a fault injection system based on BIT is set up. The basic flow and theory about fault injection is expatiated on and the hardware frame of fault injection system is given.

articleTitle: Application of Order Tracking Technology on Condition Monitoring of Turbine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The aviation gas turbine engine is the "heart" of each kind of modern military airplane, and it is the main power source of military airplane in our army. So the condition detection of aero-engine is an important measure to guarantee the engine's safe working. This paper introduced the principle of order tracking analysis and compared it with the traditional spectrum analysis, expounded the superiority of order tracking analysis. Applied this method to the condition detection of turbine, and certified its validity through experiment.

articleTitle: A New VLSI Implementation of Continuous Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper proposed a VLSI implementation of the continuous wavelet transform. The proposed approach consists of generating a chain of wavelets by multiplying two periodic functions. Each wavelet is then multiplied by the signal to be analyzed, and integrated. And time-frequency decomposition of signal, i.e. partial zoom of the analyzed signal can be gained. The multiplier is a DC-40 GHz INP HBT Gilbert multiplier, and the low-pass filter is a companding log-domain circuit. In the paper first used current-mode companding circuit technology to implement 1D continuous wavelet transform , which has a characteristic of high-speed, expanded frequency, simplified and low-voltage low-power. The PSPICE and Matlab simulation of the reconstruction and the basic cell such as multiplier and LPF are given. The results show that the CWT companding circuit proposed in the article is feasible.

articleTitle: Extraction of the Air Target Position on the CCD Image
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: After comprehensively studying OSTU method with maximum variance between two classes and the genetic algorithm (GA) principle, an OSTU method based on the self adaptive genetic algorithm (SAGA) is proposed for image segmentation. In this paper, the OSTU method is optimized in the GA based on the encoding, selection, crossover and mutation operations. The experimental results show that by using SAGA method, the efficiency of getting the optimal solutions can be improved, the premature problem can be avoided to a great extent and finally the satisfying solution can be achieved. The image segmentation results show that the OSTU method based on the SAGA is not only quicker in computing speed, but also higher quality in image segmentation. On the basis of the better image segmentation result, the target position in the CCD image can be extracted more accurately in the centroid method.

articleTitle: Effect of Digital Map on Active Beidou Position System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: On condition that the digital map in the controlling center provides for the user the altitude, the active Beidou Double-Star position system (for short: double-star) can determine the position of the user. This article analyzes the effect of the altitudes of digital map on the position precision, and deduces the error expressions. Many simulation results show that the effect of the altitude errors on the positioning precision meets the rules that altitude error has little effect on the east-west position error, but has large effect on the south-north position error.

articleTitle: Functional Interface Model and Its Application in the Networked Virtual Instrument Testing System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, firstly a design thinking, which is based on functional interface model, is put forward. Then the functional interface model based on component technology, which implements the Portability and IVI (Interchangeable Virtual Instruments) for the TPS, and the separation of data acquisition, analysis processing, data management and fault diagnosis, is studied. At last the networked virtual instrument testing platform is established, which is based on the functional interface model and the design project of software and hardware for certain missile networked virtual instrument testing system is given.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Excitation Control System for AC-Excited Generator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the excitation control system of ACEG(AC Excitation generator) is studied. The mathematical model for ACEG based on Park equation and the mathematics model of cyclo-converter is given. And with these mathematics models, the performance of ACEG is simulated. Second, the control strategy of the excitation system is discussed. At last, a new practical scheme of excitation control system is given and some simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Fault Testing And Diagnosis System Of Armored Vehicle Based On Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces a fault testing and diagnosis system of bearing in armored vehicle. It can realize real-time testing and precise fault diagnosis of bearing on vehicle chassis. In the hardware, it adopts PCL1800 data acquisition card to acquire sample data and send to the software. In the software, we compile fault testing and diagnosis system of bearing in armored vehicle on a portable computer, its core diagnostic method based on virtual instrument and multi-sensor information fusion technology. Virtual testing subsystem has various functions, including on-line data acquiring, signal displaying, different kinds of signals analyzing and data management. It only monitors the status of bearing and warning alarm. The further work to judge the type and the severity factor of the faults lies on fault diagnosis subsystem based on neural network information fusion technology.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Monitor and Fault Diagnosis Specialist System for Micro-plus Air Pressure Conveying Fly Ash
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aimed at micro-plus air pressure conveying fly ash applied in coal-fired power plant widely, a suit of real-time monitor and fault diagnosis specialist system was designed. The real-time monitor system can choose local or upper operator optionally, display the current operating condition of micro-plus air pressure conveying fly ash system on computer display and simulative board timely and facilely. The fault diagnosis specialist system has used modularization structure and laminal design idea, so the interface is friendly and the usage is facility, moreover, it can judge the fault of micro-plus air pressure conveying fly ash system, and prepare the processing measures exactly. The suit of real-time monitor and fault diagnosis specialist system is not only used as visual aid in experiment, but also as the important monitor system in master control room of coal-fired power plant.

Author Keywords: micro-plus air pressure conveying fly ash

articleTitle: Strain Measuring System for Hopkinson Pressure Bar
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A combination mode of host computer and slave computer is adopted by strain measuring system for Hopkinson pressure bar. The host computer is a microcomputer mode Pentium 4 which can be used in after-processing of measurement,while the 8098 single microcomputer used by the slave computer as controller, and data acquisition consists of sensors, converters, interfaces and peripheral equipment, carries out logging, display and printing of parameters for strain ,pressure displacements and temperatures etc. (that is preprocessing of data). Data transmission between host computer and slave computer can be realized by serial mode via the interface RS-232. This paper describes configuration and designing of this system in detail.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Composite Control Structure Scheme Based on Feedforward Counterbalance of ANN's Inverse Model
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to identify and model and effectively control to the complicated nonlinear systems, principle of identification and control of the ANN's (artificial neural network) inverse model was analysed for nonlinear system in the paper. Simulation researches of the composite control structure scheme based on the feedforward counterbalance of the ANN's inverse model was done for nonlinear system. Simulation researches were done for the composite control scheme with conventional PID controller + counterbalance of the MFN (multilayer feedforward network) ANN's inverse model. The simulation results show, the composite control structure scheme designed is successful, and the relatively simple network architecture can be improved generalization ability of the ANN's inverse model and the control precision for nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Research on Amendment of a Machine Gun's Dynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The modes and its vibrations of the weapon system have the greatest effect on shot dispersion. It is very important to get its dynamic characteristic for the good of firing accuracy. A method to amend the dynamic characteristics of a machine gun is presented. The modal analysis experiment platform based on LMS is built. The results supply academic gist for further improving the structure dynamic characteristic of the machine gun.

articleTitle: Forward Implementation Algorithm of Log-polar Transformation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The log-polar transformation(LPT) is the main realized idea of variable spatial resolution vision system. But the realized algorithms are scarce. The forward implementation algorithm of LPT is proposed in the paper. The transformation is based on the determination of uniform image rings and spoke values. The distance and angular axis are dispersed respectively and the respective one-to-one mapping rings are obtained. Then the two mapping rings are unified. With the algorithm, the data quantity of result matrix is lowed and the fast transformation of image can be implemented. The standard Lena image is analyzed with the algorithm and results show the algorithm is validity.

articleTitle: Study of Chip Level Self-Repaired Technology Based on EHW
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In extreme environment, the electronic system is being continuously bombarded by harmful radiation. This can cause local damage of the circuit and result in failure of the entire system. In this paper we introduced a new technology EHW (evolvable hardware technology) to repair the function of the system. EHW is a kind of hardware that can change its architecture and behavior dynamically and autonomously. The introduction of EHW technology can improve the system's reliability and self-repaired capability in extreme environment.

articleTitle: Surface Roughness Measurements of Titanium Alloy Plates Using Improved Ultrasonic Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new ultrasonic spectroscopic technique has been developed to fast assess the adhesive surface roughness of aerial titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4V) plates, which was pretreated by grit blasting. A surface area roughness coefficient s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub> has been introduced to specify the 3D topography of a material surface on a quantitative basis. Comprehensive theoretical models based on analyzing the AR parameter spectrum of the received ultrasonic signals have been developed to study the effect of surface on reflected ultrasonic pulses from the adhesive surfaces. When the transducer received a pulse reflected from the titanium alloy surface of the sample, the AR parameter spectrum was compiled. The computer then generated a theoretical curve to match the profile of the spectrum using a theoretical model for surface roughness and a minimization algorithm. The resulting value of the roughness coefficient s<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>, representing the best match, was a measure of the surface roughness. A virtual instrument that can obtain and display the roughness coefficient in real time based on a data card is presented. The implemented functions are described. The integrated programming package DRVI was used to design the analyzer.

articleTitle: Design of a PCI Bus High Precision and Wide Range Programmable Current Generator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Corresponding to the common dilemma of programmable current generator's narrow output range and low precision, this paper is intended to present one design of a PCI bus high precision and wide programmable current generator. A 16-bit DAC is put into use to improve the precision of output voltage and V-I transition is easily realized by means of the operational amplifiers which has features such as low noise, temperature drift, distortion and high driving ability. By the precise sampling resistors and 24-bit ADC, the design samples the output current. And then based on the results, discrete increment PID close loop control is adopted in the drivers to realize self calibration of the output. Finally, validated by HP 34401A millimeter, the results shows the output ranges from -50mA to +50mA when the output error is smaller than ±3μA, which proves that the design improves output range and precision.

articleTitle: Decoupling Strategy of Multi-dimensional Force Sensor Based on LS-SVM and αth-order Inverse System Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The coupling of multi-component force sensor is a key factor to limiting its measuring precision. It has become a popular direction of study. The alpha th-order inverse system decoupling strategy is newly proposed in the paper. One strong coupling MIMO system is decoupled into a number of 2nd-order integral subsystems. The dynamic calibration experiments should be processed by applying loads on the force sensor. In this way, the dynamic character of force sensor would be caught. The dynamic relations among inverse system could be indicated with integrators. Static nonlinear function's approximation of correspondence of inverse system is implemented via training learning network of LS-SVM. Finally, the decoupling of force sensor was realized. Simulation examples verified the availability of the method.

articleTitle: Study on Automatic Inspection of Stabilizator Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The computer vision technology is applied into the stabilizator performance's measurement system, and automatic, real-time test is realized. After utilizing digit image processing technology to analyze and research image data, the image energy centers are acquired, which indicate the motion trace of laser spot. Further, the gun real trace is obtained through the scale ratio conversion, and the test parameters are evaluated.

articleTitle: Nyquist Pulses based on Spectral Mask Constraint for Deep Space Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The Space Frequency Coordination Group (SFCG) has recently recommended a set of restrictions on the power spectral densities of space-to-earth telemetry signals. These restrictions take the form of spectral mask. We review PAM signal in the presence of additive white Gaussian noise, as well as the Nyquist criterion for avoiding intersymbol interference. The impact such masks having on the issue of intersymbol interference is discussed, a necessary and sufficient condition for a given spectral mask to be compatible with Nyquist criterion. Finally, we conclude that the SFCG masks will permit the use of a root-raised-cosine Nyquist pulse shape.

articleTitle: A New Fault Diagnosis Approach: Interactive Electronic Technical Manual Based on PDM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This study presents a new design approach for the support of integrated diagnosis requirements of complex technical system, a product data management (PDM) based IETM system structure model is put forward, which can automatically analyze, recognize, localize and diagnose the system fault or failure state. Here, technologies that are required for developing the new model are classified into three groups: (1) the ITEM-oriented data modeling based on PDM, (2) the PDM based IETM generation interface, (3) the diagnosis technology in IETM system.

articleTitle: Study and Realization of Microwave Tumor-therapy Equipment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Microwave fever therapy, after operation, radiotherapy and chemotherapy, whose vitality is imponderable, becomes the fourth way of curing malignancy and has the special effect. Therefore the development of microwave tumor-therapy equipment is of far-reaching significance. In this paper, realization the microwave tumor-therapy equipment which can be controlled in output power. It overcomes the defect uncontrolled. The experiment result shows that, the equipment can stabilize the microwave output completely. And it has the advantages of intelligent control, steady microwave output and precise power control.

articleTitle: Collection system of gastric motility information by epigastric impedance and EGG
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: AM-In order to research gastric motility information, a new collection system base on ADuC834 was designed. Methods: ADuC834 was selected to collect the low-frequency gastric impedance signal. The filter circuit was simple and only got rid of the interference of EMG and ECG. The software base on wavelet transform assumed all signals processing work. Result: The gastric motility information can be observed in this study. We can research gastric motility situation according to the signal extracted by ADuC834 and wavelet transform. Conclusion: ADuC834 is suitable for extracting the low frequency gastric impedance signal and can further simplify the hardware configuration. All useful gastric motility information can pass through the simple filter circuit. Wavelet transform have good performance to get rid of the interference. Experiments have proved that the system base on ADuC834 is feasible and a reliable collection system is provided to research gastric motility information.

articleTitle: Research on QoS Evaluation Metrics for Distributed Multimedia System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: So far, many kinds of distributed multimedia systems have been widely used and multimedia data, including audio and video, are the main data objects to be transmitted over network. The characteristics of multimedia data bring special QoS demand for a distributed multimedia system. In this paper, an integrated performance analysis model PAM for distributed multimedia system is proposed. Based on model PAM, QoS evaluation metrics for the system is researched, and four parameters are deduced to describe the performance of network, destination buffer and multimedia streams. The QoS evaluation metrics can be used to get a comprehensive view of the QoS for a distributed multimedia system.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Corner Detection for Multicolor Pseudo-random Encoded Image
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel method of corner detection for multicolor pseudo-random encoded image is proposed. With this method, the unique window characteristics of pseudo-random array pattern is extended to multicolor images, and by using quadratic curve fitting to pixel gray level around the feature point and solving its extreme value, the sub-pixel location of corner in multicolor pseudo-random code can be implemented.

articleTitle: Application of Matching Theory in Configuration of Test Ports and Instruments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The test method of port test in most automatic test systems is instrument oriented manual configuration now, and the test efficiency is very low. For this problem, a relation model of test ports and instruments was established based on graph theory. The configuration of test ports and instruments is described by "graph", so the project problem is transformed into mathematics problem. Based on the relation model, an algorithm named MTC for dynamic configuration of test ports and instruments was proposed. By using the algorithm the configuration scheme that has the maximal parallel degree is found, and parallel test is achieved effectively. The algorithm was based on matching theory and its correctness and validity were approved by both theory and example. A signal oriented automatic configuration test method was proposed based on the model and algorithm, so that the automatic configuration of test ports and instruments is achieved. The method was validated by experiment in actual system and the result showed the port test efficiency was enhanced greatly.

articleTitle: Intelligent Blood Collecting Apparatus Used in Worksite with Solar Energy Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The intelligent blood collecting apparatus used in worksite with solar energy power supply is introduced in this paper. The apparatus is supplied with AC and DC power system and DC power is solar energy system. So it can be used in case of emergency. The apparatus uses barcode technology to input the information of the donator. The apparatus can measure the volume of collected blood, the flow rate of blood, the time of blood collecting and show all procedures of collecting blood. When the collection is over, it can stop collecting and the blood bag can be sealed automatically. It accomplishes automation of collecting blood and increases reliability of collecting blood.

articleTitle: Research of Targets Detection Based on Integer Wavelet Transform and Utilize in TV Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper,we present a method of detecting small targets and realize algorithm in TV tracking system. The approach uses lifting wavelet transform and finds parts having the same feature in the targets. We utilize one of integer-type lifting wavelet transforms that contains rounding-off arithmetic for mapping integers to integers. The advantage of using integer-type wavelet transform is simple and robust to noise. Simulation illustrated the method can detect and track the moving targets in dim background. We would test our method in the TV tracking system.

articleTitle: Time Series-Neural Networks Diagnostics for the Fatigue Crack of the Large-scale Overloaded Supporting shaft
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The time series-neural network is attempted to be applied in research on diagnosing the fatigue crack's degree based on the analysis of characteristics on the supporting shaft. By analyzing the characteristic parameter which is easy to be detected from the supporting shaft's exterior, the time series model parameter which is hypersensitive to the situation of fatigue crack is the target input of neural network, and the fatigue crack's degree value of supporting shaft is the output. The BP network model can be built and trained after the structural parameters of network are selected. Furthermore, choosing the other two different group data can test the network. The test result will verify the validity of the BP network model. The result of experiment shows that the method of time series-neural network is effective to diagnose the occurrence and the development of the fatigue crack's degree on the supporting shaft.

articleTitle: Meterage of Frame and Position Error Based on Laser Computer Vision System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A non-contact computer vision (CV) system based on structured light is introduced, which is designed to measure the frame and position error of column-shaped objects, such as diameter, coaxiality, straightness accuracy and radial angle. The mathematical theory of the meterage of all the parameters based on structured light is also introduced. At the end, all the theory is validated in experiments, which contains the calibration of the cameras and the plane of the structured light, the meterage of the curve equation of borderline of the section plane, and the angle between two normal vectors. The system is proved effective, especially when meterage of large numbers of production is needed, the system can save plentiful time and manual work. The theory introduced in this paper has added a new idea to the field of non-contact meterage.

Author Keywords: meterage of frame and position error

articleTitle: A New Instrument for Ceramic Pug Moisture Measurement with Microwave
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new instrument for ceramic pug moisture measurement has been developed, and microwave heater, power supply system, high precision weight sensor and Single Chip Microcomputer (SCM) system are all designed. Through the experimental data, the conclusion can be drawn that the microwave moisture instrument can detect the moisture of ceramic pug rapidly with high precision.

articleTitle: Optimum Watermarking Algorithm Based-on Cost Function
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper proposed a cost function in DWT domain, which combines the two most critical properties including the transparency and robustness. Based on the cost function, the optimum location can be found for watermarking. Through modeling to the wavelet coefficient by the GGD (generalized Gaussian density), we proposed the method of estimation of shape parameter, which corresponding to LOD (locally optimum detection) also can be used in watermarking detection. By utilizing the proposed approach, a good compromise between the transparency and robustness can be gotten in experiments.

articleTitle: Virtual Realization of Temperature Measurement of PRTD Based on Radial Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The problem of estimating the sensor's input-output characteristic is being increasingly tackled using software techniques. Artificial neural network (ANN) method is a useful curve-fitting method. A model of PRTD (platinum resistance-temperature device) using radial basis function (RBF) neural network is presented. After the successful training of ANN using scale division data, it is then used as a neural estimator to calculate the temperature from resistance. Suitable spread parameter of the model is determined as 0.3-1.0. The absolute error is 0degC for data in specimen and 0.03~0.06degC out of specimen. The results indicate that model presented is simple in algorithm, accurate and steady. Software and hardware composition of VI system and virtual realization process of temperature measurement based on joint programming of LabVIEW and MATLAB including front panel and block diagram are given. Running results indicate that virtual realization method integrating ANN and VI is easy and inexpensive and can be used in other application fields for reference.

articleTitle: Study on Numerical Analysis Methods of EM Field and the Radiated Fields from ESD
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper discusses some typical methods of numerical calculation of electromagnetic field and presents the application of finite - difference time - domain (FDTD) algorithm in the radiated fields from ESD. As for the deficiency of the traditional FDTD algorithm, the development of numerical analysis methods is analyzed.

articleTitle: Time delay estimation of chirp signal under chaotic environment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive time delay estimation algorithm based on wavelet transform is presented by combing the multiresolution wavelet analysis and LMS algorithm. Furthermore, the validity of this algorithm is studied to estimate the time delay of the chirp signal which is under the chaotic environment. The experimental result shows that the time delay could be estimated precisely despite the SCR (signal to chaotic signal ratio) below -40dB. When this algorithm is applied to the chaotic background which includes Gaussian white noise (SNR=-5dB and SCR=-12dB), the time delay could also be estimated precisely, but the performance of the algorithm drops.

articleTitle: A Method of Analysis for Grinding Wheel's Unbalanced Signal Based on Wavelet Packet
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: There are a large quantity of noises and the broadband signals with other period composition in the vibration signal of grinding wheel, so it is important to extract signal with the same frequency of the grinding wheel in order to keep precise balance of the signal. The precision of the traditional methods where a band-pass filter has been used is not high, and the parameters must be re-designed to the different grinding wheel machines. By the decomposition of wavelet packet to the vibration signal of the grinding wheel, the good frequency characteristic can be obtained, which can provide an effective way to analyze the unbalanced signal with vibration around the unsteady state. An experiment is given in this paper, and it is concluded that the proposed method can extract the signal more precisely than the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Design and Research on New Track System for Machine Tool
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The kernel of this system is controlled by single-chip computer type 8031 to surveillance the real-time working state of bed. It can collect three-direction cutting-force, which are created at the same time and are called F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</sub> F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Y</sub> F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Z</sub> by time-sharing. Three-direction cutting-force will be converted to the variable voltage through resistance strain gage, after amplification, filtering, anti-jamming, with single-chip computer sampling and holding, analog-to-digital conversion and control through multi-switch and then putting the results in the memorizer. The system is expanded with the function of print, display, keyboard and so on and enhanced the function of man-machine dialogue.

articleTitle: Study on Lower Extremity Exoskeleton Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The wave-filtering characteristics of the RLS self-adapting filter and the method of wavelet de-noising are studied, and the two are used as the methods of filtering noises in the fact signals tested from the lower extremity exoskeleton. In order to get better effects of filtering noises, different methods are used to different signals. The noise-filtering method based on changing the threshold of small wave transformation is used to filter white noise in digital signals. The self-adapting filter is used to other noises whose statistic characteristics are uncertain, or the both are combined to filter noises in such signal. For the wavelet de-noising of changeable threshold quality, there are two pivotal questions need to be settled. One is the choice of the threshold quality, the other is the determination of level-decomposition. In this paper, the adaptable determination method of level-decomposition is used, and the threshold quantity selection based on 3 σ theorem is applied. The simulations of the fact signals tested from the lower limbs' exoskeleton validated the superiority of noise-eliminating methods given in this paper.

articleTitle: Theory of Two-phase Flow Interior Ballistics of Rarefaction Wave Gun
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new species of gun (Rarefaction wave gun) propulsion that dramatically reduce recoil momentum and heat imparted to the future cannons during firing. The method may be considered a hybrid propulsion technology with features common to both closed-breech cannons and recoilless rifles. A new interior ballistics model is presented, which may better be understood. Expatiated and argued contents as follow: background and meaning of study the task, the theory and numerical simulation of interior ballistic based on modern two-phase flow theory.

articleTitle: Expansion on Register Address Space of VXIbus Device and It's Application
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To the size C VXIbus model, it's PCB(Printed Circuit Board) is large enough to bearing several function circuit. But the A16 register based slave device only has 64 bytes address space to be used as operation registers and special registers. This paper gives a simple technique to expand the register address space, which was being used in special VXIbus module for testing missile. The external memory's addresses are mapped to specific offset address of VXIbus device, by using the internal logic of CPLD circuit. The VXIbus master controller can access the expanding address space by reading or writing the specific register. Timing simulation result of the logic circuit provides evidence for the design project. The realization and simulation results are presented, which proved that the method can solve the lack of register addresses effectively. Also, it is easy for practice, comparatively universal and very practical.

articleTitle: On the Development of Autonomous Powered Parachute
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The powered parachute (PPC)is now the most popular ultra-light flight equipments. The PPC has excellent self stability and is very simple to fly. To extend the PPC's application to some special area, for example, in long time cruise, precision airdrop, and dangerous mission, autonomous flight is required. This paper aims to fulfill such a design. The flight principle of the PPC is firstly analyzed to get the basic control variants and control rule. Then, the autonomous flight system structure is discussed. Later, an integrated sensor system designed is introduced in detail. This integrated sensor system can acquire information such as the PPC canopy location, the rudder rigging tensile force, the air speed and the ground speed of the craft, the absolute 3D location and the engine temperature, oil level etc. Information acquired by the integrated sensor system can reflect the real-time situations of the PPC, this is very important for the flight controller to make a proper flight plan or take actions to response emergency situations. The primary results of our work have shown the efficiency of the proposed integrated sensor system and the high feasibility of the PPC's autonomous flight.

articleTitle: Auto Calibration Test Method and Device for Swing Scanning Earth Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Swing scanning Earth sensor (SSES) is one of the key components in Middle Earth Orbit (MEO) satellites and High Earth Orbit (HEO) satellites for attitude sensing. Traditional calibration and test method could only be used in completely installed SSES. According to analysis of the calibration and test task in the uninstalled SSES, a new method and device which constitutes a closed-loop calibration test system in different development stage of SSES is proposed. The experiment and application results show that the method and device presented in this article constitute a better calibration test system for developing and producing the SSES.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Acquirement System for Three - Dimensional Data of Maintain Materiel
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the basis of requirement analysis for information management of ordnance equipment maintain material, this paper has advanced research task of 3D data acquisition and management system for ordnance material maintain material, and the collectivity scheme and work flow of system is present. The key technology and solve means of system is emphatically expatiated, such as 3D laser scan technology, 3D model re-construct technology, 3D data manage technology and so on. The system will provide importance basic data and powerful technology means for material information manage and exactitude support.

articleTitle: Implementation of Automatic Adjustment Approach of Feature Modeling
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is very important that each feature model of a product remains valid in itself, and, in addition, consistent with the other feature models of the product at the same time. In current feature modelling systems, an invalid feature model always has to be manually adjusted in order to make it valid again, and a feature model for which a consistent feature model in another view does not exist also has to be manually adjusted in order to make such a consistent feature model possible. An approach to avoid this is to have the system automatically adjust the feature model. The presented approach has been built on top of existing constraint solvers and checkers, which are a geometric and an algebraic constraint solver, and a dimension and an interaction constraint checker, and therefore can support several types of constraints. And the automatic model adjustment strategies for different types of constraints will be elaborated. At last, an example was introduced.

articleTitle: An Improved Cellular Automaton Model for Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A cellular automaton model for traffic flow with crossings controlled by traffic-polices is proposed. The simulations reveal that there are qualitative distinguishes between traffic flow models with and without polices. In the cellular automaton models with traffic-polices, the free flow phase occurs at a much lower car density, and the characteristic of the first-order transition disappears, and two second-order transitions come forth, and jamming phase moves towards higher concentrations, and thus traffic performances are dramatically improved. It is shown that the traffic flow model with traffic-polices conforms with the realistic traffic.

articleTitle: Differential Power Analysis for Data Encryption Standard
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Along with the society relies on more and more greatly to the computer, people also attach more and more importance to the security problem in the application. The cryptography is continuously safeguarding the safe effectively protective screen of system. Owing to the fact that to break the key using mathematics technology is very difficult, people put forward the side-channel attack method in recent years. The major content of this paper is the research of differential power analysis.

articleTitle: Study of Interferometric Noise Analysis in Optical CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Delay line technique is used in OCDMA (Optical Code Division Multiple Access) system for investigation of the interferometric noise in optical domain. The interferometric noises with the change of EXT, Δf (linewidth of the laser) and ΔT (temperature change) are analysed in detail. The experiment results show that the interferometric noise produced by the variation of temperature of optical components brings the worst case for the OCDMA system, with this kind of noise the all optical CDMA can not be realized so far. The method using electronic en/decoding process to achieve CDMA in optical channel may be a promising choice which can provide a good performance with narrow bandwidth in optical access network.

articleTitle: Characteristic of a Bullet's Digital Images Under the Illumination of Different Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: When a gun is fired, it makes special marks on its bullet casing and projectile. We call these marks as firearm fingerprints. These firearm fingerprints can be distinguished as we identify a person from his fingerprints. The fireball firearm identification system, which is digital imaging and surface profiling information system for forensic ballistics identification, consists of CCD camera, microscope, ring-light source, stepper motor, projectile specimen, graphic capture card and a computer. The fireball system works in line-scan manner. It can take images of cylindrical projectiles and cartridge cases for identification, while it is difficult to deal with the cylindrical projectiles and cartridge cases by traditional method. In this paper in order to find which wavelength light is the best light for the digital images of projectiles, we use the fireball system under the light illumination which wavelength is from 400nm to 700nm. For simplicity, the projectiles are motionless. Experiment reveals that the longer wavelength light has better effect on the digital images. The high quality of images of projectiles is the basis for their accurate identification.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Inclinometer Based on Servo-accelerator of Quartz Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The structure and basic theory of automatic inclinometer system was presented, which take advanced quartz servo-accelerometer as sense organ. Quartz inclinometer can be used to measure the vertical vector of gravitation g in axes using probe sensor in order to confirm the incline angle of probe axes relatively horizontal. Therefore uprightness displacement of probe axes relatively horizontal can be calculated based on this measuer principle. The paper presents the real-time measuring curve of quartz inclinometer. The result indicates that the system has many merits, such as high measure precision, better anti-jamming character, light mass, low power cost and it fits fieldwork for power supply by battery.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on Hybrid Re-Engineering
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Although re-engineering is often used as means to mitigate risks and reduce costs of operation and maintaining the legacy software, re-engineering has several risk areas on process, reverse engineering, forward engineering, tools and so on. In this paper, we describe an improved method which is hybrid re-engineering. It can solute risks of re-engineering and has great research value.

articleTitle: Design of Combination Antenna of Whip Antenna and Quadrifilar Helix Antenna
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel combination antenna of whip antenna and quadrifilar helix antenna is designed in this paper. Applying the numerical method of electromagnetic field, the influences of radiation pattern and S-parameter between whip antennas and different quadrifilar helix antennas are investigated. The results show that the combination antenna can work in ultra short wave band for the communication and RNSS B3 wave band for satellite navigation at the same time.

articleTitle: A New Structure of the Random Fuzzy Theory on BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The author first introduces the typical back-propagation Ann's model and the reasons why we it is used in this paper. And then. And then, the author states the random fuzzy theory and gives some useful definition and theorem that will be used in the next part. In the last part of this paper, the author gives the new structure and the process of BP model on the random fuzzy theory, which is widely used nowadays.

articleTitle: An Object-Oriented System Design Method for Autonomous Soccer Robot
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the background of autonomous soccer robot game, the autonomous soccer robot system is analyzed wholly. And the characteristics of designing system by using Unified Modeling Language (UML) are discussed. By depicting the requirements and behaviors of autonomous soccer robot system, we unify the system modeling and software realization. The instance shows how to use UML to design system, and illuminates the importance of UML in system analysis and design. It offers a new method for the modeling and design of robot system.

articleTitle: Detecting Method of Weak Sine Signal with Initial Phase
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Generally, the detecting signal methods based on the chaos theory always cope with the signal whose phase angle is zero. On this basis, this paper expands the method of chaos theory to the situation that the phase angle does not equal zero. According to initial phase angle of different detected signal, different driving force value automatically is set up. Output states of the system are detected from chaotic critical state to cycle state by automatically searching threshold value. Then make the system go back to chaotic critical state again by regulating the driving force value. Lastly, the amplitude and phase angle are solved by corresponding algorithm. This method can further perfect and supplement former methods. The simulation results indicate that this method can enhance the detecting performance of system and improve the measurement precision.

articleTitle: A Test Generating Algorithm of Sequential Circuits Based on State Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper based on descriptive model of sequential circuit's equation groups provides the algorithm by putting state forecasting techniques into the generation algorithm of test vector. First, carry out the process of fault propagation based on Boolean logic equation groups according to specific fault. And this procedure will be simplified to some degree by using new function model of fault propagation and state forecasting techniques proposed in this paper. Second, by taking continuous iteration of figuring out the logical equation group to fulfill the procedure of fault injection serve to make state jump become directional, which reduces lots of computations. Hence, this proposed algorithm does have significant performance exaltation supported by the results of experiments to indicate the feasibility and high efficiency of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Detecting and Processing of Output Signals in Transfusion Speed Monitor Adapted to Numerous Kinds of Liquids
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: People have paid more attention to their own health in present era. And the control precision of liquid dropping speed has been highly requested in the transfusion process. This paper introduces the design of signal detecting and processing circuit in which MCU C8051F206 is embedded and the system establishment of transfusion speed monitor adapted to many kinds of liquids. It's suitable for dropping speed control of kinds of liquids with different conductivity. Not only dropping speed can be displayed during transfusion process, but the upper and lower limitation can also be adjusted. According to your adjustment it can give an alarm when the dropping speed oversteps the limitation. The frame of the hardware system is given in the paper, too. In the final part, the actual systematic detecting and processing effect has been tested and the test content proves the accuracy of this design.

articleTitle: Rotational Analysis of Certain Terminal-Guidance Projectile
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The terminal-guidance shell is a shell which can be launched by the conventional cannon, but precisely guided during the terminal part of the trajectory. It can attack the static or moving slowly target accurately in the intermediate range and long range. It attacks the target on the top with big fall angle. It has the characters as launched frequently, high initial speed, continuous emission, used flexibly, repair easily as the common shell, also has the characters the common shell doesn't have , such as high accuracy and great power. However, its trajectory characters become complex, so it is a hard task to research its ballistics and motion rules. Typical characteristic of a certain terminal-guidance shell is: not-control shell's rotating velocity and keeping certain but not-unchangeable rotating velocity. It is mainly discussed in this article.

articleTitle: Study on Testability for Informationization Materiel System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As the "killer weapon" of future informationization war, Informationization Materiel System (IMS) has plentiful information technology, complex system configuration and high testability requirement. Testability is the concernful problem of maintainability and it would get more important with the development of weapon materiel and the requirement of modern war. First, the prominent characteristics of IMS and the primary performance indexes of its testability are analyzed and the application of Built-in Test (BIT) technology is discussed. Then some design problems of BIT for IMS is studied. This could have referenced significance for the testability design of IMS.

articleTitle: Study of the Signal Readout System in a Multilayered Waveguide Memory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Signal readout technique is very important for the multilayered waveguide optical memory, which is based on an optical waveguide principle and a promising subject in the optical storage field compared to other 3D optical memory techniques. In this paper, the electric system is designed, the controlling system design ,the servo system design and the pre-signal design are discussed in detail, the key steps of testing multilayer disc are given in this paper, the experiment shows that the multilayered disc system works well.

articleTitle: Development of On-line Monitoring Equipment of Medium Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a set of on-line monitoring equipment of medium voltage switchgear is introduced, the structure of dual-CPU is adopted, on-line monitoring of the temperature of bus-bar with self-made infrared temperature sensor, on-line monitoring of the temperature rise of CT/PT with thermocouple of T type, on-line monitoring of leakage current of insulator bushing to reflect its characteristic of insulation, monitoring the arc fault in switchgear with self-made arc sensor, real-time on-line monitoring of multi-parameters comes true. Two sets of power are used to supply the circuits insulated respectively, and the measure of restraint of EMI in PCB design is implemented and so on, the equipment can work normally in the switchgear where the electro magnetic interference is serious.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of the Temperature Distribution in SiC Sublimation Growth System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Although serious attempts have been developed silicon carbide bulk crystal growth technology to an industrial process during the last years, the quality of crystal remains deficient. One of the major problems is that the thermal field of SiC growth systems is not fully understood. Numerical simulation is considered as an important tool for the investigation of the thermal field distribution inside the growth crucible system involved with SiC bulk growth. We employ the finite-element software package ANSYS to provide additional information on the thermal field distribution. A two-dimensional model has been developed to simulate the axisymmetric growth system consist of a cylindrical susceptor (graphite crucible), a graphite felt insulation, and a copper inductive coil. The modeling field is coupled electromagnetic heating and thermal transfer. The induced magnetic field is used to predict heat generation due to magnetic induction. Conduction, convection and radiation in various components of the system are accounted for the heat transfer ways. The thermal field in SiC sublimation growth system was provided.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Filter Base on Linear Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an arithmetic method of bilinear transform is introduced, it can be used to realize the system transform from analog low pass to digital low pass, digital high pass, band pass and band stop. The coefficient matrix can be obtained by the binomial calculation, the elements of matrix can be got only by addition and they are ruled which can be realized by computer, This bilinear transform arithmetic method is very clear, we can get the digital system transfer function by matrix transform from the numerator and denominator polynomial coefficient of analog system transfer function. Compared by the general calculation, this method is convenient high precision easy to adjust. In the automation and digital signals disposal field, it is very valuable.

articleTitle: Analyzing Signals Radiated from Corona Discharge by Fractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Studying the signals radiation from corona discharge can provide the important theory basis for on-line monitoring and diagnosis of gas insulated substation (GIS) partial discharge. In this text, the wavelet packet and fractal theory were used to analyze the corona discharge signals. Firstly, the corona discharge signals were decomposed to several frequency bands. The fractal dimension of every band was calculated, and the fractal dimension was used as characteristics of signals radiation from corona discharge. The character peaks of signals radiation from corona discharge were determined by fractal dimension, and the differences of different voltage were found.

articleTitle: To Generalize Array Illumination by a Multiple Phase Grating and a Lens
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Array illumination is an array distribution of light. There are many kinds of array illuminators such as tiny lens array illuminator and Talbot array illuminator. Talbot array illuminator generates array distribution by fractional Talbot effect of a phase grating. Array illumination can be used in many fields such as industrial measurement and photoelectric mixed treatment. In this paper we study how to use a multiple phase grating and a lens to fulfil array illumination. We will give an analytical expression to study the array illumination for a given multiple phase grating and a lens. By using a multiple phase grating, we can more easily raise the intensity of the diffraction light, and this will be benefit to the actual measurement. From the analytical expression we know that the spatial structure can be conveniently adjusted by the multiple phase grating and the lens. Thus industry measurement can be more easily carried out.

articleTitle: Study of 600A Direct-Current Standard
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Now, in the range of DC high current Measurement, these questions is also occurring: the lower current measurement range(≪600A), the lower accuracy(5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>). it didn't able to meet the requirement of high-power test equipment's verification. So, the study of DC 600A current standard will resolve the question of high- current equipment's verification. The work include tow parts: the first, the DC 600A current transducer(the accuracy: 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>), the second, the DC 600A current standard single afford unit. Thereby, the standard have the ability of output 0600A and the ability of test DC 0600A current standard single. Fulfilling the verification of DC high current. There into, the DC 600A current transducer is developed using a new technique on zero-flux detecting principle, The circuit in the transducer can track the variation of magnetizing current and compensate it by single chip processor systems automatically to assure the magnetic core working in "zero- flux" condition. it was used for testing DC 0600A single.
