Simulation results of diagnosing a four op-amp biquad high-pass filter circuit have confirmed the validity of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Using DLL for PC/104 Data Acquiring in LabVIEW Platform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As a high efficient graphical soft development environment, LabVIEW is used in data acquiring and testing and measuring extensively. Because NI (national instruments) company doesn't support drivers for other company's card, there is an obstacle in programming by labVIEW in PC/104 system. By analyzing the mechanism of dynamic link library (DLL), this paper introduced the key technique of driving PC/104 data acquiring card on Lab VIEW platform by using DLL, given a concrete method of using ADT700. Test result shows the system can work effectively and stably, satisfied the design desire.

articleTitle: Breakdown Voltage Analysis of SOI LDMOS with Step Buried Oxide
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: On the basis of analyzing SOILDMOS structure with step buried oxide, the modulation effect of SOILDMOS step buried field plate on surface electric field of drift region is analyzed, according to modulation theory of field plate on surface electric field. Besides, the effects of step buried oxide thickness and step number on breakdown voltage are also simulated and optimized by ISE. When buried oxide step number is 3 and step thickness is in the range of 0.8μm—1.2μm, surface electric field distribution is nearly uniform, breakdown point moves into body form surface, and breakdown voltage of SBOSOI is improved by 30%, compared to conventional SOI device, which provides a practical application conclusion for the design of SOILDMOS device.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Cost Effective System for Module Test Automation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Module test is often required to test product functionalities and reliabilities. This paper presents the design of a cost effective system for module test automation. The system uses NI LabVIEW for Linux, data acquisition hardware, and interface circuit boards designed for the module under test. The system is designed to capitalize on the advantages of PC based LabWindows/CVI test systems, while eliminating the disadvantages. The new design principle holds prospects for significantly reducing the product test sustaining cost, while providing both improved stability and security of the test system. The test system hardware architecture and software component development strategy make it easy for customer specific module test applications and future test capability expansion. The data from one module reliability test shows that this system is very reliable. The test system hardware and major software components can also be configured for chemical detection and environmental monitoring using fluctuation-enhanced multiple-gas sensing techniques.

articleTitle: Adaptive Image Blind Watermarking Method Based on Zerotree of Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Zerotree of wavelet based digital watermarking techniques are considered to be an efficient blind watermarking method, but the difficult of it is the determining of the threshold in watermarking process. A new method based on the types of the image block is presented to solve this problem. Experiment results show the superior performance in both qualities of the watermarked image and robustness of the embedded watermark

articleTitle: Research on Multi-source Heterogeneous Spatial Data Exchange Model Based on Ontology and GML
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Geography spatial data sharing and interoperation are the key technology of digital earth as well as digital city. They are also the precondition of national spatial information construction and spatial data utilization. Based on the analysis of several key technologies such as ontology, GML, GIS data integration and interoperation as well as their present research status, the system framework of GIS data integration and interoperation is studied firstly in this paper. Then, an ontology and GML-based spatial data exchange model and SVG-based information visualization model are proposed. Finally, by describing specific spatial concepts and their relationship with ontology, and labeling data model with ontology information, the data model not only has structure information but also has semantic information. Which provides a well support for the realization of full semantic data exchange.

articleTitle: 3D Texture Classification Using 3D Texture Histogram Model and SVM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A 3D texture classification method based on support vector machines (SVM) and histogram model is proposed in this paper. We compute the bidirectional histogram of Lambertian, isotropic, randomly rough surfaces which are common in real-world scenes firstly, and final classification results are gained with SVM. Performance is evaluated by employing 600 texture images corresponding to 61 real-world surface samples extracted from the Columbia-Utrecht reflectance and texture (CUReT) database. Our experiments produce good classification results.

articleTitle: Periodic Test in Quartz MEMS Vibrant Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The traditional test and measurement method with low sample frequency and long test time is not suitable to the test and measurement of quartz MEMS vibrant gyroscope zero drift. The quartz gyroscope short-time drift is studied and found in experiment that the drift is periodic and even more obvious in higher sampling frequency. A new accurate test and measurement method is brought forward after studying each error transfer coefficients of period's parameters with error analysis theory. The experiment results show that by this method the test precision of quartz gyroscopes can be improved and the measured parameters are more applicable to compensate quartz gyroscopes online in long subsequent time. It is proved that this method is more suitable to the quartz MEMS vibrant gyroscope.

articleTitle: Design of the Fault Diagnosis System of Generator Rotor Winding Inter-Turn Short Circuit Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Firstly the stator winding parallel-connected branches circulating current characteristics, caused by the rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault, are analyzed. The results discover that the second harmonics circulating current will increase when the fault occurs. Then the software of the Lab VIEW and the hardware of data acquisition card PCI-6251 is selected respectively, the fault diagnoses system based on virtual instrument is designed, the function is made up of the signal acquisition, signal analyzing, database management, parameter query, and fault diagnosis. Finally, the fault diagnosis system is successfully applied to SDF-9 generator.

Author Keywords: rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault

articleTitle: Design of Portable Personal Positioning System Based on SoC Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, considering the disadvantages of traditional GPS products, large size, high price, inaccurate positioning and single function, etc, a portable personal positioning system based on SoC technology is designed, which adopts a combined positioning technology using GPS and digital compass .The reliability and feasibility of system are proved by many experiments .

articleTitle: Multiple Motion Targets Detection and Tracking Based on Embedded Linux
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Motion target detection and tracking is widely applied in many fields, taking great convenience for people's life and work. In this paper, a difference-image-based motion target detection and tracking algorithm which uses statistics method and fits for embedded system, is presented. Use XScale 32 bits processor PXA270, transplant the embedded Linux and Qt/Embedded as embedded graphic library, carry out this motion target detection and tracking system by adopting mmap means capture data from camera. Experiments result shows this system has a preferably capability.

articleTitle: Software Design for Measurement of Bullet Attitude Based on Linear CCD
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aimed to the character of high speed of bullet, combined with the principle of linear CCD camera, the software for data acquisition and processing is developed in this article based on the computer programming techniques and image processing techniques. It is introduced integrated design scheme and realization of software for measurement of bullet attitude in Windows by VC++ and MATLAB, which solves the problem that bullet attitude is not measured at real-time. Application of experiment for measuring bullet attitude, this system can accomplish the task of measuring bullet's angle of attack and velocity parameters at real-time.

articleTitle: Function Block Application in ARM-based Field Intelligent Instruments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The design and implementation of function block application (FBA) in intelligent instruments is the core to the implementation of control function from intelligent field instruments. Function blocks represent the basic automatic function implemented by function block application. In this paper, the features of function block in intelligent field instruments based on ARM processor are analyzed, method and scheme for design and implementation of function block application in ARM-based intelligent instrument are proposed, which are based on function block parameters-type description, data partition and storing structure in intelligent instruments. 4 data-storing segments are allocated in static memory of intelligent instrument, which are instruction segment, input segment, output segment and contained parameters segment. Static pointers to respective data-storing segments are created, with which any parameters information used in function block application can be found quickly combined with the data and information stored in instruction segment, by which the connection and communication between function blocks are implemented. A implementation method for the operation mode of multi FBA (MFBA) based on map of data segment and memory allocation in intelligent instruments to virtual registers is proposed. The structure and implementation in C++ for the instruction code in instruction segment are also presented. The experimental and operational results show the design and implementation scheme for function block application in intelligent instruments with ARM kernel are scientific and reasonable, stable and efficient in operation.

articleTitle: Application of Pseudo-Random Sequence in Luminescence Detection Instruments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: More development works for luminescence detection instruments have been done on stimulated part or on receiver part. A new improvement for counter of luminescence detection instruments is introduced in this paper. Pseudo-random sequence is one kind of binary-code which can be designed as pre-request. The principle of shift register counter is introduced and design of pseudo-random counter is discussed at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: ANN-based Track Correlation Algorithm in Multisensor System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An algorithm of track-to-track correlation based on neural network is presented . On the basis of membership function in fuzzy logic, this paper presents the method of multi-dimension assignment of track correlation on the condition of multi-node. The problem of multi-dimension assignment is a nondeterministic polynomial complete problem, it is very hard to find its optimum solution and its computing burden is easy to increase exponentially. So a new model of three-dimension neural network is proposed to deal with the problem of three-dimension assignment. The experimental results illustrate that this model not only makes the correct track association percent high, but also the computing time can not increase exponentially with dimensions. And the model of three-dimension neural network proposed in this paper can be generalized to multi-dimension model to solve the problem of multi-dimension assignment.

articleTitle: Serial Communication Interface Design Based on Lab VIEW and VC Mix Programming
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This article proposed one serial port communication program method, which the DLL functions called by Lab VIEW. In the method the DLL functions are compiled with VC++, and call the DLL function in LabVIEW. The serial port communication is realized in LabVIEW environment by the mix programming between Lab View and VC++. The hybrid method is used in temperature control on injection mould machine, which used serial port for temperature data communication.

articleTitle: Analysis of Pulse Performance Based on Cd(Zn) Te Detector Spectrometry
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The analysis for pulse waveform is a sticking point for digital pulse processing. In this paper, the waveform of current pulse in Cd(Zn) Te detector and output pulse of preamplifier are analyzed in detail. The cause of formation of pile-up pulse is illuminated. And an identification method for pulse pile-up type by means of digital signal processing technique is offered, which indicates that it is possible to make use of pulses of slight leading-edge pile-up and general lagging-edge pile-up except some severe leading-edge pile-up for digital spectrometry.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Digital Informational System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The digital informational system (DIS) is a portable, handheld, battery-operated data collection device for collecting "real-world" data. In this paper the design and realization of the DIS in hardware and software are introduced. In core module there are three part: embedded CPU (S3C44B0XX SDRAM (HY57V641620HG) and FLASH (28F320C3BA100) form handheld instrument basic system. The popular ARM microprocessor was applied to the DIS. Combining the powerful data calculation and control capability of ARM, the kinds more than 40, analog and digital sensor can be connected. The man-machine interaction is realized from the 160times160LCD and the keyboard circuit; the low power consumption and high reliably power supply is designed used in the special power supply chip; and the general functions are programmed. The principle graphic of hardware design based on S3C44B0X is presented and the analog test circuit and cycle/frequency circuit and software of measurement and control are expatiated in detail.

articleTitle: A New Test Method and System of Low-cost MEMS Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The test precision of MEMS gyroscope parameters is depressed by the influence of its big input axis misalignment angle. We studied the influence to the test error of input axis misalignment angle itself and the scale factor. Then we proposed an uncouple principle, established a precise mathematic model, and designed a set of uncouple test equipment and experiment. The findings of half-physics simulation show that this method can realize uncoupling of scale factor and input axis misalignment and can make the test precision be free from the influence of the input axis misalignment value. This method can improve the test accurate and especially be suitable to the MEMS gyroscopes with big input axis misalignment angles.

articleTitle: Developing of an Intelligent Oil Quality Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper chiefly introduces the design principal of an intelligent analyzer used to accurately measures quality of lubricating oil in service based on MCU SST89E554, meanwhile further discussing in detail the overall structural design of hardware and software as well as the key technology in the process of realization. The application of intelligent analyzer can alter traditional oil changing by time into oil-changing by its quality and can get the best use of its effect and lifespan.

articleTitle: Offline Handwritten Numeral Recognition Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To overcome the difficulty of fusing statistical feature and structural feature in the research on handwritten numeral recognition, Principal Component Analysis is used to reconstruct numeral model and estimate the numeral reconstructive error based on the statistical information of digit structural feature. At the same time, the height-width ratio and Euler value of numeral is extracted. Recognition of the digit character is completed through combining the neural network and Bayes classifier respectively corresponding to the three type features. The recognition rate of this method is 90.73% on handwritten numeral database.

articleTitle: Application in Measuring the Microwave Complex Permittivity of Cylindrical Dielectric by Using a Terminal Loaded Coaxial Probe
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new terminal loaded probe which can measure the complex permittivity of dielectric has been proposed in this paper. We have analyzed the effect of some high order TM modes brought by the discontinuity of the dielectrics on the interface in the coaxial cable to the reflectance. According to the mode-matching method, the analysis of the electromagnetic in the coaxial and the dielectric loaded on the terminal of the probe is performed. With the result, we have measured some dielectrics (silicon and Teflon) at and under C band and have compared the metrical value with the computational value and they were nearly the same, and it can advance the precision. This method can be used in measuring the solid material and the liquid as well.

articleTitle: Study on Hardware Protection Technique of Flash Disk
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the security fatalness of the flash disk is analyzed, the work principium and operation commands of the flash memory K9F5608U0B are studied, and a hardware protection technique scheme of flash disk based on the user qualification authentication, data encryption and decryption is put forward. User qualification authentication module applies the P89C51X2's UART transmitting mode to transmit the authentication key between the host and the guest processor to get the qualification signal and distinguish the encryption disk or decryption disk. Data encryption and decryption code creation is linked with the column address of the flash memory storage structure and each code unit is unattached. With the randomicity of encryption result being defined as the next key address input as well, the difficulty of the decryption is enhanced. Encryption and decryption module uses the CPLD chip as the hardware control logic, and according to the control enable and the operation status signal between the USB SIE MCU and the Flash Memory to harmonize the scheduling of the logic apparatuses.

articleTitle: Implementation of High-speed High-resolution Data Conversion System Using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper analyzes the implementation of high-speed high-resolution data conversion system based on Subranging A/D model in detail. We use a 10 bit ADC and an 8 bit ADC to construct the Subranging A/D system and then make a simulation by QuartusII. The result of the experiment shows that the system's sampling rates is 17 MHz, and the resolution is 16 bit, so it can solve an antinomy between sampling rates and resolution, which is prevalent in current market.

articleTitle: An Approach for Measurement and Recognition of Electroencephalography
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the fast development of brain computer interface (simply called BCI), electroencephalography (simply called EEG) will be another interesting bio-electrical signal applied in the dexterous control of the robot hand after EMG. In order to realize it finally, pattern recognition of human hand activities based on EEG is a very important and elementary research objective. After discussing the signal features of EEG, a two-channel measuring system about EEG signal is at first set up in this paper. And then, an artificial neural network classifier is presented based on the five spectral features of EEG. After sample learning is over, the artificial neural network can output good results of pattern recognition about human hand activities according to input spectral features of these mental tasks.

articleTitle: Method of Creating Database for Test System Based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper the method of creating database for test system based on MCU was introduced. Firstly, a database which could save the data transmitted through the serial bus connecting PC with a test system based on MCU, was created on PC. Then a serving application on PC was programmed with the technologies of serial interface and ODBC. When the test system based on MCU sends data in NEMA message format to PC through serial bus, the application on PC receives the test data and connects the background database to save them timely. Such a method of creating database for storing test data is simple and practicable, making the test data captured in test system based on MCU be stored, handled and checked in data tables of the database on PC. The method provides an effective way to configure network test system.

articleTitle: Successive Approaching Phase Rotation Algorithm for Amplitude & Phase Computation in Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A successive approximation phase rotation algorithm (SAPR), based on Data Table, was presented to calculate amplitude and phase from In-phase and Quadrature-phase data as to avoid complicated calculation using square root and arctangent transcendental functions in digital demodulation. Multiplication is only needed in the algorithm by using data table stored in large capacity memory, the procedure is simple and fast. The algorithm can be realized by the use of CPU, Field Programmable Gate Array-FPGA and Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory-SDRAM. The sinuous values of certain bits are stored in the SDRAM after being quantized. And FPGA reads the sine values in the SDRAM to calculate the amplitude and phase according to I/Q data in demodulation. The algorithm has the characteristic of convenient^ high speed and high accurate.

articleTitle: OS-EM Reconstruction for X-ray CT
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is one of the advanced means for non-destructive testing (NDT), which has the virtues of non-destructive, non-contact and high resolution. It is called the best means for NDT by the circle of international NDT. It has been widely applied in diagnostic medicine and industrial non-destructive testing. X-ray CT (XCT) is the most popular CT. Compared with other parts of CT system, reconstruction algorithm is an important part. In this paper, the theory of maximum likelihood estimation is applied to XCT, and ordered subsets expectation maximization (OS-EM) algorithm is studied and implemented. OS-EM algorithm is a feasible iterative method. It can provide good quality reconstructions after only a few iterations. Experiments results with real X-ray CT data show this method is effective. Reconstructed slice images of OS-EM algorithm are accurate and clear.

articleTitle: Research on the Test Process of Joint Operation Materiel Support Simulation System Based on HLA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Joint Operation Materiel Support Simulation System (JOMSSS) was established on the complete analyzing of Joint Operation Materiel Support System(JOMSS). To maximize the validity and reliability of JOMSSS based on HLA and achieve its reusability, interoperability and extendibility, the test process of JOMSSS was discussed at length with characteristics of engineering practices according to the actual federation development process. Then test goals, test steps and test content of every phase were described particularly. The test process of JOMSSS also can guide the test process of developing other simulation systems.

articleTitle: Process Control System Based on DCS for Synthetic Ammonia Decarburization
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The different control modules for the different parts of process of the synthetic ammonia decarburization are established. Some control tactics combining the softer sensor technology and neural network control with the fuzzy control technology are adopted and the different certain values of the control variable parameters are obtained by calculating. The method is based on the distributed control system (DCS), and it can control the complicated industry process automatically and reduce the product cost.

articleTitle: RAIM in Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In integrated navigation system, several navigation systems work follow certain rules and errors can hardly be avoided in one of the systems. A great error will be caused by using the wrong information to calculate the position of carrier. This article takes GPS for an example, an Autonomous Integrity Monitoring method of satellite navigation receiver was put forward in integrated navigation system. It not needs to send special information. This is a simple and feasible method.

articleTitle: Development of Embedded Operating System For Warship Electronic Equipment ATS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In an intermediate-level warship electronic equipment ATS (automatic test system), we developed an equipment called Portable Maintenance Aid Equipments (PMAE) which could cooperate with the main testing system in realizing remote measurement and control through virtual instrument (VI) technology. In these PMAEs, ARM(Advanced RISC Machines)-based microcontroller was used to realize 0-slot VXI controller as well as some dedicated VXI test modules, and developing suitable embedded operating system available on the embedded system architecture was thought a crucial problem to meet different requirements. VxWorks run-time system software was chosen as embedded operation system which could be tailored to specific custom hardware architectures. The application procedure flowchart was given in the paper, non-preemptive scheduling and dynamic memory allocation method was also discussed. Test results indicated good performance of real-time operating system in time-effectivity and flexibility adaptable to different application's needs.

articleTitle: Increment Algorithm for Survey Signal of Differential Transducer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The article proposes an increment algorithm of survey signal of differential transducer, which in industrial parameter surveys of pressure, strain, displacement and so on, may directly figure out the temperature value according to the differential transducer survey signal, without increasing the temperature survey electric circuit. The algorithm principle is according to the differential transducer two observed values, to figure out the increment of two observed values in each sensor, then to calculate the measured temperature value according to the increment. This article, taking differential motion structure SAWR as an example, introduces the increment algorithm principle and the realization method in detail.In this paper, the principal characteristics and the disadvantages of Genetic Algorithm and BP algorithm are introduced

articleTitle: Key Technology in Detecting and Eliminating Isomerism Fibre in Cotton
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Framework and working principle of detecting and eliminating isomerism fibre in cotton system online is introduced and several key technologies involved in its design are analyzed. Experiment studies are implemented and advances solved scheme. In the technologic methods flow of cleaning and rippling the cotton, cotton has been loosed enough and impurity is removed. Then a linear CCD (charge coupled device) camera is used to capture the image of cotton and foreign fibre. from the camera. The images are sent to the industry control computer through a high-speed frame grabber acquires digital card and operated in computer. HSI (Hue, saturation, Intensity) color model, threshold method and binarization algorithm are used to distinguish cotton with isomerism fibre. When finding the foreign fibre, the computer will send out an instrument to drive the corresponding position gas-act electromagnetism valve to act and using high-pressure gas to jet it out to the trash box. Through a series of experiments and locale debug analysis, a sample machine system is established. Through testing it can reach the need of control and exact distinguish the cotton and isomerism fibre in real time and eliminate it.

articleTitle: Resolution Test Technique and Influencing Factors Analysis of a Low-background Anti-Compton HPGe γ-ray Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper tests the resolutions under different high voltages, electronics and source's position of a low-background anti-Compton HPGe gamma-ray spectrometer. The experimental results show that these factors have important influence on resolution. It is experimentally confirmed that the spectrometer can reaches at the best resolution of 1.77 keV at a high voltage of 3250 V under the condition of suited electronics and proper position of the source.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Instrument & Neutral Network in Heat Treatment Furnace Verification
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The heat treatment process makes strict demands on the stability of furnace temperature, so does the testing of furnace temperature uniformity in the field of furnace verification. Therefore, furnace temperature control and measurement should be made. The temperature measurement and control system of heat treatment furnace was developed using the technologies of virtual instrument and neutral networks. The software module of the system adopted the BP neutral network model to adjust the PID parameters of furnace temperature, according to which the PID temperature control model is built. This kind of intelligent algorithm is implemented on the LabView 7.0 platform. Combined with the system hardware module used to do data acquisition and signal conversion, the whole control system is able to hold the furnace temperature to a certain degree rapidly, steadily and accurately, which makes great sense to the heat treatment process and the temperature uniformity testing in furnace verification. Experiments of data acquisition and processing were made on furnace temperature rising, holding and measurement, during which the type S thermocouples were used to test the effective heating zone of heat treatment furnace. The practice results show that the utilization of virtual instrument and neutral networks technique improves the performance of furnace temperature control and measurement. The temperature measurement and control system is real-time, exact and reliable.

articleTitle: Equalization and Performance Analysis of the Non-orthogonal Phase-Offset Modulation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel modulation technique for digital communication (NPOM )was proposed recently (Liang Dequn et al., 2003). Computer simulation results show that it outperforms the DMT modulation in the ADSL channel (Liang Dequn et al., 2003 and 2005). The studies and simulations have been focused on the basic principle and transmission performance of the new technique. The equalization scheme and its effect on the performance of NPOM has not been studied in detail. This paper discusses the equalization of NPOM modulation and the problems encountered in the equalization process.

articleTitle: Extraction Algorithm of Grinding Wheel Unbalanced Signal Based on the Multiwavelet
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The multiwavelet and the traditional wavelet are investigated in this paper. Original signal of the grinding wheel vibration is established, the multiwavelet and the traditional wavelet are applied for the grinding wheel unbalanced signal extraction respectively. It is concluded that the unbalanced signal can be extracted more efficiently by the multiwavelet than the traditional method from the results of experiments.

articleTitle: Portable Fault Diagnostics Facility of Corresponding Equipments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This facility clearly diagnosticates malfunctions of corresponding equipments and provides data accurately and entirely. There are many virtues in this facility, such as: convenience use, simple operation, practicability, strong function, high intelligence and automatization, and so on. It can quickly and accurately diagnostics malfunctions with the help of the new nerve network expert system, so the time to discover and repair faults has been shorten consumedly. This facility is mainly used for quickly examining and rushing to repair of corresponding equipments.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Supervisory Control System for Training Simulator of Rocket Launcher
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The supervisory control system is the main component of the rocket launcher training simulator in the need of teaching and training, which is applied to scout and examine the gunner's operation. It is composed of three functions: motoring control, examining and managing. The geometrical models of operation stations for the supervisory control system are modeled based on the software of Multigen-Creator. With the SCM of ADuC-812, the operating information is inverted to the control information to droved the visual model to move, and then the monitoring function comes true based on functions of Vega and VC++. On the software of VisualBasic6.0, auto-examination module is developed to examine the gunners on training and theoretic knowledge. Transmission of data between the operation stations and supervisory control system comes true with the technology of serial communication. Finally, the software for supervisory control system is developed with VisualBasic6.0. It meets the requirement of training in real time monitoring applications.

articleTitle: Cutting, Shifting and Pasting for manipulation in DCT Domain
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An approach to get the block DCT coefficients from one size to any size at arbitrary position of an image/video frame in the DCT domain directly by simple cutting, shifting and pasting operations is proposed. Many existing approaches, which require the input block(s) to align with the border of the output block, could be considered as special cases of the proposed approach. The practicality of the approach is illustrated by an example where an image can be resized arbitrarily in the DCT domain directly.

articleTitle: Signal-oriented On-station Calibration System for Missile Weapon Testing Equipments
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: After the introduction to the calibration system function and target for missile testing equipments, the signal-oriented on-station calibration category is discussed. The calibration method based on self-check process is proposed to simplify the calibration process and saves the calibration time. Then, the measurement uncertainty promulgation in the measurement chain and the measurement uncertainty of significant signals are validated. At last, the hardware flat based on PXI-bus modules and calibration software based on Virtual Instrument are developed to meet with the requirement of universality, portableness and automatization. As shown in practice , the calibration system presents better measurement uncertainty and higher stability.

articleTitle: Application of Data Fusion in Detecting End Face Run-out of Tapered Roller
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The end face run-out of tapered roller is an important quality index for tapered roller bearing. This article introduces a kind of auto-measuring system for this quality index and focuses on application of data fusion. Multi-cycle measurement under single sensor and data fusion are very effective for eliminating various disturbances and improving detecting veracity. This system accords with the rule of measurement for tapered roller bearing and can actualize auto-measurement of large end face run-out and auto-sorting. It has been validated by practical application and obtained Chinese patent.

articleTitle: Measurement of Micro oil in Water by Using Ultraviolet Fluorescence Spectrum Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we discuss using a UV fluorescence technique to target the aromatic component of the oil contamination. This examination method is can absorb certain wave length based on the aromatic hydrocarbon the energy of light (absorption) and launches the long ultraviolet wave length the energy of light (launch), this process is called the ultraviolet fluorescence process. This fluorimeter only can examine the hydrocarbon (and other materials), because these materials can launch the pair wave length which absorbs and launches chooses. The fluorescence method to the PAH examination is one kind of high sensitivity, the high selective special method, may in the water elimination air bubble and the solid suspension to examines the process the influence.

articleTitle: High Frequency Inductive Heat Power Supply Based on Microcontroller AT89C52
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A high frequency inductive heat power supply consists of high-speed V-MOSFETS was introduced. The frequency and power of the power supply were 1 MHz and 5 kW respectively. A high-speed PLL MM74HC4046 was used for frequency following its track automatically. The rectifier of the power supply was controlled by microcontroller. The biggest power was attained when steady and reliability of equipment was guaranteed. The experiment results show that the power supply is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Multifunctional Signal Source Based on Nios
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper brings forward a multifunctional signal source design method by integration of freewill waveform generator and equal precision cymometer on a chip with Nios as the core. The signal source can modify freely its main functions in accordance to the real need, and it has broad using range. This design method changes the main works on hardware design into software design, makes the designs easy relatively. The signal frequency generated by DDS can keep high resolutions, speedy conversion, and continuous phase. Equal precision cymometer can keep constant testing precision during the whole frequency area, as well as little measuring tolerance of equal precision cymometer. Due to the main functions of the system are on FPGA, so the system has strong anti-interference performance.

articleTitle: Relative Sensitivity Analysis of Typical Faults of Guns Based on Virtual Prototyping Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: As conventional land-based armament, guns are playing an important role in local wars in recent decades. The typical faults of guns are analyzed, and three indexes to represent guns performance are put forward and three working principles of guns are outlined. Virtual prototyping model of some-type gun is created by using ADAMS, and the validation is suggested by comparisons of simulation and test results. The degrees of guns faults affecting performance indexes are obtained based on relative sensitivity analysis, thus the comparison difficulty of fault parameters with different dimensions is solved, and the parametric thresholds of guns faults are achieved through virtual prototype according to firing limits of guns. Finally, the perspective of virtual prototyping technology applied in fields of armament engineering is presented.

articleTitle: Optimal Wavelets Vanishing Moments for Singular Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The wavelet transform modular maximum corresponds to the singularity of signal. Based on the fact that wavelet transform modular maximum of signal is different from that of noise at different scales, the noise can be removed from signal. The relationship between wavelet with different vanishing moments and Lipschitz exponent is discussed. And the influence of vanishing moments on singular signal detection is analyzed. The experimental results show that it is necessary to choose appropriate wavelets with different vanishing moments to detect signals with different singularities.

articleTitle: A Networked Data Acquisition System Based on the MSC1210
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a new high precision A/D Converter MSC1210 which integrates 8052 Micro-controller and Flash Memory is presented at first. Then a networked data acquisition system based on the technology of Ethernet and RS-485 is designed. The communication between remote monitoring center and host computer is based on TCP/IP protocol through Ethernet, and the communication between host computer and numerous MSC1210s is based on RS-485 serial protocol. The system has characteristics of long-distance transmission, flexible configuration, good reliability and real-time performance. The scheme can be used in many fields, such as metallurgy, chemistry, colliery and etc, where remote data acquisition on large-scale system is needed.

articleTitle: Fabric Texture Classification Based on Wavelet Packet
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The main energy of texture image is concentrated on middle frequency regain, but ordinary image on low frequency regain. With increasing the resolution level, wavelet transform focuses on low frequency domain, but wavelet packet on any frequency domain. Therefore it is very effective to use wavelet packet algorithm to classify the fabric texture. In this study, we use wavelet packet and BP neural network together to classify the fabric texture. Experimental result shows that the classification rate can attain 98%.

articleTitle: Bearing Vibration Signal Analysis Based on Chirplet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A method based on the fast adaptive chirplet transform is presented for bearing vibration signal analysis. Based on parameters coarse estimation, it converts multi-dimension optimization process to a traditional curve-fitting problem. This method is not only free of cross-term interference, but also maintains good time-frequency resolution. In addition, as a result of fewer inner product calculations are conducted, the computational speed is fast and parameters estimation is more accurate. The experimental results show that the algorithm can efficiently extract the time-frequency characteristics of the fault signals, and the effect is better than other time-frequency methods. Therefore, it is an efficient fault diagnosis method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vibration Intensity Over Criterion of a Diesel Engine Based on Vibration Theory and Experiment Measurements
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Vibration intensity of a diesel engine was over criterion when it was rigidly set up on its foundation. To found out the reason, vibration velocities of the engine and of its foundation were measured and their coherence was analyzed. Velocity admittance of the foundation was measured, too. Based on these measurements, a conclusion was drawn that small stiffness of the foundation was important reason of vibration intensity that was over criterion. Vibration theory and experiment measurements indicated that vibration of the foundation would be reduced when stiffness of foundation was enhanced, and velocity intensity of the diesel engine would be reduced, too.

articleTitle: Face recognition with DWT and Two-dimensional Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for recognizing face images by combining wavelet decomposition and two-dimensional principal component analysis (2DPCA). The first stage uses the wavelet decomposition that extracts intrinsic features of face images. In wavelet multi-resolution decomposition of images, an image is split into approximation and details in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions. The second stage of the method concerns the application of the 2DPCA method to the approximation image. The discriminative features in the corner are use to classify the face image. The experiment results show that the proposed method is more effective than several representative wavelet.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Chinese Digital Audio Broadcast System on Base Band
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a simulation model is put forward using Matlab and Simulink based on "Specification of 30MHz-3000MHz terrestrial digital audio broadcasting system" issued by China. All transmission modes in the specification have been simulated, and the results of simulation were analyzed. We concerned more on the Doppler Shift than the SNR in simulation. Results of simulation prove that effect of the Doppler Shift is in main position in mobile reception while effect of the SNR is in main position in fixed or low-speed movement reception.

articleTitle: One Design of Communication Bridge for Profibus-DP Bus and CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces one kind of bus interface between Profibus-DP and CAN .It gives the detail of hardware design ,includes dual-port RAM, two CPU and field bus protocol controller chips SPC3 and SJA1000. The paper also describes the design of CAN node circuit, and data communication processing etc. This king of interface could implement basis data communication between these two field buses.

articleTitle: Method of Plant Growth Modeling Based on Genetic Algorithm and RBF Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The plant growth model is very difficult to be set up. Because the relations between the growth parameters and surround envelopment parameters are very complex. A new method that using artificial neural network for plant growth modeling is presented. For improving the algorithm convergence rate, the radial basis function (RBF) network is adopted. As an example of this method, the prediction of tomato stem daily growth and its surround relation is also presented. The experiment results show that the method is effective for plant growth modeling.

articleTitle: Electro-Magnetic Field Calculating Based on Wavelet-MoM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: MoM is used in electro-magnetic field numerical calculation widely. Discretizing operator equation is a kind of effective method to solve electro-magnetic radiation. The advantages are stable and precise. But the formative discrete matrix is a dense matrix. To electrically large object, solving its inverse matrix is waste time and makes the whole calculation scope become huge. The article uses wavelet transformation to sparse its coefficient matrix in solving magnetic field integral equation. The method can reduce calculation time effectually.

articleTitle: Vibration Measurement for Evaluating Lifetime of 12V150 Type Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Vibrate signals include abundant information of machine. It can be used to evaluate the machine technical states. This paper used 7 acceleration transducers to sample vibrate signals of diesel engine on different measuring points under the laboratory environment. The object of this experiment is the 12V150 tank diesel engine. Experiment carried on 700 hours. 10 hours as a stage selected a data. Computed total 270 parameters from each of data. Analyzed the change trend of each parameter along with service time of diesel engine. Found the best parameters set. Based on the optimum solution of characteristic vector, each data extracted 11 characteristics. Using the 11 characteristic vectors built recognition program based on Euclidean distance to identify the lifetime of diesel engine. The results validated that acceleration transducer used on evaluating lifetime of 12V150 diesel engine. Evaluating the lifetime of diesel engine scientifically has important military affair meanings and economic benefit.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis on Radioactive Aerosol in an Area
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to know long-life radioactive aerosol's concentration in the atmosphere in three places of the area and evaluate radioactive environment's quality and the radioactive aerosol's infection to the teachers and students, we investigate radioactive aerosol's concentration in the working place, living place and teaching place of the area. The result shows that the radioactive aerosol's concentration of the area is under the country's control criterion.

articleTitle: Research of Testability Knowledge Acquisition Technology Based on Functional and Structure Model
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aiming at the practical problems of lacking testability knowledge and difficult in knowledge acquisition, it puts forward a knowledge acquisition method based on functional model. It analyzes fault mechanics from using test signal flow, builds models in fault space, guides testability design by FTA and FMEA, acquires fault symptom information by functional simulation, acquires testability knowledge by comprehensive analysis the results at last. The reliability of knowledge acquired by this method is very high, which has important meaning in improving the testability design level for products.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Electronic Circuits Based on Data Fusion Technique
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the field of fault diagnosis of electronic circuits, because of the complexity of the electronic equipments and instability of the running environment, the single diagnosis result may be uncertain. The uncertainty can reduce the veracity of fault diagnosis. Data fuse technique provides a new path for this problem. A method which can deal with the result of the K node diagnosis, direct current analysis, and alternating current impedance characteristics is proposed in this paper. Fault diagnosis of analog circuits based on D-S Evidence theory is introduced and the distribution of credibility of the various methods is given in the paper. According to the theory analysis and the simulation result, the proposed method can reduce fuzzy obviously and raises the accuracy of fault diagnosis though fusing useful information provided by different diagnosis methods.

articleTitle: Research on Information Hiding Theoretic Model
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the development of Internet, People have paid more attention on one branch of security-information hiding. The paper study the present information hiding mode, gives new kinds of information hiding secure model. Then the paper analyzes the existed communication model of information hiding system and provides a new model, which improved Waston model. We discuss the characteristic of the model. At the end, the paper gives the broad perspective of the research.

articleTitle: Imaging System of Remaining Information of Fingerprint in Paper
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This article elaborates on the testing principles and working procedures of the remaining trace on paper (mainly invisible fingerprints of sweat). In order to keep the original testing samples intact, a new method is proposed to test and get image of the invisible of fingerprints of sweat. The new approach is to test the difference on resistance between the remaining trace in paper and non-remaining trace, and input the tested data into computer. This approach makes use of software to convert the tested data into image and some method to obtain a keener image.

articleTitle: Relative Image Measurement on Cigarette Filter Tip
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Cigarette filter tip is a deformable and irregular shape wok piece; it could not be measured by traditional instruments. This paper put forward a novel computer vision measurement: relative measurement based on image analysis. In this method a standard work piece and a measured work piece were put in the same imaging fields, measured image was collected by CCD camera. Wavelet has been used to remove noise, Sobel detector to detect image edge, and an improved randomized Hough algorithm to detect circles. It improves the precision of image location and the efficient of image processing. The standard part's roundness error was evaluated by minimum region Law. The cigarette filter tip's circumference and roundness errors have been calculated by comparing with the standard's dimensions (relative method). An algorithm for edge sub pixel location based on Zernike moment mask of square was used to calculate measured valuables. The results show that the relative method accuracy based on the single pixel edge image was good enough to the results based on the sub-pixel edge image. Experiments show this method is applicable, simple, precise and robust.

articleTitle: Automatic Control Technique Research on Periodic Narrow Pulse Signal Precision Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is comparatively difficult to measure precisely the narrow pulse signal of less than 1μs by means of routine methods, and it is costly by using express acquisition equipment. Precision measurement with integration method for the periodic narrow pulse signal described in this paper is just satisfactory. With energy measurement of a certain beam as one example, based on integration circuit principle, this paper gives a detailed analysis and discussion on design of amplifying circuit, error resources of measurement and processing. This paper also explains shortcomings of the integration circuit and describes in a detail principle and constitutes of the envelope-forming circuit.

articleTitle: Measurement of Radon Concentration in the Air of Underground Establishment with Solid State Track Detector
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper the determination of Radon concentration at fifteen sites of the air of underground establishment was measured by the SSTD. A distribution of Radon concentration in the air of underground establishment between α particles and environment is plotted primarily. The measurements with the SSTD indicates that Radon concentration in the air of underground establishment ranges from 66.4 to 1356Bq/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> with an average of 556.42Bq•m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. The experiment indicates that the kind of the new-style detector can detect Radon level in the air of underground establishment exactly and effectively.

articleTitle: Adaptive Mesh Generation and Refinement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An approach to the generation of unstructured surface meshes for surface models was presented. The global processor outputs a control signal to the plurality of processor elements, and, thereby, sets processor-element numbers corresponding to the plurality of processor elements as input values of the operation arrays, respectively. By assigning element size distribution function reasonably in conforming Delaunay triangulation procedure, the generated surface mesh was a nice approximation of the underlying surface model, and self-adaptive surface mesh can be achieved. The capability of the method is demonstrated for several 3D surface models. At the same time, by studying the functions and the characteristics of the system management nodes, the paper points that configuration nodes is very important in choosing resources nodes.

articleTitle: Optical Electric Current Transformer Error Measuring System Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Optical electric current transformer is introduced in this paper. Based on virtual instrument and digital signal processing technology, error measuring system is designed by using LabVIEW software and DAQ-2006 data acquisition card. There are harmonic analysis module, error analysis module, and history data analyses module in error measuring system. Functions of these three modules are introduced. Measuring channel's error and protection channel's error of optical electric current transformer, are measured. Random phase error curve and ratio error curve of measuring channel in different test current are plotted. The result shows that, this error measuring system achieves accuracy standard, and is able to measure phase error and ratio error of optical electric current transformer exactly.

articleTitle: Study of α Energy Spectrum Smoothing and Appraising Smoothing Goodness
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper smooths an experimented alpha energy spectrum by means of gravity method and the least-square method, and illustrates the aim and significance of data smoothness of alpha energy spectrum. According to the fitted energy spectrum, we find a simple and useful method of appraising fitting goodness by using spline interpolation polynomial fitting with the curve-fitting tool in the program of MATLAB7.0. A visual, precise and convenient way of selecting optimal smooth windows and times is found through analyzing the effect of smooth windows and times to alpha energy spectrum. The problem that how to use an optimal smooth windows and times during smoothing energy spectrum is apparently solved, and also raise the precision and accuracy of analysis of alpha energy spectrum.

articleTitle: Adaptive Parallel Processing Algorithm in Digital Signal Series
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: During vector predictive coding of digital signal series, the vector signal series, obtained by grouping adjacent samples of sources signal series, can approximate to a vector autoregressive series with stable covariance. This paper, applying the orthogonal projection principle of Hilbert space, attempts to formulate a vector predictive coding strategy highly capable of parallel processing and to deduce from this strategy an adaptive parallel processing algorithm, which, compared with traditional lattice algorithms, has improved remarkably in calculation complexity and storage space.

articleTitle: Application of DDS Based on DSP in Rubidium Atomic Frequency Standard
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The present status and development of rubidium atom frequency standard are introduced. The main limitation of adopting the phase lock frequency modulation was discussed. On the foundation of analyzing the DDS algorithm, the plan of direct digital frequency synthesis based on DSP was given. Through adjusting the parameter of DDS online, we can obtain the output frequency of the high resolution in the experiment, and aim the excitation transition frequency of rubidium frequency standard at the center spectrum frequency of quantum system automatically. Simultaneously, two output frequencies of DDS haven't the phase difference. Thus the cost of the rubidium atomic frequency standard is not only reduced, but also its stability is greatly improved.

articleTitle: A New Method of Testing High Reliability Bridgewire Explosive Initiator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the defects of the traditional methods to be used in selecting the quality of the bridgewire explosive device, a non-destructive selecting technology is given by the author in this paper. After the author introduced the development and application of this product, the key parameters to its quality are shown and the testing method is introduced. It is transient pulse testing technology. The testing theory is introduced in detail and the construction of testing system is illustrated. Given single constant-current pulse, by simulation the products action procedure of the igniters, we could get a curve of performance parameters in this testing way. Depend on the testing results, we could select out the needed high quality bridgewire explosive device easily.

articleTitle: The Research of Distributed Remote Digital Control Experimental Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Students in industrial control need to learn design and analyze their own experiments. In train of system design, the tutor cannot guide every student. This paper describes a computer-based approach applied to a laboratory course in industrial control systems. Based on PC-LabCard and intranet, experimental teaching system have been developed. Students can thus acquire experience in the real behaviour of the various industrial-type subsystems. Teaching system allows students to build experiments on their own design. The tutor monitors the course and results in real time. The experiment become standard for every trainer. The system provided interactive tools for understanding complex concepts.

articleTitle: Research on Zero-Coding Optimization
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is difficulty to get the most reasonable project artificially when the number of the encoding sequences is bigger so a method of computer simulation is introduced. Base on the mathematics model of the zero-coding, the reciprocal of the contrast D, the general number of bright lines, the general number of reticles, and the influence on the zero-coding due to differ photoelectric devices are considered. The project of zero-coding sequences with higher contrast and light-passing efficiency or higher signal-to-noise ratio is achieved via the optimized non-symmetric encoding.

articleTitle: Design of Programmable Tee Networks Based on Digitally Controlled Potentiometer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Using Digitally Controlled Potentiometers all kinds of programmable Tee networks can be composed. The paper introduces the base structure of the Tee networks. Then expatiates the design of the programmable Tee networks and the application examples in the analog system, which includes controlling the limiting frequency of the amplifier, controlling the coefficient of IGSF active filter and the design of current / voltage (I/U) converter.

articleTitle: An Embedded System of Automatical Timber Classification by Rigidity Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: On the basis of establishing a mathematical model, the real-time test of elastic ratio of timber sticks is transformed to the test of deflection under certain loads, and ARM embedded system is used to operate a pneumatic device to test the elastic ratio of stick, and control air cylinder to classify sticks according to rigidity automatically and then put them in respective place. The system consists of two levels. The manage level uses PC; the control level uses 32 bits ARM7 MPU. They communicate with RS232 serial communication protocol. Several anti-interference methods have been implemented to ensure the system's reliability and consistency. The system has such functions as automatically feeding, real-time loading and testing, classification, counting, printing testing data, sorting statistic results, alarm on error. The system accomplishes classification of sticks automatically, replacing manual work, which has been applied in a factory. Both the efficiency and precision have remarkable enhancement.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Call Center System based on H.323
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: VoIP which transmits voice over IP will be the basic technology carrying voice through telecom network in the future. Using the designing model of traditional call centers for reference, authors design the model and framework of VoIP call center based on H.323 and realize it through Softswitch. Compared with traditional call centers, the system designed has several advantages such as replacing costly Private Branch Exchange (PBX) with a software Softswitch, supporting both Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) and Internet connecting. In addition, it gets rid of the limitation of space to support distributed agents. It can transmit voice, video and instant messages, implement Text to Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR).

articleTitle: Model and Simulation of a Polymer-Coated Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Embedding a FBG with polymer could improve the pressure sensitivity of a sensor. Based on the theory of elastic mechanics, considered the polymer with optical fiber transversely isotropy, which is encapsulated in the metal tube and 3 components of stress are not equal, the relation between the shift of Bragg wavelength and the pressure is proposed. How to improve the pressure sensitivity is also discussed. It is useful for designing a fiber grating sensor.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis System Design and Application of Generator Using Self-Organizing Learning Wavelet Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To improve the limitation of applying traditional fault diagnosis method to the diagnosis of multi-concurrent vibrant faults for turbo-generator set in power system, a novel approach combining the wavelet transform with self-organizing learning array (SOLAR) system is proposed. The effective eigen-vectors are acquired by binary discrete orthonormal wavelet transform based on multi-resolution analysis. These feature vectors then are applied to a SOLAR system for training and testing. SOLAR system has three advantageous over a typical neural network: data driven learning, local interconnections and entropy based self-organization. The synthesized method of recursive orthogonal least squares algorithm and improved Givens rotation is used to fulfill the combined network structure and parameter initialization. By means of choosing enough practical samples to verify the proposed network performance and the information representing the faults is inputted into the trained network, and according to the output result the type of fault can be determined. Simulation results and actual applications show that the method can effectively diagnose and analyze the multi-concurrent vibrant fault patterns of turbo-generator set and the diagnosis result is correct.

articleTitle: A Method for Calculating Total Harmonic Distortion of Digital Sinusoidal Waveform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A digital sinusoidal waveform is defined as a periodic waveform whose amplitude and time can be quantified. How do the bit number N of Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) and the number M of discrete points in one period influence the Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) of the sinusoidal wave synthesized by digital waveforms? We propose in this paper a theoretical formula representing the relation of THD, M and N on the basis of time-domain analysis and give the calculation results and the experimental data. The novel method presented in this paper can also be applied to harmonic analysis.

articleTitle: Research on New Metrology Support Modes
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The principle of each support mode is introduced. The disadvantages of traditional support mode and the advantages of MAP, tele-calibration and traveling-calibration are discussed. The tendency of metrology support mode is analyzed.

articleTitle: Design and Numerical Simulation of a Novel Vortex Generator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Vortex generator is an important component of vortex flowmeter. The shape of CFD decides vortex flowmeter's range and accuracy. This paper present a novel vortex generator, simulate its numerical value and analyse the theory by FLUENT, and compare the other common generators with it. As a result, through practical application, the advanced vortex generator have a better performance than others, it is able to make powerful and steady vortexes in low or high Renault value.

articleTitle: Exploration for the Calibration of Passive Intermodulation Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Passive Intermodulation Analyzer (PIA) is widely used in the R&D and manufacture of mobile communication high power passive devices, but the verification regulation or calibration specification of PIA has not published in domestic yet. This article introduces the calibration items and methods of PIA, particularly the calibration of the measurement accuracy of passive intermodulation. It shows that the items chosen and the method used are feasible by calibrating several PIA

articleTitle: Study on VRLA Batteries on-line monitor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces the principle of valve regulated lead acid batteries (VRLA) on-line monitor——internal resistance measurement of monocell's transient constant current discharge. Hardware design and software program based on this principle were analyzed in detail, and experimental results were put forward. The system, with the function of remote control and measurement, is convenient to realize the automatization of invalid battery detection.

articleTitle: Key Techniques on Design of Laser High-speed Video System for Recording Metal Transfer in Arc Welding
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The metal transfer process of arc welding with consumable electrode is a complicated procedure that combines momentum, heat and mass transfer as well as transportation. Due to the difficulties of observing fast changing process of melted drop transition, a proper high-speed video system with laser in the background was established for recording the process. Structure of the high-speed video system, design of optic system, selection of laser and preferences of camera lens which have influences on the recording results are introduced. The electrical waveforms and images of welding process were collected in synchronous with the system.

articleTitle: Discrete Spectrum Correction Based on Centroid Method
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: There are frequency and amplitude errors in spectrums obtained from discrete spectrum analysis to windowed signals. In this paper, the discrete spectrum correcting technology based on centroid method is proposed. The deduction of correction formula applying to Hamming window function, Blackman window function, and Kaiser window function are putted forward. The validity of the formulas is testified through the simulation on Matlab and Labvindows/CVI.

articleTitle: Data Processing Method of Surface Defect Detection on Sphere Workpiece
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the feature of measuring data, data processing method is discussed to detect surface defects on the sphere workpieces using numerical simulation technique. The idea that the datum surface formed from the datum line is proposed. The mathematical model of some error composing parts was established by analyzing operate process. Some feasible schemes of the data processing were introduced. Comparing the data processing results, the evaluation datum line of defect identification was chosen. And then the key techniques to ensure accurate measure were discussed. Simulation and experiment results show that the least-squares fit and the space low-pass filter are effective and reliable approaches for the defects detection.

articleTitle: Design of Optimal Engineering Filters
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper is to realize the equivalent wave approximation of the FIR filter, based on its main characteristics, by application of the Alternate Theorurm, and generalizing its mathematical model. Moreover, it can realize stop band controllable dent. This approximation is arbitrary. Setting up the dent in the noise power density area can best eliminate the general noise power output of the filter so as to improve the filter characteristics. This provides a relatively good theory and a practical method for the engineering design of a FIR filter.

articleTitle: Efficient Algorithms of Mining Top-k Frequent Closed Itemsets
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Top-k frequent closed itemsets mining has been studied extensively in data mining community. But the I/O cost of database scanning is still a bottle-neck problem in data mining. TFP-growth is a powerful algorithm to mine Top-k frequent closed itemsets and it is non-candidate generation algorithm using a special structure FP-tree. Many algorithms proposed are based on FP-tree. However, creating FP-tree from database must scan database two times. In order to enhance the efficiency of TFP-growth algorithms, propose a novel algorithm called QFPC which can create FP-tree with one database scanning. With QFPC, we can mine top-k frequent closed itemsets efficiently.

articleTitle: Effect of Gaussian Source on Differential Confocal Microscopy Pointing Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The axial response of conventional confocal microscopy is affected by an extended Gaussian source, so does the differential confocal microscopy which is proposed because of the better signal to noise ratio(SNR) and better resolutions both in axis and lateral. When the specimen is measured with the method based on the differential confocal microscope, Gaussian source influences the output signal , as well as the measuring accuracy and resolution of the differential confocal microscope. In this paper, the principle of the differential confocal microscopy is introduced, and the optical transfer function of that is obtained according to the 3-D coherent image theory with a z-axial symmetric Lorentzian-Gaussian laser source. Considering both the size of the source and of the beam spot of Gaussian beam, their influences on the axial resolution are studied and calculated. The results are also presented and the conclusion of the influences with a relevant source aperture is obtained finally.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Strain and Temperature Measurement Using a Brillouin Scattering Based Superstructure Fiber Grating Filter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
