abstract: Superstructure fiber grating filter is presented in measuring Brillouin intensity, which is used to suppress the Rayleigh backscatter and separate the Brillouin signal by double-peak design. In this way, Brillouin-based temperature and strain sensor system is achieved. A temperature resolution of 5°C, strain resolution of 500μεand a spatial resolution of 15m was obtained along a sensing range of 30km.

articleTitle: Inspection of Yarn Nep Based on Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The yarn nep often shows severe local-extent change of the signal. Because the wavelet transform can inspect the singularity of the signal, we use the wavelet transform to deal with the yarn signal and identify the nep. A new method of identifying the yarn nep based on the wavelet analysis is given in this paper, the result of the experiment shows that identifying rate of the cotton neps can attain 97%.

articleTitle: Research of Exponentially Filter in Atomic Time Scale Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The settings and effects of exponentially filter in the Atomic Time 1(AT1) scale algorithm is researched in this paper. The different effects of time scale algorithm with an exponentially filter or no exponentially filter is discussed. Simulations verified that the exponentially filter makes the result better. Then how to choose the exponential frequency-weighting time constant is discussed. This parameter is determined from the relative levels of white noise and random walk (or flicker) for clock. Different numerical value gives different results. Compared with a series of numerical values, the optimal value of each clock is given in this paper. On the basis of these works, exponentially filter optimized the AT1 time scale algorithm by estimating of the current average frequency of clock. Waveform figures are given and some valuable conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Design of Pan-Camera Decoder in Digital Video Monitoring System Based on Embedded Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents the design method of pan-camera decoder applying in digital video monitoring system including software and hardware. This decoder was based on embedded microcontroller C8051F330 and was mainly composed of regulated power supply circuit, serial communication interface circuit, watching dog circuit, input/output alarm circuit and pan-camera control circuit. It is connected with the UP computer by RS-485 serial communication protocols. This decoder can realizes the pan-camera automatic control, including pan's up, down, left, right, level rotation movement and camera's focus, zoom, iris adjustment. Experimental results show that this decoder operates reliability and accurately.

articleTitle: Study about Test Ammunition Terminal Effectiveness with the Velocity Radar
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper analyzes the fragment movement rule when the ammunition exploded. The mathematics model of the fragment radar echo signal is established on the basis of the principle of the movement targets modulating Doppler signal. The simulation data processing was achieved in using FFT method for the fragment echo signal. Quantitative analysis was realized about the influence for the signal processing precision by the fragment amount, the velocity difference value between the fragments and SNR.

articleTitle: Remote Embedded Power Measurement System Based On Global Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A remote embedded power measuring and supervising system is developed based on the global network. The electric signal such as voltage, current and power for a single-phase two-wire circuit or a three-phase three-wire circuit can be measured by the power measurement device. The center embedded server composed of the embedded Linux OS (operation system) called as TimeSys and embedded framework with Hitachi microcomputer, works as the bridge between users and power measurement devices. RS485 communication bus is designed to connect at most 31 measurement devices to the center server. The Web access service based on the network communication interface is provided to enable remote data supervising, comparing, downloading, and so on. The whole system achieves remote supervision and abundant data analysis for energy conversation.

articleTitle: Fabric Defect Detection Method Based on Image Distance Difference
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: By using machine vision and digital image processing technology to fabric defect detection, this paper brings forward a new method of detection of fabric defect, namely image distance difference arithmetic. The system permit user to set appropriate control parameter of fabric defect defection based on the type of the fabric. It can detect more than 30 kinds of common defects, which has advantages of high identification correctness and fast inspection speed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Apparatus Testing System Based-on Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Having developed an embedded testing device of electromagnetic apparatus successfully, we profound the distribution dynamic testing technology and develop a 3-tiers electromagnetic apparatus testing system based-on network. With the application of Lab VIEW as the measurement and control platform, the network system provides with performances evaluation of electromagnetic apparatus, furthermore, the testing data should be shared among different departments of electromagnetic apparatus R&D, product assembly as well as product quality management.

articleTitle: Non-metric CCD Camera Calibration for Low Attitude Photogrammetric Mapping
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A low attitude photogrammetric system is developed in Chinese Academy of Surveying and Mapping, since the UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) has advantages over traditional photogrammetric craft, such as small size, low weight, slow flight speed and extended range. This paper discusses calibrating method of an inexpensive 3 K by 2 K non-metric CCD camera used in this system. First,with 3D testified the self-calibrating bundle adjustment is adopted to determine the principal distance , the location of the principal point and distortion parameters of the camera. Secondly, a further distortion test was performed, this time with a planar 2D test field to create a digital distortion model. Moreover, the residual distortion error detection method is proposed by transforming and comparing the distortions obtained from the two calibration steps .

articleTitle: Special Equipment Railway Transportation Communication Net Based on the Field Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The special equipment railway transportation communication net based on the field bus that the paper issued, aimed at the characteristic of railway transportation, such as simple structure, distinct layer, reducing data intermediate link as far as possible in network flows , reducing the cost of entire system, increasing flexibility, reliability and the fast communication. According to this principle, the paper only adopted OSI model 1, 2 and 7 layers, and created a user layer. The structures of the transportation communication net based on the field bus are physical layer, data linking layer, application layer and user layer. On the foundation of communication net layers, we designed the communication net communication protocols based on the field bus. We set monitoring unit logic number in the data token defined in transportation communication net protocol, realized the random net of transportation task at random. RS-485 half-duplex communication net shift circuit is designed and the net experiment is as well completed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of DAC on Total Harmonic Distortion in Digital Waveform Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Harmonic distortion exists in sinusoidal waves generated by digital waveform synthesis techniques. The total harmonic distortion (THD) is not only related to the number M of discrete points in one period but also the bits N of Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC). Through testing a 16-bit "LTC1597 DAC" on a D/A testing system designed by ourselves, we analyze in this paper the influences of the DAC resolution and the establishing time on THD of sinusoidal waves generated by digital waveform synthesis techniques.

articleTitle: Software of Golay Decoder Based on C++ Builder
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The Golay code is a type of the irnprimitive BCH code. The (23, 12, 7) Golay code is a unique perfect linear error-correcting code that can correct all patterns of three or fewer errors in 23 bit positions. This paper designed the Golay decoder based on C++ Builder. It can encode , correct the error bits of transmission and decode . This paper put forward a new algorithm which can calculate all error patterns. It can list the all 2047 error patterns.

articleTitle: A Digital Phase-locked Loop Based on MAP in PLC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The conventional DPLLs (Digital Phase-locked Loops) are designed for Gaussian noise environment, and play important roles in carrier and clock recoveries. However, in power line communication (PLC), the power line noise is often impulsive, and then its statistical feature is different from Gaussian one. Therefore, we introduced Class A noise model in PLC first, and then proposed an optimum DPLL for such Class A noise environment using the techniques based on MAP (Maximum A Posteriori) estimating. The simulated results show the proposed DPLL has the smaller steady state phase errors than the conventional DPLL under Class A noise environment.

articleTitle: Workflow Simulation for Maintenance Support of Electronic Instrument Based on HLA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With Object Oriented (OO) method, this paper analyzes the maintenance process of the electronic instrument and its information exchange capability with external environment. Consequently the electronic instrument federate is developed according to High Level Architecture (HLA) standards. This paper develops graphical modeling tool for workflow based on VC++, and creates workflow model for Maintenance Support of Electronic Instrument (MSEI) in this tool based on Petri net. By setting simulating environment, this tool can create simulation models that can be executed in simulation software—ExSpect automatically. Simulate models are integrated into Run-Time Infrastructure (RTI) by ExSpect's Component Object Model (COM) interfaces. By simulating these instantial workflow models, this paper analyzes the validity, rationality and operational efficiency of MSEI workflow model, and proposes improvement measures for workflow model. Consequently, it carries out Business Process Reengineering (BPR) for maintenance process.

articleTitle: Research on the Ontology-based six-element Conceptual Modeling
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the extending of the simulation scope, the complexity of the system is becoming larger and larger. Therefore, the request for the conceptual modeling is enhancing rapidly. This paper summarizes the existing methods of conceptual modeling, and puts forward the six-element modeling method. Then along with the mechanism of Ontology, it presents the Ontology-based six-element conceptual modeling method, and describes the modeling process.

articleTitle: An Improved Joint Data Rate and SNR Estimation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Knowledge of data rate is required to carry out maximum-likelihood detection of other parameter, such as the carrier phase or modulation type. In this paper, we introduce an improved algorithm of joint SNR and data rate estimation in absence of symbol-timing error. The algorithm is a GLRT-type modification to the method described in section 2. To compare the algorithm, performance metrics are presented. Simulation results show that algorithm in section 2 outperforms the proposed algorithm for the higher data rates, but fails to do so for the lower ones.

articleTitle: Research and Application of ATML for Aircraft Electric Power Diagnosis and Prognostic System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The technology of integrated health management (IHVM) is an important approach to improve the security, reliability and maintainability of airplanes and spacecrafts, and to reduce their cost significantly. Taken aircraft electric power system into consideration, it is one of the important equipment that provides electric energy for all electro-equipments in airplane. Its working state is a crucial to ensure airplane normal and secure flight, so the research of condition detection, fault diagnosis and prognosis is a great concern in the field of IHVM system. Aiming at interoperability and complexity of data exchanging for aircraft electric power diagnosis and prognostic system, a method of using ATML (automatic test markup language) based on XML (extensible markup language) is proposed in order to describe the information of devices and conditions for fault diagnosis and prognostic in the system. First, based on reference frame of integrated health management system, a distributed multi-level fault diagnosis and prognosis system structure that exchange data through ATML is designed. Secondly, condition monitor is a foundation of fault diagnosis and prognosis, and a schema of test information for aircraft electric power parameters is designed by using ATML after data of crucial fault is analyzed. The result shows that the method can implement seamless interaction among test, diagnosis and prognosis. At same time, sharing and transplant of test information and diagnostic knowledge is improved and the process of fault diagnosis is accelerated.

articleTitle: Design of FIR Filters with Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Frequency sampling method is one of the usual methods in FIR digital filter design. In frequency sampling method the value of transition band samples are usually obtained by searching for table. However, the value obtained by searching for table can not be ensured to be optimal. In this paper a new application of differential evolution (DE) to frequency sampling method is introduced and its performance is compared to that of genetic algorithm (GA). Experimental results have shown that the value of transition band samples obtained by DE can be ensured to be optimal, also, it is seen that DE is significantly faster than GA for finding the optimum filter.

articleTitle: New Algorithm of Automatic FEM Mesh Generation for Electromagnetic Scattering Calculation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Automatic mesh generation for finite element method (FEM) plays an important role in electromagnetic scattering calculation. A new algorithm for the automatic generation of finite element meshes is presented. The methodology is a grid-based approach type. Take advantage of it, the algorithm improve the traditional mesh generation scheme thanks to the integration of simple and flexible density control and the rationalization of boundary discretization. In two dimensional cases, the original domain is separated into squares, and then all interior squares are split into isosceles right triangle, which results in uniform meshes with excellent internal triangles like the Almost Regular Triangulations. According to different condition, the squares which intersect the boundary of the domain are adjusted to triangles. A new algorithm is presented for improving the quality of the meshes near to the boundary. In three dimensional cases, it's similar. Compared with other methods, it's capable of automatically and adaptively generating meshes with reasonable quality, and is easy to implement in program. Also it achieves good quality of mesh. These characteristics have been demonstrated by the examples in the paper.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Signal-Conditioning IC in Micro-Pressure Measure
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In certain type UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) altitude sensor performance detection equipment, a kind of signal-conditioning circuit which is used for piezoresistive transducer (PRT) is designed to solve the measure problem of pressure. In this circuit, the sensor's zero point output, thermal zero shift, full-scale output, thermal sensitivity shift, and full-scale output nonlinearity etc. are compensated and calibrated. The error compensation form of former tradition is abandoned in this circuit, a new signal-conditioning chip MAX1457 is adopted, then a method of software compensation is put forwarded, the error calibration table is established. So the sensor output error is controlled in 0.11%0.158% by calibrating compensation.

articleTitle: A Method Research on Robust Fault Diagnosis of Integrated Navigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Optimal parity-vector test (OPT) approach was applied to the fault diagnosis of the integrated navigation systems. According to robust design principle, the optimal parity vectors, be most sensitive to designated sensor's fault and least sensitive to other sensor's fault and unknown in-puts such as noises, were designed and the optimal parity residuals were obtained. According to matrix theory, the fault detection and fault isolation functions were constructed, respectively. Many Monte-Carlo simulations were performed in three navigation systems by using the presented method and the general fault diagnosis method , respectively, and the results show the proposed method, compared with the general diagnosis method, can increase the fault isolation rate obviously for navigation systems who have greater measurement noise. This proposed method depends only on the measurement data of every navigation sensor not on their dynamic models and can be applied to the fault of other redundant sensor systems.

articleTitle: Development of HSK Tooling Expert System in High Speed Machining
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The analysis, design and development of HSK tooling expert system is an important process of expert knowledge managing system in the paper. For a given application environment, the entity model and data model of the system are analyzed and abstracted through investigation and research. Then an expert system is set up which is able to reflect the relationship between information in realistic world to fulfill data requirements and cutting requirements, with the support of a certain database managing library system. Therefore, a HSK tooling expert system should possess advantages as data structurized, high independence of data and application program, data sharing, and reducing data redundancy to the least limit.

articleTitle: Design Method and Application of Wavelet Neural Network for Direct Torque Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A torque ripple reduction technique based on wavelet network of direct torque control running in low-speed is presented. The wavelet network can accurately localizes the characteristics of a signal both in the time and frequency domains, and the occurring instants of the signal change can be identified by the multi-scale representation of the signal.Taking advantage of complex wavelet transform, combined information can be obtained from both the magnitudes and arguments of complex wavelet transform coefficients to extract the desired feature of the transient signal. The input nodes of the WN are the stator current error and the change in the stator current error and the output node of the WN is the stator resistance error. The synthesized method of recursive orthogonal least squares algorithm and improved Givens rotation is used to fulfill the wavelet network structure initialization and parameter identification, and then the accurate stator flux vector and electromagnetic torque are acquired by means of state estimator, optimizing the inverter control strategy. The simulation results show effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: An Defect Detection Method Based on Zernike Moments for Industrial CT Image
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Industrial computed fault scan imaging is able to provide intuitive and clear images, without any overlapped pictures or geometrical distortion and it is widely used in nondestructive test. When we use industrial CT to conduct nondestructive test on defect and assembly error of batches of complicated workpiece, we meet some problems about distinguishing CT image with manual method, thus assembly defect detection method based on Zernike moments is put forward, which is identification method in two steps. Firstly, it uses rapid arithmetic to select a possible matched location through reliable method with a low amount of calculation. Secondly, it will conduct further estimation on matched location using Zernike moments and then select accurate matched location. The test has indicated that selection method we adopted is feasible and it is effective to use Zernike moments for the final judgment. This method is fairly helpful for detecting neglected-loaded accessories and error assembly location.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Feasibility of the Shipborne Pseudolite for GPS Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In allusion to the need of high-precision and high-stability navigation system in the airplane during taking off and landing process, a original shipborne pseudolite for augmenting GPS has been put forward. The feasibility of shipborne mobile pseudolite has been analyzed by comparing with the airborne pseudolite, and the performance of shipborne pseudolite is superiority over one of airborne pseudolite's. Geometric Dilution of precision (GDOP) is deduced from the pseudo-distance error, it is approved that GDOP can be reduced by using shipborne pseudolite and the difficulty of GPS receiver select satellites is debased, the select satellites method which calculated the maximum volume of four GPS projected tetrahedron is simplified to calculated the maximum area of three GPS projected triangle. By the way of simulation, the variable trend is analyzed quantificationally between GPS augmentation back and forth, while GPS vertical angle varies from 0deg to 70deg and pseudolite vertical angle varies from -15deg to -90deg, the navigation system has a optimum performance.

articleTitle: Amnesic Multi-sensor Fusion Algorithm for Streaming Time Series
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Since more and more real time multi-sensor system generated continuous measurement values, a novel amnesic fusion algorithm is proposed. In the case of any prior knowledge is unknown, the algorithm takes use of the exponential function to build the support degree matrix, so each sensor's weight coefficient of different time can be obtained. Based on the fact that in many domains recent information is more useful than older information, the user-specified piecewise constant amnesic function is defined and ensured the correctness of weight coefficient re-assignment and the reduction of computation and storage complexity. Three thermocouples with observation noise distribution unknown are used to detect the temperature of a constant temperature box to verify the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Controlling Two-dimensional Spationtemporal Chaos
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A bailout embedding method for controlling chaos can make the chaotic orbits targeting into Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser orbits. We apply this method to a high-dimensional system with two coupled standard maps. The numerical simulation shows that this method could obtain target islands in order and hence could be used to control chaos. Moreover, it is robust in the presence of week external noise.

articleTitle: Adaptive Smith Predictor Based Fast Converging Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Smith predictor provides an effective method to improve for plants with pure delay in theory, but it depends on the accuracy of the model too much. However genetic algorithm (GA) has quite good robust and optimization. So an adaptive Smith predictor based fast converging genetic algorithm (GA) for a class of systems with pure delay is proposed. An improved genetic algorithm (GA) is applied for system identification online, which fitness may decrease or increase automatically to get the fast convergence, and probabilities of crossover and mutation are adaptive along with the evolution proceeding to get the global astringency. So the adaptive Smith predictor can estimate the dynamic model to compensate delayed time. This design is applied to optimize controller of furnace. It shows that the control effect is better than that of traditional PID controller. It has strong robust and restrained from disturbance.

articleTitle: A Detecting Method based on Data Fusion Processing And Numerical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: For the digital thermocouple-temperature-detection system, a new detection method based on data fusion and numerical analysis has been put forward. The data fusion technique was according to much information redundancy with multiple points measuring, and used a new type weighted average method, which gathered amount of information of the target at the utmost. Meanwhile, by using the interpolation and data fitting method, best solution and optimal estimate of user terminal was achieved. This method combined the latest microprocessor technique, carried out correcting automatically, expanding the quantity distance scope. The test results show that the proposed method raised the accuracy of the gauge, also in general can be used in other intelligence detection system.

articleTitle: Design of a Fluorescent Lamp Control Platform Based on Power-line Carrier
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduced a design of a fluorescent lamp control platform based on the technology of power-line carrier, which was consistent to the trend of green lighting and intelligent building. And the key point of this platform was to make the communication among those transceivers, which are connected just by power-line, dependable and stable. So this paper focused on the circuitry designing around the PLC chip SC1128.

articleTitle: Research on Deadbeat Control Strategy Based on Recursive LSM for Harmonic Compensation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The traditional deadbeat control strategy is based on an accurate mathematical modeling, the property of which is subjected to be affected by the parameters of power system. In this paper, a systemic research is carried out on a deadbeat current control (DBCC) strategy based on recursive Least Squares Method (LSM) for harmonic compensation of shunt single-phase voltage-source APF.

articleTitle: Design of Data Acquisition System for SINS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A data acquisition system was designed for SINS. The system was composed by adjustment circuit, A/D convertor and DSP processor. The analog signal can be adjusted by adjustment circuit to plusmn 10 V which was the A/D convertor's full scale. The A/D convertor has 8 channels in 16-bits which can be used for sampling analog signal. The A/D convertor was serial output and the time of sampling 8 channels of analog signal is less than 10 mus. The DSP has A/D convertor in 12-bits which was used to sample temperature. The DSP can compensate the previous A/D conversion result in A/D conversion time and send the result from serial interface or parallel interface. By isolating the digital and analog signal and utilizing the filter for power supply, the sampling error of this system is lower than 1LSB.

articleTitle: Solution-concentration Sensor Using a Fused Fiber-optic Coupler
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an optical fiber sensor is reported to be capable of measuring the concentration of the solution. When a 2times2 fused tapering single-mode optical fiber coupler is immersed in the solution, the light propagating through the fused tapered coupler and makes the coupling ratio (CR) sensitive to the variation of the liquids concentration surrounding the fused tapering zone of the coupler. So, the sensor can be realized. As a result, the solution concentration can be measured by the corresponding change of the CR. In addition, the theoretical and experimental processes are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Incorporating Design Research for Missile Testing in PXI Based on BIT and ATE
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Progressively, built-in test (BIT) and automatic test equipment (ATE), synthesizing design and application, become the effective approach to improve complex system testability and maintainability. Widely, PXI (PCI extensions for Instrumentation) is applied to the domain of automated test. Analyzed on the configuration of resource, module design, system design, compatibility design, tolerated error design, and so on, this paper presented the method on the BIT and ATE. This paper researched the test-launch control system for launch missiles, incorporating design in PXI bus based BIT and ATE. It presented the system level test structure figure, the circuit level test structure figure and the flow chart of software. The application of technology promotes the intelligentizing; generalizing and miniaturizing of the test-launch control system for launch missiles so as to improve the whole performance of missiles.

articleTitle: Research of Diagnosis method Based on Optimized D-S
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In fault diagnostic, because of the imperfection of the test node, unpreciseness of the measured value and unknowable structure of system, people have to go on fault uncertain diagnosis. Among them, evidence theory is important for it's advantage in uncertain expression and focus. In evidence theory, the key is to get the basic probability value. With incorrect basic probability value, the ability of fault diagnosis will be reduced. Now, they are always presented subjectively by experts, but the given values and the facts aren't really match. This paper puts forward a way of optimizing them to objectively solve the key problem of basic probability value. First, this paper explicates the optimization background of problem, then presents a set of target function and limited function. Solution of these function are found through particle swarm optimization algorithm. In simulated experiments, the result shows that: the way in this paper to find solution of basic probability value heightens the credibility of the fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Wide-Band High Resolution Homing Sonar Echo Detect Based On Spread Spectrum Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper propose and analyze high resolution auto-navigation sonar system based on DS/SS technology. Compare to traditional auto-navigation sonar system, the system have big time and frequency range , can provide high distance and speed resolution and good anti-interference capability. Paper discuss the principle of waveform design and enduce ambiguity function of DS/SS modulation signals. In the case of high-speed target, paper provided and proved a algorithm using CZT which can estimate Doppler frequency offset and target speed in very low SNR condition.

articleTitle: The Comparison Of Time-Frequency Analysis On The Feature Extraction Of Maglev' Track Long-Wave Irregularity
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the signal processing, the theories and methods, such as optimization, auto-adaptive, high resolution and multi-dimension, is become systematic. We are looking forward to higher research. Many people are focusing on the signal of non-stationary, non-Guassian, non-minimum phase, nonlinear system and so on. As a result, the method of the analysis is changed from time analysis and frequency analysis to time-frequency analysis. In this paper, we simulate the data of the maglev' track, according to the data from the real testing of the maglev on the railway. Some typical time-frequency method is used to analyze the data, to estimate and recompose the track irregularity signal, including short time Fourier transform (STFT), Wigner-Ville distribution(WVD), Gabor distribution(DGS), Hilbert-Huang transform(HHT), and wavelet transform(WT). On the base of the analytic results, the difference of each method, which is used to analyze the data of maglev' track in this paper, is compared. Some feature of the method is given in this application. Because of the purpose of this thesis to complete the engineering project, all of the arithmetic programs in this system have been validated in practice. According to the analysis of practical measurement, the measurement system is proved to be a success and the performance meets the expectations.

articleTitle: Study on Flowlimiter of High Pressure Common-rail System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A flowlimiter is one of the important safety links in the high pressure common-rail system. According to the typical structure of the flowlimiter in foreign CR system, its working principle was analyzed and its simulation model and mathematics model were set up, then the matlabsimulink calculation were done and the key parameters were selected. Finally, the samples were manufactured and tested.

articleTitle: Navigation Sensors Fault Diagnosis Based on Wavelet Transformation and Neural network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Fault diagnosis plays an important part role in ensure the reliability of integrated navigation, the paper was proposed especially for the integrated navigation which used on ship. How to keep its safety must confront to us. Now most of fault diagnosis are based on traditional methods, Because wavelet transformation can localize signals both in time and frequency, and neural network has the ability of self-organized, self-learning. To make fault diagnosis more effective and can adapt to the development of technology. The paper proposed a more intelligent method which combined wavelet transformation and neural network to enhance the efficiency, the summary procedures were designed as below: we combined the wavelet transformation and neural network in series. After three-layer wavelet decomposition, the coefficients of the third layers are achieved. Then 8 eigenvectors as fault samples to train three-layer RBF neural network, for RBF network is good at classification, after training the network can detect a fault on-line. At the same time, it can classify faults and alarmed the users. Gyro signals are chosen as the simulation inputs, the results prove the method applicability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Predict Malfunction-Prone Modules for Embedded System Using Software Metrics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: High software dependability is significant for many software systems, especially in embedded system. Dependability is usually measured from the user's viewpoint in terms of time between failures, according to an operational profile. A software malfunction is defined as a defect in an executable software product that may cause a failure. Thus, malfunctions are attributed to the software modules that cause failures. Developers tend to focus on malfunctions, because they are closely related to the amount of rework necessary to prevent future failures. This paper defined a software module malfunction-prone by class cohesion metrics when there is a high risk that malfunctions will be discovered during operations. Also proposed a novel cohesion measure method for derived classes in embedded system.

articleTitle: A new realizable structure to improve VCO linearity
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: FM nonlinearity is the main obstacle to improve the performance of a good many VCO applications. In the paper, a universal correction model is brought up and based on the model the sources of dominant error in the correction process are analyzed. To decrease errors produced in the carrier frequency-transfer segment, a dividing frequency – delay structure of high performance, low cost is brought up based on ideas from some existent correction structures. The structure has an innovative feature, dividing frequency relativity. Simulation proves that the new structure and feature has excellent noiseproof performance and deserves further research.

articleTitle: Effects of Distributed Antenas of LAS-CDMA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Distributed antennas with Large Area Synchronous wideband code division multiple access (LAS-CDMA) model under multi-path fading channel is analyzed. The spreading codes of the CDMA system are Loosely Synchronized(LS) spreading codes. LS codes exhibits a so-called Interference Free Window ,where both the autocorrelation and cross correlation of the codes become zero. Therefore, if the signal is limited in the window, LS codes have the promise of mitigating the effect of Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) and Multiple Access Inference (MAI) in multi-path fading channels. The performance of LAS-CDMA with distributed antennas factors was studied. it has been verified that BER of mobile is related with the location of bases, the numbers of antennas and the signal's power. Numerical results indicate that macro diversity gain is obtained by the use of distributed antennas, the performance of the system is affected by many factors

articleTitle: Applied Technique and Development Trend of CCD Image Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: On the base of explanation of the basic principles of CCD and its status, we briefly introduced several recent advances in the application of CCD, and give an outlook of CCD development trend.

articleTitle: Fiber Optic Coupler as Sensing Probe of Temperature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The temperature sensing probe is obtained by coating the waist region of the fiber optic coupler with some temperature sensitive material. The coupler used here is made by the fusion and etching method from two standard communication single mode(SM) fibers. The influence of coupler's initial coupling ratio on the sensing probe is studied. The goal of our research is to fabricate desired couplers for the fiber optic temperature sensor. The system for the temperature sensor is simply introduced, and the temperatures are tested with different initial coupling ratio in our experiment. Finally, the experimental results show that the temperature sensor has good characteristics of the temperature when the initial coupling ratios are between 0.2 and 0.3.

articleTitle: Design for Step Motor Control System of Automatic Biochemistry Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Automatic biochemistry analyzer is a necessary instrument for clinical diagnostics. In this paper, a new scheme of concentrated control system for Automatic biochemistry analyzer based on FPGA (field programmable gate array) is put forward. As an important part of automatic biochemistry analyzer, motor control system is one of key parts. In the light of the problems of stepping motor in application, such as surge at low frequency, low torque at high frequency and bad frequency characteristic, the paper presents a kind of practical method of the constant flow chopping subdivision driving based on FPGA. This scheme solves oscillation of stepping motor, improves the control system of biochemistry analyzer instrument.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of a Testing System Using Hybrid Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Hybrid Petri Net(HPN) is a complex dynamic system model that includes both discrete events and continuous variables. Testing systems are usually modeled as discrete event dynamic systems. Nonetheless some types of the systems include continuous variables and system state transitions, some discrete state transitions can be treated as continuous ones at the macro level as well. Thus testing systems have the characteristics of hybrid systems. This paper studied a testing system as a hybrid system, proposed a HPN model for a multi-parameters acquisition card of a testing system for aviation engine, analyzed the system using such model. The analysis results prove that HPN model is able to reduce the system model's state space and represent the dynamic evolution of the system more abstractly and cleanly.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Method based on Lifting Wavelet and Watershed Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The overlapping phenomenon often appears in medical cell images. Traditional watershed based image segmentation methods have the drawback of over-segmentation. A method combining lifting wavelets with watersheds is presented to solve this problem. Lifting wavelet transform is firstly used to create multi-resolution images, then the watershed arithmetic based on distance transform is applied to segment the low-resolution image. At last, the inverse lifting wavelet transform is used to get the high-resolution image. Experimental results show that this arithmetic can successfully separate the cell clusters.

articleTitle: Distortion of Correlation Analysis Caused by Identical Frequency Interference
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Correlation analysis is an important method in signal processing. However, the process and mechanics that the identical frequency interference makes the correlation analysis distorted are not well understood because the expression of correlation function itself is perfect in terms of mathematics. The work carried out an investigation deep into the essence of correlation analysis, proposed a signal model that makes the mechanics of identical frequency interference clear and the experiments for further study being possible. The experimental investigations come to a conclusion that the interference may bring considerable impacts on the distortion, and it may reach as large as 100% or even more.

articleTitle: Virtual Test System Based on Visual C++
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: At present, although most of the literatures about virtual instruments (VI) are based on LabVIEW, it lacks of flexibility and expansibility as a graphical development environment. In order to program a short cycle, friendly interface, easy-to-use and easy-to-repot application, the paper uses Visual C++.Net and Measurement Studio instead of LabVIEW as the platform. Measurement Studio includes a Visual C++ application wizard and a full set of C++ class libraries for creating measurement applications. Measurement Studio defines data types that simplify C++ programming for measurement applications and uses these data types across the various class libraries, from acquisition, to analysis, to visualization. Furthermore, the Measurement Studio class libraries work in combination with the proven Microsoft Foundation Class libraries so we can easily build standard Windows applications. In addition, the program adopts multithreading technique, ActiveX Data Object (ADO) database access technique and Visual C++ Extensions for ADO data binding technique to improve the speed of data acquisition and storage and reduce the complexity of data type convert.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Diagnosis Testing Centre for Electronic Control Engine
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The engine test setting was the core of the fault diagnosis centre for electronic control engine. Its function included the display of engine running condition, independent setup of engine fault, diagnosis with instrument and diagnosis expert system. The engine synthesis analysis instrument can measure engine parameter, collect dynamic signal waveform at real time for on-line diagnosis. Automobile diagnosis computer has function of fault code and stream readout, system test, action test. By its four channels oscillograph function, all kinds of signal waveform can be collected at real time. Comparing it with standard waveform, fault cause reason was confirmed by pattern recognition method. Character of the electronic control engine was considered in diagnosis expert system. By utilizing self diagnosis and diagnosis tree method and waveform analysis method, fault orientation became more convenience.

articleTitle: Application of Discrete Haar Wavelet Decomposition in Identification of PN Codes in PN Phase Modulated Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Known PN codes bring convince to PN phase modulated signal processing. In order to identify PN codes in PN phase modulated signal, the paper introduces a PN codes identification method based on discrete Haar wavelet decomposition. Firstly mathematical model and Haar wavelet representation of PN phase modulated signal are analyzed. Then the principles of identifying PN codes by discrete Haar wavelet decomposition are deduced and proved by mathematical induction. In the process of reasoning, the paper gives out the effective condition of this method. In the end, computer simulation in severe SNR conditions is carried out, and the results which can be illustrated by some figures snapped in the process of computer simulation testifies the judgment to be right and the method to be effective.

articleTitle: An Active Steganalysis Method of Block-DCT Image Information Hiding
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An active steganalysis method is proposed based on HMT (hiding Morkov tree) model and independence component analysis (ICA) methods, aimed at the block-DCT coefficients steganography in this paper (here we assume only one copy of stego message image is supplied). The simulation experiments in Matlab7.0 show that the active steganalysis method can not only improve the steganalysis the efficiency and the accuracy, but also improve the reliability of estimated message length.

articleTitle: Research on System-level Automatic Metrology System for Aircraft Integrated Automatic Test Equipment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to solve the problems in metrology support for aircraft integrated automatic test equipment (IATE), the paper proposes a set of system-level automatic metrology project. First, the paper analyzes aircraft integrated automatic test equipment test demands and hardware/software construction, works out system level metrology rules, clarifies system-level metrology parameters, range and uncertainty. Second, it puts forward a set of methods for IATE system-level metrology, composing verification standards and calibration regulations. Third, through the development on dedicated metrology modules and test program set (TPS), it designs a system-level automatic metrology system for a certain aircraft IATE. The application shows the system-level automatic metrology system can realize metrology support for the aircraft IATE effectively, ensure the accuracy, consistency and credibility of the IATE parameters, shorten metrology support duration, lower technical level of metrology support personnel.

articleTitle: A PCB Component Location Method Based on Image Hashing
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel method based on image hashing is proposed to locate the acquired component from a CCD DSC camera in this paper. Image hash is extracted resistant to geometric distortions. The extracted hash is used to identify the component and related defects including missing component, mistake component, inverse orientation. The proposed method is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of the Fabric Defects Image
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The feature extraction of the fabric defects image is an important basis in the fabric defect identification. It affects directly the efficiency and accuracy of the fabric defects identification. The feature parameter should have high sensitivity, independency and rapid operation, based on this principle, the feature parameters of fabric defects are extracted, which include the area of fabric defects, the boundary perimeter, the center coordinate, the length of the long and short axes, the shape parameter F and eccentricity E. The experiment proved that the size and shape of fabric defects can be identified and the position can be confirmed based on these feature parameters.

articleTitle: Design of Fault Diagnosis System Based on B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the wide application of modern electrical technique to weapon systems, weapons become more and more complicated, integrated, high-speed and intellectualized. To insure weapons in their good conditions, the function of fault diagnosis gets more important than before in the process of repairing. Now, it cannot give fault diagnosis quickly and correctly only by conventional means. So developing proper system is in need. This paper designed and developed a network fault diagnosis system based on B/S (Browser/Server) frame through the analysis of the need of fault diagnosis. Taking good use of testing information and diagnosis rules, the system realized open and distributed diagnosing process, and provided a flat of sharing information, which is the technique basis of combining testing and diagnosing. During design, we use Macromedia Dreamweaver MX 2004 as developing software and Java Scripts and VB Scripts in ASP language as scripts to program. It is proved in LAN that the system can utilize present diagnosis rules in database to diagnose fault distributed. Besides, the system is stable with expansibility and security.

articleTitle: Microwave Devices Simulation with Ansoft HFSS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Some microwave passive devices for applications in microwave moisture content measurement, including waveguide absorption type variable attenuator, optimum H surface horn antenna, optimum pyramidal horn antenna, were simulated by Ansoft's HFSS. Certain targets have been achieved, and it is a new attempt to apply the microwave simulation technology to instructing practice. The dielectric slab painted absorbing material (graphite powder) method or both sides of it inflicted resistance boundary condition method was separately used for the attenuator models. The latter method may achieve the big attenuation and satisfy the need of microwave moisture content measurement according to the simulation results. Optimum gain H surface horn antenna and pyramidal horn antenna with E and H 3dB lobe width equal were designed. The pyramidal horn antenna is better, which can obtain good antenna pattern, big gain and small VSWR according to the simulation results; therefore, it has been used widely in the microwave moisture content measurement.

articleTitle: Simulation of Radar A/R Scope Based on Linux System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Radar failure training simulator can provide a new training method for radar equipment repairing, and the simulation of radar A/R scope is an important part in developing radar failure training simulator. This paper uses Linux system, which has open source code, high stability, and good robustness, to develop the simulation part of radar A/R scope. On the basis of analyzing the display character of A/R scope, this paper introduces the object-oriented application program interface GTK+ and plotting tool Glade in Linux operating system, and also gives the simulating method, steps and result based on this system.

articleTitle: ATS Software Architecture Based on Function Interface
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The purpose of studying Automatic Test System(ATS) software architecture is to improve the ATS instrument interchangeability, promote automation in software development and portability of Test Program Sets(TPSs). Based on the research and analysis of the characteristics and existing shortcomings of the current ATS software architecture, this paper puts forward a modular and standard ATS software architecture based on the function interface which can satisfy the demands of the general-purpose ATS software. Then it undertakes a reasonable partitioning of the software layers according to the ABBET standard. This software architecture based on the function interface is much better in the aspects of the instrumental independence, the openness of software system and the portability of TPS.

articleTitle: Building Technique of the Room Virtual Environment Based on VRML
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Virtual reality technique is the attractive domain for computer application research, its real-time three dimensional expressive force and realistic immersion will greatly improve the computer technique. This paper discusses the main characters and application of virtual reality technique, and introduces the basic format and feature of virtual reality modeling language. At last, modeling on the three dimensional complicated object can be realized based on 3DS MAX software which support VRML, and dynamic interaction between user and room virtual environment can be accomplished by Java/JavaScript.

articleTitle: Target Recognition Based on Seismic Sensors and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the development of sensing technology and the applications of data fusion, acquisition and processing of reconnaissance information enters a new period. On the basis of research on information acquisition, features extraction, classification and decision of target in battlefield, acquiring features of seismic signal of target by ground seismic sensors, in virtue of neural network, pattern recognition of typical military target based on seismic signal has been solved. It is very important that to select which network to be the structure of training, it will effect to the precision and the time length of the pattern recognition directly, and it has important meaning to pattern recognition in the battlefield. Aiming to the shortage of the BP network on the foundation of the Elman type network structure, a new structure design of IRN network with biased units was presented, to, experiments prove it can be used in target recognition and it is superior than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on LCR Impedance Measurement Based on SOPC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, LCR impedence measurement based on SOPC is introduced in detail. The measurement circuit is functionally divided into following three sections: The signal source section generates the test signal based on NCO in SOPC of Altera's FPGA-Cyclone-II EP2C8. The frequency of the test signal is variable from 30 Hz to 1 MHz; The vector ratio detector section measures two vector voltages across the DUT (Edut) and range resistor Rr (Err) series circuit. Each vector voltage is separated into 0° and 90° parts using phase detector and measured using an A to D converter by multi-integration. The software is developed under the Altera's development environmen qartusII 7.0 and NIOS II in FPGA. In this paper, A series adusting measures is adopted. All these measures make the entire instrument measurement accuracy 0.25%.

Author Keywords: LCR impedence measurement based on SOPC

articleTitle: Research on Calibration Method of Magnetic Sensor in Hybrid-Source Magneto Tellurics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To obtain sensor sensitivity to the real weak magnetic field intensity in field so that it can be used in hybrid-source magneto tellurics, a kind of indoor calibration method of magnetic sensor is introduced. In this paper, with calibration conditions being satisfied, a calibration system was designed and results error was analysed. Because of the power-line disturbance, magnetic shielding and its influence to the calibrating precision are introduced.

articleTitle: Investigation of Ship Autopilot Based on FNN
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In view of the nonlinearity and time-varying parameters of ship maneuvering, a new type of marine autopilot is put forward that is made up of a Bang-Bang controller and a fuzzy artificial neural network (FANN) controller. It improves the quality of ship maneuvering. In this paper, the autopilot based on FANN controller is compared with the general fuzzy Autopilot in performance by simulation. The result shows that the method proposed in this paper has the good control performance.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detecting Method of Negative Sequence Current in Traction System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: When electric locomotive moves in power system, it will produce negative sequence current, which will threat the electric equipments and the power system security operation. So it is very important to measure the value of negative sequence current rapidly and exactly. This paper introduces one new kind of method to measure the negative sequence current. The method adopts digital sampling, exact filtering technology and multifarious alarm setting function, has the function of data save and return, and considers the influence of thermal effect. The method can measure accurately the negative sequence current of each surveillance spur track, and the process of measure is simple. The method is also satisfied with the measure in multiplicative different run condition, and it has stronger universality and practicality.

articleTitle: Quasi-orthogonal Space Time Block Codes (STBC) with full transmit rate Concatenated LDPC codes
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In MIMO system of wireless communications, Space time block coding (STBC) is the attractive technique for high bit-rate and high capacity transmission. Methods for providing transmit diversity in communication over fading channels also been concerned. Although STBC has full diversity gain but not coding gain. The concatenation scheme of STBC codes and LDPC (STBC-LDPC) was proposed and it has been shown that the STBC-LDPC can achieve the good error rate performance and coding gain. Recently, low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes have attracted much attention as the good error correcting codes achieving the near Shannon limit performance like turbo codes. In this paper, a concatenation scheme of LDPC codes and Quasi orthogonal STBC which should apply full transmit rate with multiple transmit antennas is proposed. Refering to it as the QOSTBC-LDPC. We evaluate the bit error rate (BER) of the QOSTBC-LDPC with multiple transmit antennas in a quasi-static Rayleigh fading channel by the computer simulation. We show that the BER of the QOSTBC-LDPC is better than that of the STBC with same antennas in a quasi-static Rayleigh fading channel. When receive antennas increasing, the diversity gain will be increasing too.

articleTitle: Design of New Low Power Loss Nonmagnetic Water Meter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we present a design of new type of water meter with nonmagnetic and low power. Some kinds of flow measurements are analyzed, and we discuss the principle of the nonmagnetic sensor used by LC oscillating circuit measuring water flux in detail. The MSP430FW427 is used as MCU with the function realized by the SCAN IF module without IC circuit external, which improves the precision and sensitivity of flow measurement. It realizes the fluid flow measurement and in this paper the correlative design of hardware and software are introduced.

articleTitle: 3D Data Acquisition and Modeling of Traverse Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An outdoor 3D (three-dimensional) information traverse acquisition system based on range data reconstruction solid image is introduced. The system has two laser scanning distance meters mounted on the roof of the vehicle, and the horizontal and vertical data are sampled separately. As the vehicle moves ahead, a horizontal and a vertical range profile of the surroundings are captured at each trigger. According to the captured data, the solid image is restructured through vertical range profiles are aligned to the coordinate system of horizontal one. The accuracy and efficiency of traverse measurement system be improved by means of the cost function calculation and range profiles matching

articleTitle: Error Analysis and Compensation of roll Measuring Device for Roll Grinder NC
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: There are many parameters that cause roll measurement error of roll grinder NC. The effect factors of probe error in roll two-point measurement approach are analyzed, and the mathematic models and compensation methods of the probe static error and dynamic error are proposed in this paper. Based on the original control system and hardware of roll grinder, we designed a new type measuring device and error compensation software system. And the experiment shows that the probe compensation operation can greatly improve the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Conversion Relation Between Square Wave and ESD EMP in the Electromagnetic Damage of Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: By proceeding from micro electromagnetic damage function of the device, combining with domestic and foreign research achievement on square wave EMP damage, the relation between the damage data of square wave and it of ESD EMP is analyzed. The dependence among the damage data of square wave and it of ESD EMP is setup tentatively. Then, the conversion among damage voltage of square wave and it of ESD EMP is finished.

articleTitle: Advantages of PWM-A/D Conversion Techniques in Smart Sensing Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper dedicates a particular attention to pulse-width modulation (PWM) analog-to-digital ( A/D) conversion techniques underlining their importance in smart sensing systems. Nowadays, smart sensing systems and advanced signal processing techniques can improve measuring system's performance and flexibility relaxing hardware specifications and associated cost. The integration of sensing units, conditioning circuitry and A/D conversion is becoming trivial in a large number of instrumentation and measurement applications. In a large number of systems, linearization is generally required because most sensors have an intrinsic nonlinear characteristic or the presence of influence variables makes their characteristic nonlinear over its measuring range. Fortunately, digitalization and linearization can be performed in a single step nearby the transducer in smart sensing systems. A possible solution to achieve this goal is based on a PWM scheme for nonlinear A/D conversion. The proposed A/D conversion method is easily implemented in low-cost microcontrollers that generally include comparator inputs and PWM outputs. The input voltage range can be divided in several intervals and the nonlinearity profile of the A/D in each interval can be dynamically adapted if results from calibration or auto-calibration are available even when hysteresis effects are present. The paper includes some simulation results obtained with MATLAB and an experimental result of a strain gage system linearization is also presented in the final part of the paper.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent terminal with Wireless Transportation Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: To monitor and secure the large weapon system, a design scheme of an intelligent instrument with wireless transportation based on ARM was put forward. On the microprocessor S3C2410 hardware platform, by design of the data acquisition and conversion circuit by chips of TLP521-4 and TLC2543, the wireless transportation circuit by chip of CLPD-6710 and multi-serial communication circuit by chips of ICL232, the whole hardware platform to monitor Input/Output data, analog data and send collected data to a host computer was established. Moreover, corresponding software such as I/O device driver, AD device driver, block device driver and monitor program under Linux system was realized too. By applying this data acquisition and communication system, a famous performance is got.

articleTitle: New Temperature Idity Fuzzy Neural Neural Network Controller Based On Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The greenhouse is a complex system. There is strong coupling relationship among its environmental factors inside greenhouse. So it's difficult to get satisfying effect by using conventional control methods. Based on the characteristics of the greenhouse, a new fuzzy neural network controller was propose to create a proper condition for crop growth.The genetic algorithm was used to train the architecture of fuzzy neural network controller, which was adopted in the greenhouse. Finally, the simulations with Matlab about this system were done. The result was that the speed and precision of the system were improved. The overshoot was reduced also. And the greenhouse system with this fuzzy neural network based genetic algorithm had such features as responding quickly, smooth transition.

articleTitle: Application on the E-Government of the Personal Information Service based on the Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The E-government of our country has improved a lot since it immerged, but there still existing many problems because of various reasons. In this paper, the author analyzed the personal information service based on multi-Agent of the E-government. This paper introduced the design thought of the system and then gave a model based on the multi-Agent.

articleTitle: Built-in Self-test Scheme for IIR Digital Filter
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A built-in self-test (BIST) scheme is proposed for IIR digital filter chip. It needs no modification of the basic building cells and can detect all the non-redundant stuck-at faults in reasonable time. The testability of its cells is analyzed and the deterministic test sequence is deduced. By reusing available arithmetic function units such as adder to generate test vectors and compact test responses, this scheme can be implemented at-speed with minimum hardware overhead and performance degradation.

articleTitle: Geometric Global Registration of Parallax Images Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Image registration is an important task of image processing. In parallax image mosaic, the geometric registration is a global registration minimized residual in translation model. In order to realize quick and robust geometric registration of parallax image, a coarse-to-fine global registration strategy using the coarse images weighted with detail image is proposed. Taking the advantage of multi-resolution characteristic of Wavelet, the original image is pyramid decomposed by Wavelet transformation. The registration result of the upper layer can be the initial value of the next layer in the global registration. The better initial value by this way is applied in the registration of coarse image and vertical detail image in the layer next to the bottom, and the correlative registration curve can be got. The extremums can be got from the correlative registration curve which weights the weight vector by means of the correlative registration curve of the vertical detail image in the layer next to the bottom. Then the optimal registration can be achieved. Experiments indicated that this method has high accuracy, reliability and real-time property.

articleTitle: Research of PID Parameter Self-Tuning Applied in Temperature Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new PID parameter self-tuning algorithm is proposed, which adapts to single plant. Guaranteeing the stabilization of closed loop systems and satisfying the conditions of self-tuning, we can use recursion least squares method and estimate the change of model parameter of the plant online. The PID self-tuning control algorithm is applied to control and research the real-time temperature of the resistance furnace. The conditions of the PID self-tuning: When the difference of the real-time temperature and the hypothesis temperature ⩽±1

articleTitle: Using 3D Body Scans for Shaping Effects Testing Developed by Foundation Garment
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: 3D scanning technology makes it possible to digitize the complete surfaces of a large number of human bodies, providing much richer information about the body shape than traditional anthropometric measurements. This technology opens up opportunities to extract new measurements for quantifying the garments shaping effects. This paper a) gives a brief description of several major body scanners, b) presents a comparison of traditional anthropometry with the measurement techniques for each scanner, c) using 3D body scans for shaping effects testing developed by foundation garment.

articleTitle: A Novel Toxic Gases Detection System Based on SAW Resonator Array and Probabilistic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonator array as the key element for analytical sensor system is a very promising technique for toxic gases detection. In this work, a novel analytical system based on high Q-value surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonator array and probabilistic neural network (PNN) was developed to detect toxic gases such as chemical warfare agents or the simulant. The array consisted of four two-port SAW resonator sensors with a fundamental frequency at 200 MHz was fabricated. To improve the selectivity and sensitivity, four polymers such as polyepichlorohydrin (PECH), Silicone (SE-30), Hexafluoro-2-propanol bisphenol-substituted siloxane polymer (BSP3), fluorinated polymethyldrosiloxane (PTFP), were selected as the sensitive film materials and were coated on the surface of different resonators of the array by spin-coating method respectively. Then, the array was used to detect mustard gas (HD), dimethyl methylphosphonate (DMMP), sarin (GB) and sarin acid. The frequency output of each sensor was mixed with a bare reference device. The signals obtained from the array were analyzed with PNN to identify the toxic gases. The success rate of identification was 90.87%. It showed that the SAW resonator array combined with PNN was able to detect and identify the above toxic gases quite well.

articleTitle: A New Method of Testability Prediction on Model and Probability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: For improving the accuracy of fault-test dependency analysis and test prediction, we introduce two new additional properties into multi-signal model and give a new method of testability prediction on refined multi-signal model. The paper illustrates the method and procedure of testability prediction in two ways. The new method can improve the accuracy of estimating FDR and FIR evidently.

articleTitle: Distributed Air Quality Monitoring Based on Bluetooth Sensing Nodes and Virtual TEDS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A smart sensor network implemented for air quality monitoring that includes a set of multivariable sensing nodes designed and using appropriate solid state sensors and low power consumption multi-input acquisition devices is presented. The communication between the nodes and a host personal computer (PC) that is used for advanced data processing and data logging is performed through a sensor channel acquisition interface characterized by class1 Bluetooth and serial port profile in order to emulate serial cable connections using RFCOMM between two peer devices. The non-linear characteristics of the air quality sensors requires the implementation of inverse modeling processing blocks at the PC level, which are materialized using IEEE 1451 standard elements such as virtual transducer electronic data sheet (Virtual - TEDS). A proposed neural network TEDS solution is also referred in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Display Instrument for Construction Machinery Based on Embedded RTOS
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Taking the intelligent wheel loader as an instance, this paper researches on the intelligent display instrument for Construction Machinery based on embedded RTOS. A structure of embedded system based on RTOS is proposed, and designs of both the hardware and software are completed. The system takes the TMS320LF2407A chip of the TI as the hardware platform, and the real-time operate system of μC/OS-II as the software platform; completes real-time monitoring and management of the construction machinery by the CAN bus communicating with the main controller.

articleTitle: Multi-layer Secure Model of Task-based Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Task-based information systems are special systems for task-based application with high secure requirements and explicitly secure goals. It has explicit application border, fixed process and roles and a lot of pre-experience knowledge. In order to develop the secure task-based information systems, secure models of the systems should be built firstly. A multi-layer secure policy model of the task-based information systems is proposed in the paper. According with the least privilege principle, we consider the properties of subject and object, the requirement, secure policies and action environment together, introduce the confidentiality check engine and integrity check engine, and transit the authorization trusted of the subject to action trusted in the secure model. Its implementation provides a good reference for the design of the secure task-based information system as well.

articleTitle: Research on the PWM Waveform Compensation Algorism
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, dynamic PWM waveform compensation algorism is introduced in detail. The PWM waveform is generated with FPGA(field programmable gate array). The hardware is based on the Altera's FPGA-Cyclone-II EP2C8 and its configuration device-EPC2LC20. The software is developed under the Altera's development environmen qartusII 6.0 and NIOS II CPU in FPGA. In this paper, PID algorism is adopted. Simulation and experiments validate the system. The THD of the output voltage drops from 2.0% to 5%. During the adding and removal of the load, the rate of output signal fluctuation is less than 0.5% and the adjusted time is less than 2ms.

Author Keywords: NIOS II FPGA-based Dynamic Waveform compensation

articleTitle: D-S Algorithm Based on Particle Swarm Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The D-S evidence theory is an excellent method of information fusion.
