Because of the difference which is caused by the sensors, it is essential to deal with the evidence with a method of weighed D-S theory. Presently, the study of the weighed D-S theory is confined to synthetic methods, and the study on how to obtain better weight value is also rarely covered. In fact, the definition of the weight values is fundamental to the process of weight-synthesizing the evidence. Considering the disadvantages of the weighed D-S theory, this article presents a best method of obtaining evidence value. After elaborating the thoughts of the new method, this article provides an excellent value by establishing an optimized model and improving the particle swarm algorithm. Compared with the compared methods, this evidence theory proves more effective and advanced by making simulation test.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis based on Evolutionary Algorithm and Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new intelligent fault diagnosis (IFD) method based on evolutionary algorithm and support vector machines (SVM) for multivariate process monitoring was proposed. A hybrid method combining feature selection and generation in a wrapper based approach via evolutionary algorithm was proposed to automatically generate feature set, and SVM was proposed to serve as an inductive learner for the evaluation of the feature set both as a classifier for the whole diagnosis system. The whole diagnosis process is in a full-automatic way. First, training stage is carried out. Original data with known features was directly sent to the IFD system and then selected features together with generated features are determined by the evolution of SVM learner. Finally, test stage is on the way. Test feature sets are put into SVM classifier, and IFD outputs current fault patterns, which terminates the whole diagnosis process. Applications in TEP data sets prove this method effective and robust.

articleTitle: Realization of Dynamic Angle Measurement of Rotation Flat Based on Pulse Encoder
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to working characteristics of rotary flat in certain big equipment, a kind of dynamic angle measuring instrument is designed. In this instrument, angle and displacement are transformed each other with pulse encoder, so it has a simple structure and good precision. After describing the method of measuring dynamic angle of rotary flat with the instrument and signal process, the result of measurement is analyzed at last.

articleTitle: Application of Fiber bragg Grating Sensors on Monitoring of Cables' Tension
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new on-line monitoring method based on fiber Bragg grating (FBG) for cable tension of cable-stayed bridge is studied. The major structure of sensing head in the test of cable tension is an elastic annulus. The FBG is attached inflexibility to the exterior surface of annulus and form straight-through sensing head. Sensing head is installed between the anchor device and stow-board of funiculus holes of the cable-stayed bridge. Accompany with the changed outside pressure, the Bragg center reflective wavelength of optical fiber grating will be changed correspondly. According to this characteristic and through demodulating the Δλ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub>, the value of the cable tension may be determined. The experiment results and theory indicate that the test system has good stability and linear response capacity, high intensity signal and signal to noise ratio, and has no request for test man, The measurement method for test of cable tension is practical and effective.

articleTitle: Power Self-Regulation Circuit of Piezoelectric Multi-Shaker Micro-Generator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on requirement for power supply of wireless emitting module of machine malfunction vibration monitoring system and characteristic of low power output of micro-generator, a novel power supply manage and control module which controls output power of micro-generator is advanced, and low power consumption self-regulation circuit is designed. Its feasibility has been proved by experiments. Under the condition of resonance frequency 50 Hz and acceleration 0. 15 g ~ 0. 2 g, piezoelectric multi-shaker micro-generator managed by power self-regulation circuit could maintain wireless emitting module of machine malfunction monitoring system to stably work for long time at 3.28 V.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Signal Processing in UFM Based On Digital Polarity Correlation
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to resolve the reliable recognization and procession of ultrasonic signal in ultrasonic flowmeters, an ultrasonic signal recognization and processing method was put forward in this paper based on digital polarity correlated algorithm, and because there were multiple maximal values after polarity correlation, a modified digital polarity correlation algorithm was also put forward for this kind of polarity correlation in this paper. A 4 ultrasonic standard signal is selected to immune to the noise, In the meantime it helps to increase the computing speed. Through software programming and physical experimentation, the result was certified that the stability of ultrasonic transmission time's measure value is less than 0.2% and the measurement accuracy of experiment is up to 0.25%.

articleTitle: An AMUSE-based Approach for Detection and Blind Separation of Multi-component Radar Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The separation of multi-component radar signals is the key problem in the field of radar countermeasure etc. In the real time-vary signal scenario with short data acquired, an AMUSE-based second order statistics approach for effective separation of multi-component radar signals is presented using an effective blind signal processing model built for the intercepted radar signals. The efficacy of this approach is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Reduction of Stochastic Petri Nets for Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The model types used for reliability modeling are classified into two categories: combinatorial model types and state-space model types. Stochastic Petri nets (SPN), belonging to one of state-space types, can represent the dependencies, imperfect coverage, correlated failures, and repair dependencies that realistically occur in genuine life scenarios, but the combinatorial models such as reliability block diagrams, fault trees and reliability graphs can't. So, SPNs as a powerful modeling and analyzing tool have received considerably more attention in system reliability analysis.But the problem of state-space explosion of SPN is so serious that limits its ability to analyze complex and large-scale systems. In this paper, we bring forward a method of equivalent reduction to simplify SPN model before analyzing it. The method utilizes four structure-reduction rules: sequence, concurrence, choice and loop structures of elementary reliability model to simplify SPN model and overcome state-space explosion.

articleTitle: Remote Measurement Framework -Multi-Agent and Web Service Solutions
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Today, remote testing techniques represent a particularly interesting topic. Although we may have obtained many result, but some problems are yet to be solved, such as scalability and flexibility. That integrating multi-technology into a unitive framework is capable of providing interesting solutions to the aforementioned problems. Based on C/S architecture, by combining of agent and web service, This paper reports a remote measurement system preliminary framework. Finally, to validate this framework, a simple prototype for antenna remote measurement, is described.

articleTitle: Application of Radial Basis Function Neural Networks in Complicated Radar Signal Measurement and Sorting
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An intelligent radar signal sorting system with a robust radial basis function (RBF) is presented in this paper. This system can automatically sort the random overlapped radar signal stream and separate the input pulse stream to individual radar pulse sequence. Because tradition Gaussian neural network uses Gauss function as its basis function and adopt gradient descending method to adjust parameters. So the tradition method is likely to produce some non-expectation in learning process. In order to solve the problem, the proposed RBF uses Log-Sigmoid function as its basis function, so it eliminates any risk of instabilities, and it has better learning properties and function approximation capabilities. This algorithm ameliorates the traditional algorithm and enhances the robust properties of learning process. For one thing, the method can adapt to the complicated electromagnetic environment demand due to its self-adapting capability. For another, it can overcome the difficulty that the data have too much noise due to the detection system faultiness. Simulation results demonstrate the obvious superiority of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Signal's Encryption and Decryption Using Nonlinear System and its Inversion
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is researched in the paper that non-linear system and its inversion are used to achieve signal encryption and decryption. Non-linear system and its inversion, which are of mapping relationship, are designed with BP neural network. The impulse signals are decoded with four dimensions to four dimensions, one of the systems encrypts and another decrypts. The result of simulation proves that it is reasonable in theory and workable in practice; the encryption and decryption system can come true easily. Being great secret effect and hardly decryption, the encryption and decryption system will be useful in future.

articleTitle: A Study on TGIS Based on WebGIS in YuLin City
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The development and maturity of WebGIS technologies provided tourism information with good technological support. In this paper, the system structure and running mechanism of the issued platform ArcIMS of popular WebGIS is expatiated. From the view of administrators and tourists, and combing with the investigation of Shaanxi tourism resources and analysis of current Yulin tourism, a design scheme of TGIS for Yulin city is put forwarded.

articleTitle: A New Semi-blind Channel Estimation for ZP-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, a new subspace-based adaptive semi-blind channel estimation method is proposed for zero padding OFDM systems. The algorithm is fully adaptive in the sense that both the subspace information and the optimization. Not only does this algorithm reduce computation complexity, but improves the convergence rate in channel estimation. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Real Time Multisensor Target Recognition Based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The target detecting and recognizing are the key techniques in the intelligent weapon research. Aimed at the shortages of the higher uncertainty and the worse real-time of battlefield target identification system, the solution, that based on digital signal processor and some necessary devices and circuits are designed to accomplish the high speed target identification, is put forward.

articleTitle: Medical Image Recognition Based on Line Moment and the BP Neural
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A method of medical image recognition based on line moment feature and neural network, is proposed in this paper. It includes multi-structuring elements morphological operator, line moment invariant feature extraction, line moment vector standardization, fuzzy preprocessing, BP net and competition selection. Experimental results demonstrate that the method is both effective and efficient, and the trained neural network possesses high classification ability.

articleTitle: A Study on Destriping Methods of Imaging Spectrometer Images
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The existence of stripe noises seriously influences the quality of imaging spectrometer data. In this paper, the characteristic of stripe noises especially their influence on the mean value distribution of image was deeply analyzed firstly. Based on the previous analysis, two new destriping methods were proposed. The experimental result indicated that both the new methods could effectively remove stripe noises and preserve the textures and details of the imaging spectrometer images better.

articleTitle: Base on Hybrid Reasoning Mechanism Fans of Coal Fault Diagnosis Expert System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is necessary to guarantee that timely diagnosis of fans of coal fault is for mine safety production in enterprises. To establish fans of coal fault diagnosis expert system is a kind of effective way for improving fans fault diagnosis. The roughness set is applied to fans fault expert system for knowledge; this way can improve the objectivity of mining knowledge, which to establish effectively fans fault diagnosis rules. The reasoning machine adopts the mixed reasoning mechanism which is based rules and examples, consequently achieved the function of expert system to self-learning and self-improvement. After fans of coal fault diagnosis expert system is put in to use, the operation and maintenance of fans is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Online Self-test for Intelligent Instrument
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The paper introduced the concept, development process of online self-test for intelligent instrument firstly. Then, the online self-test strategies are discussed in detail, which includes test strategy of CPU, memories, ADC/DAC and other functional components. At last, the strategies are applied into the design of a portable ARINC429 data bus analyzer. The test result indicates that the online test strategies discussed in valuable in improving the reliability and performance of intelligent instruments.

articleTitle: Design of On-line Pipeline Ultrasonic Data-Acquisition and Storage System Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Based on the theory of ultrasonic testing, an on-line data-acquisition and storage system is designed. The design scheme of hardware and software of the system are introduced in this paper, in which embedded processor ARM and FPGA are used as its core and UC/OS-II is used as its operating system. Thus a high speed and high frequency and large-capacity ultrasonic signal can be processed, and the pipelines defects can be analyze and evaluate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DDS Based on VHDL
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The direct digital frequency synthesizer circuit, the frequency and phrase of which are controlled, is designed on the basis of presenting the structure and principles of direct digital frequency synthesizer. The DDS system design is realized utilizing VHDL language, and receives functional simulation in the development environment of QurtusII and MATLAB. Finally, using the device of FLEX of ALTERA Company as a hardware design platform, the DDS system receives correlative experimental tests. The experiment result shows that the simulation and experiment are of great consistency, which proves the validity of the method.

articleTitle: A Research on Static Tester of Artillery Recuperator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Artillery recuperator is the important part of recoil system. Pressuring sensing technology and micro-electronics technology been adopted, mixed with automatic computation technology for data collection, a general static tester of the gas pressure and liquid quantity of recuperator is used to replace the traditional testing method of gas pressure and liquid quantity of artillery recuperator. Experiments and engineering application prove that the tester is reliable, higher practicability and testing precision, and it can greatly lower the labor intensity of artillery operators, it is an absolutely necessary testing equipment for increasing the artillery technical support capability and battle capability of troops.

articleTitle: Development of a High Precision MWD System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper proposes to develop a high precision MWD (measurement while drilling) system based on microcontroller. The advanced ISP (in system programming) technology is applied to develop the system, which shortens system developing time, simplifies system upgrade, and declines the cost in system development. A/D module completes data acquisition of seven channel sensor signals, and the related data is displayed by the LCM. The microcontroller communicates with PC through RS232. The PC software uses VC++6.0 as development environment, which realizes friendly human-computer interaction interface. After testing, the system has high precision and good stability, which responds to the need for directional drilling operations, has considerable practical value.

articleTitle: Application of Foundation Fieldbus Technology in Chain Grate Boiler Automation Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Full and thorough distributed automation control sited in fields is implemented for a large enterprise of heat-supply by grate chain boilers with Foundation Fieldbus technology. The main content for the design of the system includes the control plan for the key parameters of the system etc..The control of water level and combustion sub-system are realized. Gradient method is adopted in the searching for the optimum value of air-fuel ratio. The whole control architecture is constructed based on foundation fieldbus network, intelligent instruments in field, Ethernet networks and upper-level supervisory and control computers. Operation practice of the engineering project shows good control and economic performance index. Significant economic benefit is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimizing Control Based on Immune Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This thesis tries to provide immune algorithm which is used to reactive power optimization of power system. The possibility of getting locally optimal solution which brought by the singularity of initial colony in GA can be effectively avoided, the local searching ability can be improved, and calculation can be accelerated. After the optimization calculation of the IEEE-6 node, it shows that the reactive power optimizing control based on IA and GA can reduce the power loss, raise the voltage percentage of pass, and improve the power quality.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experiment Research on Two Layers Vibration Isolation of Diesel Generating Set in "Superiority" Oil Tanker
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The dynamic characteristics of the two-layer vibration isolation and the transmission function curves obtained under different ratio mass and rigidity are mainly discussed. For the two- layer vibration isolation, it is shown that the many benefits of reducing vibration energy transmission and improving the isolation effect when rigidity ratio increases or mass ratio decreases as possible. It is proved by the actual test that there are more benefits for two-layer vibration isolation system than single layer vibration isolation system.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Hydrology Telemetric System Based On GPRS Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: It is very important to remotely measure and monitor hydrology information real-time so as to improve modern management of water resource. In this paper, a new hydrology telemetric system is introduced. The system mainly consists of remote terminal units (RTUs) and monitoring center. The RTU based on ARM is mainly designed to collect, store and transmit the water information to the host computer in the monitoring center. The host computer receives the data from the RTUs and makes correct decision after analyzing, which provides the water conservancy with immediate and exact water information. The remote communication between RTUs and the monitoring center is realized over GPRS. The basic principle, the system composition, and the researches on key technological problems are presented in the paper. And the main idea about improving information security in remote monitoring would also be given. The practical results showed the system is stable and reliable.

articleTitle: An Optimization Expert Control System in Forecasting Sinter Production Process
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, an optimization expert control system in forecasting sinter production process is presented. The system can predict the quality of the sinter and generate the ore mixing recipes model based on the quality requirement. We have obtained remarkable benefits with applying the system to the sinter production. The results show that the model is simple is simple and efficient, and it has higher predictive precision. Here we mainly from the aspects of the exploration ingredient rule, establishing the ingredient model, forecasting agglutinates the quality and the optimized ingredient plan to conduct the research, thus realizes agglutinating the ingredient automatic optimized control. The practice indicated that, applies the nerve network technology in the ingredient expert system is suitable and the success, the ingredient plan optimization method which uses practical is effective, This method is not is only suitable for the ingredient question, it has the big versatility; This technology definitely may promote applies in other domains. We foresee, this technical achievement will have the broad application prospect in the practice.

articleTitle: Active Vibration Control of a Cantilever Beam Using Bonded Piezoelectric Sensors and Actuators
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a numerical study concerning on the active vibration control of piezoelectric cantilever beam. The equations of motion governing the vibration of the beam are derived by application of the Bernoulli-Euler theory and the Hamilton principle. The modal superposition method is adopted to simplify system, a general method of active vibration control and suppression for intelligent structures is put forth on the basis of a negative state feedback control law. Actuator on different positions is performed in order to investigate their effectiveness to suppress vibration in intelligent structures, and the optimal position of piezoelectric cantilever beam in vibration control is pointed out in this paper. Analytical results are verified with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A New Codebook Design Method Based on Genetic Programming
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Vector Quantization is a very important signal compression method with rich applications in wide fields such as image signal compression and speech signal compression. In the process of codebook design, traditional LBG algorithm owns the advantage of fast convergence, but it is easy to get the local optimal result and be influenced by initial codebook. Considering that Genetic programming (GP) has the capability of getting global optimal result and the characteristic of changing the individual coding length, a new clustering algorithm GP-L which is based on GP and LBG to improve the quality of codebook. Concrete complementations of the GP-L algorithm as well as the experiments are given. Experiments show that GP-L algorithm can not only extract the speaker's information, in favor of individual's model, but also improved the recognition rate of the system than the traditional LBG algorithm.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction for Low-field Pulsed NMR Signal Via Stationary Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The measure technology of low-field pulsed NMR (nuclear magnetic resonance) is a new technology, which has great potential development. It can be widely used in industry and agriculture for product detection as a lossless method. The most important work of NMR measurement is the multi-exponential inversion of NMR signal based on the peak information. But the signal is interfused by noise during the measurement. It is important to reduce the noise while keeping the peaks well. The effective wavelet shrinkage method based on SWT (Stationary Wavelet Transform) is firstly introduced in this paper. All wavelet coefficients at the same scale are shrinked with the same threshold in the traditional algorithm, which is not appropriate for NMR signal because the SNR of NMR signal varies in different position. In view of this, the adaptive thresholds are introduced for NMR signal denoising. Different coefficients at the same wavelet scale are shrinked with different thresholds which are self-adaptive to SNR in our algorithm. The novel method is applied to the low-field pulsed NMR experimental equipment developed by ourselves. The experimental results indicate that our method can keep the peaks and edges while restraining noise well.

articleTitle: Research on A Control Strategy Configuration Platform for Field Intelligent Control Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A control strategy configuration platform for field intelligent control network is introduced and expounded. The structure and composition of the configuration platform are expounded systematically and the configuration modes of the platform are discussed. The design and implementation methods for the objects model of the platform are given in detail. Design principle and compiling mode of compiler based on object-oriented approach (OOA) are expounded. Design of the configuration platform is standardized and the user interface is friendly. Users can program the control strategy in IEC61131-3 standard programming language efficiently and construct various algorithm and strategy orienting field intelligent control network with different scale flexibly to realize automation and intelligence for process control.

articleTitle: Selecting the Principal Feature Components in the Three-dimensional Parameter Space for Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a novel face recognition method of selecting the principal feature components in the 3D parameter space constructed using the dimensions of three subspaces, i.e., PCA subspace, LDA subspace and LPP subspace, as axes. The global, local and clustering structure information can be used fully to enhance the recognition performance by selecting the principal feature component in 3D parameter space. The feasibility of the proposed method is successfully tested on the ORL and Yale face databases.

articleTitle: Research on The Function Model of Distributed Intelligent Monitoring and Diagnosis System Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The improvement of equipment complexity leads to more complicated faults reasons, and the requests of the ability, efficiency and feasibility to deal with the faults are improving continuously. So the quondam manual diagnosis and the fault diagnosis method by traditional single expert system cannot adapt to the request of monitoring and diagnosis to modern complex equipment any more. In this paper, a distributed intelligent condition monitoring and fault diagnosis system function model based on multi-Agent with the idea of component is established, and the structure and function of each Agent in this model is described in detail. By cooperation of multi-agent, this model system can adequately utilize distributed knowledge, information and technology resource to improve the adaptability to dynamic environment of monitoring and diagnosis system, and the distributed computation and problem solving can be realized in network environment. This model that has a certain guidance meaning for realization of the distributed intelligent monitoring and diagnosis system, is helpful to build an integrated, intelligent and network diagnosis system. It can give a gist to establish distributed intelligent monitoring and diagnosis system for large-scale complex equipment.

articleTitle: Test Method of Pneumatic Cylinder's life
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Pneumatic cylinder is an important element in pneumatic fluid power systems, and its performance determines the system's performance. Efficient and economical production requires highly reliable machines and equipment, so its reliability must be grasped. However, there were no evaluating standard and test methods in ISO standard. The paper presents a method about the reliability test circuit of pneumatic cylinders, which include test conditions, test circuit, threshold levels, and data analyses and finally give a test example; these permit the assessment of pneumatic cylinders' reliability.

articleTitle: Model Checking with "X" Value Based on PSL
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The foundation of hardware verification is that an implementation satisfies its specification. The specification described by a natural language may be ambiguous and inconsistence. The Acclellera Property Specification Language (PSL) is developed for the formal specification of hardware. It provides a standard means of specifying design properties using a concise syntax with clearly-defined formal semantics, particularly it offers an input method for dynamic (simulation) and static (formal verification method, such as model checking) verification tools. This paper proposes how to use model checking to verify a property with "X" value, and gives a model checking algorithm based on 3-valued (true, false, X) logic formula of PSL. This algorithm has the same time complexity as 2-valued logic model checking. Finally, we present how to separate CTL formula from a PSL verification unit, and verify these properties from PSL under the given model.

articleTitle: Design of Anti-jamming Antenna for the GPS Receiver
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Since GPS signal is very weak when arriving at the ground, even smaller than the background noise of space. This makes GPS receiver's capability of resisting repressive interference poor. By using power inversion algorithm, a GPS receiver antenna is designed. Simulation and the experimental results show that the repressive interference resistance GPS antenna the based on power inversion algorithm, can inhibit the strong signal interference, and the stronger interference is, the better inhibitory effect is.

articleTitle: Signal Denoising of Laser Exploration System Using Adaptive Lifting Scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, according to information that is slightly characteristic of adaptive adjust prediction and update operators, the paper adopts the adaptive lifting wavelet transform algorithm for accurately matching the processed information. This algorithm can effectively decrease the amount of calculation, as well as the computational complexity of information wavelet analyzed, which can carry out the same address operation and advantages that recur in the laser exploration system realization. Secondly, this paper analyzes how to create a threshold of noise-filtering, using the noise features in laser exploration system. The algorithm can also adapt to the requirement for detecting weakened signal occurring in high noise through the definition of floating threshold. The results show that the new algorithm has improved the traditional algorithm and effectively maintains signal detail while filtering out the signal noise, leading to an improved.

articleTitle: Intelligent condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of a gearbox based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper the vibration test system for the gearbox of mining machine , the wavelet denoising method , the artificial neural network' s essential principles and its features, BP network structures model in the gearbox fault diagnosis are discussed.Tested vibration signals are disposed by the method of wavelet denoising and than as the inputs of BP neural network. By using classical BP neural network, four kinds of typical patterns of gearbox faults have been studied and diagnosed and satisfied results have been acquired. The research results indicate that BP neural network with the excellent abilities of parallel distributed processing, self-study, self-adaptation, self-organization,associative memory and its highly non-linear pattern recognition is an efficient and feasible tool to solve complicated state identification problems in the gearbox fault diagnosis simultaneously.

articleTitle: Design of Reconfigurable CNC System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper brings forward a hardware design method of reconfigurable CNC system which makes use of the abundant logic resources of FPGA and programmable characteristics. It introduces the scheme of a CNC system which has regarded FPGA as the control centre. It mainly represents the thought of reconfigurable design, design of programmable pulse signal generator, the speed control of stepping motor, and the communication of FPGA and PC. As a result, this system has fast response and strong reconfiguration ability. It can reduce the number of peripheral interface devices and result in cost-reduction.

articleTitle: A method to locate Partial Discharge Based on the theory of Sectional Winding Transfer Functions
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In order to locate partial discharge (PD) source in transformer, ATP-Draw simulates the propagation of PD pulses along the windings model. Then the method of PD locating based on the theory of Sectional Winding Transfer Functions is introduced in detail, and simulation analysis and calculations indicate this method is effective and applicable. Moreover, some researches are explored based on the same theory to locate two or more PD sources by ANN. These researches can afford basic theories to PD online-monitoring and system diagnosis actually.

articleTitle: Study on Performance of Flexure Hinge Mechanism Based on the EBM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The basic principle of the equivalent beam methodology (EBM) is introduced and the performance of a double parallel four-bar flexure hinge mechanism is discussed. First, the displacement of this mechanism is theoretically analyzed. Then the displacements of mechanism are studied with the EBM and the conventional finite element method (CFEM) in software ANSYS. Compared with the analytic result of the CFEM, the EBM has the advantage of high efficiency with a low number of elements, which is very important for the simulations of micro-positioning stage with complex flexure hinge mechanism.

articleTitle: Using Advanced Time Domain Function And Interpolation In Frequency Domain Algorithm Based On The Shannon Wavelet Packet Transform To Measurement The Nonstationary Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Wavelet packet transform (WPT) is one of the most powerful tools in the analysis of the nonstationary signals. Shannon wavelet function is the only function that can divide the frequency domain strictly in the single wavelet family, but the time waveform of Shannon wavelet is not compactly supported, so the application of it is limited. In this paper, a kind of optimized Shannon wavelet transform (SWPT) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the incompactly supported characters is improved in time domain by modification the function's time expression; secondly; the interpolation algorithm in SWPT'S frequency filter is proposed to ameliorate the performance father more; then the fast computation of algorithm using chirp Z transform is implemented, at last the numeric simulation has been given out. The result shows the algorithm improves the performance of the SWPT effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Control System for Stage Precision Winding
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The properties of conventional random and precision winding for winding machine are analyzed in this paper. A new design of computer control system for stage precision winding is proposed. This system with programmable computer controller (hereafter PCC) is introduced. It combines the advantages of the conventional winding, can be applied to high speed winding and off-winding. The proposed system has been applied. The results testing the performance of real setup show that the control deviation is accurate to within 0.2% and the rate of variation in winding speed is lower than 3%. It plays a key role in the process of staple fibre yarn or continuous filament production, and has many potential applications.

articleTitle: Research on Protecting the Safety in Web System With SSL
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: According to the susceptible problem about user's password safety guard, we propose the solution of using secure sockets layer (SSL) in Web system. After disposing SSL in your server, encrypt the random data provided by the server's script and user's password saved in system with MD5. Then transfer the disposing result and user's id to the server. The experimental results show that in this way the susceptible information's safety transferred between the server and browser and saved in the database is ensured, as all of the information will be transferred in secret word.

articleTitle: Design of Micro-oxidation power control system based on LPC2119
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: MAO (micro-oxidation) is a surface process technique which makes ceram layer grows in the original position of the surface of metal. A self-developed micro-oxidation power control system was introduced in this paper. The hardware part composed of low consumption 32-bit microcontroller LPC2119 developed by Philips Company instead of MSC 51 single chip, which enhanced the stability and extensibility of system; while the software design adopted uC/OS-II multitask type instead of the traditional forward and backward design type, which enhanced the precision and real-time response of the system. Parameters can be set the same as PC, and preset functions can also realized in this system. We have used the PID control way in the system.. In addition, large scale adjustment of voltage, current, pulse frequency and duty ratio can also be satisfied. The developed system has been applied in products, leading to well effects.

articleTitle: A New Method for Real-time Wavelet De-noising
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a new method for a real-time sequence with multi-scale wavelet transform analysis. When the amount of the sequence data is too small, using an artificial noise sequence with a certain variance and expend the sequence data to sufficient amount. Then the sequence real value can be recovered by off-line process and driving out some redundancy data. As for those data increasing with the time, supplementing and eliminating the redundancy data with a certain regularity to avoid the de-noising time with exceeding the renewal rate of the real-time system. This method is easy to be executed and suitable for digital process and the application of the computers.

articleTitle: Development of A New-type Shaft-driven Generator
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new-type marine shaft-driven generator system is introduced, in which an IGBT technology-based PWM converter is used to convert the varying mechanical energy of rotation into the AC energy with the fixed frequency and voltage. Based on space vector control, this system maintains the constant voltage and constant frequency of generator and supplies effective power and reactive power to load in ship.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of High-Speed Large-Capacity Data Storage in DSO
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This thesis discusses a method of high-speed large-capacity data storage used in a digital storage oscilloscope, which is the technology of data storage with different phases. It has achieved the technical indicators of maximum real-time sampling rate of 200MSPS, memory depth of 2M sampling points. The principle and implementation of the technology of data storage with different phases, including logic design, timing simulation, and the compare to the different design schemes and so on are discussed in this thesis in detail.

articleTitle: A Comparison between LAN and GPIB Instrument Interfaces in a Automated Test System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: For many years, GPIB has been the primary instrument input/output interface. However, new standards, such as LAN and USB, are gradually being built into modern instruments and test systems. This paper introduces the characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of using GPIB, LAN and USB interfaces in an automated test system. After that, a practical case using instruments with GPIB and LAN interfaces is analyzed, including the methodology developed for this study. It will also be discussed the possibilities to optimize production costs and a comparison between the used interfaces will be made, including the analyses of the system behavior when the instruments are controlled in parallel using different interfaces configurations, combining GPIB and LAN control. In the end of the paper, after the results achieved are presented and commented, conclusions are drown on the instrument architecture that best fits the requirements to optimize the automated test system is made.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Security Proxy Based on SSL Protocol
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: For electronic commerce, security is the important problem. SSL protocol becomes supreme available because of its simplicity and credibility. The hidden trouble in application is decided by limiting factors of SSL itself and the American restrictions on cipher exporting. This paper is to offer proposals to improve SSL based on the analysis of it. On the basis of feasibility, security proxy is designed and installed at both client side and server side as the transition software, so as to ensure the security of electronic commerce. A designing of modularize is adopted to guarantee the extensibility and flexibility of security proxy. And search for a balance between security and function further. Finally, its partial process has been simulated.

articleTitle: Image Pre-processing Algorithm Based on Lateral Inhibition
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Enhancing the contrast and projecting the edge is the two important functions of the lateral inhibition network. Some image details are lost when the infrared image is processed based on traditional lateral inhibition algorithm. A new method that the processed image is weightingly added to the original one is proposed. The algorithm can not only project the image edge, but also overcome the above-mentioned shortage. The simulation results show its effectivity.

articleTitle: Implementation of Improved VPN Based on SSL
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: An improved VPN (virtual private network) system based on SSL (secure socket layer) protocol is discussed to overwhelm the defect of the traditional VPN, which is required to install client software and to do a complex operation. The concept and critical technique of VPN are discussed, and then SSL protocol architecture and the working process of the handshake layer and the record layer are analyzed in detail because they are very important for ensuring the network safety in the SSL. Based on the above technology, an improved VPN based on SSL protocol is designed; it overcomes the flaw of currently VPN system and enhances the security of VPN system. In this project the task of validation, encrypting and decoding is completed by integrated circuit (IC) card and cipher card, moreover, a SSL proxy is added behind the corporation firewall to improve the security of SSL VPN. Moreover, this system improves not only the connected ability of communication but also the identity validation. This design of SSL VPN is more comfortable to browse the public web and it is much safer.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Advanced Triggering in Digital Phosphor Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the design, implementation and verification of advanced triggering circuit in digital phosphor oscilloscope are introduced. The simulation results, implemented performance and extended dual-triggering system are discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Real-Time Temperature Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces a remote wireless temperature monitoring system which can be applied in real-time and with multi-regional access to information without geographical restriction by short message service (SMS).

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Universal RS232-GPIB Interface
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to outline a universal RS232-to-GPIB interface which can enable a computer with an RS232 serial port to be a GPIB Talker or GPIB Listener and has the capable of interfacing RS232 instruments and peripherals to the GPIB. The dominating feature of the interface is that the baud rate of the serial communication can be adjusted by the user and the data flow can be controlled automatically. In this paper, the National Instruments TNT4882 and the 8051 microcontroller are used to realize the interface. This paper mainly presents the hardware architecture and software design of the RS232-GPIB interface.

articleTitle: Design of UART Based on ARM+DSP Distributed Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces how to realize UART between acquisition and processing module based on DSP and data collection terminal module based on ARM. Then it takes the TMS320VC5402 DSP and S3C44B0X ARM for example, and designs hardware interface and procedures, the paper shows how to realize synchronization of asynchronous transfer for DSP and the communication between the two chips. After certification of the design the system, it can meet the real-time detection, also it can conveniently realize the communication between the system and PC to storage data, so it is with a good prospect.

articleTitle: Identification of Dynamics for Nuclear Steam Generator Water Level Process Using RBF Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the operation of nuclear steam generator (SG), the reverse thermal-dynamic effects make SG water level process dynamics characteristic difficult to identify. In order to improve the effect of identification, a new method based on radial basis function (RBF) neural networks (ANN) is proposed and investigated in this paper. The identification model employs series-parallel model to assure the convergence and stability of identification process. The train algorithm for the RBF neural network (RBFN) adopts the orthogonal least square (OLS) method. The mathematical model of the SG in Qinshan Nuclear Power Plant (NPP) in China is used for simulation demonstration. The identification on SG typical operation modes, which the steam flow rate and feed water flow rate are step change respectively, were implemented to demonstrate the feasibility of modeling SG process dynamics employing RBFN. The identification results show that employing RBFN can identify SG process dynamics correctly and has adequate precision and fast convergence.

articleTitle: Face Protection of H.264 Video Based on Detecting and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With more and more attention on security in video, people have proposed many video encryption algorithms and many of them have been put into application. However, these algorithms encrypt the whole frame, they don't consider regions of interest, this will increase the communication cost. In this paper, we proposed a safe protection scheme of interesting facial region. This approach included rough face detection based on skin-color model, accurate facial region location based on Bayes classifier depending on direction character convolved by Sobel filter, tracking based on Kalman filter and encrypt face region in CABAC coding. Experimental results showed that this approach has better quality of anti-attack and protect interesting facial region effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Direct Torque Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Drive Based on Extended State Flux Linkages Observer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper describes an investigation of direct torque control (DTC) for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). The drawback that the flux observation accuracy was influenced by uncertain parameters in tradition flux model could be overcame by using observer method, and the flux is estimated accurately under whole speed range. This paper designs the nonlinear extended state observer and uses it in the stator magnet flux linkage estimation. The simulation results indicate that observed flux with the uncertain stator resistance values is more precise and robust than conventional flux model.

articleTitle: Non-linear Error Compensation of Voltage Sensitivity for Vibration Accelerometer Based on Cymbal Transducer
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new type of piezocomposite vibration acceleration sensor was studied, which sensitive element consists of Cymbal transducer. The amplitude and frequency characteristics of this new vibration acceleration sensor and nonlinear characteristic of output voltage sensitivity were investigated. The least squares approximation method, partition linear interpolation and average value filter methods were employed to carry out non-linear error compensation of output voltage sensitivity. The experimental results shown that the non-linear error of output voltage sensitivity can be 0.6% or less than 0.6% after the non-linear error compensation was made. Micro-controller unit (MCU) was used to data logging, and the least squares approximation method was used to carry on fitting a straight line and establish the non-linear compensation data table. Every time 8 points sampling values are collected, which are used to obtain an average value as the actual sampling value, so the unwanted signal can be filtered, the accuracy of the sampling value can be improved.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Wavelet Network-Based Stator Estimation for Induction Motor Temperature Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A novel motor stator estimation scheme for the purpose of monitoring the temperature in steady state is proposed and the feasibility of wavelet network-based estimation of the stator resistance as an indicator of stator winding temperature is evaluated. By the use of wavelet network that accurately localizes the characteristics of a signal both in the time and frequency domains, the occurring instants of the signal change can be identified by the multi-scale representation of the signal. The improved least squares algorithm transform is used to fulfill the network structure initialization and parameter identification, and then the mapping relationship between the stator voltage, stator current, power factor angle and the rotor speed is obtained. The stator resistance and rotor resistance are identified with motor mathematical model, and then the corresponding temperature is calculated according to the principle that the metal resistance depends on its temperature. The simulated results verify the validity of the proposed method and the analysis for asynchronous motor temperature monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Characteristics of Signal Radiated from Corona Discharge
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In the shielded room, the effect of different factors, which includes different polarity of potential, direction of polarization of antenna, receiving distance, the shape of discharging needle, temperature and humidity etc., on the spectrum of signal radiated from corona discharge. According to the experiment, it concludes that the waveform of signal radiated from corona discharge has a steep rising edge; the spectrum of signal radiated from corona discharge is continual spectrum, which frequency range is from 20MHz to 100MHz; when the polarity is different, the waveform of signal radiated from corona discharge is different, and the amplitude of signal of positive corona is higher than of negative corona; the politicization mode of fields radiated from corona discharge is vertical; the intensity of fields radiated from corona discharge is inversely proportional to the receiving distance; the relative humidity is different, the amplitude of signal is different, the higher the relative humidity is, the higher the amplitude is.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Measurement System Based on Hybrid Bus
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents an architecture for radar remote measurement based on hybrid bus. Using TCP/IP and DataSocket techniques for remote communication, the system integrates PXI and GPIB bus for real-time data acquisition and instrument control. Experiments show that this system has the advantages of complete functions, simple operation and friendly user interface for general application.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Feature Extraction Based on Wavelet Transforms for Speaker Recognition
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, we try to place emphasis on the dynamic feature extraction and detection of speech signal under the forensic identification practice, which meet the demand of text-independent speaker recognition analysis. As a result of voice changeability, accent diversity and influence by all kinds of environmental factors, voice detection become very difficult. The text-independent speech signals are non-stationary and have important parameters included both in time and frequency domain. Wavelet transforms is proposed because it holds multi-resolution analysis ability and a reasonable wavelet cores is selected. Additionally, a new combined-future-extraction algorithm based on Mallat algorithm of biorthogonal wavelet is proposed to extract the new feature of voice and detect the singular signal in noise environment. Theoretic analysis and simulated experiment results show that new algorithm not only achieves new signal with precisely and available by decomposition and reconstruction to the target signal, but also suits to real areas, real-time application and also can be strengthen. The experimental results are better to verify the above analysis.

articleTitle: Research Based on the CCD Vision Thread Parameters Automatic Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The threaded connection is widely applied in the industry, its traditional examination methods all need manual operations, and their measurement precision is low relatively. For real-time and accurately to measure thread parameters such as thread angle (tooth-type half-angle), screw-pitch, lead, thread height, major diameter, minor diameter, pitch diameter, helix angle etc, and enhancing the measuring accuracy, a non-contact thread parameter measuring system based on an array CCD is designed and achieved. And its optics imagery, preprocessing of images, edge detection, sub-pixel location and camera calibration are emphatically investigated, test and analysis software is excogitated, and corresponding experiments are studied. The results obtained indicate this system has advantages such as quick test, high precision and good repeatability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System of Welding Torch's Attitude for Pipeline Welding Robot
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Aiming at the control problem of the welding torch' attitude in the case of whole-position welding, an intelligent control system of welding torch's attitude for pipeline welding robot is presented in this paper. The ADXRS300 micro-mechanical gyro is used as the welding torch's position sensor in this system. When the welding torch's position is obtained, an appropriate pitch angle can be obtained through the experiential inference of the expert system. ARM is used as the controller to drive the welding torch pitch angle step motor in order to real - time adjust the pitch angle of the welding torch. The experiment result shows that the intelligent control system of welding torch's attitude using expert system is feasible and it enhances the welding quality. This system has wide application prospect.

articleTitle: Software Development for Electromagnetic Tomography Image Reconstruction Using ActiveX
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Though the research of electromagnetic tomography (EMT) technology is still at the stage of development in laboratories in China, the speed of development is really high. The development of software component for EMT image reconstruction will be helpful for further exploitation of algorithm and software of EMT. In this paper, at first, the demand of the image reconstruction software is analyzed, afterwards, some existing algorithms are combined and MS ActiveX technology is applied for encapsulation, and finally, a software component of EMT image reconstruction algorithm which has a good application interface is realized, and the reuse rate of image reconstruction software is increased.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of OQPSK Modulator Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: OQPSK is the one kind of improved QPSK. QPSK can produce the phase ambiguity in carrier recovery process. OQPSK eliminates the influence of phase ambiguity, on the correct decision. For the requirement of designing the digital modulation of satellite signal simulator channel, the article proposes the proposal to realize the OQPSK by selecting Xilinx Corporation Spartan3 series XC3S4000. This design combines the VerilogHDL hardware description language with the schematic diagram union design method, has the very strong versatility and the very good probability. The test result indicates this plan has achieved the anticipated goal.

articleTitle: A Method Of Amplitude-Frequency Characteristic Compensation About DDS Signal Source
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: DDS (direct digital synthesis) is widely applied in signal generator. In this paper, amplitude-frequency characteristic of DDS signal after D/A conversion (DAC) was analyzed. Then a method for improving amplitude-frequency characteristic was put forward. The method is based on characteristic of LC parallel circuits that signal can be amplified at resonance frequency. By this method, amplitude attenuation caused by DAC is compensated; amplitude frequency characteristic of DDS signal is improved. The experiment results indicate that amplitude flatness of arbitrary waveform generator increases about 2 dB at 0 Hz-40 MHz.

articleTitle: Using Powergui Capabilities of Matlab in Teaching of Electric Power Engineering
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: With the application of IT in the field of electric power system, computer aided electric power system design and analysis software has played an important role in electric power system research and teaching. With the pragmatic feature of power system analysis and Powergui capabilities of Matlab, it is presented to introduce the Powergui into electric power engineering class. By means of the graphics and interaction of Powergui, an example is provided which can not only visualize abstract theory, but also make students acquire the more practical knowledge. At the same time some complicated problems associated with actual engineering is designed, which can improve the ability of student to analyze the actual engineering.

articleTitle: Interpolation Algorithm of Oxygen Content Measurement Data in Bio-reactors
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The oxygen content in bio-reactors is an important parameter to judge the status of bio-reactor operation, but the oxygen content data is finite in experiment. In order to find the distribution of oxygen content in bio-reactors, the interpolation algorithm is introduced in this paper. At first, according to the characteristic of experimental data field, the bio-reactor domain is grided to hexahedron, the space of bio-reactor is reconstructed through the hexahedron element mesh of the scattered data field, and the region mapping algorithm is used to interpolation calculation. This integrate algorithm is good for the data field reconstruction and interpolation, which the field is belongs to the three dimensional space of bio-reactor.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of the Direction of Arrival Estimation Algorithm of Spatial Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation is an important research direction in array signal processing field. The MUSIC (multiple signal classification) algorithm is classical super-resolution algorithm. Basing on exact model of antenna array, the MUSIC algorithm can estimate the DOA of signal accurately, but the resolution becomes low if the SNR or sample number is small. Min-norm (MN) algorithm is an improvement on the MUSIC, it can improve the resolution. Basing on analysis of the MUSIC and MN algorithms, the two algorithms are simulated and their character is compared in this paper.

articleTitle: A 1.2V High Linearity Mixer Design
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper introduces double balance active mixer which is designed by Barrie Gilbert, it shows good characteristics in linearity, gain and isolation. In 1998, Barrie Gilbert present multi-tanh principle with bipolar transistors. So this paper uses the multi-tanh technique to design some new structure in order to improve linearity and gain. First we double the transconductor level with four NMOS transistors, then we tripled the transconductor level with six NMOS transistors, meanwhile we keep the circuit is symmetry. Using Cadence SpectreRF, the circuits show better linearity and gain, yet noise figure increase, so it exists a tradeoff among these parameters of active mixer. In this paper, the circuit simulated in 2.4 GHz down-conversion mixer with 0.18 mum process, IIP3 and ldB compression point achieved 8.5 dBm and 2 dBm, gain is 4 dB, power assumption is 6 mW. Although this new architecture being used in down conversion mixer, it can be applied in up conversion active mixers too.

articleTitle: Research on High-Speed Data Acquisition and Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper discusses the chief techniques and design principles of an ultra high speed data acquisition and processing module, which aims to solve dynamic, transitional and transient signal measurement. The module consists of A/D converter, on-board memories, DSP processor and control circuit integrated in FPGA. It can achieve 8-bit resolution allowing up to 1GHz sampling rate with 512Mbyte on-board real-time memory. The DSP processor is the module controller, also can be controlled by host PC through PCI bus interface. Voluminous data transfer is very easy to complete. DSP has the advantage of data real-time processing and data preprocessing such as FFT, FIR etc. It greatly improved the performance of the data acquisition module. The module can carry out two record mode: continuous record and pre/post record, two trigger mode: internal trigger and external trigger, two storage mode: on-board real-time 512Mbyte memory storage and hard disk storage. This can basically meet all kinds of application.

articleTitle: Application of PSD in Space Point Position Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Introduced one kind of new photoelectric PSD (position sensitive detector) in the two-dimensional space and three-dimensional space point light source position measure application, and has carried on the experimental measure to the two-dimensional space point light source, according to point light source establishing coordinate system, does displacement in the horizontal plane x, y direction, displacement changing causes output of the PSD change according to certain relational, sends 4 groups outputs about two set of PSD module into the signal conditioning electric circuit, after the output signal is gathered by data acquisition card, carries on the data processing and the point light source two-dimensional position count through software. Finally has analyzed question that exists in the experiment, improved measure as well as the question of PSD should pay attention in the application.

articleTitle: A CMRF-Based Approach to Unsupervised Change Detection in Multitemporal Remote-Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Simple MRF model based method usually suffers from less inaccuracy because it assumes that each subimage used to estimate features is homogeneous. In this paper, an adaptive algorithm based on the fields correlation Markov random field (CMRF) model is proposed. The labeling is obtained through solving a MAP problem by ICM. Features of each pixel are calculated by using only the pixels currently labeled as the same pattern, while the new labeling is obtained by using the adapted feature. The satisfying experimental results in change detection of multitemporal remote-sensing differencing images confirm the effectiveness of proposed techniques.

articleTitle: Optical interferometry Endpoint Detection for Plasma Etching
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The optical interferometry is a non-invasive plasma diagnostic method. Etch experiment were carried out in a high density plasma etching tool (ICP). The theoretical model for optical interferometric endpoint detection and prediction in plasma etching are presented. It is observed that the optical properties of oxide layer and polysilicon layer can affect the interferometric signals. The endpoint algorithm and real time plasma parameters diagnostics are discussed, then process control with optical interferometry during the poly-silicon etch is described. The endpoint prediction technique has been applied to poly-silicon gate etching in high density plasma etching tools.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Digital Phase-Sensitive Demodulator for EIT System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: Electrical impedance tomography (EIT) requires high precision voltage measurement to reconstruct image. In this paper a novel FPGA-based digital phase-sensitive demodulator designed for EIT system is put forward. Unlike the traditional analog multiplier demodulator of poor dynamic behavior and high noise, the digital demodulation is used to obtain both in-phase and quadrature components of the voltage signal with high SNR, high data precision and high demodulation speed. This paper first expounds the theory of digital phase-sensitive demodulator, then discusses the blocks and technique specification of the demodulator. Different parts are realized by VHDL. The demodulator is implemented and tested. Emulation is given by QUARTUS II and the phase error is 1.03deg. The result shows that the digital demodulator is suitable for the signal processing in EIT system and meets the requirement of digitized EIT system.

articleTitle: Study of a New GPS-Carriers Based Time Reference with High Instantaneous Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A possibility to obtain a new time reference constantly locked to the Caesium-derived GPS satellites carriers was investigated by means of a new GPS receiver architecture able to lock the two GPS carriers and mix them to obtain a reference frequency with an accuracy close to the GPS one. This is very important in Perceived Power Quality distributed measurements systems where the exact knowledge of the events on the geographic compass is strongly joined to the capability to associate them an accurate time. A simulation of the carrier tracking loop has been performed. It shows how choosing appropriately the frequency of the low-pass filter of Costas loop, a modified PLL typically used in GPS system, it is possible to recover carriers in presence of high noise to signal ratio too. The front-end of the system able to select GPS frequencies, which is the first block of the entire system, was also realized.

articleTitle: Online Remote Controllability Verification via Internet and Dial-up Network for DVD Recorder Based on Virtual Instrument Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: One of the most impressive and attractive evolutions of DVD recorder is the remotely controllable ability. In this paper we concern about the verification of remote controllability of latest DVD recorder by Internet or dial-up network, through RJ45 and RJ11 sockets respectively during manufacturing process. The virtual instruments tools, LabVIEW and TestStand are used to form a function module of the whole measurement system. The detailed procedures are given and G-codes are depicted. Some human-machine interfaces are captured to show the process. The developed modules is successfully put into use.

articleTitle: A New Approach for Monitoring Grounding Grid of Electrical Power System
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: A new approach, to monitor the corrosion status of the grounding grid which plays an important role in the power system, is proposed in this paper. This method is based on the principle of potentiostatic technique, by which status of grounding grid can be detected from the sensor buried in earth near the grounding conductors. The mathematical relationship among corrosion depth, the measured soil resistances and corrosion potential is deduced in detail based on circuit model and theory. The integral quantity of corrosion depth in a year is the yearly corrosion depth. The status of grounding grid can be known from this yearly corrosion depth. This new approach has been tested in laboratory and in Yanfeng substation in China. The test reports demonstrated that the proposed model is a practical tool to monitor the status of grounding grid.

articleTitle: Online Measurement System for DVD Recorder and its Video Signal Deficiency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper firstly focuses on the video signal measurement system for DVD recorder, one of the most demanding tasks for DVD recorders manufacturing. An online measurement system is configured and set up by PC workstation and LabVIEW, a virtual instrument development platform. After that, the system is put into practice successfully. Some deficient video signals are captured and their image and waveforms are illustrated. The causes behind the deficiency are further analyzed. The online measurement system becomes an essential tool to guarantee the quality of DVD recorders before packing.

articleTitle: Area Harmony Dominating Rectification Method for SIFT Image Matching
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper presents a method of verifying matching key-point couples extracted by SIFT algorithm from two relative images. This method defines dependability of matching couples with local area features which express the harmony of the tested couple with nearest matching couples. In this paper, pictures that have similar contents are first analyzed by SIFT algorithm. After this operation, original matching key-point couples are found out. Then the result of SIFT are examined by our method. In the pilot study, experiments have proved the method behaves fast, efficiently and stably. The data from experiment shows that the method is capable of discriminating correct matching couples from incorrect couples, so it can eliminate mismatching key-point couples automatically in the same time protect the matching couples. In most tests, it increases the matching rate from about 70% to more than 95%.

articleTitle: Remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system for power transformer based on HMM
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: This paper aims at large-scale power transformer, introduces Hidden Markov Models theory into power transformer fault diagnosis field, and a fault diagnosis method using the HMM is put forward. Some issues and their settling methods about the HMM applying into power transformer brings are further analyzed. The fault diagnosis principle bases on the HMM is discussed in detail. The power transformer faults are classified and each of their characteristic variables is determined, accordingly, the fault diagnosis model library for power transformer is researched. Finally, the fault diagnosis system for large-scale power transformer is designed.

articleTitle: Research on Rough Set-Neural Network and Its Application in Radar Signal Recognition
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: The purpose of reconnaissance system's information processing is signal recognition, which is also a key step in the whole process of radar reconnaissance information processing. In order to solve the problem of radar signal recognition, a new type of recognition model is established which combines rough set and neural network closely in this paper. The model can be divided into these steps such as recognition information's pretreatment, sample data's reduction by rough set, neural network's learning and training and network's recognition to information which is not identified. The model mixes rough set's strong rule extraction ability and the excellent classification ability of neural network through preprocessing initial information and reducing data and training network etc. The experimental results illustrate the model reduces subject factors in signal recognition, improves network's structure. Compared with traditional signal recognition methods, this model can manage to identify radar signal objectively and effectively without any transcendental information.

articleTitle: A New Method for Conducted EMI Noise Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2007 8th International Conference on Electronic Measurement and Instruments
abstract: In this paper, the conventional EMI noise separators are discussed and the disadvantages of these separators are pointed out. In order to avoid those shortcomings of conventional methods, a new method based on FPGA to separate the conducted EMI noise is proposed. This method no longer needs transformers which cause a lot of problems in separating conducted EMI noise.
